chapters.title: Chapter 4401 Courting Death
paragraphs: The two great elites fought from east to west, from left to right, and the remaining power rolled out, killing anyone it touched.
How were they supposed to pass?
But in truth, there was not a single Golden Generation here. In fact, there was not even a Silver Generation here, nor any ordinary Imperial Son here. What did this mean?
The prodigies had all thought of a way to pass.
Thus, they would definitely be able to pass. It was just that no one had found the key point.

At this time, everyone could not help but sigh ruefully. Because there had been people who had walked the Imperial Path through the various generations of the various great Imperial Clans. Thus, they had practically complete records of the Imperial Pat. If they advanced through referring to these records, what need was there for them to worry? How could it not save them effort?

In the first place, they were naturally talented, strong, and had a strong background. Now that they had grasped so much information, the starting point was practically everyone's finishing line. How could others compare?
Everyone was racking their brains, studying how to grasp the key point.
However, there were only more and more people, yet not a single person passed through.
It was as if this was a dividing line. A true prodigy could pass through with practically no effort, but the others were all mediocre, and could not do anything about it at all.
"I have an idea!" Suddenly, a young man stepped out. He was dressed in a light green tight fitting suit, filled with heroic spirit.
"What idea?" This caused a great many people to feel excited.
It was rare for someone to think of a way to pass through, and he was actually willing to share it with others. This was really a very kind person.
"Come, everyone, come here," the man in the green tight-fitting outfit called out to everyone, gathering everyone in the vicinity.
Actually, Ling Han could already tell that there was something off, but he also wanted to hear what kind of grand idea this person would have, so he followed them over.
All of a sudden, everyone was gathered around the man in green tight-fitting clothes. There was really no way to see him through the crowds.

None of them dared to breathe too loudly, fearing that their words would drown out this person's voice, causing them to miss out on the key words. They were also afraid that they would accidentally say the wrong thing, and anger the other party, and cause him to be unwilling to reveal the "idea".
The man in green pressed his hands down, and said, "Everyone, please sit down first, and cross your legs."
Everyone did as they were told, but it was inevitable that there would be doubts in their hearts. I am only listening to your suggestion; is there any need to do this?
"All right, now everyone calm down," the young man continued.
"Have you felt your heart become ethereal?"
"M-hm, everyone, focus your attention on observing."
One second, three seconds, ten seconds.
Someone rioted, and stood up in anger, "This is the method that you speak of?"

"That's right!" The man in green nodded, his face filled with pride, "As the saying goes, one person is less intelligent, and the more people there are, the greater the intelligence. Now that everyone is sitting together, whatever discoveries you have can be shared. We will definitely be able to resolve this dilemma in front of us!"
"How about it? Is this method good?"
When they heard his words, those who had initially been restraining their tempers could no longer bear it. F***, are you playing around with us?
How could there be such a despicable person?
All of a sudden, everyone stood up, rolling up their sleeves, their eyes shining with viciousness.
Ling Han couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself. How could this guy be so suicidal?
"Hit him!" Someone shouted, and then everyone rushed forwards, beginning to punch and kick him.

There were too many people, and the space was too small, so it was inevitable that there would be accidental injuries in this battle. Instantly, the situation became chaotic. They were no longer targeting the man in green, but rather attacking randomly, causing a chaotic battle.

"Phew, that was really close. Thankfully, I managed to escape quickly. Otherwise,I would be in deep trouble." The man in green had squeezed out of the crowd at some point in time, and appeared beside Ling Han, as he said this, patting his chest.
Ling Han was astonished. This person was quite slippery, being able to escape even after being surrounded by so many people.
"Brother, I see a black light on your face. I'm afraid it's a sign of great misfortune." This green-clad man stared at Ling Han for a while, and began to seek death again.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "Expert, how should I address you?"

The man immediately revealed a proud expression, and gave Ling Han a thumbs up, "Amongst so many people, you have the best eyesight, and know that I am an elite! Cough, cough, my surname is Jing, and my name is Haoran."
"It's fun to tease people, right?" Ling Han asked calmly.

"Brother, your words are wrong. How could I possibly be that kind of person?" Jing Haoran's expression was filled with grievance, "I am a warm-hearted person, and take joy in helping others. When others are happy, I am happy..."
Blah, blah, blah. It was as if he had opened his voice box, and had absolutely no intention of stopping.
Ling Han smiled, and called out loudly, "That guy is here!"
With this shout, he used the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
Instantly, the chaotic battles stopped, and they all turned to look at Jing Haoran.

Jing Haoran couldn't help but grit his teeth. He smiled bitterly at Ling Han, and said, "Brother, there is no animosity between us in the past, and there is no animosity between us in recent days. Why do you have to harm me like this?"
"When a passerby sees injustice, he draws his saber to help. Moreover, helping others is the foundation of happiness..." Ling Han also began to speak non-stop.
Wasn't it just making up nonsense? It wasn't like he didn't know how to do it himself.
Jing Haoran was dumbfounded with shock. He was already skilled in blabbing nonsense, but he had not thought that this guy he had encountered was actually not the slightest bit inferior.
"Fight!"
Everyone roared loudly, and rushed over again, continuing to gang up on Jing Haoran.
This time, Jing Haoran did not stay where he was. Instead, he broke into a run and fled.
One ran, and the others chased. They ran from the east side of the plaza to the west side, and then charged back and forth, making for a very lively scene.
Ling Han saw very clearly that there was no fear on Jing Haoran's face. Instead, there was a smile on his face, and it was clear that he was enjoying himself.
This was a b*tch!
He thought to himself, appraisal complete.
Without wasting any more time, Ling Han focused his attention on the plaza. The two great beings were still fighting, as if they would never stop.
Was this a formation?
Ling Han analyzed. As a grandmaster of formations, he was naturally sensitive in this area.
After a long while, he nodded. This was indeed a formation, but it was impossible for future generations to lay out such a formation.
That was because this was a natural formation.
However, this wasn't the main point. There was no need to decipher this formation, because the main point was the footwork of the clay figure and fiery figure.

In Ling Han's eyes, everyone in the surroundings had disappeared. In fact, even the clay figure and fiery figure had disappeared, leaving behind only the aftermath of their battle that was sweeping over the plaza.
There was a safe path!
Ling Han immediately thought. However, this safe passage was constantly changing, requiring him to step on a special rhythm, and this rhythm was the footwork of the clay figure and the fiery figure.
It was definitely not a simple imitation, but rather one yin and one yang, one positive and one negative, which needed to be coordinated.
After a while, Ling Han stood up, and descended towards the plaza.
"Yi, another person has stepped in."
"Sigh, he's seeking death."
"There will always be people who think that they are very lucky, and in the end? Only when they lose their lives would they know regret."
A great many people were playing the opposite tune, thinking that Ling Han was merely going to his death.
However, Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back, his feet light, yet it was as if he were taking a leisurely stroll. Very easily, he had already crossed half the distance.
Instantly, these people all gaped, feeling their faces flush hotly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4402 Wait
paragraphs: Ling Han stepped on a special beat. Hu, hu, hu! It was clear that the fiery figure and clay figure were fighting right next to him, but the strong winds merely swept past on either side of him, and did not touch him in the slightest.
It was as if a special force had dispersed the force of the wind.
This was the power of formations.
"Damn it!" Wenren Liangping cursed as he arrived before Ling Han. He glared at Ling Han and stomped his foot in anger.

Because he had ingested that special toad, he still had a period of weakness. Previously, he had gone into hiding to survive this period of weakness. Once his condition had recovered to his peak, he would immediately rush over.
Who would have thought that he would still be a step too slow? He could only watch helplessly as Ling Han walked further and further away.
He wasn't stupid. There were so many people here, yet none of them dared to take one step into the plaza. It was clear that this was a minefield, and touching it would be extremely dangerous.
If he had arrived earlier, Ling Han definitely wouldn't have had the time to think about how to pass. It would be equivalent to being trapped here, and it would be very easy for him to kill him.
Damn it, he was just a little bit away.
He hurriedly composed himself, and began to observe and study how he could pass.

On the other side, it was unknown when Jing Haoran had run out of the crowd, but none of those people had reacted yet, and were still fighting a battle royale. It was unknown who had been taken as a scapegoat, and he was wailing in pain.
"Interesting, he passed so quickly?" he muttered. "I can't play anymore, I have to hurry."
Ahead of them, Ling Han soon passed through the plaza. The narrow terrain once again became wide.
He stopped, turned around, and looked unerringly at Wenren Liangping.
Coincidentally, Wenren Liangping also looked at him sharply.
Ling Han smiled faintly, withdrew his gaze, and began to walk forwards.
When he advanced into the Ninth Change, he would come back to kill this guy.
There was no one in the vast plains. Ling Han ran to his heart's content, while using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. His speed was incredibly fast.
Though he did not think that being the first person to pass through the Imperial Path would affect his ascension into Emperor Tier, since he was already here, he naturally had to compete.
Moreover, there were still opportunities here, so it must be that if one was fast, he would have them, but if he was slow, he would not.
His speed was extremely fast, and a pair of fiery red wings sprouted from his back. With a flap of his wings, he had left the journey of several hundred kilometers behind him.
It could not be helped. There were strange Regulations in effect here, which greatly decreased his speed.
However, even if he was slow, others would definitely not be fast either. This was fair.
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly stopped, because a masked person had appeared in front of him.

Masked people were very common. Usually, as long as they did not want others to know their identity, they would cover their faces. However, this masked person had a voluptuous figure. Where she should be round, she would be erect, and where she should be large, she was voluptuous. Ling Han recognized her with a single glance.
Wasn't this the crazy woman who had seen his naked body?
Feng Miaoling also swept her gaze over at the right time, revealing a cold smirk, "As expected, you are behind me!"
She had been chasing madly all this while, but as she chased, she became suspicious.
Was Ling Han really that fast?

She was only slightly slower than Ling Han, but when she had previously obtained the Immortality Leaf, her luck was off the charts. The moment she arrived, a leaf just happened to fall, so it could be said that she had not wasted any time.
But even so, she still did not find Ling Han at the plaza.
It should be known that she had also spent two hours to decipher the mystery of their movements.
No matter how awesome Ling Han was, there was no way he could surpass her by so much without any delay at all.
Thus, it finally dawned on her that Ling Han was most likely behind her.
Thus, she waited here for a very, very long time, but she had guessed correctly, so she waited until Ling Han arrived.
"Crazy woman, you've seen me naked, and I still haven't asked you for compensation yet. Yet, you're still haunting me?" Ling Han shouted.
Feng Miaoling almost threw up blood in her fury. You are really too shameless, aren't you?
"Die!" She couldn't be bothered to waste words, and immediately charged over.
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and hurriedly dodged.
This woman wasn't a weakling like Wenren Liangping. Not only was she at the Sect Master-level, but she was also a Golden Generation!
Too strong!
Boom, a great river surged behind her. The river waters were turbulent, and occasionally, a wave would surge over, its might shocking the heavens.
Ling Han didn't dare to face it head-on at all. He simply used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to dodge. Flames surged, and this could be considered a counterattack.
Since Feng Miaoling was standing guard here, she had naturally made arrangements. She had set up restrictions in the surroundings, locking Ling Han within, restricting Ling Han's range of movement.
Ling Han responded calmly. He still had the Saint Tool in his possession, so it was not impossible for him to break out of this siege.
"Yi, this big brother, I was right, wasn't I!" Jing Haoran's voice suddenly rang out, "I was just saying. Your face is dark, so there must be an ominous sign!"
It was unknown when this guy had suddenly appeared nearby.
Ling Han couldn't help but grimace, feeling like he was about to go crazy.
'Should you be proud of yourself at this moment?'
Why hadn't you been beaten to death just now?
Ling Han ignored him, and Feng Miaoling naturally paid him no heed either. She just targeted Ling Han and attacked him madly.
"Brother, did you peek at this beauty bathing, or did you run naked in front of her?" Jing Haoran asked very suicidally.
When these words reached Feng Miaoling's ears, she naturally exploded in fury.
Weng, a figure walked out of her body. She too had a graceful figure, but her pretty face was completely blurred, and could not be seen clearly at all.
Spiritual body.
This spiritual body immediately charged towards Jing Haoran. With a single strike, the power of Sect Master surged, shaking the heavens and earth.
Ling Han also felt a headache coming on. Just how had this guy managed to live until now?
See, this was called courting death.
Ling Han also felt a headache coming on. Just how had this guy managed to live until now?
Logically speaking, with how toxic his mouth was, and how much he loved to seek death, he should have died a long time ago.
However, after Feng Miaoling split out a spiritual body, her own battle prowess decreased slightly, causing the pressure on Ling Han to decrease slightly.

—In the Spiritual Transformation Tier, every spiritual body would have the same battle prowess as the original, but could not be stacked. Thus, even if they were split apart, it would not affect the battle prowess of the spiritual body. But in the Sect Master Tier, it was different. The battle prowess of the spiritual body and the original could be stacked, and when they fused together, they would be the strongest, and once they separated, this would correspondingly weaken the battle prowess of the original.

However, Feng Miaoling was not just a little bit stronger than Ling Han. Thus, even if she lacked a spiritual body, and her battle prowess was slightly weaker, Ling Han was still under a mountain of pressure.
"Hey, hey, hey. Beautiful lady, there is no animosity between you and me, so why did you hit me?" Jing Haoran shouted loudly, "I didn't peep on you bathing, so why do you have to do this?"
With such a toxic mouth, there was no need to pity his death.
Feng Miaoling was naturally even more furious. The spiritual body's attacks were like a flood.
Don't say, with how much Jing Haoran liked to seek death, his abilities were really not weak. Otherwise, he would have long since died.
His movement technique was extremely agile. Although he was stumbling here and there, and looked extremely disheveled, he still managed to save his life under the battle prowess of a Sect Master.
Feng Miaoling was stunned.
What was going on here?
First, there was Ling Han, and then there was this person with a bad mouth. They were obviously both Spirit Transformation Tier, so how could their abilities be so freakish?

However, after Feng Miaoling split out a spiritual body, her own battle prowess decreased slightly, causing the pressure on Ling Han to decrease slightly.
—In the Spiritual Transformation Tier, every spiritual body would have the same battle prowess as the original, but could not be stacked.
Thus, even if they were split apart, it would not affect the battle prowess of the spiritual body.
But in the Sect Master Tier, it was different.

The battle prowess of the spiritual body and the original could be stacked, and when they fused together, they would be the strongest, and once they separated, this would correspondingly weaken the battle prowess of the original.
However, Feng Miaoling was not just a little bit stronger than Ling Han.
Thus, even if she lacked a spiritual body, and her battle prowess was slightly weaker, Ling Han was still under a mountain of pressure.
"Hey, hey, hey.
Beautiful lady, there is no animosity between you and me, so why did you hit me?" Jing Haoran shouted loudly, "I didn't peep on you bathing, so why do you have to do this?"
With such a toxic mouth, there was no need to pity his death.
Feng Miaoling was naturally even more furious.
The spiritual body's attacks were like a flood.
Don't say, with how much Jing Haoran liked to seek death, his abilities were really not weak.
Otherwise, he would have long since died.
His movement technique was extremely agile.
Although he was stumbling here and there, and looked extremely disheveled, he still managed to save his life under the battle prowess of a Sect Master.
Feng Miaoling was stunned.
What was going on here?
First, there was Ling Han, and then there was this person with a bad mouth.
They were obviously both Spirit Transformation Tier, so how could their abilities be so freakish?

chapters.title: Chapter 4403 Psychedelic Forest
paragraphs: Ling Han was also very surprised. He only knew that Jing Haoran was very good at courting death, but he had not thought that the latter's strength would actually be so impressive as well.
However, no matter how freakish they were, there was no way they could match a Sect Master-level Golden Generation.
Ling Han took out his staff. After a large portion of his spiritual power had been extracted, he suddenly exploded with the might of a Pseudo Sect Master, and blasted towards an empty space.

If this attack had been directed at Feng Miaoling, it would have been too easy for her to deal with it. She only had to wave her hand lightly, and she would have been able to disperse this attack. After all, she was a Sect Master, so how difficult would it be to disperse an attack from a Pseudo Sect Master?
However, the restriction that she had set up was different. How could it possibly have too high a defense?
With a single strike, this restriction was immediately shattered.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and instantly broke through the siege.
He activated his Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and rapidly travelled a far distance.

Feng Miaoling gave chase, but in terms of movement technique, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was definitely the most kickass Imperial Technique. Even if there was a disadvantage of a major tier, she was still unable to catch up, and could only maintain a distance of neither advancing nor retreating.
However, the flat plains soon ended, and a forest appeared ahead of them. Ling Han dived in, and soon disappeared from her field of vision.
Feng Miaoling stopped in her tracks, and roared furiously at the sky, filled with resentment.
Ling Han had actually managed to escape again!
She turned around angrily. Since Ling Han had fled, she would make an example of the other guy who had a cheap mouth and was seeking death.
After Ling Han circled around the forest for a while, he stopped.
In the end, he managed to throw off that crazy woman.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Previously, he had even sworn that he would spank that woman's behind, but now? He was being chased and hunted again.
"How humiliating!"

"I don't know how Jing Haoran is doing, but he's still alive and well even though he's been doing this all this while. He must have ultimate techniques to save his life. Otherwise, he would have died long ago."
"No need to worry about him."
Ling Han shook his head, reorganized himself, and continued onwards.
Actually, there was nothing to be embarrassed about. Wasn't it very normal that a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator would be no match for a Minor Advanced Tiercultivator?
Very quickly, he walked out of the forest area.
"Yi?"
At the end of the forest was a cliff. Wrapped in clouds and mists, he couldn't see the end at all, but there were rainbow bridges on the cliff that led to who knew where.
Counting, there were a total of 99 rainbow bridges.
"In other words, I have to make a choice here?"
Ling Han didn't feel conflicted. He simply chose a rainbow bridge based on his instincts, and then stepped on it.
He had obtained the True Dragon of Fortune, and when faced with choice, it was as if there was a mysterious power taking effect, allowing him to make the most beneficial choice.
The rainbow bridge was very long, and Ling Han was already sprinting at full speed. However, it was as if this bridge could reach the depths of the universe, and he couldn't see its end.
After a whole five days, a cliff finally appeared ahead of him.
He had finally reached the end.
Ling Han stepped onto the cliff, and with a sweep of his gaze, he saw that this cliff was only connected to this rainbow bridge.
As expected, every rainbow bridge should lead to a different place.
Ling Han didn't stop, and he continued to advance.
Crossing this mountain, there was another stretch of forest, but this forest seemed to have been artificially planted. One area by another, they were separated, like multiple squares.
Among them, a large tree was clearly much taller. There were no other trees beside it, and it was so tall that it seemed as if it could pierce into the heavens.
With Ling Han's vision, he could clearly see that there were green fruits growing on this large tree. They weren't big, and looked like the eyes of dragons.
Celestial fruits?

Ling Han's heart throbbed wildly. However, he was not the only one who had chosen this path. In that forest, there were a great many people traversing, as if they were searching for that great tree, but they were like headless flies, completely unable to approach that great tree.
Was this a labyrinth?

Ling Han did not act rashly. He first observed, but from here, the forest was divided in an orderly manner. After entering, one only had to take a few turns, and they would be able to reach the great tree. There was no difficulty at all.
After watching for a while, he shook his head. Looks like he would not be able to see much here. He had to go in and experience it himself.
He took a step, and entered into the forest.
Yi!
He shockingly discovered that his surroundings had immediately changed. They were clearly still large trees, but the situation was completely different from what he had previously seen.
He closed his eyes, not wanting to be confused by what he saw.
However, this was useless. His divine sense swept over, and it was no different from what his eyes could capture.
No wonder there were so many people wandering around here. Even their vision and divine sense had been confused, so the difficulty level was naturally higher.
Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed it on a large tree. Instantly, a rough feeling assaulted him.
In his memories, this great tree should not exist, but he had seen it, and he had even touched it.
Could it be that this was not an illusion?
Ling Han delivered a palm strike, and instantly, the power rebounded, causing his figure to sway, and take a few steps back.
Yi, that was strange.
If this was only an illusion, then as long as he firmed his resolve and walked according to his memories, he would naturally be able to penetrate through the illusion and reach his target.
But if it was so simple, those who had entered earlier should have long since found that great tree, and plucked the celestial fruits.
—Those who had stepped onto the Celestial Path, if they did not even have this little bit of memory, that would really be too trashy.
Thus, it was not as simple as that.
Then how should he find this great tree?
Ling Han strolled around. Since he didn't have a clue at the moment, he decided to take a walk first.
After walking for a while, he had more or less circled around this forest.
After all, this forest was not very big, and Ling Han was very fast, so it naturally wouldn't take too much time to tour around.
Where was the exit?
Ling Han shockingly discovered that he had not discovered the large tree, but similarly, he had not discovered the exit either. In fact, the entrance had disappeared as well.
Interesting.
He revealed a smile. Then let's contend.
He walked around again, and discovered that what he saw, sensed, and touched were all different again.
This was still a forest, but it had become a completely different forest.
Hehe, there were really a lot of changes.

Ling Han walked again, and again, and again. Every time he walked, the forest would undergo corresponding changes. By the seventeenth time, he was already somewhat confident. At this moment, two young people walked towards him.

—There was a relative age limit for entering into this space. Thus, no matter what cultivation level one was at, even if they were 5000 or 8000 years old, they would definitely still belong to the category of young people.
However, these two people in front of him were only in the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and strode forwards.
The two of them naturally saw Ling Han as well, and the two sides soon passed each other.
"We've been cooped up here all these days, so we're bored. Should we mess with him?" one of them asked in a low voice.
"Forget it, the less trouble there is, the better," another person said.
"All right." The first person nodded, "Hehe, consider this brat lucky."
Though these words were spoken softly, Ling Han's hearing was astonishing, so he naturally could hear them clearly. He was displeased, and suddenly stopped.
"Wait!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4404 Conflict
paragraphs: "What is it?" The young man who had suggested the beating also turned around, and looked towards Ling Han. He was dressed in purple robes, his expression filled with pride.
"You guys said you wanted to beat me up?" Ling Han asked smilingly.
In the past few days, he had been hunted down by Feng Miaoling and Wenren Liangping, one after another. Although he had come out of it unscathed, how could he not feel angry?
"Yi, you actually heard it?" The young man in purple was a little surprised. He deliberately lowered his voice, but it didn't matter. So what if he heard it?
"So what?" he asked, a hint of disdain in his expression.
Ling Han spread his hands and said, "Just in time. My mood hasn't been too good these past few days, so I can give you a beating to soothe my emotions."
"Ha, hahaha!" The young man in purple laughed loudly. This was really too hilarious.
"What an ignorant guy!" He withdrew his smile, his tone cold.

The other person, who was dressed in green robes, couldn't help but look impatient, and said, "You should be glad that we don't want to waste time on you. But you insist on asking for your own suffering. Heh, now even I think that you are really asking for a beating."
"Don't waste your breath on him, beat him up!" The young man in purple strode out, bearing down on Ling Han.
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, as if he didn't take the other party seriously at all.
"Where do you get such confidence from?" The young man in purple looked furious. This guy actually dared to look down on him like this.
Beat him, beat him to death!
He suddenly sped up, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
His companion did not help, but rather watched coldly from the sidelines. That was because he believed in his companion's strength. One person was enough to suppress Ling Han.
Pa, a figure flew past at the speed of lightning, and crashed heavily into the large tree behind them.
However, the tree didn't break, and this person fell back heavily, forming the Chinese character for 'big'.
The smile on the green-robed young man's face suddenly disappeared, because the person who had been sent flying was not Ling Han, but rather his companion.
How was this possible?
To say nothing of how Ling Han could possibly win, even if his companion had met someone that was his match, he shouldn't have been insta-killed.
"Come, it's your turn." Ling Han waved at the young man in green.
The young man immediately revealed an awkward smile, and hurriedly waved his hand, "Friend, we would not have known each other without a fight. Just now, we were rash. Please forgive us, brother."
"Aiya!"
He screamed in pain, because Ling Han had already thrown a punch at him, holding him down and giving him a good beating.
After beating him to his heart's content, Ling Han finally stopped, and said with a smile, "I was rash, so please forgive me."
Now, he was finally feeling refreshed.
This was also because he only wanted to vent his anger. Otherwise, with a punch, the other party would be smashed into mush.
The green-robed young man was about to cry. Since you know that you are rash, why didn't you control yourself? Why did you only say it after beating him? Wasn't that deliberately insulting him?
But what could he say?
Hadn't he had enough of being beaten up just now? Did he want to go through it again?
Ling Han waved a hand dismissively, and strode off.
After Ling Han left, the green-robed young man hurriedly went to help his companion up. He shook him hard a few times, waking his companion up.
Fortunately, Ling Han didn't use too much force.
"Ow, ow, ow!" The moment the young man in purple awoke, he immediately cried out in pain, feeling as if every single bone in his body had been broken.
"Come, let's immediately go find Young Master Zhu."
His face was filled with fury. This was too despicable. He actually dared to hit even him. Didn't he know that he had to see who was the Master before he hit his dog?
The green-robed young man nodded as well. He too had been beaten to his heart's content, so how could he be willing to accept this?
However, Ling Han was in a good mood. He walked left and right, and after a long time, when he took a step, that forest was already behind him.
He walked out.

"The exit is easy to find, but that great tree." Ling Han turned his head, and that great tree once again appeared clearly in his field of vision. It was clearly much taller, like a crane standing out from a flock of chickens.
"Let's search again."
Ling Han did not leave. Instead, he entered into the forest again, and continued to search for that great tree.
He walked over and over again, and also captured the changes in the forest over and over again, looking for patterns in it, and found the passageway that led to the large tree in the middle.
This time, it was difficult. After a whole month, Ling Han finally found that pattern amidst the myriad of changes.
He immediately sped up, heading towards his target.

His speed was extremely fast, but he was not heading directly for that great tree. Instead, he was continuously taking a roundabout route, because this was the only path that could lead to the great tree.
More haste, less speed, and if he wanted to reach his target, he could only circle around and walk further away.
Half a day later, he revealed a smile. As long as he passed through the bushes ahead of him, he would be able to reach the large tree.
Celestial fruits, here I come.
Ling Han was slightly expectant. He had only managed to come here after so much difficulty, so the celestial fruits that he would obtain must be incredibly valuable.
Was the Ninth Change already close at hand?
'Hmm?'
He was startled, and footsteps were heard from behind him. There were a total of... three people!
Ling Han suddenly turned around, and right at this moment, three people also crawled out of the bushes.

When they saw Ling Han, the three of them looked surprised. They had not thought that someone would actually beat them to it. But after an instant, two of them immediately showed expressions of mixed joy and fury.
Why?
It was very simple. These two people were the main in green and the man in purple, whon Ling Han had previously thrashed to his heart's content.
However, they were bothfollowing behind a white-robed young man at this moment, their hands hanging by their sides, appearing to be extraordinarily respectful.
"Young Master, it was him!" The purple-robed young man pointed at Ling Han and said, "He was the one who hit us."
The young man in green nodded continuously.
Ling Han was astonished. This world was far too small, wasn't it? He had actually come across these two people again?
Furthermore, it was clear that they had not just randomly walked here. Instead, just like him, they had come for that great tree.
The white-robed young man looked at Ling Han, and revealed an expression of arrogance. He said calmly, "Break your own arms, then get lost!"
"Hurry up and thank Young Master for his kindness!" the purple-robed young man immediately shouted at Ling Han.
"That's right. It's rare for Young Master to be so generous!" the young man in green said.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Breaking your own arms is far too difficult. Why don't you guys perform for me first?"
"Hehe, your mouth is really quite quick." The white-robed young man shook his head, "However, this has also laid a path to death for yourself."
Hearing these words, both the young man in green and the young man in purple looked pleased.
If Young Master was angered, then Ling Han would definitely die.
They were naturally aware of the abilities of their Young Master.
—The Dao Child of the Azure Splendor Holy Land, Luo Huatang, a dignified Sect Master!
Ling Han smiled faintly, but did not speak.
"Hmph, how stubborn." Luo Huatang merely moved his feet, and instantly appeared in front of Ling Han. He stretched out a finger, and pressed it down on Ling Han's forehead.
Golden light filled the skies with this tap of his finger.
Pu, with a tap of his finger, blood sprayed out.
Yet Luo Huatang frowned, and immediately shook his head. His eyes were clear, but there was no trace of blood that he could see.
Illusion.

Ling Han suddenly turned around, and right at this moment, three people also crawled out of the bushes.
When they saw Ling Han, the three of them looked surprised.
They had not thought that someone would actually beat them to it.
But after an instant, two of them immediately showed expressions of mixed joy and fury.
Why?
It was very simple.
These two people were the main in green and the man in purple, whon Ling Han had previously thrashed to his heart's content.
However, they were bothfollowing behind a white-robed young man at this moment, their hands hanging by their sides, appearing to be extraordinarily respectful.
"Young Master, it was him!" The purple-robed young man pointed at Ling Han and said, "He was the one who hit us."
The young man in green nodded continuously.
Ling Han was astonished.
This world was far too small, wasn't it?
He had actually come across these two people again?
Furthermore, it was clear that they had not just randomly walked here.
Instead, just like him, they had come for that great tree.
The white-robed young man looked at Ling Han, and revealed an expression of arrogance.
He said calmly, "Break your own arms, then get lost!"
"Hurry up and thank Young Master for his kindness!" the purple-robed young man immediately shouted at Ling Han.
"That's right.
It's rare for Young Master to be so generous!" the young man in green said.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Breaking your own arms is far too difficult.
Why don't you guys perform for me first?"
"Hehe, your mouth is really quite quick." The white-robed young man shook his head, "However, this has also laid a path to death for yourself."
Hearing these words, both the young man in green and the young man in purple looked pleased.
If Young Master was angered, then Ling Han would definitely die.
They were naturally aware of the abilities of their Young Master.
—The Dao Child of the Azure Splendor Holy Land, Luo Huatang, a dignified Sect Master!
Ling Han smiled faintly, but did not speak.
"Hmph, how stubborn." Luo Huatang merely moved his feet, and instantly appeared in front of Ling Han.
He stretched out a finger, and pressed it down on Ling Han's forehead.
Golden light filled the skies with this tap of his finger.
Pu, with a tap of his finger, blood sprayed out.
Yet Luo Huatang frowned, and immediately shook his head.
His eyes were clear, but there was no trace of blood that he could see.
Illusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 4405 Obtaining the fruit
paragraphs: Ling Han didn't linger in battle. No matter how freakish he was, he was only at the Eighth Change. He was still not qualified to match a Sect Master.
Thus, after he shot out the black light of illusion, his figure immediately retreated, heading towards that great tree.
He would harvest the fruits and leave.
Xiu, he broke through the last thicket, and instantly, a towering tree appeared ahead of him. It was indescribably tall, and as wide as a small mountain.
He was clearly still close to three hundred meters away from that great tree, but the tree trunk blotted out the sun, completely enshrouding him.
Ling Han's eyes swept over the surroundings, and saw a green fruit on the ground.
Fallen from the tree?
It should be.
He leaped out, and with a stretch of his hand, he had already grabbed that fruit.
At this time, Luo Huatang also charged over. When his eyes caught sight of Ling Han, he immediately let out a battle cry and charged towards him.
Ling Han leaped up, and headed towards the large tree.
This tree was extraordinarily large, and there was an extremely large space for movement on it. Furthermore, he could also take advantage of the opening to harvest fruits.
—Picking fruits was the way to go. When he advanced into Sect Master-level, no, as long as he was Ninth Change, he would be able to truly match Luo Huatang, or even defeat him.

Luo Huatang naturally wouldn't let him off the hook. He immediately soared into the sky as well. He definitely couldn't allow Ling Han to escape, and he definitely couldn't allow Ling Han to pluck the celestial fruits.
"Wu!"
"Er!"
The two of them groaned at the same time, and instantly fell down from the skies.
What was going on?
After leaping to a certain height, the pressure became like a heavy hammer that blasted towards Ling Han and Luo Huatang, forcibly smashing them into the ground.
Though their cultivation levels were different, they were both throwing up blood, which was extremely uncomfortable.
The higher one's cultivation level, the greater the power of the attack.
Xiu, xiu! At this moment, the young man in green and the young man in purple also leaped in, and took advantage of the opening to make a move, charging towards Ling Han.
"Even if a tiger has fallen from grace, it is not up to you guys to bully it!" Ling Han smirked coldly, and the barrage of murderous aura shot out.
The two of them immediately rolled their eyes, and directly collapsed onto the ground, dead.
Their minds had been obliterated, so how could they not die?
No matter how many spiritual bodies you had, it was useless. Under such an impact, every spiritual body would be blasted apart, so how could they possibly escape with their lives?
"Damn it!" Luo Huatang said coldly. Though he did not care about the life or death of these two attendants, to kill these two people in front of him, wasn't that a heavy slap to his face?
Thus, his killing intent blazed.
Ling Han circled around the large tree. By now, he already knew that the large tree could not be climbed. If the power blasted him a few more times, his body would definitely explode from the impact.
Similarly, Luo Huatang did not dare to leap too high, so he could only circle around the tree trunk in pursuit of Ling Han.
As Ling Han ran, he continued to check if there were any more fruits that had fallen from the ground. He was really lucky. He saw another fruit, which he took into his pocket.
"Put down the celestial fruits!" Luo Huatang roared furiously from behind.
Since they couldn't climb the tree, they naturally couldn't harvest the fruits on it either. They could only wait for the fruits to fall off by themselves.
In his eyes, the fruits that Ling Han had picked up should all belong to him.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and circled around the large tree, waiting for another fruit to drop.
This trip took three days, but Ling Han was disappointed. Not a single fruit fell.
He raised his head, and saw that there were about a dozen fruits growing between the branches, but they were all greenish white in colour, and the fruits that fell were completely green in colour.
With how long celestial fruits took to ripen, he would probably have to wait several tens of thousands of years, or even longer in fact, before the fruits on the trees ripened and fell.
Forget it then.
Ling Han changed his course and headed out of the forest.

"You won't be able to escape!" Luo Huatang forced out through gritted teeth. His two subordinates had been killed, which was a humiliation to him, and the celestial fruits had also been picked up by Ling Han. He had every reason to capture Ling Han.

Ling Han laughed loudly, "If I wanted to flee, how could you possibly stop me? Furthermore, you should be thankful that I am only fleeing now, and have no intention of killing you. Otherwise, if I wanted to kill you, no one would be able to stop me!"
He let out a battle cry and used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. As the flames danced, he quickly pulled out the distance between himself and Luo Huatang.
What!
Luo Huatang was stunned. He was a Sect Master, but in terms of speed, he was actually left so far behind by Ling Han?
He chased a few more steps, but this forest was heavily twisted. If he fell slightly behind, he would have completely lost Ling Han.
He stopped in his tracks, a twisted expression on his face.
"I will definitely not spare you!" he forced out through gritted teeth.
After Ling Han exited the forest, he directly found a secluded place and began to study the two green fruits.
"I don't recognize these fruits," he said with a shake of his head. "However, I can sense an astonishing amount of energy from within, so it should be extremely nutritious."
"Forget about it. I really need strength now!"
"Eat!"
He picked up a fruit and began to eat.

This was far from being as delicious as the Extreme Fire Earth Spiritual Fruit, but it wasn't too bad either. Ling Han quickly ate one, and after some thought, he didn't eat two in a row, fearing that the medicinal effects would be too terrifying. If it did not nourish him but rather damaged him, wouldn't extreme joy turn into sorrow?
Very soon, the medicinal effects took effect, boiling inside his body, and circulating in every vein.
He channelled the Imperial Scroll and refined the medicinal effects, pushing the Body Art and mystical power to improve at the same time.
In his mind, the eighth spiritual body was rapidly strengthening.
Two days later, the medicinal effects were completely exhausted.
There was still about half the distance to the peak stage of Eighth Change. Ling Han took out the remaining green fruit, washed it with clear water, and began to gnaw on it again.
This time, he was naturally familiar with it. Another two days later, the medicinal effects were exhausted again, and he was still a sliver away from the end of Eighth Change.
"I was just a little bit away."
"Although it's only a sliver, without the help of external power, I have to cultivate for at least another two to three months."
"Sigh, now that my cultivation level is so high, it's extraordinarily difficult to improve even the slightest bit."
Ling Han collected his distracting thoughts and walked forward.
That was the truth. What could he do even if he lamented?

Thus, he still did whatever he needed to do. If he could obtain natural treasures in this period of time, he would be able to break through to Ninth Change. If he couldn't, then he would only have to wait two to three months, at most.
After leaving the forest and walking for a few more days, a large city appeared ahead of him.
Yi, there was actually a city on the Imperial Path?
Ling Han was slightly surprised. There were actually living creatures here, and had even built a city in fact?
Let's go and take a look.
Ling Han strode toward the city gates.
Xiu, right at this moment, a strong gust of wind surged behind him. Someone flashed past his head, and arrived at the city gates first.
Was there any need to rush things like this?
Ling Han thought to himself. This person was dressed in a green Battle Armor, and only his head was revealed. He was handsome and filled with heroic spirit.
"Halt." There were guards at the city gates, and they immediately stretched out a hand to stop him.

"Humph! A measly Foundation Building Tier cultivator dares to block me?" The young man wearing the Battle Armor humphed coldly, appearing extremely proud. He ignored them and continued to charge inside.
He was a Spirit Transformation True Lord!
Unexpectedly, those guards actually moved aggressively, blasting towards the young man in Battle Armor.
This was an uncanny sight. The young man in the Battle Armor was actually sent flying!

chapters.title: Chapter 4406 Strange City
paragraphs: Even if Ling Han was freakish, and it was a common occurrence for him to go against an opponent with a higher cultivation level with himself having a lower cultivation level, for Foundation Building Tier to go up against Spirit Transformation Tier, and still not fall into a disadvantage, even he could only watch in dumbfounded shock.
However, these mere guards in front of him did it.
This... were they supreme prodigies?
Really, if these people advanced a few major tiers and reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier or the Sect Master Tier, then wouldn't they be able to easily suppress even the Great Emperor?
Obviously, this was impossible. Otherwise, history would have long since been rewritten.
The young man in the Battle Armor hadn't expected this either. His face was filled with shock. A measly four Foundation Building Tier cultivators working together was actually able to push him back?
He got to his feet, a hint of hesitation flashing across his face.
His opponents were too strange, and he could not make up his mind whether he should make a move or not.
Thankfully, the four guards had no intention of attacking, and merely stood guard at the doors.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked at the four guards. However, he only saw a cloud of murky light, which was very strange.
Ordinarily, what he would see should be the strength of blood and Qi, life and vitality, and definitely not this kind of murky light.
They... weren't humans?
It was very possible.
Ling Han nodded internally. If these weren't humans, then it could explain why they could defeat a stronger opponent with themselves being weaker. At least, the reason could be found.
"Entering the city requires registration," a guard said. It was as if he were merely making clear that he had absolutely no intention of attacking the young man with the Battle Armor.
Ling Han walked over and registered his name. He could vaguely feel that his soul had also been marked. Then, he was allowed to enter into the city.
Behind him, the young man in Battle Armor also became well-behaved and registered his name.
This city was a little strange, so it was best to cooperate.
The city was very lively. There were stalls by the roadside, and there was an endless stream of passersby. It was a scene of prosperity.
However, when Ling Han used his eye technique to scan them, he discovered that these merchants and commoners in the city were also like those guards previously, displaying lumps of murky light.
However, without activating his eye technique, these people were really no different from ordinary people.
Ling Han went to ask around. What exactly was going on here?
There were many outsiders in the city, and in fact, there was no shortage of Imperial Sons among them.
Had Ling Han finally caught up to the group of people at the forefront?
No.
It was said that the Golden Generation had long since left, and some of the Silver Generation and ordinary Imperial Sons had also left, but why was there still Imperial Sons left behind?
Trapped here?
This would explain the purpose of this city's existence.

In this city, it was easy to enter and easy to leave. There was definitely no one stopping them. Previously, when the guards stopped people and insisted for them to register, it was really just to ensure that they registered.

However, after leaving the city, there would be a dark place ahead of them. The moment they entered there, whether it was vision or perception, they would be severely affected. They would be like headless flies inside.
Unless... a special kind of torch was lit, which would be able to chase away the darkness.
Where had this kind of torch come from?
It could only be obtained in this city. To be more precise, it was the Li Clan, from the City Lord Residence.
How was one supposed to obtain it? Should he buy it?
No, it was through battle.
Challenge the Li Clan, but one had to win with a disadvantage in cultivation level. The more levels one was disadvantaged, the longer the torch one obtained would be able to burn.
What was the use of this?

That was because that land of darkness did not only serve as a blockade. There were also a great many natural treasures inside. Thus, the longer the torch burned, the more various treasures could be found inside.
But the problem was, challenges could be repeated, but there was only one chance to get hold of the torch.
Thus, it was impossible to switch torches every time, roam around in the darkness and then come back out again and switch to another torch and look around again.

Thus, those who were determined to find natural treasures would all be very cautious. They definitely had to obtain their best battle merits, and only then would they redeem torches, thereby maximizing their gains.
The reason why some Imperial Sons had not left was because they were still tempering themselves, and wanted to challenge in their prime condition.
So that was the case.
Ling Han nodded, then showed a hint of excitement.

In the place of darkness, there were natural treasures, and in his present state, he only needed to obtain a Five Star celestial fruit, and he would probably be able to reach peak stage Eighth Change.
At that time, he would be able to push open the doors to the Ninth Change.
He headed to the city lord's residence.
This was very easy to find, and there were no strict guards in the city lord's residence, so anyone could easily enter.
Ling Han entered the city lord's residence in a flash. A guard approached and brought him to the training ground.
There were a great many outsiders here, and they were all seated around the training ground. And inside the training ground, there were presently two young people clashing.
One was an outsider, while the other was a native. One only had to use an eye technique to know that his whole body was covered in a murky light.

This outsider was a Dao Child who had the cultivation level of Spirit Transformation Tier Fourth Change. However, his battle prowess had reached Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change, and he fought intensely against his opponent.
After battling for half a day, the two of them finally ended in a tie.
This Dao Child redeemed a torch and left without stopping.
They didn't stop him, because everyone knew that the torch was connected to each person's soul. Only one's own spiritual power could make a torch burn.
Of course, they could also force him to lead the way.
However, he was a Dao Child, after all, and had powerful strength. There really weren't many people that could defeat him.
"Next," the young man from the city lord's residence said.
At this moment, no one answered.
Since no one was going to fight, he would do it.
Ling Han leaped down and landed in the arena.
The young man from the city lord's residence swept an eye over him, "Spirit Transformation Tier, Eighth Change."

This kind of cultivation level didn't astonish the masses. As long as one was a prodigy, they could basically form nine True Selves at the True Self Tier. Then, they would naturally be able to easily reach the Ninth Change.
Thus, Eighth Change and Ninth Change could only mean that one's cultivation level was high, but it had absolutely nothing to do with whether one was a prodigy or not.
Boom!
The young man immediately charged out, launching an attack at Ling Han.
He was also using the power of Eighth Change. One after another, spiritual bodies leaped out of his body, using his full strength.
Meanwhile, Ling Han casually parried. He was very interested in the natives here. What kind of existence were they?
Thus, he patiently exchanged blows with this young man.
"Sigh, this is too weak, isn't it?"
"Even someone with the same cultivation level is struggling so much. Hehe, he actually still has the face to come out."
"How laughable."
Everyone shook their heads, thinking that Ling Han's strength was really too weak. How could he have the nerve to make a move?
After battling for a long time, Ling Han was finally tired of watching. He threw a punch, defeating his opponent.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change," the young man said as he pointed at Ling Han.
Yi?
Ling Han shockingly discovered that one of his spiritual bodies had been sealed, and he couldn't unleash the slightest bit of power.
His cultivation level had been suppressed to Seventh Change.
Interesting.
This opponent was clearly not as strong as him, yet could easily suppress his cultivation level.
It was definitely not human.
Ling Han thought internally. An ordinary living being would definitely not be able to suppress his cultivation level so easily. At least, only a Venerate Tier would be able to do so.

In the place of darkness, there were natural treasures, and in his present state, he only needed to obtain a Five Star celestial fruit, and he would probably be able to reach peak stage Eighth Change.
At that time, he would be able to push open the doors to the Ninth Change.
He headed to the city lord's residence.
This was very easy to find, and there were no strict guards in the city lord's residence, so anyone could easily enter.
Ling Han entered the city lord's residence in a flash.
A guard approached and brought him to the training ground.
There were a great many outsiders here, and they were all seated around the training ground.
And inside the training ground, there were presently two young people clashing.
One was an outsider, while the other was a native.
One only had to use an eye technique to know that his whole body was covered in a murky light.
This outsider was a Dao Child who had the cultivation level of Spirit Transformation Tier Fourth Change.
However, his battle prowess had reached Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change, and he fought intensely against his opponent.
After battling for half a day, the two of them finally ended in a tie.
This Dao Child redeemed a torch and left without stopping.
They didn't stop him, because everyone knew that the torch was connected to each person's soul.
Only one's own spiritual power could make a torch burn.
Of course, they could also force him to lead the way.
However, he was a Dao Child, after all, and had powerful strength.
There really weren't many people that could defeat him.
"Next," the young man from the city lord's residence said.
At this moment, no one answered.
Since no one was going to fight, he would do it.
Ling Han leaped down and landed in the arena.
The young man from the city lord's residence swept an eye over him, "Spirit Transformation Tier, Eighth Change."
This kind of cultivation level didn't astonish the masses.
As long as one was a prodigy, they could basically form nine True Selves at the True Self Tier.
Then, they would naturally be able to easily reach the Ninth Change.
Thus, Eighth Change and Ninth Change could only mean that one's cultivation level was high, but it had absolutely nothing to do with whether one was a prodigy or not.
Boom!
The young man immediately charged out, launching an attack at Ling Han.
He was also using the power of Eighth Change.
One after another, spiritual bodies leaped out of his body, using his full strength.
Meanwhile, Ling Han casually parried.
He was very interested in the natives here.
What kind of existence were they?
Thus, he patiently exchanged blows with this young man.
"Sigh, this is too weak, isn't it?"
"Even someone with the same cultivation level is struggling so much.
Hehe, he actually still has the face to come out."
"How laughable."
Everyone shook their heads, thinking that Ling Han's strength was really too weak.
How could he have the nerve to make a move?
After battling for a long time, Ling Han was finally tired of watching.
He threw a punch, defeating his opponent.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change," the young man said as he pointed at Ling Han.
Yi?
Ling Han shockingly discovered that one of his spiritual bodies had been sealed, and he couldn't unleash the slightest bit of power.
His cultivation level had been suppressed to Seventh Change.
Interesting.
This opponent was clearly not as strong as him, yet could easily suppress his cultivation level.
It was definitely not human.
Ling Han thought internally.
An ordinary living being would definitely not be able to suppress his cultivation level so easily.
At least, only a Venerate Tier would be able to do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 4407 Skill surpassing one’s cultivation level
paragraphs: They battled again.

Everyone shockingly discovered that though Ling Han's cultivation level had been weakened, his strength had not decreased in the slightest. His battle prowess had actually maintained the same level as before.
This!
How was this possible?
His cultivation level had clearly been weakened by a minor level, yet his battle prowess hadn't decreased at all. This was simply unfathomable.
After battling for a while, Ling Han defeated his opponent again.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change." The young man from the city lord's residence pointed at Ling Han again, weakening Ling Han's cultivation level further.
Everyone was once again shocked, because Ling Han still managed to withstand it. In fact, he seemed to have gotten the upper hand even faster this time.
They were practically about to go crazy. Was this guy a monster?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han was incredibly domineering. Within ten moves, he easily defeated his opponent.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change." The young man pointed again, and Ling Han's cultivation level was further weakened.
"Spirit Transformation Tier, Fourth Change."
"Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change."
Everyone's mouths were wide open, and they could no longer close them.
Heavens, they must have seen a monster.

It was clear that Ling Han's cultivation level had already been suppressed to Spirit Transformation Tier First Change. However, he was still able to exchange blows with an opponent at Spirit Transformation Tier Eighth Change. In fact, he even had the upper hand. Just what kind of freak was this?
In just a few moves, Ling Han defeated his opponent again.
"Heavens, there are a whopping seven minor levels of cultivation level!"
"This is about the standard of Imperial Son."
"Powerful, he is really too strong."
"A wolf in sheep's clothing."
Everyone shook their heads, feeling that they had been deceived too terribly by Ling Han.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change," the person from the city lord's residence pointed at himself. His cultivation level suddenly increased by a notch.
First Change against Ninth Change.
However, this still couldn't change the course of the battle. Ling Han forcefully suppressed his opponent, and it wasn't long before he defeated his opponent again.
Everyone was already rendered completely speechless. Ninth Change against First Change, and Ling Han actually managed to win so easily. Just how freakish was this guy's strength?
"Silver Generation's standard, right?"
"Or even Golden Generation!"
Everyone was stunned. Could it be that this was an Imperial Son, and a Golden Generation at that?

This was possible, because the Imperial Clan was high and noble, especially the Golden Generation. How many people would have seen them under ordinary circumstances? It was very normal that they did not recognize them.

"True Self Tier!" The young man pointed at Ling Han. This time, he directly pushed Ling Han's cultivation level into True Self Tier. However, he also lowered his own cultivation level, cutting down to Spirit Transformation Tier First Change.
They battled again.
Peng!
It was only a single punch, and Ling Han had defeated him.
This... everyone felt their scalps go numb.

Previously, whether it was the Seventh Change fighting Eighth Change, or the First Change fighting the Ninth Change, no matter how great Ling Han's advantage was, it was still a battle at the same cultivation level, after all. They were both in the Spirit Transformation Tier.
However, this time was completely different.

A True Self Tier cultivator against a Spiritual Transformation Tier, and even if it was only the weakest Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator, there was still a gap of a major tier between their cultivation levels. That kind of gap was completely crushing.
And what about Ling Han?
He had defeated his opponent with a single punch!
Could the Golden Generation achieve this? Impossible, they had never heard that the Golden Generation could be so freakish.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change," the young man from the city lord's residence continued to raise his cultivation level.
They battled again.
This time, Ling Han finally didn't defeat his opponent in an instant. Instead, he spent some effort, but it was still very easy.

A smile appeared on Ling Han's face. If he had still been at the True SelfTier Ten Forms, he definitely wouldn't have been able to defeat a Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change so easily. However, his soul had also reached perfection by now, so his battle prowess naturally rose to another level.
"Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change."
This time, Ling Han still won. However, the number of exchanges between the two of them reached 300 moves, and it seemed to be slightly straining.
"Spirit Transformation Tier, Fourth Change!"
Even if Ling Han was freakish, he had really reached his limit this time. After several hundred moves, the two sides were still tied. You can't defeat me, and I can't suppress you either.
When the battle reached the five hundredth move, the young man from the city lord's residence took the initiative to stop.
"After five hundred moves, you'll pass."
"Do you still want to test out a higher difficulty level?"
The young man asked.

Ling Han shook his head. He really didn't need to try again this time. He had reached his limit. If he fought against Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change, he would probably be defeated within 300 moves. He couldn't possibly last 500 moves.
—Unless he used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, or the Saint Tool staff.
This obviously wasn't a good idea. If he used a Spirit Tool that surpassed his cultivation level, then Ling Han's strength would definitely increase as well.
Enough, this result was probably enough to crush all other competitors.
Ling Han took the torch and left in satisfaction.
And in the surroundings, everyone was looking at him as if they had seen a monster.
After leaving the city lord's residence, Ling Han immediately left. He wanted to go to the place of darkness to find natural treasures.
"Stop right there!" A loud shout rang out, and Luo Huatang suddenly charged over.
This pesky guy.
Ling Han did not linger in battle, and directly broke into a run and fled.
"Don't even think of running." Luo Huatang gave chase.
One fled, while the other pursued. Very soon, they had exited the city, and at this time, another person had joined the group of pursuers.
Wenren Liangping.
He had also discovered Ling Han's presence, so he immediately set off in pursuit.

The two Sect Masters looked at each other, and saw the killing intent towards Ling Han in each other's eyes. Thus, they instantly formed a tacit understanding, and did not make a move on each other, thinking that the other was Ling Han's helper.
However, they also felt a sense of admiration. Ling Han was really capable of causing trouble. He had actually provoked another Sect Master elite.
Not long after, an absolute darkness appeared ahead of them.
The place of darkness.
"We can't let him escape in!"
"En!"
Luo Huatang and Wenren Liangping immediately reached a consensus. Once Ling Han fled in, it would be a pipe dream for them to find him again.
And every once in a while, Ling Han's strength would become slightly stronger, which was equivalent to having a saber placed on both their necks, filling them with a sense of urgency.
They definitely had to kill Ling Han as soon as possible.
They all used their respective techniques to stop Ling Han from charging into the darkness.
However, in front of the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight's absolute speed, what use would their techniques be?
The only thing they could do was watch helplessly as Ling Han rushed into the darkness.

The two of them came to an abrupt halt. Without torches, it was extremely normal to be trapped in darkness for eight to ten years. Those who were lucky had only managed to retreat by luck, and it was not impossible that they would be trapped inside forever.
"Damn it!" The two of them stomped their feet, a powerful anxiety rising up in their hearts.
"Come, let's go back to redeem torches."
"Even if I have to give up the opportunity, I have to find and kill this boy."
The two of them reached a consensus, and immediately turned around to redeem torches.

And in the land of darkness, Ling Han had already lit a torch with his Spiritual Power. As it burned fiercely, the darkness was instantly chased away by the flames. Within a radius of 1km, it was bright.
It should be known that Ling Han hadn't even been able to see half an inch away previously, and his divine sense had also detected complete darkness.
This was truly a mysterious place.
Ling Han raised the torch high, and began to search everywhere, searching for natural treasures.

chapters.title: Chapter 4408 Ninth Change
paragraphs: A piece of cold falling metal.
A broken six-star Spirit Tool.
A meteor shard.
Ling Han soon had some gains, but he had yet to encounter Celestial medicines that could increase his cultivation level.

Thankfully, the torch he redeemed was definitely "extremely large". Even if his opponent's strength surpassed his by a major tier, or even surpassed his cultivation level by two major tiers, in terms of tier surpassing battle prowess, who could compare to him?
His Spiritual Power could clearly sense that this torch could burn for about three more hours.

If he passed through the land of darkness, he would need about ten minutes. Thus, Ling Han only needed to reserve ten minutes. Then, no matter where he went by then, he would still be able to successfully walk out.
He searched, searched, searched, searched, but the heavens seemed to be joking with him. He just could not find any Celestial medicine that could increase his cultivation level.
"I've collected a pile of scrap metal, but where's the Celestial medicine?"
Ling Han sighed in emotion. Of course, if these "trash" were taken outside, they would definitely be fought over by others. There was no lack of good stuff among them.

Five-star or six-star tool refinement materials, supplementary ingredients for alchemy, and so on. There was also a broken talisman. Ling Han had studied it before. After it was activated, it could blast out the might of a Sect Master. It could even reach the level of five-star talisman.
"But, what I want is the Celestial medicine!"
"Yi?"
He was startled, and saw that there was a carrot-shaped plant growing ahead of him.
Could ordinary carrots possibly grow here?
Ling Han couldn't help but feel overjoyed. He had finally found the Celestial medicine.
He hurriedly ran over, and carefully dug out this Celestial medicine, but was immediately disappointed.

It was true that this was Celestial medicine, but it was not used to increase one's cultivation level. Instead, it was used to strengthen one's vitality. If it was ingested by another, it would definitely be no problem for them to live another two to three hundred years.
This was a lifespan of two to three hundred years. This definitely could be considered a Great Herb, but for Ling Han, it was extremely useless.
"Let's see if I can trade it for other Great Herbs and medicines in the future."
"To those Venerate Tier elites, the significance of lifespan is greater than anything else. I should be able to trade it for something good."
Ling Han put away the Celestial medicine, suppressed his disappointment, and continued his search.
He picked up a lot of "rubbish" again, and time was also passing. There was only about half an hour left of the three-hour deadline.
"F***, there are treasures everywhere, but there's nothing that can increase cultivation level?" Ling Han gritted his teeth. He was really too unlucky, wasn't he?
Twenty-five minutes, twenty minutes, fifteen minutes.
Ling Han sighed, and planned to leave the land of darkness. If he continued to stay here, it was possible that he would be trapped here forever, and that would be a great loss for him.
"It's fine. It will only take me another two or three months."
He consoled himself, and searched for another five minutes, then left.
As he walked, he suddenly saw a plant that was no more than three feet tall. A small treetop was spread open, and there were three fruits growing on it. They were divided into gold, silver, and red.
Celestial fruits!
Ling Han was delighted, and hurriedly turned around. He plucked the fruit, and without even having the time to examine it, immediately left.
Time was limited.
With two minutes left on the torch, Ling Han rushed out of the land of darkness.
He actually appeared at the edge of the beach, surrounded by trees with fat leaves. The sun shone brightly, and the temperature was pleasant.
Looking back, he was enveloped in darkness, blotting out the sky and covering the sun.
He walked forward and jumped onto a large tree. Then, he checked his gains.
These were celestial fruits that could increase one's cultivation!
A smile spread across Ling Han's face. Finally, the heavens had regained their benevolence and weren't toying with him.
He picked up the red fruit, threw it into his mouth, and began to eat.
The fruit was very small, about the size of a longan, so it could not be gnawed on at all. With a bite, the juice dispersed, and the sweet fragrance filled his mouth. It was very delicious.
But after a while, a heat took effect in Ling Han's body.
'Here it comes.'

Ling Han channelled the Imperial Scroll and pushed his cultivation level up. In his mind, the eighth spiritual body that was still a sliver away from reaching consummate level soon completed the final step.
It was perfect and flawless.
He could now attempt to break through to the Ninth Change.
In a single breath, Ling Han began to break through to Ninth Change.

From First Change to Ninth Change, there was actually no qualitative change. It was just that one after another, True Self after True Self would be molded into a spiritual body. Thus, there was indeed some increase in difficulty, mainly because the spiritual bodies repelled each other. However, the overall difficulty level was only so-so.
Ling Han soon entered into an optimal state, pushing his cultivation level towards a higher cultivation level.
A day later, he sensed a divine sense sweep over him.
It was Luo Huatang.
However, Ling Han was currently wearing the Void Beast hide, so this divine sense swept over him, not stopping on him.
A while later, another divine sense swept over.
Wenren Liangping.
However, his divine sense also swept past, and did not stop for a moment.
The two of them didn't give up so easily. Instead, they scanned back and forth a few more times before finally giving up and not appearing again.
Ling Han merely smirked internally. After he broke through, it would be his turn to seek out these two people for an accounting.
Another day later, the ninth spiritual body took form.
Ninth Change!
Ling Han stood up, and with a light wave of his hands, instantly, waves of power surged out like a tide.
A qualitative change. This time, it was an absolute qualitative change.
After reaching Ninth Change, he finally possessed power that could match Sect Master-level.
"Sect Master Tier is divided into nine minor levels of cultivation level, one to nine stars respectively, just like Venerate Tier and Saint Tier."
"My current battle prowess should be equivalent to a One Star Sect Master."
"It's time to shock some people."
Ling Han strode forwards, heading towards the coast.
Weng, he released his divine sense, which was like the great seas and rivers, turbulent and boundless, without any concealment.
The reason why he was so open and aboveboard was because he hoped that the two of them would sense his presence, and then follow his tracks.
Xiu, xiu, two figures suddenly flew over, their speed extremely fast.
Luo Huatang and Wenren Liangping.
The two of them looked coldly at Ling Han, revealing baleful killing intent.
'Finally caught you.'
Ling Han smiled faintly, "It's been a long time."
"What is it? Not going to hide anymore?" Luo Huatang asked coldly. In these few days, not only had his fury not subsided, it had instead become even more intense.
Ling Han spread out his hands, "When did I hide?"
"Since you're prepared to die, tell me your name, lest you become a fool." Luo Huatang didn't argue with Ling Han about hiding or not; this was meaningless.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, "Since you're asking, then I'm a man of my word. I'm Wenren Liangping!"
Wenren Liangping's expression instantly darkened. 'F*ck! Just how shameless are you to impersonate me?'
"Fine, Wenren Liangping, I'll send you on your way!" Luo Huatang said with a sneer. He charged over.
Ling Han couldn't help but feel amused. At first, he was only teasing him. He didn't expect that Luo Huatang actually didn't know Wenren Liangping's name.
True, they were only cooperating on the matter of killing Ling Han, but in essence, they were competitors on the Imperial Path. Did they need to announce their names and socialize?
On the other side, Wenren Liangping wore a dark expression.
