Finally, the heavens had regained their benevolence and weren't toying with him.
He picked up the red fruit, threw it into his mouth, and began to eat.
The fruit was very small, about the size of a longan, so it could not be gnawed on at all.
With a bite, the juice dispersed, and the sweet fragrance filled his mouth.
It was very delicious.
But after a while, a heat took effect in Ling Han's body.
'Here it comes.'
Ling Han channelled the Imperial Scroll and pushed his cultivation level up.
In his mind, the eighth spiritual body that was still a sliver away from reaching consummate level soon completed the final step.
It was perfect and flawless.
He could now attempt to break through to the Ninth Change.
In a single breath, Ling Han began to break through to Ninth Change.
From First Change to Ninth Change, there was actually no qualitative change.
It was just that one after another, True Self after True Self would be molded into a spiritual body.
Thus, there was indeed some increase in difficulty, mainly because the spiritual bodies repelled each other.
However, the overall difficulty level was only so-so.
Ling Han soon entered into an optimal state, pushing his cultivation level towards a higher cultivation level.
A day later, he sensed a divine sense sweep over him.
It was Luo Huatang.
However, Ling Han was currently wearing the Void Beast hide, so this divine sense swept over him, not stopping on him.
A while later, another divine sense swept over.
Wenren Liangping.
However, his divine sense also swept past, and did not stop for a moment.
The two of them didn't give up so easily.
Instead, they scanned back and forth a few more times before finally giving up and not appearing again.
Ling Han merely smirked internally.
After he broke through, it would be his turn to seek out these two people for an accounting.
Another day later, the ninth spiritual body took form.
Ninth Change!
Ling Han stood up, and with a light wave of his hands, instantly, waves of power surged out like a tide.
A qualitative change.
This time, it was an absolute qualitative change.
After reaching Ninth Change, he finally possessed power that could match Sect Master-level.
"Sect Master Tier is divided into nine minor levels of cultivation level, one to nine stars respectively, just like Venerate Tier and Saint Tier."
"My current battle prowess should be equivalent to a One Star Sect Master."
"It's time to shock some people."
Ling Han strode forwards, heading towards the coast.
Weng, he released his divine sense, which was like the great seas and rivers, turbulent and boundless, without any concealment.
The reason why he was so open and aboveboard was because he hoped that the two of them would sense his presence, and then follow his tracks.
Xiu, xiu, two figures suddenly flew over, their speed extremely fast.
Luo Huatang and Wenren Liangping.
The two of them looked coldly at Ling Han, revealing baleful killing intent.
'Finally caught you.'
Ling Han smiled faintly, "It's been a long time."
"What is it?
Not going to hide anymore?" Luo Huatang asked coldly.
In these few days, not only had his fury not subsided, it had instead become even more intense.
Ling Han spread out his hands, "When did I hide?"
"Since you're prepared to die, tell me your name, lest you become a fool." Luo Huatang didn't argue with Ling Han about hiding or not; this was meaningless.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, "Since you're asking, then I'm a man of my word.
I'm Wenren Liangping!"
Wenren Liangping's expression instantly darkened. 'F*ck!
Just how shameless are you to impersonate me?'
"Fine, Wenren Liangping, I'll send you on your way!" Luo Huatang said with a sneer.
He charged over.
Ling Han couldn't help but feel amused.
At first, he was only teasing him.
He didn't expect that Luo Huatang actually didn't know Wenren Liangping's name.
True, they were only cooperating on the matter of killing Ling Han, but in essence, they were competitors on the Imperial Path.
Did they need to announce their names and socialize?
On the other side, Wenren Liangping wore a dark expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 4409 Misunderstanding
paragraphs: Luo Huatang charged over, and Sect Master-level power surged. He used his full strength from the beginning, wanting to crush Ling Han into dust.

If Ling Han was only an ordinary Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator, he would naturally be able to unleash his spiritual body. In any case, each spiritual body was enough to kill the strongest Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator. However, Ling Han was too freakish, so freakish that even Luo Huatang didn't dare to use his spiritual body which would weaken the original's battle prowess.
Thus, he charged over alone. As his hands intertwined, multiple divine chains of order appeared, stabbing, slashing, or entangling towards Ling Han.
There was a faint smile on Ling Han's face, and he casually shifted his feet. He dodged all of them before the divine chains of order had reached him. By the looks of it, it was really an easy feat.

"Wenren Liangping, since you dare to provoke me, why are you dodging? Could it be that you're still not prepared to die?" Luo Huatang said coldly. This was naturally provoking him, hoping that Ling Han could face him head-on.

This caused Wenren Liangping's expression to darken even further. He couldn't help but grumble in his mind. 'Now that we're face-to-face, do you have to address by name directly? What's wrong with you?!'
He couldn't hold it in any longer, and said, "I'm Wenren Liangping!"
Yi?
Luo Huatang was shocked. He was Wenren Liangping, so who was Ling Han?
From the tone of his words, it seemed like there was some kind of indescribable and complicated relationship between the two of them.
He couldn't help but connect the dots. Why did Ling Han suddenly dare to come out?
—You have not advanced into the level of Sect Master!
Hence, something was very off.
At first, he had thought that Ling Han had nowhere to hide, so he could only come out for a battle. Instead of dying in such a cowardly manner, it would be better to have a vigorous battle.
But now, his heart was filled with doubts.
Could it be that this was a trap that Ling Han and Wenren Liangping had laid out for him together?
Actually, was he the target of the ambush?
With this in mind, he naturally didn't dare to make another move. He hurriedly looked at Wenren Liangping with a vigilant gaze. This was a true enemy.
Wenren Liangping felt like he was about to go crazy upon seeing this.
F***, you are really sick in the head!
Face-to-face, you still have to call someone by their name. Now? He had only explained that he was Wenren Liangping, and in the end, he had been misunderstood by the latter.
He didn't explain. Firstly, he was disdainful. What kind of mess was this? Secondly, action was better than words.
Boom! He unleashed his full power as he charged at Ling Han.
Luo Huatang didn't immediately attack. He was afraid that Wenren Liangping was deliberately putting on an act, waiting for him to attack so he could launch a sneak attack on him.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Wenren Liangping unleashed his full power with every move, but Ling Han had already advanced into Ninth Change, and his abilities had undergone a qualitative change. His strength had officially advanced into the level of Sect Master, so what did he have to fear?
Ling Han pointed at Luo Huatang, and said, "Hehe, Brother Liangping, there's no need to continue the act. Let's work together to kill him!"
He had not thought that he had only been spouting nonsense, and would actually cause such great suspicion to rise up in Luo Huatang.
However, since the misunderstanding between the two of them had already arisen, he did not mind making use of it. He would just treat it as some fun.
As expected!
Luo Huatang's expression was grim, and he revealed a cold smirk. This was a trap to tempt him.
He knew it. Why had Ling Han suddenly appeared? This was too illogical.
"Don't fall for his trick!" Wenren Liangping said in a solemn voice. "If we don't get rid of him, you and I will both be in big trouble! Hurry up and join forces with me!"
"Haha, if I make a move now, then there would be big trouble." Luo Huatang sneered, "Act, continue the act!"
You see, Ling Han's expression was too relaxed. What part of him looked like he was having a mortal duel?
So, your acting skills are really too poor, and you still want to trick me?
Humph, did he really take me for an idiot?
"Brother Liangping, it's better not to fight anymore. He's not stupid, and won't fall for it at all!" Ling Han said with a smile.
How could Wenren Liangping pay any heed to him? With a loud shout, his attacks became even fiercer.
However, what was the point?
Ling Han's strength was already no weaker than his. He merely defended and didn't attack, so he was naturally at ease.
Peng, peng, peng! Wenren Liangping's attacks were like the tide as he launched wave after wave of attacks at Ling Han. However, each wave was easily blocked by Ling Han.

Even more "understanding" dawned on Luo Huatang. It wasn't like he didn't know Ling Han's strength. If Wenren Liangping really attacked with his full strength, Ling Han would probably be battered and exhausted. He would definitely be able to escape in just a few dozen moves.
But now?
Ling Han was extremely relaxed. They still wanted to trick him like this?
Naive, he was really too naive!
"All right. Since Brother Liangping has decided to put on a full act, I will cooperate!" Ling Han released a battle cry, and began his counterattack.
Boom, a terrifying power surged. He stretched out a hand, and a streak of Regulations had already been extracted. It turned into a divine spear, and shot rapidly towards Wenren Liangping.
This was a special technique that he had obtained from the Extreme Flame Earth Spiritual Fruit. The speed at which he extracted the Regulations of heaven and earth was astonishingly fast.
Xiu, the divine spear pierced through the air, shooting towards Wenren Liangping.
Wenren Clan sent out a palm strike towards the divine spear.
Peng!

Power and Regulations exploded, forming a terrifying shockwave. Meanwhile, Wenren Liangping also stumbled back in retreat. There was blood dripping from his palm. It was like amber, and was extremely condensed.
His strength was indeed not inferior to Ling Han, but the gap between the celestial techniques cultivated was too wide. Thus, in a head-on clash, he suffered a slight loss.

This was just like how two people had equal power, but one used a treasured sword forged from tempered iron, while the other used a rusty broken saber. In a head-on confrontation, who would be at a disadvantage?
Of course, because their abilities were equal, Ling Han also stumbled back.
Looking at it this way, the two sides had come to a tie, and Wenren Liangping had suffered a slight loss.
When Luo Huatang saw this, the disdain at the corners of his lips became even more pronounced.
When had Ling Han become so strong that he could stand against a Sect Master? It should be known that this guy's cultivation level had not changed, and he was still a Spirit Transformation Tier.
Thus, it must be Wenren Liangping who had deliberately given way.
Hehe, he was really quite good at acting. He actually deliberately injured his own hand, and bled a little.
He simply crossed his arms over his chest. 'Let's see how long you guys can continue this act.'

Furthermore, though it was an act, they had really used a lot of strength. He was also happy to see the two of them fight to the point of exhaustion. At that time, he would be able to easily pick up the pieces.
Worse come to worst, even if the two of them weren't acting, so what?
He wasn't familiar with Wenren Liangping, and he didn't even know his name.
What he wanted was only one result, and that was Ling Han's death!

Ling Han counterattacked aggressively, using Regulations casually. They turned into various weapons in his hands, slashing, slicing, hacking, stabbing at Wenren Liangping. He was familiarizing himself with this technique, and could use it in other celestial techniques in the future.
In fact, he could even use this as a foundation to create a new celestial technique.
Wenren Liangping's expression became more and more solemn.
This opponent... was actually capable of matching him!
Heavens, was this really a Spirit Transformation Tier?
However, the aura he sensed was truly so. It was definitely Spirit Transformation Tier. He himself had just passed this stage, so he was naturally extremely familiar with it.
A monster, he was truly a monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 4410 Just go along with it
paragraphs: "Are you an idiot?" Wenren Liangping couldn't help but shout at Luo Huatang. "This guy's strength has increased again. He's already at the level of Sect Master!"
Haha, hahahaha!
Luo Huatang sneered. Wasn't this the biggest joke in the world?
A Spirit Transformation Tier possessed battle prowess on the level of Sect Master?
To say nothing of the Imperial Son, even the Golden Generation couldn't do it.
So, this guy was a monster that surpassed the Golden Generation?
Are you treating me like an idiot?
Luo Huatang ignored him completely. This must be a deliberate act from Wenren Liangping. His purpose was to make him take the field.
At that time, Ling Han might possess a deadly weapon that could deliver a fatal blow to him.
Right now, he was completely on the upper hand.

—If the two of them fought to the point that both sides were heavily injured, he would be able to easily pick up the pieces. If the two of them stopped fighting and joined forces to attack him, he would also be able to turn around and flee.
'Come, continue your performance.'

Fight, fight, fight. Ling Han and Wenren Liangping battled fiercely, but even if Ling Han possessed battle prowess on the level of Sect Master, he was still unable to overwhelm Wenren Liangping. Furthermore, he still had to rely on the barrage of murderous aura, the black light of illusion, and other means to maintain a tie.

Sigh, no wonder one could be called a great elite from the level of Sect Master onwards. Indeed, from the level of Spirit Transformation Tier to the level of Sect Master, the gap in this step was too wide. The further one went, the stronger one's abilities would soar, completely crushing Spirit Transformation Tier.
Fortunately, in a one-on-one battle, Ling Han wasn't at a disadvantage.

Meanwhile, Wenren Liangping was filled with anxiety. He had been unable to defeat Ling Han for a long time, and Luo Huatang was also eyeing him covetously from the sidelines. It was unknown what he was thinking, and this caused him to feel a sense of worry.
He gave a loud shout, and drew his Spirit Tool. The sword shone brilliantly, and was incredibly sharp.
"Competing in Spirit Tools?" Ling Han chuckled. Wasn't this just asking for a beating?
He drew out his staff and similarly delivered an attack.
His Spiritual Power had been weakened slightly, and this attack had also officially advanced into the might of a Sect Master. The blue arc of light had a dangerous beauty to it.
Peng!
The sword light clashed with the arc of light, and both were annihilated.
Ling Han couldn't help but shake his head. This was still limited by his cultivation level. Otherwise, how could the attack delivered by a Saint Tool be so weak?
Of course, he also had a talisman that could unleash the might of a Five Star Sect Master. However, he didn't want to waste it on Wenren Liangping.
He could use his own strength to deal with this opponent. Moreover, it would be more fun to kill him with his own hands.
Meanwhile, Luo Huatang inhaled sharply, secretly exclaiming his luck.
Sure enough, Ling Han was truly hiding a deadly weapon.
If he was suddenly attacked by Ling Han and Wenren Liangping, both of whom were wielding Spirit Tools, he would be severely wounded even if he didn't die.
Fortunately, he was smart enough.
Kill, kill, kill. Ling Han and Wenren Liangping's battle became more and more intense. Every move was extremely fierce, and they began to put their lives on the line.
It wasn't long before both of them were wounded and riddled with wounds.
Hesitation flashed through Wenren Liangping's eyes. Although he wanted to kill Ling Han to avenge his brother, he definitely didn't want to sacrifice his life.
But if this continued, it was really possible that he and Ling Han would die together.
Moreover, Luo Huatang was watching from the sidelines. Who knew what he would do at that time?
Thus, he had a lot of worries.
With this in mind, his attacks became less resolute.
Ling Han was also injured, but it was on purpose.

He could neutralize attacks within six Heavens of power. Although he hadn't advanced to the level of Sect Master, which meant that he couldn't unleash this ability to its full potential, coupled with his powerful physique, Wenren Liangping's attack on him was far less terrifying than he had imagined.
Thus, he deliberately feigned injury, and took the initiative to lower his battle prowess so that he could numb his opponent.
Otherwise, if Wenren Liangping ran separately from Luo Huatang, he would only be able to pursue one of them.
He had no wish to drag this grievance on for too long.
The more they fought, the lower their battle prowess became.
Luo Huatang saw this, and did not make a move all this while. He merely smirked coldly.
All of a sudden, Wenren Liangping revealed a weakness.
Ling Han naturally wouldn't miss this opportunity. He aggressively barged in, seizing this opening to attack.
"You've fallen for it!" Wenren Liangping said with a cold chuckle. His battle prowess had suddenly increased by a significant amount.

His power was indeed beginning to decline, but the extent was far from being as exaggerated as it appeared. He was deliberately laying a trap for Ling Han, so that the latter would misjudge, and he would take advantage of the opening to explode, and severely injure Ling Han.
Sure enough, Ling Han had bitten the bait.
Boom! He unleashed a Saint Technique. This was a powerful attack that he had meticulously prepared.
Peng!
His attack arrived, yet it was blocked by an iron fist.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "What did I fall for?"
His power was endless. If it was not for the sake of convincing these two people, what need was there for him to cooperate and weaken his battle prowess slightly?
Wenren Liangping's mouth was half-gaping, yet he couldn't speak.
F***, he was laying a trap for Ling Han. He had not thought that Ling Han was also laying a trap for him.
How did he do it?
You are only a Spirit Transformation Tier!
Even if your battle prowess could reach the level of Sect Master, could you compare to a true Sect Master in terms of endurance?
But that was indeed the truth, which gave him a great "surprise".

Wenren Liangping had the intention to retreat. Luo Huatang was still unwilling to make a move, and it was even possible that he had killing intent towards him, causing him to worry about the future. How could he go all out in this gamble?
Moreover, even if he went all out, it was still a question of who would be the final victor.
With this in mind, he immediately turned around to leave.

He would let Luo Huatang go and fight Ling Han to the death, and he would take advantage of the opening to recover his strength, and reap the benefits of the conflict. In turn, he would take the initiative.
However, how could Ling Han allow him to flee?
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed, and Ling Han immediately caught up to Wenren Liangping. Flames burned fiercely, transforming into a heaven-burning fury.

This placed a huge pressure on Wenren Liangping. He was only the Dao Child of a Holy Land, and hadn't mastered the Imperial Technique, so faced with this True Phoenix's strongest technique, he naturally appeared to be at a disadvantage.
He couldn't escape, so what could he do?
He gritted his teeth. Then the only option was to fight to the death!

Wenren Liangping charged back with all his might, locked in a fierce battle with Ling Han. At the same time, he shouted at Luo Huatang, "If you still don't make a move, to say nothing of killing this brat, it's possible that you yourself will be consigned to eternal damnation!"
Luo Huatang was unperturbed. How could it be that he couldn't tell? Whether it was Ling Han or Wenren Liangping, both of them were close to exhaustion.
This was the most beneficial conclusion for him. Regardless of whether Ling Han was in cahoots with Wenren Liangping or not, he could still successfully pick up the pieces.
Seeing that Luo Huatang was unmoved, Wenren Liangping could only swallow his anger. After all, this was his own choice.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, and Wenren Liangping's disadvantage was becoming more and more obvious.
Ling Han finally used Destructive Energy. This destructive power was too terrifying. It wrapped around his fists, and defense was completely useless in front of such a punch.
"Urgh!" Wenren Liangping groaned in pain. Ling Han's fist had easily penetrated his defenses and severely wounded him.
He realized that the situation was not good, and charged towards Luo Huatang without any regard for anything else.
No matter what, he had to drag the other party down with him. Otherwise, he would definitely die today.
"Finally showing your fox's tail?" Luo Huatang sneered. He did not make a move, and merely retreated rapidly.
Wenren Liangping cursed.

The further one went, the stronger one's abilities would soar, completely crushing Spirit Transformation Tier.
Fortunately, in a one-on-one battle, Ling Han wasn't at a disadvantage.
Meanwhile, Wenren Liangping was filled with anxiety.
He had been unable to defeat Ling Han for a long time, and Luo Huatang was also eyeing him covetously from the sidelines.
It was unknown what he was thinking, and this caused him to feel a sense of worry.
He gave a loud shout, and drew his Spirit Tool.
The sword shone brilliantly, and was incredibly sharp.
"Competing in Spirit Tools?" Ling Han chuckled.
Wasn't this just asking for a beating?
He drew out his staff and similarly delivered an attack.
His Spiritual Power had been weakened slightly, and this attack had also officially advanced into the might of a Sect Master.
The blue arc of light had a dangerous beauty to it.
Peng!
The sword light clashed with the arc of light, and both were annihilated.
Ling Han couldn't help but shake his head.
This was still limited by his cultivation level.
Otherwise, how could the attack delivered by a Saint Tool be so weak?
Of course, he also had a talisman that could unleash the might of a Five Star Sect Master.
However, he didn't want to waste it on Wenren Liangping.
He could use his own strength to deal with this opponent.
Moreover, it would be more fun to kill him with his own hands.
Meanwhile, Luo Huatang inhaled sharply, secretly exclaiming his luck.
Sure enough, Ling Han was truly hiding a deadly weapon.
If he was suddenly attacked by Ling Han and Wenren Liangping, both of whom were wielding Spirit Tools, he would be severely wounded even if he didn't die.
Fortunately, he was smart enough.
Kill, kill, kill.
Ling Han and Wenren Liangping's battle became more and more intense.
Every move was extremely fierce, and they began to put their lives on the line.
It wasn't long before both of them were wounded and riddled with wounds.
Hesitation flashed through Wenren Liangping's eyes.
Although he wanted to kill Ling Han to avenge his brother, he definitely didn't want to sacrifice his life.
But if this continued, it was really possible that he and Ling Han would die together.
Moreover, Luo Huatang was watching from the sidelines.
Who knew what he would do at that time?
Thus, he had a lot of worries.
With this in mind, his attacks became less resolute.
Ling Han was also injured, but it was on purpose.
He could neutralize attacks within six Heavens of power.

Although he hadn't advanced to the level of Sect Master, which meant that he couldn't unleash this ability to its full potential, coupled with his powerful physique, Wenren Liangping's attack on him was far less terrifying than he had imagined.
Thus, he deliberately feigned injury, and took the initiative to lower his battle prowess so that he could numb his opponent.
Otherwise, if Wenren Liangping ran separately from Luo Huatang, he would only be able to pursue one of them.
He had no wish to drag this grievance on for too long.
The more they fought, the lower their battle prowess became.
Luo Huatang saw this, and did not make a move all this while.
He merely smirked coldly.
All of a sudden, Wenren Liangping revealed a weakness.
Ling Han naturally wouldn't miss this opportunity.
He aggressively barged in, seizing this opening to attack.
"You've fallen for it!" Wenren Liangping said with a cold chuckle.
His battle prowess had suddenly increased by a significant amount.
His power was indeed beginning to decline, but the extent was far from being as exaggerated as it appeared.
He was deliberately laying a trap for Ling Han, so that the latter would misjudge, and he would take advantage of the opening to explode, and severely injure Ling Han.
Sure enough, Ling Han had bitten the bait.
Boom!
He unleashed a Saint Technique.
This was a powerful attack that he had meticulously prepared.
Peng!
His attack arrived, yet it was blocked by an iron fist.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "What did I fall for?"
His power was endless.
If it was not for the sake of convincing these two people, what need was there for him to cooperate and weaken his battle prowess slightly?
Wenren Liangping's mouth was half-gaping, yet he couldn't speak.
F***, he was laying a trap for Ling Han.
He had not thought that Ling Han was also laying a trap for him.
How did he do it?
You are only a Spirit Transformation Tier!
Even if your battle prowess could reach the level of Sect Master, could you compare to a true Sect Master in terms of endurance?
But that was indeed the truth, which gave him a great "surprise".
Wenren Liangping had the intention to retreat.
Luo Huatang was still unwilling to make a move, and it was even possible that he had killing intent towards him, causing him to worry about the future.
How could he go all out in this gamble?
Moreover, even if he went all out, it was still a question of who would be the final victor.
With this in mind, he immediately turned around to leave.
He would let Luo Huatang go and fight Ling Han to the death, and he would take advantage of the opening to recover his strength, and reap the benefits of the conflict.
In turn, he would take the initiative.
However, how could Ling Han allow him to flee?
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed, and Ling Han immediately caught up to Wenren Liangping.
Flames burned fiercely, transforming into a heaven-burning fury.
This placed a huge pressure on Wenren Liangping.
He was only the Dao Child of a Holy Land, and hadn't mastered the Imperial Technique, so faced with this True Phoenix's strongest technique, he naturally appeared to be at a disadvantage.
He couldn't escape, so what could he do?
He gritted his teeth.
Then the only option was to fight to the death!
Wenren Liangping charged back with all his might, locked in a fierce battle with Ling Han.
At the same time, he shouted at Luo Huatang, "If you still don't make a move, to say nothing of killing this brat, it's possible that you yourself will be consigned to eternal damnation!"
Luo Huatang was unperturbed.
How could it be that he couldn't tell?
Whether it was Ling Han or Wenren Liangping, both of them were close to exhaustion.
This was the most beneficial conclusion for him.
Regardless of whether Ling Han was in cahoots with Wenren Liangping or not, he could still successfully pick up the pieces.
Seeing that Luo Huatang was unmoved, Wenren Liangping could only swallow his anger.
After all, this was his own choice.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, and Wenren Liangping's disadvantage was becoming more and more obvious.
Ling Han finally used Destructive Energy.
This destructive power was too terrifying.
It wrapped around his fists, and defense was completely useless in front of such a punch.
"Urgh!" Wenren Liangping groaned in pain.
Ling Han's fist had easily penetrated his defenses and severely wounded him.
He realized that the situation was not good, and charged towards Luo Huatang without any regard for anything else.
No matter what, he had to drag the other party down with him.
Otherwise, he would definitely die today.
"Finally showing your fox's tail?" Luo Huatang sneered.
He did not make a move, and merely retreated rapidly.
Wenren Liangping cursed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4411 Killed All
paragraphs: Wenren Liangping was already at the end of his rope, yet Luo Huatang was still unwilling to help him. How many more strikes could he withstand?
Ling Han used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and quickly caught up to Wenren Liangping. He launched a barrage of punches.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Three consecutive punches landed heavily on Wenren Liangping's back. Destructive Energy rushed into Wenren Liangping's body, dealing a fatal blow to him.
Pu! Wenren Liangping spat out a mouthful of blood as he fell to the ground.
Die.

Even until death, his eyes were still wide open as he stared at Luo Huatang's handsome face. It was as if he was still making a denunciation against Luo Huatang. How could he possibly be acting to the extent of losing his life?

Luo Huatang, on the other hand, didn't take it to heart at all. He wasn't friends with Wenren Liangping. In fact, he had only just found out Wenren Liangping's name. How could he feel the slightest bit of guilt?
"Hehe, then I'll just say sorry," he said calmly to Wenren Liangping's corpse. "But don't worry. I'll soon send your murderer to hell with you."
Ling Han shook his head, "Speaking of daydreaming, you are really an expert."

"Haha!" Luo Huatang laughed loudly. "You are indeed very strong. A Spirit Transformation Tier being capable of killing a Sect Master, throughout history, you may be the only one. However, your strength is only slightly stronger than that guy, so you must have paid an extremely great price just to kill him."
"Let me guess, how much battle prowess do you have left?"
His expression was filled with pride, and he said with a smile, "Don't pretend to be calm in front of me. I know that you're just pretending to be strong on the outside but weak on the inside."
Yi, what else could he say?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and crooked a finger, "Come, you can experience it."
"Haha, the more you act like this, the more it proves how weak you are in reality!" Luo Huatang let out a battle cry and charged towards Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them fought fiercely, and Luo Huatang quickly frowned.
Why was Ling Han's battle prowess still so strong?
Was this a short-lived flash before death?
However, after another 100 exchanges, Ling Han was still brimming with energy. His power was unlimited, and it was as if he were an endless river or the sea, where there was no sign of an end.
Luo Huatang couldn't help but feel shocked. This guy, it couldn't be that he really had unlimited power, right?
What kind of monster was this?
He inhaled sharply, and a strong sense of regret rose up in his heart.
If he had known, he would have teamed up with Wenren Liangping.

"Feeling regret?" Ling Han said with a smile. "At first, I was just joking. I didn't expect you to fall for it so easily. This proves that you're a vile character, and that's why you're using the most sinister way to guess the intentions of others."
"The treacherous one is you!" Luo Huatang shouted, as he unleashed Sect Master-level battle prowess.

There was no way he could escape. Just now, Wenren Liangping had already used his life to prove this fact. Furthermore, he had pursued Ling Han several times without successfully catching up to him, which already proved how fast Ling Han was.
He could only fight to the death.
After all, he was presently in his prime condition, while Ling Han had already battled a Sect Master to the death. Even if he still had spare energy, how long could he last?
Thus, as long as he gritted his teeth and endured, he would definitely be able to last until Ling Han could no longer hold on.
With this in mind, he instead increased the intensity of his attacks. He wanted to force Ling Han to go all out, so that he could exhaust his power as soon as possible.
Thoughts were beautiful, reality was cruel.
Ling Han's power didn't decrease. Instead, it was Luo Huatang who was the first to collapse.

After battling fiercely for two consecutive days, even if he had been in prime condition, he would not have been able to hold on any longer. However, to his despair, Ling Han was still very stable, and there was no sign that his power was declining at all.
'Holy f*ck!'
He could finally taste the despair that Wenren Liangping had experienced before. Death was right in front of him, yet no one could help him. He could only hold on helplessly.
"No!" he roared in fury.
Pa, a spiritual body inside his body shattered, but in comparison, his power suddenly increased by a notch, and he returned to his prime condition.
—He had self-destructed a spiritual body, turning it into incredibly pure power.
However, this was like drinking poison to quench one's thirst.
However, for the sake of survival, he couldn't care less.
Only by staying alive would there be hope.
Fight, fight, fight.
A day later, the effects brought about by the spiritual body's self-explosion disappeared, and Luo Huatang's power declined drastically again.
He gritted his teeth, and exploded another spiritual body.
To him, this was a destructive blow. Every spiritual body was a part of his power, and with one less, this portion of battle prowess would be forcefully decreased.
But what could he do?
Ling Han smiled faintly. Without two spiritual bodies, his battle prowess had dropped drastically, so how could he possibly be a match for him?
Boom!
Ling Han increased the power of his attacks, causing Luo Huatang to become more and more powerless.
He didn't have the chance to kill a third spiritual body, and he was forcefully killed by Ling Han.

At Dao Child-level, he didn't have a Substitution Seal, so he was naturally completely dead. To say the least, even if he had a Substitution Seal, under the Destructive Energy, his only fate would be death.
Ling Han looked at Luo Huatang's corpse with a cold expression, without the slightest bit of mercy.
This was seeking death, so there naturally wouldn't be any waves caused in his heart.
After searching the two corpses, Ling Han found a few Spatial Spirit Tools, but there was nothing precious inside.
"Poor people!" Ling Han shook his head.
He was in no rush to advance. Instead, he took out the remaining two fruits, gold and silver, and consumed them one by one, refining them.
This took him two days, and the ninth spiritual body solidified a little more, but he was still more than half a step away from reaching the consummate level.
There was no hurry.

From the Seventh Change to the Ninth Change, he had been walking too fast on this path, so he still had to control it. He couldn't just focus on increasing his cultivation level and neglect the basics.
He continued forward, and it wasn't long before an expanse of sea appeared before him.
Thus, after a few days of delay, there were naturally more people coming from behind, and they had all cut trees down to construct rafts.
Couldn't one directly fly over?
Ling Han gave it a try. He had just flown to the surface of the sea, when he suddenly felt a massive power sucking towards him. With a plop, he fell into the sea.
"Hahaha!" Quite a few people in the vicinity all laughed loudly, but even more people only swept an eye over before withdrawing their gazes.
They had come here to contend for a great opportunity, not to watch the excitement.
"Brat, stop dreaming," a brawny man called out to Ling Han after seeing him appear above the water.
Ling Han hadn't swam out of the water. Instead, he had walked out from the seabed step by step.
Because there was also a powerful pressure in this seawater, he couldn't float at all. Furthermore, even with his physique, he could still feel his skin swelling, as if it was about to break open.
And this was only the coast. If he was in the deep sea, and directly sank to the bottom, how many times more terrifying would the pressure be?
Perhaps even a Venerate Tier elite would be crushed into a pancake.
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and his wounds quickly healed.
"Just obediently go and cut some wood," the brawny man continued.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I want to try again."
Try again?
Hehe, what else do you want to try?
Quite a number of people instantly looked disdainful. 'Oh, you think you're the only one who can? Can you cross the great ocean?'
Didn't you see that everyone was building rafts, yet you just had to show off? Wasn't that mocking everyone's incompetence?
"You are really arrogant!" A blue-robed young man said, a cold smile on his face, looking like he had long since seen through him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4412 Ugly People Do Many Acts
paragraphs: This time, Ling Han was truly baffled.
'F*ck! Who did I offend by crossing the sea? How can I attract animosity?"
Ling Han chuckled upon hearing this. He looked at the young man in blue robes, and said calmly, "So what? Can you control what I want to do?"
"Haha, I don't have the time to care about you! It's just that you're too arrogant, and I can't bear to see it." The young man in blue humphed.
Am I very arrogant?
Ling Han smiled and said, "Then you haven't seen when I'm truly arrogant!" Just think, when he had been in Genesis World, he had challenged the Heavenly Venerates. He had made an enemy of Hysteria, a
world-destroying monster. That was what arrogance and domineering was. Now, he was already very reserved, all right?
Ling Han shook his head, and couldn't be bothered to deal with this kind of minor character.
The young man in the blue garment was still shouting, but Ling Han ignored him, causing those around him to shake their heads.
As it turned out, he was a coward.
In the cultivation world, the thing that people looked down on the most was cowards.

You can be defeated, but you don't even have the courage to fight? Hehe. One had to realize that Ling Han and the young man in blue were both at the Spiritual Transformation Tier. Moreover, neither of them had reported their specific cultivation level. Thus, either of them could have possibly won. However, Ling Han didn't have the courage to battle against him, so how could they not feel disdain?
The people around them whispered among themselves, their eyes filled with disdain as they looked at Ling Han.
He still wanted to cross the sea?
'You?'
Yet Ling Han did not take the looks of others to heart. When one had reached a height like he had, what need was there for him to be concerned about this kind of misunderstanding?
He made another attempt, and crossed the sea alone.
Plop! He still fell into the sea.
However, this time, a faint smile appeared on Ling Han's face. He had a sliver of an idea.
He made a third attempt, but it still ended with him falling into the sea.
In everyone's eyes, this result was not the slightest bit unexpected. If Ling Han could really cross with his own power, that would be an inconceivable thing.
"This is truly rendering me speechless."
"You clearly know that you can't do it, yet you still insist on showing off. You're just making a fool of yourself."
"It can't even be considered a joke. It's just an ugly person doing strange things. I can't even be bothered to take another look at him."

The people around them all shook their heads, and couldn't be bothered to pay any more attention to Ling Han. In their eyes, Ling Han was just a coward and a clown that didn't know how embarrassing he was.
Thus, they didn't notice that though Ling Han was still failing time and time again, the time he stayed in the air was getting longer and longer.
"That's right!" Ling Han revealed a smile. After dozens of failures, he finally made a discovery.
He released his divine sense, which vibrated at a certain frequency.
Instantly, the whole world changed.
Multiple threads appeared in the sky above the sea, as thin as silk.
It was Regulations.
"Haha, everyone, I'll take my leave first." The blue-robed young man who had previously shouted at Ling Han had already gathered enough tree trunks to build a wooden raft.
This was extremely difficult, because there were only so many trees on the coast. With so many people cutting down trees, there was not much left, and could only be obtained through battle.
Thus, this proved the strength of the blue-robed young man.
Instantly, a few female cultivators ran over, all of them smiling seductively, begging the young man in blue robes to bring them along.

The blue-robed young man looked around. This greatly satisfied his vanity. Thus, with a wave of his hand, he had the four female cultivators all board the wooden raft. Meanwhile, he sent out a palm strike, and the wooden raft immediately flew up. Then, it fell into the sea, riding the winds and waves, rapidly leaving into the distance.
From start to finish, he didn't even cast a second look at Ling Han.
Was there any need to be concerned?
Ling Han was naturally even less concerned. With another leap, he stood
firmly on the surface of the sea, standing in midair.
That was because his foot was stepping on a thread of Regulations.
"Motherf*cker!"
"Heavens!"
Someone saw it, and immediately exclaimed in shock, which also alerted the people beside him. They followed his gaze, and similarly exclaimed in
shock.
Thus, one after another, the news spread. The whole beach was filled with exclamations of shock. They all widened their eyes, looking at Ling Han in
disbelief.
What had they seen?
This was a miracle!
Most of the people here were Spirit Transformation Tiers. In fact, there
were even Sect Masters. However, which of them dared to fly over?
It was not that they did not want to, but rather that they could not.
But now, they saw a miracle. Someone was stepping on the sea, his robes fluttering, like a celestial being.
Those who had previously laughed at Ling Han wanted nothing more than
to dig a hole to bury themselves in.
Was he a clown?
No, they were the real clowns here.
In the distance, the young man in blue also heard everyone's exclamations
of shock. He was even more pleased with himself, but at the same time, he
was also a little puzzled. That was because there were too many people that were making rafts to cross the sea. Was there any need to be so
surprised by him?
"Heavens!" A female cultivator on the raft turned around, and her eyes instantly widened. Her face was filled with shock.
"My goodness!" The other three women were not any better, their mouths
gaping widely.

The young man in blue hurriedly twisted his neck to look back, and similarly, showed an expression of disbelief. In fact, he even forgot that he had twisted his neck so quickly, that his neck was hurting.
In the distance, Ling Han was walking on air, rapidly approaching him.
'Holy f*ck! I've seen a ghost!"

Ling Han's speed was very fast. In just a few steps, he had already caught up to him. Then, without a second look, he directly passed by and left. There was no boasting, but leaving in such a high-profile manner was even more humiliating than boasting ten thousand times.
The blue-robed young man really felt an urge to jump into the sea. Previously, he had mocked him in every way possible, but what was the
result?
Ling Han strode over on the sea. That aura... in comparison, he was
nothing.
He could sense gazes of others sweeping over him from the shore, bringing
with it half mockery and half sympathy.
What a tragedy!
Ling Han didn't take the blue-robed young man to heart. His level had long
since surpassed this level.

He strode forwards, and did not use the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, because every step he took had to be taken on the silk of Regulations. If he used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, the flames of Regulations drawn would conflict with it, and he would no longer be able to step in midair.
This wasn't slow either, and it was countless times faster than the wooden
raft.
It wasn't long before he caught up to the wooden raft in front of him. When he surpassed it, he could clearly see the expressions of the three people on the raft as if they had seen a ghost.
He greeted them, and it was as normal as if he was asking his neighbors if
they had eaten. Then, he strode off, leaving the three people on the wooden raft dumbfounded.
After another while, he caught up to another wooden raft.
This time, he didn't greet them and directly surpassed them. However, the
two people on the wooden raft were still so shocked that they almost fell
into the sea.
Just like that, Ling Han surpassed others all the way. Who knew how many
eyeballs had popped out in shock. Three days later, a horizon appeared in
the distance.
He had initially thought that he had crossed the great ocean, yet immediately discovered that something was off.
This was not a mainland, but rather an island. It was just that it was too big,
and that was why he had the misconception that he had crossed the great
ocean.
After walking for a while, he took a step and landed on the island.
It was so hot!
Ling Han almost stomped his feet. The ground here was extraordinarily
hot, as if supreme true flames were burning beneath the ground, causing
the entire island to become hot and scorching.
He channeled the Starlight Screen to block the heat. Then, he surveyed the
surroundings.

sentences.text: This time, Ling Han was truly baffled.
'F*ck!
Who did I offend by crossing the sea?
How can I attract animosity?"
Ling Han chuckled upon hearing this.
He looked at the young man in blue robes, and said calmly, "So what?
Can you control what I want to do?"
"Haha, I don't have the time to care about you!
It's just that you're too arrogant, and I can't bear to see it." The young man in blue humphed.
Am I very arrogant?
Ling Han smiled and said, "Then you haven't seen when I'm truly arrogant!" Just think, when he had been in Genesis World, he had challenged the Heavenly Venerates.
He had made an enemy of Hysteria, a
world-destroying monster.
That was what arrogance and domineering was.
Now, he was already very reserved, all right?
Ling Han shook his head, and couldn't be bothered to deal with this kind of minor character.
The young man in the blue garment was still shouting, but Ling Han ignored him, causing those around him to shake their heads.
As it turned out, he was a coward.
In the cultivation world, the thing that people looked down on the most was cowards.
You can be defeated, but you don't even have the courage to fight?
Hehe.
One had to realize that Ling Han and the young man in blue were both at the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Moreover, neither of them had reported their specific cultivation level.
Thus, either of them could have possibly won.
However, Ling Han didn't have the courage to battle against him, so how could they not feel disdain?
The people around them whispered among themselves, their eyes filled with disdain as they looked at Ling Han.
He still wanted to cross the sea?
'You?'
Yet Ling Han did not take the looks of others to heart.
When one had reached a height like he had, what need was there for him to be concerned about this kind of misunderstanding?
He made another attempt, and crossed the sea alone.
Plop!
He still fell into the sea.
However, this time, a faint smile appeared on Ling Han's face.
He had a sliver of an idea.
He made a third attempt, but it still ended with him falling into the sea.
In everyone's eyes, this result was not the slightest bit unexpected.
If Ling Han could really cross with his own power, that would be an inconceivable thing.
"This is truly rendering me speechless."
"You clearly know that you can't do it, yet you still insist on showing off.
You're just making a fool of yourself."
"It can't even be considered a joke.
It's just an ugly person doing strange things.
I can't even be bothered to take another look at him."
The people around them all shook their heads, and couldn't be bothered to pay any more attention to Ling Han.
In their eyes, Ling Han was just a coward and a clown that didn't know how embarrassing he was.
Thus, they didn't notice that though Ling Han was still failing time and time again, the time he stayed in the air was getting longer and longer.
"That's right!" Ling Han revealed a smile.
After dozens of failures, he finally made a discovery.
He released his divine sense, which vibrated at a certain frequency.
Instantly, the whole world changed.
Multiple threads appeared in the sky above the sea, as thin as silk.
It was Regulations.
"Haha, everyone, I'll take my leave first." The blue-robed young man who had previously shouted at Ling Han had already gathered enough tree trunks to build a wooden raft.
This was extremely difficult, because there were only so many trees on the coast.
With so many people cutting down trees, there was not much left, and could only be obtained through battle.
Thus, this proved the strength of the blue-robed young man.
Instantly, a few female cultivators ran over, all of them smiling seductively, begging the young man in blue robes to bring them along.
The blue-robed young man looked around.
This greatly satisfied his vanity.
Thus, with a wave of his hand, he had the four female cultivators all board the wooden raft.
Meanwhile, he sent out a palm strike, and the wooden raft immediately flew up.
Then, it fell into the sea, riding the winds and waves, rapidly leaving into the distance.
From start to finish, he didn't even cast a second look at Ling Han.
Was there any need to be concerned?

firmly on the surface of the sea, standing in midair.
That was because his foot was stepping on a thread of Regulations.
"Motherf*cker!"
"Heavens!"

They followed his gaze, and similarly exclaimed in
shock.

disbelief.

This was a miracle!
Most of the people here were Spirit Transformation Tiers.
In fact, there
were even Sect Masters.
However, which of them dared to fly over?
It was not that they did not want to, but rather that they could not.

Those who had previously laughed at Ling Han wanted nothing more than
to dig a hole to bury themselves in.
Was he a clown?
No, they were the real clowns here.

of shock.

was also a little puzzled.

surprised by him?

gaping widely.

chapters.title: Chapter 4413 Vicious Person
paragraphs: The strange thing was that even if the heat waves here were so high that even the soles of his feet were about to burn, there was actually still a large number of plants growing here. There were trees and grass, and they were all extremely exuberant.
Why hadn't they been burned to death?
Ling Han casually snapped off a blade of grass, and instantly saw a crimson red liquid emerge from the stem. Upon a closer look, this was actually lava!
F***, what kind of grass was this.
He cut down another large tree. This was amazing. Crimson red lava gushed out, as tall as three hundred meters, and then poured down.
Ling Han dodged the lava rain with a flash.
This was very terrifying, causing him to instinctively feel danger. It was best not to touch it.
As he surveyed the surroundings, he could see that they were all plants of varying heights. If a battle was started here, it would definitely be lively.

—These plants were all extremely fragile, and could very easily be broken. Furthermore, their heat tolerance was frighteningly strong. There was lava surging in their roots, and once they were broken, lava would spray out.
It could be imagined that if two cultivators were to battle here, the result would definitely not be either side winning, but both sides would be burnt to ash by the lava.
Ling Han started to advance.
An island had appeared here, so it shouldn't just be for people to land, right?
Danger had always been accompanied by great fortune. Thus, it was extremely possible that there was some kind of treasure here.
He walked slowly, and as he walked, xiu, he saw someone fly through the air, landing in front of Ling Han.

This was a supreme Sect Master elite, but he looked very young. He looked to be only twenty-four years old. He was dressed in snow-white robes, without a single speck of dust, appearing elegant and otherworldly.
However, the reason why he could fly was not because he too had grasped the threads of Regulations like Ling Han had, but rather because there was no pressure on this island.
This Sect Master glanced at Ling Han, and when he discovered that he was only a Spirit Transformation Tier, he immediately withdrew his gaze, a hint of disdain flashing in his eyes.
A mere Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator was naturally not worthy of his notice.
His eyes swept over the surroundings, as if he was searching for something.
All of a sudden, his eyes lit up, and his gaze locked onto a spot in the bushes.
Ling Han followed his gaze, and saw that he could vaguely see something as red as fire in the bushes, as if it was crystal.
This was what the Sect Master was looking for?
A look of delight appeared on the white-robed young man's face, and he walked towards that patch of grass.
However, before he could stretch out his hand, he saw a fiery shadow scuttle out of the bushes, pouncing towards him.
This was... a giant cat.

This cat was completely fiery red in colour, and did not have a single strand of mixed fur. As its fur fluttered, it seemed to be burning. Its speed was extraordinarily fast. It opened its mouth, revealing sharp teeth.
The white-robed young man frowned, yet turned and ran without hesitation, appearing to be very resolute.
The fire cat gave a low growl, and chased after him relentlessly.
The white-robed young man swept past Ling Han. He thought for a moment, then stretched out his right hand, and actually delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
This was a subconscious action on his part.

The wild beasts here were extremely hard to deal with. Once he was targeted by them, they would chase and hunt him down for ten days to half a month. He had experienced it before, and it had wasted a lot of his time.

Hence, he made a move to attack Ling Han, so that Ling Han would crash into the fire cat. In this way, it was equivalent to actively provoking the fire cat. Then, it would naturally incite the angered cat to make a move on Ling Han.

Though a mere Spirit Transformation Tier couldn't possibly block a few moves from the Sect Master-level fire cat, he only needed a little bit of time, and would be able to easily shake off this large cat.
As for whether Ling Han had died an unjust death? Hehe, did he need to take that into consideration?
Of course, it was himself that was most important.
Ling Han faltered at this. He hadn't imagined that he would be attacked.
But he only had to think for a moment, and he understood the other's intentions. He was using him as a shield.
There was no animosity between them, so wasn't this a little too ruthless?
In this kind of instant reaction, it was the best way to see through a person's heart. There was no time for consideration at all, and one could only make an instinctive choice.
Thus, this person... was extremely evil!
Killing intent rose up in Ling Han's heart. However, the fire cat had already pounced over.
Should he fight or not?
Ling Han pondered for a moment before throwing a punch at the fire cat.
He was very interested in the thing in the bushes. It was something that even a Sect Master elite wanted to obtain. Perhaps it was related to the great opportunities on this island.
Ling Han barreled towards the fire cat like this, so the fire cat naturally treated him as an enemy. It also swiped out a claw, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Peng!
The fist and claw collided head-on, instantly creating a terrifying wave, completely crushing the trees and plants in the surroundings.
This time, it was lively. Lava fell like rain, spraying all over the sky.
In the distance, the white-robed young man paused slightly, a puzzled expression flashing across his face.
How could a Sect Master-level vicious beast kill a Spirit Transformation Tier with such great commotion? Shouldn't it have insta-killed him?
Forget it, what did it have to do with him?
Guo Yuhang smiled faintly, increased his speed, and strode off.
What a pity for that fire crystal, he thought.
Boom!
Ling Han battled fiercely with the fire cat. One punch, one claw, and every move was a head-on confrontation.
This fire cat was at the level of One Star Sect Master, and its battle prowess wasn't excessive. However, it was extremely ferocious, fully displaying the unique traits of a fierce beast.

Ling Han was unafraid. It wasn't that he hadn't killed a One Star Sect Master before. It was just that the environment here was unique. In a fierce battle, lava sprayed everywhere. This possessed terrifying destructive power, causing him great trouble.

On the other hand, the fire cat was completely unafraid of the lava, as if it was merely bathing in the rain. In fact, when it was injured by Ling Han, the lava flowed through its wounds, and they miraculously healed.
F***, are you immortal here?

Ling Han unleashed all of his trump cards. He only had the battle prowess of a One Star Sect Master, so if he wanted to kill this fire cat, he definitely had to show his trump card. Furthermore, he didn't want to waste time now.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unleashed. Zi, arcs of lightning flashed, and the oncoming rain of fire was completely blocked by the body of the tower.

It wasn't the Primal Chaos Qi. The current Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hadn't reached six stars yet, so the power of the Primal Chaos Qi wasn't enough to block the rain of fire. However, the Origin Gold itself could easily do so.
He unleashed another barrage of murderous aura, yet shockingly discovered that it was actually ineffective.
What was going on?
Could it be that it was not a living being?
Ling Han's heart jolted. If it was a living being, then even if it was a Sect Master, he would still be affected by the barrage of murderous aura.
However, he was only slightly stunned, and immediately began another powerful offensive.

The fire cat was actually not too strong. The hardest to deal with was the lava that was spraying around. Its destructive power was too terrifying. That was why the white-robed young man, Guo Yuhang, had left without a fight.
Thus, after the biggest dilemma was resolved, Ling Han soon gained the upper hand. After another few hundred moves, he killed the fire cat.
Pu, the fire cat crumbled, but there was no shower of blood. Instead, lava also exploded, spraying towards him.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower suddenly enlarged, protecting Ling Han within.
The lava sprayed over, yet it was completely blocked by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. No wonder that person had acted as if he were avoiding snakes and scorpions. This kind of vicious beast was indeed difficult to deal with.
Pa, the fire cat's whole body turned into lava, but there was still a fiery red crystal left behind, which fell onto the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 4414 Flaming Dragon’s Saliva
paragraphs: Yi, why was it the same as what he had seen in the bushes?
Ling Han picked up this fiery red crystal, and then walked into the bushes. As expected, he picked up another crystal, and they were both as red as fire.
It was exactly the same.
Looks like these crystals were scattered all over the island, and could be picked up, or obtained through killing fierce beasts.

Speaking of which, it was a little funny. Previously, that person was clearly looking for this kind of crystal, and the fire cat also had this kind of crystal on it, but that person avoided it as far as possible, and would rather give up the crystal that had already been discovered.
Was this fire cat really so hard to kill?
This was indeed the case. Without the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, what treasure could block this level of lava rain?
"It's rare for me to be scammed by someone. This is truly a rare event that would only happen in 10,000 years," Ling Han murmured. Instead of getting angry, he smiled.
"Although this experience is rare, how could it be that I don't want face?"
Ling Han wasn't in a hurry to find this guy who had screwed him over. Instead, he began to study this crystal.
After spending some time, Ling Han still couldn't make heads or tails of the situation. He didn't discover anything.
He naturally wouldn't throw away the crystal because of this. Instead, he strolled forward.
If he found someone to ask, he would definitely be able to find out the use of this thing.

On the way, he indeed saw a great many people searching for this kind of crystal, but when Ling Han went to ask, these people all looked furious, as if they thought that Ling Han was playing around with them.
What was going on here?
After walking for a long time, Ling Han saw a harbor.
Strictly speaking, this was only a shallow bay, but only this place could be docked from the sea.
Ling Han gave an 'oh'. This should be the starting point for the others. Because the others had all come by raft, they could only go ashore here.
He walked out, and set out from the beach, heading towards the island.
He had not taken too many steps, when he saw a scene that shocked him.

There was a giant whose entire body was burning with flames. His body was trapped by chains, and he was tied to a massive iron pillar. However, his arms and legs were free, but he did not attempt to free himself.
Perhaps, he couldn't do anything to this metal chain at all.
He was seated, but even so, he was still more than 200 meters tall. His flame-like hair seemed to be burning, fluttering wildly.
"Young man, come here quickly." The flaming giant waved at Ling Han.
Ling Han walked closer, but not too close.
He couldn't tell the cultivation level of this giant, but he still didn't dare to be careless. The unknown was the most terrifying.

"The little guy is quite cautious," the giant said. "Go and get some shiny things. There are them everywhere on the island, and even in the bodies of wild beasts. Get me a hundred, and I will trade this with you."
As he spoke, he took out a jade pot, opened its lid, and shone it at Ling Han. There was a fiery red liquid inside, but it was definitely not lava. It was like beautiful jade.
At the same time, an intoxicating fragrance also wafted out. Merely a single sniff was enough to make Ling Han's ninth spiritual body show signs of accelerating solidification.
This was good stuff.
Ling Han retrieved a fiery red crystal, and asked, "Is this it?"
"That's right." A greedy expression immediately appeared on the flaming giant's face, "Give it to me. A hundred would be enough to trade for a drop of Flaming Dragon's Saliva."
Dragon's saliva?
It should not be the saliva of the True Dragon, but rather some kind of natural treasure. Perhaps, it was born from the True Dragon, and that was why it was called the dragon saliva.
"A hundred in exchange for a single drop?" Ling Han shook his head, "I'm at too much of a loss. Here, either ten in exchange for a single drop, or a hundred in exchange for ten drops."

"Little guy, it's not like I haven't seen people bargaining with me before, but you're the only one who has to bargain so outrageously." The fire giant smiled, and said, "All right, just for your courage, I'll make an exception for you. 99 fire crystals in exchange for a drop of Flaming Dragon's Saliva."
"I've never seen someone as petty as you either. Why don't we do this? Eleven for one." Ling Han sat down and made a counter offer.
The flaming giant wasn't angered, but he still insisted on trading 99 for one, not letting go. No matter how much Ling Han talked, he was still unmoved.
By the looks of it, he really couldn't go cheaper.
Ling Han nodded, turned around, and left.

—No wonder when he had asked others previously, others misunderstood that he was playing around with them. That was because if they went ashore from here, they would definitely encounter the flaming giant.

His strength must be world-shaking. Otherwise, he would have long since been robbed.

There could only be one person who would become Emperor in future, but every single person had their own fated opportunity. Who did not want to become stronger?
Because the plants here were too fragile and dangerous, it was natural that few people would start a fight here, to avoid getting into trouble.
However, if two people discovered a fire crystal at the same time, it was still possible that a battle would break out. After all, humans would die for wealth, and birds would die for food.

Guo Yuhang.

Since when had vicious beasts become so benevolent? Were they going to let go of meat that was already at the tip of their tongue?

He definitely did not believe that Ling Han possessed strength that could match a Sect Master. Then there was only one possibility — Ling Han had hidden some kind of rare treasure, and that was why he managed to save his life from the hands of a Sect Master.

Hehe, there is no animosity between us, but you pushed me towards a fierce beast, and now that you see that I am not dead, you covet the treasures I have?
How could anyone be so shameless?

He was that kind?

Of course not. He was only willing to grant some allowance because he was afraid that Ling Han would use the "treasure", so he did not push him too far. However, after Ling Han handed over the treasure, hoho, that would be a different story.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I have never liked killing. However, you are an exception, so I am very happy to send you on your way."
"You really won't give up until you're faced with the grim reality!" Guo Yuhang humphed, stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.

The speed at which the large hand stretched out was very slow. This was something that he had deliberately controlled. He did not want the power to surge, and shatter the surrounding plants, but a majestic power had long since imprisoned Ling Han.
A mere Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator!

As expected, he picked up another crystal, and they were both as red as fire.
It was exactly the same.
Looks like these crystals were scattered all over the island, and could be picked up, or obtained through killing fierce beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 4415 Talisman Weapon appears
paragraphs: However, Guo Yuhang immediately discovered that something was off, because when his "palm" encountered Ling Han's power of defense, it could not advance the slightest bit further.
How was this possible?
A measly Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator was actually able to block his attack, even if he had only used a very small portion of his power.
"How is it?" Ling Han cracked a smile.
"Interesting." Guo Yuhang soon calmed down.
So what if you are freakish to the heaven-defying level? I am a Three Star Sect Master!
'You want to challenge me?'
Guo Yuhang's figure leaped, and charged directly towards Ling Han.
Boom!
This time, he went all out, and the might he displayed was completely different.
A Three Star Sect Master was naturally terrifying.
Ling Han only took a single strike head-on, and already felt his body tremble violently from the impact. He was about to throw up all his internal organs.
This guy hadn't just advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier, but was at least a three-star or even four-star elite. Otherwise, how could he have been hit so hard with a single strike?

Thankfully, he could disperse a portion of the attack, and added with the toughness of his physique, otherwise, this would not just be uncomfortable. Instead, he would be severely injured, or even killed in fact.
"Merely a Spirit Transformation Tier," Guo Yuhang declared proudly. Though Ling Han was extraordinary, he was only a One Star Sect Master, and was far from being his match.

—And he really had the nerve to boast. His cultivation level was higher than Ling Han by more than a major tier, so it was only natural that he was strong. If others heard this, they would naturally only laugh at him.
"When I kill you, you will know regret," Ling Han said calmly.
Guo Yuhang's eyes were filled with greed, and his attacks became even fiercer.
Ling Han was only in the Spirit Transformation Tier, yet he could possess battle prowess on the level of a One Star Sect Master. Just how inconceivable was this?
Thus, this brat should have some heaven-defying fated opportunity.
Just how great was this great opportunity?
Even the Golden Generation could only watch in dumbfounded shock.
Had anyone ever heard of the legend of the Golden Generation facing his opponent head-on with a gap of a major tier of cultivation level?
There was none!
Thus, if he could snatch Ling Han's fated opportunity, he would be able to surpass the Golden Generation and become the most likely person to contest for the throne.
From an ordinary Dao Child, he had suddenly turned into the strongest prodigy. In future, he could even become Emperor. How could he resist such temptation?
"Thank you!" He revealed a smile, and couldn't help but laugh.
"Your laughter is even worse than pigs squealing!" Ling Han shook his head.
Instantly, Guo Yuhang's fury surged. His laughter was indeed a little strange, but no one had ever dared to compare it to the squealing of pigs.

"On the basis that you have gifted me treasures, I will let you die a swifter death." Guo Yuhang was going to begin a great massacre. At this time, he completely did not care how much damage the aftermath of the battle would cause, and how much trouble it would cause for him.
His mind was completely occupied by that heaven-defying great opportunity.

Ling Han smiled faintly, and his figure danced, no longer facing Guo Yuhang head-on. However, he would occasionally deliver a barrage of murderous aura, and take advantage of the opening to counterattack. This was something that Guo Yuhang could not guard against, and was very uncomfortable for him.
How could there be such a freakish Spirit Transformation Tier?
If Guo Yuhang had not seen it with his own eyes, and personally exchanged blows with Ling Han, but had heard the retelling from others, he would definitely reprimand it as utter nonsense.
Wasn't it?
A Minor Advanced Tier was qualified to be called a great elite. A Sect Master would be able to suppress a Spirit Transformation Tier with a single finger.
Moreover, he was a Three Star Sect Master, yet he was still unable to defeat Ling Han after several dozen exchanges. No one would believe this.
But the more this was the case, the stronger his greed became. This meant that the great fortune that Ling Han had obtained was incredibly heaven-defying.
He wanted it! He wanted it! He wanted it!
At the same time, he was also a little worried.
What if Ling Han fled?
Though this guy's battle prowess was far inferior to his, his movement technique was extremely slippery. If he ran at full speed, it was very possible that he would not be able to catch up to him.
Such a heaven-defying opportunity!
He had already considered this kind of great opportunity to be his, so he definitely could not tolerate "losing it after gaining it".
"Why do you have to do this?" he asked as he continued to fight. "Under my attacks, your only fate is death. Thus, it would be better for you to have a quick end, and save yourself some punishment."
Ling Han scoffed and said, "Not only are your abilities inferior, but your intelligence is also insufficient. Can you say something more creative?"
Guo Yuhang's eyes were filled with anger, and his attacks became even fiercer.
There was nothing much to say about persuading others to stretch out their necks and wait to be slaughtered. How could this be described in a way that it was what others yearned for?

"You have already angered me!" Guo Yuhang said balefully, "Previously, I only planned to kill you, and snatch your fated opportunity, but now, not only will I kill you, I will also search for information about your family and friends from your consciousness, and kill them one by one!"
"Before they die, I'll tell them that it was you who caused their deaths."
Hearing these words, Ling Han's eyes finally became ice-cold.

'I have no animosity with you, yet you brazenly attacked and pushed me toward the wild beast. Now, you covet the treasures that I possess. And because I did not take the initiative to just hand them over, you actually want to threaten my family and friends?'
"I had wanted to play a few more moves with you, but you are so determined to seek your own death!" he stated calmly.
"Hahaha!" Guo Yuhang laughed loudly, "You, a mere Spirit Transformation Tier, still want to kill me? How?"
He was naturally unafraid. Even if a Spirit Transformation Tier obtained the Imperial Weapon, how much of its might could they activate?
Thus, Ling Han could only threaten him verbally.
"I said I'll kill you, so of course you won't live!" Ling Han said coldly as he retrieved a talisman.
This was a treasure that he had obtained from the place of darkness, and could blast out the might of a Five Star Sect Master.
Guo Yuhang's eyes swept over the surroundings, and a strong feeling of unease suddenly rose up in his heart.
That talisman was tattered, but for some reason, it made him feel a huge threat.
Talisman Weapon!
He was stunned, but at the same time, he was a little disbelieving.
Talisman Weapons were actually quite common, but the more powerful Talisman Weapons were, the higher the production requirements would naturally be.

For example, the six-star Talisman Weapon not only required the creator to be a Venerate Tier, but even the talisman paper used as a vessel had to be a Venerate Tier-level beast hide, and use Venerable Tier-level blood as ink.
How many forces could afford to use them?
Thus, there was a suspicion in his heart. Was Ling Han bluffing?
He made two preparations. On one side, he was still attacking, and on the other, if he discovered that something was off, he could also immediately escape.
"Hehe, are you trying to scare me with a Talisman Weapon?" he said proudly.

"Just try it then." With a wave of Ling Han's hand, his divine sense had already locked onto Guo Yuhang. Then, with a wave of his hand, Spiritual Power stimulated the Talisman Weapon. Xiu, that talisman paper floated towards Guo Yuhang.
Guo Yuhang's greatest fear was actually that Ling Han would not use the Talisman Weapon. Now that you have used it, he only had to dodge it and everything would be fine.
Thus, he smirked internally. After all, he was a rookie, and did not have the slightest bit of battle experience.
He retreated rapidly. Even if the Talisman Weapon wasn't as terrifying as he had imagined, he still decided to avoid it for the sake of safety.

The Talisman Weapon shot out, and immediately emitted a purple-coloured light. Then, the talisman paper directly combusted into ash, but a purple-coloured sword of light appeared, slashing towards Guo Yuhang.
Five Star Sect Master-level!
Guo Yuhang was shocked, and hurriedly turned around to flee.
