chapters.title: Chapter 4416 Killed
paragraphs: Even though the might of the Talisman Weapon was only two minor levels higher than Guo Yuhang, at the level of Sect Master, a difference of one star could bring about a massive gap in battle prowess, what more two stars?
He wasn't Ling Han, who could freakishly battle against an opponent who was a major tier above him.
It should be known that when one had reached the level of Sect Master, which one of them was not a prodigy among prodigies?
He wanted to battle above his cultivation level?
Hehe, at least, he, a Dao Child, would not be able to do so. It was already very impressive that there were few opponents that could match him at the same cultivation level.

He fled, and the purple sword of light chased after him. Furthermore, it was not a physical object, but rather an attack that an elite had left on the Talisman Weapon through a special method. Its speed was naturally far faster than cultivators of the same level.
Shua, the sword of light arrived.
Guo Yuhang had no choice but to turn around to parry. Otherwise, if he was directly hit by a Five Star Sect Master, he would definitely die without leaving a trace of himself behind.
He exerted his full effort, and delivered an attack.
"Ah!" He released a terrible scream, and his whole person was sent flying. It could be clearly seen that the lower half of his body was gone.
—It was forcibly destroyed by the sword light.
However, the purple sword of light finally exploded with the might of the Talisman Weapon. It also rapidly dimmed, and disappeared into thin air.
This strike had passed.

However, Guo Yuhang could only scream in pain. Even though his lower body had only been shattered, the foreign martial intent that was contained within the purple sword of light had already invaded his body, making it extremely difficult for him to even raise a finger.

Fear appeared on his face. How had he treated Ling Han previously? Now, the tables had turned. He was so weak and powerless, completely like fish on a chopping board, and could only be slaughtered by Ling Han.
This turn of events was too fast, and he could not accept it.
Ling Han strode over. Though he had wasted a precious Talisman Weapon on Guo Yuhang, he did not take it to heart.

In any case, as long as he advanced into Sect Master-level, even if his battle prowess couldn't reach Five Stars, it probably wouldn't be too far off. At that time, this Talisman Weapon would become useless.
Thus, he might as well use it now, so that he could vent his anger.
"We can talk things over peacefully." Guo Yuhang forced himself to speak. With these words, he spat out a few mouthfuls of blood.

"Don't, don't, don't. The moment you open your mouth, you're throwing up blood. I'm a person that would become dizzy at the sight of blood, so it's best that you close your mouth," Ling Han said with a smile.
Dizzy? Dizzy your sister.
Guo Yuhang was so infuriated that he spat out a few mouthfuls of blood. 'You've already destroyed my lower body, yet you're still saying that you get dizzy at the sight of blood?'
However, his life was in Ling Han's hands at this moment, so he naturally didn't dare to say anything to anger Ling Han.
"I said I'll kill you, so I will. Do you believe me now?" Ling Han asked.
Guo Yuhang nodded in agreement. His life was in Ling Han's hands now, so he had no choice but to lower his head.
"Do you regret it now?" Ling Han asked again.

Guo Yuhang nodded repeatedly. If he had known that Ling Han was such a freak, he should have ignored his status and ambushed him, so that Ling Han would not even have the chance to use the Talisman Weapon.
Damn it, he was too proud.

Ling Han couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, "A vile character is a vile character. Even at this moment, you still have no intention to reflect on your actions. You think that it's someone else's fault that you ended up like this."
"Forget it. There's nothing much to say to you. It's a complete waste of time."
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and pressed it down on Guo Yuhang.

"Ah!" Guo Yuhang tried his best, but his body was filled with the foreign martial intent. The moment he moved, he would only be asking for his own suffering. The foreign martial intent in his body took advantage of the opening to attack, instantly shattering his mind.
Guo Yuhang died.
"Yi?" Ling Han was surprised. He had not even made a move, and he had already died?
So be it if he died, so as to avoid dirtying his own hands.
Ling Han searched Guo Yuhang, and found a few Spatial Spirit Tools, one of which contained nine fire crystals.
"He arrived much earlier than I did, yet he only obtained nine?"

Ling Han's expression was filled with disdain, but when he thought about it, Guo Yuhang had clearly discovered a fire crystal, but because of the appearance of the fire cat, he would rather give up the harvest that was close to his grasp.
For such a coward, it was already very impressive to have nine fire crystals.
"Alright, then I have twenty with this. I've completed one fifth of my quota."
Ling Han continued to search for fire crystals. He tried his best to avoid battle, because this was a pointless waste of time.
Of course, if someone insisted on robbing him, he wouldn't mind counter-robbing him.

The cultivation level of Spirit Transformation Tier gave him a perfect cover. Some Spirit Transformation Tier cultivators even wanted to gang up on Ling Han and rob him, but they encountered Ling Han, who was a tough nut to crack.
With the help of these fools, only 22 days later, Ling Han had gathered 100 fire crystals.
"There's no hurry."

He did not return to redeem the Flaming Dragon's Saliva, but rather continued to search for fire crystals. Another 31 days later, the number of fire crystals in his possession had reached as many as 200.
"All right, let's go find that big flaming guy."
Ling Han returned, and soon arrived in front of the flaming giant.
"Little guy, have you found those shiny things?" the flaming giant asked, his voice booming.
Ling Han retrieved 99 fire crystals and tossed them toward the flaming giant.
The flaming giant reached over and caught the flaming crystals. He then smiled, and said, "Aren't you afraid that I won't give the Flaming Dragon's Saliva to you?"
Ling Han revealed the remaining fire crystals, and said with a smile, "I'm not."
Everyone was collecting fire crystals for the fire giant. Obviously, he needed a lot.
The flaming giant faltered for a moment, then laughed loudly. He took out that jade bottle, and drew out a drop from it. Then, he tossed it towards Ling Han.
Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed down, similarly controlling this drop of liquid in midair.
A refreshing fragrance seeped out, causing his mystical power to overflow with liveliness, and the ninth spiritual body was showing signs of accelerating in formation.
"Brat, the Flaming Dragon's Saliva evaporates very easily. When the time comes, don't blame me for giving you fake goods," the flaming giant warned.
Only then did Ling Han swallow the dragon saliva in a single gulp. Instantly, a refreshing fragrance spread out in his mouth, making him feel so comfortable that every pore on his body opened up.
He hurriedly leaped up, found a remote place, and began to refine the medicinal effects.
After refining a drop of dragon saliva, his ninth spiritual body also advanced by one-tenth.
"After another eight to nine drops, I'll be able to reach the peak stage of Ninth Change."
Ling Han returned, redeemed another drop of dragon saliva, and similarly found a remote place to consume it.
Then, he set out again on the path to find the fire crystals.
This was really a good way to rapidly increase his cultivation level.
However, more and more people came to the island, which led to the difficulty of finding the fire crystals becoming higher and higher.
Recently, there were more and more robberies, and there were even some people who took risks, and actually had designs on fierce beasts. Some succeeded, while others died terrible deaths.
This naturally affected Ling Han as well. In half a year's time, he had only managed to redeem four drops of dragon saliva.
"Sigh, business has been difficult recently." As Ling Han searched, he searched all over the island.

The strange thing was that there seemed to be an endless supply of fire crystals. There were some areas that Ling Han had clearly searched, but when he turned around after a few days, he actually made another discovery.
"Hmm?"
He suddenly sensed a killing intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 4417 Fatal tribulation
paragraphs: Murderous intent!
Ling Han wore a stern expression as he looked to his left. It was this direction that the killing intent had been emanating from, and it was directly surging toward him.
In a mere instant, a graceful figure appeared, standing in front of him.
Feng Miaoling.
F***, this crazy woman that was like a lingering ghost.
Ling Han had wanted to beat up this crazy woman after he advanced to the level of Sect Master, but he didn't expect to encounter this woman so soon.
Although he now officially possessed the battle prowess of a Sect Master, he should still be no match for Feng Miaoling.
This woman's strength was definitely above three stars. In fact, if he didn't use the Talisman Weapon, he wouldn't be able to deal with her even if he stayed behind.
"Die, mad man!" Feng Miaoling immediately charged over, slashing out with the longsword in her hand, as if she wanted to sever even heaven and earth.
Ling Han hurriedly retreated. A wise man does not fight when the odds are against him.
"Crazy woman, just you wait. If I don't smash your behind, my name isn't Wenren Liangping!" he shouted as he ran.
If Wenren Liangping still had awareness after death, the casket lid definitely wouldn't close over his corpse.
You are too mischievous.

Feng Miaoling gave chase quickly, but in terms of movement technique speed, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was definitely number one in the world. In a situation where his power had already advanced into Sect Master level, Ling Han's speed was even faster than hers.
In this manner, in the blink of an eye, Ling Han had already disappeared from her sight.
"Ah!" Feng Miaoling slashed madly with her sword in hatred. Pu, pu, pu, the whole sky was filled with a rain of lava, making her appear extremely disheveled.
"Crazy woman, crazy woman, she's really sick."
"I wonder how Jing Haoran is doing. He wouldn't have been killed by the crazy woman, right?"
"That shouldn't be possible. That guy's mouth is even more despicable. If he could be killed so easily, he would have been chopped into pieces ages ago."
Ling Han shook his head, and continued to search for fire crystals. At present, this was the fastest way to strengthen himself.
Fifty days later, Ling Han found another 99 fire crystals.
103 days later, the number of fire crystals doubled.
He went to redeem the dragon saliva. After ingesting the dragon's saliva, his cultivation level naturally soared rapidly.
"The situation has exceeded my expectations. As long as I redeem another two drops, I will definitely be able to reach the peak stage of Ninth Change."

But by this time, the difficulty level of obtaining the fire crystals had further increased, because more people had come, and they were not willing to leave. The use of the dragon saliva was too great. It could probably push a Sect Master to the peak stage of that cultivation level.
Thus, only Venerate Tiers would leave.
But the problem was, how many Venerate Tiers could be called young?
There were only a few Golden Generations, and they might not have chosen this path either.
Thus, those who could come here were all clinging onto this island.
Just how many people were there?
The entire island was almost filled to the brim with people.

And this was still because there were many obstacles ahead that had blocked the majority of people. Otherwise, there would be even more people here, and it was not impossible that even a needle would not be able to penetrate through the masses of people here.
Ling Han was also slightly driven mad, and felt that it was a little useless, because the longer it took, he might as well choose to cultivate while advancing instead.
Looking at the 70 fire crystals in his hands, Ling Han prepared to wait a little longer. At least, he had to redeem another drop of dragon saliva. Otherwise, it would be too much of a waste.

Fortunately, the signs of robbery on the island were also becoming more and more serious. Ling Han was robbed every few days, and the result was naturally that it was others who gave him fire crystals.
And just like that, a month later, he had gathered 99 fire crystals.
He went to redeem, and obtained a drop of dragon's saliva.
Seeing that he had turned around and was about to leave, the flaming giant couldn't help but feel curious, and asked, "Little guy, you're leaving just like that?"
Previously, Ling Han would always redeem two fire crystals.
Ling Han shook his head, "Business is difficult."
He turned around and said with a smile, "However, I don't mind lowering the purchase price. Why don't I trade fifty fire crystals for a drop of dragon saliva?"

There was an obvious look of disappointment in the flaming giant's eyes. It was as if he was a child that had been anticipating a birthday gift for a long time, yet the adult had said that he had forgotten it.
Ling Han was astonished. He had thought that this flaming giant was naturally formed from heaven and earth. It only had one use, and that was to exchange for dragon saliva.
But from the look of things now, there seemed to be more to it than met the eye.
Xiu, at this moment, another figure descended.
This was a powerful Sect Master elite.
He was dressed in a tight-fitting green suit, and when his eyes swept over Ling Han, a hint of greed involuntarily rose up in his expression.
The air was still filled with the unique fragrance of the dragon saliva, so Ling Han must have just redeemed a drop of dragon saliva.
Though Ling Han had already consumed it, if he killed Ling Han now, he should still be able to extract the medicinal effects.
He was a Spirit Transformation Tier, so he could be easily dealt with.
He smiled, and with a casual toss, threw his own fire crystals towards the fire giant.
However, the flaming giant didn't hand over a drop of dragon's saliva like before.
"Where's the dragon's saliva!" the Sect Master in green raised his voice and asked loudly.
The flaming giant laughed loudly, and suddenly waved his hand. Instantly, his body was covered with fire crystal, which he had traded for from outsiders previously.
Yi, what are you doing?
Boom, the fire crystals lit up one after another, and then began to burn fiercely.
Flames soared into the sky, and waves of heat rolled out. Even Ling Han couldn't help but stretch out a hand to block in front of his face.
However, the flaming giant was completely unaffected. On the contrary, the metal chains that bound his body were burning bright red, and looked like they were about to melt.
Ling Han immediately turned around and fled. He finally knew what was wrong.
"Trying to escape?" the Sect Master in green said with a cold chuckle. He reached over to block Ling Han.
He still wanted to refine Ling Han's body and extract the dragon's saliva.
"Idiot!" Ling Han ignored him. He was out of time.
Boom! He unleashed his full speed as he unleashed the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. His flaming wings soared into the sky, and xiu, he disappeared from sight.
The Sect Master in green was startled. He had not thought that a mere Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator would actually be able to burst out with such speed.
However, before he could decide whether to pursue or not, he suddenly felt a terrifying aura behind him.
He turned around, only to see a giant of flames standing behind him. His power was boundless, and it was as if he were a god.
A Venerate Tier elite!
"Ga, ga, you are the first!" The flaming giant suddenly moved, and delivered a palm strike at the Sect Master in green.
If a Venerate Tier elite made a move, how could a Sect Master block it?
The Sect Master in green wanted to flee, but a Venerate Tier had already made his move. How could he make it in time if he only wanted to flee now?
Pa, with a palm strike, he was instantly turned into mush, his body and soul destroyed.

"Interesting little guy, you're quite fast at fleeing." The flaming giant looked in the direction where Ling Han had disappeared, but didn't give chase, because there were too many little guys on the island for his amusement.
A Venerate Tier-level killer had joined the battlefield, and this naturally caused a wave of calamity. There was bloodshed everywhere on the island.
There were no Venerate Tier-level outsiders here, so the flaming giant was the only Venerate Tier here. If he wanted to start a massacre, who would be able to stop him?
There was no longer any great opportunity. This was a hell.
Those who were still alive all ran towards the harbour, leaving at the first instant, maddened for the sake of their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 4418 Again
paragraphs: Ling Han naturally left at the first instant.
He didn't need to enter the harbor. Instead, he directly soared through the air, stepping on the silk of Regulations as he crossed the sea.

In the distance, he turned his head, and could still see the tall figure of the flaming giant, as well as the shockwave created by the battle, which caused a rain of lava that filled the skies on the island.
Those who came later could no longer reach the island, or they would only be seeking death.
Ling Han shook his head. Who exactly had trapped the flaming giant there?
The flaming giant took out the dragon's saliva as bait. Its purpose was naturally for the fire crystals, which could help him escape.

Most importantly, the Imperial Path would only open once every tens of millions of years. If it was said that the last time the Imperial Path opened, someone had trapped the flaming giant there, then how many tens of millions of years could that large fellow live for?
What a joke.
"Could it be that the flaming giant was nurtured by the heaven and earth, and was also trapped there by the heaven and earth as... an opportunity and a calamity?"
Ling Han could only understand it this way. It couldn't be helped. It was even more impossible to say who had trapped the flaming giant here.
It was unknown whether this flaming giant would chase out again after killing everyone on the island.
However, this should only happen a long time after this.
Ling Han walked through the air at an extraordinarily fast speed.
A dozen over days later, the horizon appeared ahead of him again.
However, Ling Han quickly discovered that this was still an island, though it was astonishingly huge.
Again?
En, if it was still the same as the flaming giant, then the first batch of people to arrive would still be able to reap a great amount of benefits.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and stepped forwards.
Cold.
He couldn't help but feel a chill run down his spine. Previously, that island was so hot that one could burn, and here, it was bone-chillingly cold.
Surveying the surroundings, this place was covered in snow and ice.
Ling Han waved his hand, sending a cloud of ice and snow flying. Instantly, the degree of coldness soared, causing him to shiver. His battle prowess dropped straight down.
As expected, this was similar to the last island. The environment had a great influence on battle prowess.
He circled the island, and did not see a single person during his journey.
This was very normal, because about everyone had left the same island at the same time, and in terms of speed, could the wooden raft compare to the speed of his flight?
After circling around for a while, he indeed discovered another beach that could allow the wooden raft to reach the shore.
From here, after walking for a while, the corner of his mouth suddenly twitched.
Another giant was chained to a pillar by metal chains.
The only difference was that this was a giant of ice.
F***, the person who had planned all this, just how lazy are you!
"Little guy, come, come, come." The giant of ice waved at Ling Han.
It was the same trick.
Ling Han was speechless, and walked over with a numb expression.
Sure enough, the giant of ice blabbered on and on. Although the item he wanted had become ice crystals, the item he wanted to trade for it was still the dragon's saliva.
Fine then.
Ling Han sighed. In any case, he only wanted to improve his abilities, and as for how lazy the person who had designed this stage was, there was no need for him to care.
He did not bargain. 100 for one, or 99 for one; this gap was really too small.
Moreover, he only needed a drop of dragon saliva to reach the peak stage of Ninth Change.
He set out, and began searching everywhere.
After spending half a day's time, he didn't find any ice crystals. Instead, he encountered a fierce beast, and after killing it, he obtained it from its body.
So this was how it looked like.
The color of the ice crystal was too similar to the color of the ice and snow, so it was very easy to be confused.
Now that Ling Han knew what he was doing, it would be much easier to search for them.
One, two, three. Because he was the only one on the island, his speed was naturally faster.
Three days later, when Ling Han went to redeem the dragon saliva, only then did a second person reach the island.
Feng Miaoling.
What, a, lingering, ghost!
Without another word, this woman immediately moved to attack.
Ling Han hurriedly swallowed the dragon saliva as he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to flee.
Crazy woman, this is the last time I will tolerate you.
After shaking off this woman, Ling Han found a secluded place to begin refining the dragon saliva.
As expected, when this drop of dragon's saliva was refined, Ling Han also successfully reached the peak stage of Ninth Change.
He could break through to the level of Sect Master Tier.

Though this was a Mystery Realm, it was naturally formed by the heaven and earth. Thus, unlike other Mystery Realms, the Regulations were complete, so he was completely capable of breaking through to Minor Advanced Tier.
However, Ling Han hesitated for a moment.
Breaking through just like that?

He had exchanged blows with Sect Masters before. Indeed, taking this step would bring about a qualitative change, completely suppressing Spirit Transformation Tier. However, he still felt that those opponents all had their shortcomings.
Spiritual body.

In the Spirit Transformation Tier, it was indeed good to have spiritual bodies. With every additional body, there would be an additional portion of power, because a spiritual body was a spiritual body, and would not affect one's own battle prowess.

And after advancing into Minor Advanced Tier, the advantage of having a lot of spiritual bodies was also very obvious, because the Sect Master's battle prowess was the sum of the main body together with the spiritual bodies. After it was split, the original battle prowess would decline, and the more spiritual bodies there were, the stronger the original battle prowess would be.

There were many spiritual bodies, and this was a good thing. Undoubtedly, what made Ling Han feel that it was not perfect enough was that though the spiritual body was manifested from the original, there was always a certain barrier between it and the original, and it could not work perfectly together.
Unless... he fused all of his doppelgangers with himself. In that way, there would be no problem of coordination.
Of course, the disadvantage was also very obvious. He had lost the convenience of doppelgangers.

After all, the spiritual body could handle some trifling matters, which was very convenient. Furthermore, the existence of the spiritual body also gave the cultivator a chance to live if he encountered danger.
His spiritual body could also transform into the original.
"No, since I want to pursue the strongest, I must make a choice."
"And I choose... to be the strongest!"
Ling Han decided not to be in a rush to break through. Instead, he would fuse all nine great spiritual bodies into himself.
He did not know what consequences such a choice would bring. Perhaps, it would make him stronger, but perhaps... this would bring about a calamity.
But when one had reached this kind of height, if he still wanted to break through his limits, he could only explore on his own.
In front of him, no predecessor had ever walked this path before.
"I'm unafraid!"
Ling Han firmed his resolve. He began to find wild beasts to battle, hoping to give himself inspiration through battle.
—Smashing the spiritual bodies, and fusing them back into one's own body, this was not just empty words.
Ling Han now had this thought, but about how to make this reality, he could not act rashly.

Fight, fight, fight. He obtained more and more ice crystals, but because the dragon saliva couldn't be stored for a long time, he didn't redeem it. He could only hope that this ice giant wouldn't escape too quickly.
Going by the experience of the last time, he should be able to hold on for at least a year.

The number of people on the island gradually increased, and after the baptism on the last island, the strength of the survivors had also been screened. At least, they would have to be Spirit Transformation Tier-level, and there was absolutely no sign of True Self Tiers among them.
In this period of time, Ling Han encountered Feng Miaoling a few more times. He chose to battle, but he was defeated very quickly all these times, and he had no choice but to run madly for his life.
After doing this a few times, he gradually gained appreciation.
Nine spiritual bodies return to one, he could give it a try.

chapters.title: Chapter 4419 Tenth Change!
paragraphs: Ling Han began to shatter the spiritual bodies, fusing them back into himself.
However, it was difficult.
At first, he had wanted to obliterate all the spiritual bodies in one go, but he discovered that this was only a pipe dream.

Though the spiritual body was also under his control, when it was about to be destroyed, it would instinctively develop resistance, making it a battle of one against nine... hehe, it should be known that in the SpiritTransformation Tier, the battle prowess of the spiritual body and original were equal.
Hence, one may not even win in a one-on-one battle, what more when it was a one-on-nine battle.

He changed his method, and was no longer so greedy to shatter all the spiritual bodies in a single go. Instead, he chose one, and then had the other eight spiritual bodies help him suppress it together.
This had an effect. The first spiritual body was slowly worn away, and endless energy surged out to nourish the self, making the self inconceivably grow stronger again.
Originally, he had already reached the end of the Spirit Transformation Tier, and it would have been impossible for him to improve any further.
Now, he had turned the impossible into possible.
The record had once again been broken.

Ling Han couldn't help but break into a smile. It was said that there was no limit to the Spirit Transformation Tier. Hoewever many True Selves you formed in the True Self Tier, then that was how many Changes you would be able to reach in Spirit Transformation Tier, because this was how this cultivation level was cultivated, and the restrictions were fixed.
But he still managed to create a miracle.
Ninth Change was the finishing line?
Hehe, then I will fuse all nine spiritual bodies into myself, and that would be... Tenth Change!
A whole seven days passed, and the first spiritual body finally fused completely with the original, becoming a part of the mind again.
The strength of his divine sense had increased greatly!
Ling Han smiled, and was just about to begin refining the second spiritual body, when a strong feeling of hunger rose up in him.
This was not because he was really hungry, but rather a feeling of weakness in terms of power.
He hurriedly absorbed the power of heaven and earth, but it was useless. He was still hungry.
Ling Han went to redeem another drop of dragon's saliva. After ingesting it, his hunger instantly disappeared.
As it turned out, what he needed to fill his hunger was natural treasures.
However, not long after, this feeling of hunger returned.
F***, you've become so greedy?
Ling Han hurriedly went to redeem another drop of dragon saliva. After ingesting it, the feeling of hunger disappeared, but it came back again.
After ingesting four drops of dragon's saliva, he finally managed to rid himself of such a strong feeling of hunger.
Thankfully, he had gathered enough ice crystals previously. Otherwise, how could he have withstood such expense?
However, after four drops of dragon saliva, Ling Han was completely broke.

"Thankfully, I'm not as hungry as before. Otherwise, it would really be uncomfortable," Ling Han mumbled to himself. However, it was obvious that if he fused with another spiritual body, he would definitely need at least four drops of dragon saliva.
"Just what kind of path have I walked?"

Ling Han was stunned. To completely evolve the ninth spiritual body only needed nine drops of dragon's saliva — previously, he had used gold and silver fruits to increase his cultivation level a little, so afterwards, he only needed eight drops of dragon's saliva.
But now? He had only fused with a spiritual body, and he had actually used up four drops of dragon saliva.
Then how many drops would he need to complete the Tenth Change?
More than thirty drops?
Heavens!
Just how long was this going to continue for?
However, though he was under great pressure, Ling Han was still pleasantly surprised.

That was because he only needed around nine drops of dragon saliva to complete the Ninth Change, and to complete the Tenth Change, he actually needed more than thirty drops. How much did this mean that his strength had increased?
He moved his limbs, but did not discover any qualitative improvement in his power. On the contrary, his power had decreased.
Just how far had his cultivation declined?
Eighth Change.
He had fused with a spiritual body, which was equivalent to having one less Change, so his power had directly dropped to Eighth CHange?
Then, if he fused one spiritual body after another, would his power fall further and further, weakening to First Change, or even True Self Tier?
If it was another person, they might have to worry, or even stop such a risky action.
This was because this was a path that no one had ever walked before. Who knew if they would walk towards destruction?
However, Ling Han didn't hesitate at all. Since this was a choice that he had made, he would definitely walk to the end.
If he gave up now, he would definitely regret it in future.

"If I want to rise, I have to suppress it first. Just for the sake of Tenth Change, I need more than thirty drops of dragon saliva. Then, when I succeed, I will definitely explode with world-shaking power," Ling Han murmured, filled with confidence in himself.
"I'll get some more dragon saliva. Otherwise, I really won't dare to continue."

He once again set out on the path to find the dragon's saliva, but as more and more people came here, the difficulty of obtaining the ice crystals naturally became higher and higher. After three months, he had only managed to redeem a drop of dragon's saliva.
Ling Han decided to leave. There was not much meaning to staying here any longer.
"Found you!" The sound of gritted teeth was heard, and Feng Miaoling appeared again.
It was unknown how many times the two of them had met. She did not waste any more words, and directly made her move.
Ling Han didn't face her head-on, choosing to flee.
But this time, he directly left the island, and tore through the air.

Feng Miaoling was hot on his heels, but as she chased, she suddenly realized that a terrifying pressure was bearing down on her, causing her to fall in a straight line. With a plop, she fell into the sea, and directly sank to the bottom.
Fortunately, this was the edge of the island, so the seawater wasn't very deep. She quickly walked ashore.
She looked at the sky where Ling Han had disappeared, and an expression of shock appeared on her face.
Why was Ling Han capable of flight!
She was a Sect Master, and even she couldn't fly, so how had Ling Han managed to do so?

"After arriving at the seaside, everyone thought of the simplest method to cross the sea, and that was to use a wooden raft. However, it was obvious that the evil thief had thought of a second method. Though the difficulty level of obtaining it was so high that others would immediately give up, he had succeeded."
"His battle prowess is so strong, and his thoughts are also so agile. He doesn't go with the flow, and is inventive. This is... the aptitude of a Great Emperor!"
A hint of killing intent appeared on her face. This was a powerful opponent.
"However, I will not lose to you!" She immediately regained her confidence, because aside from herself, no one knew how much help she would be able to get.
That evil criminal definitely could not compare to her.
Ling Han treaded through the air and continued to advance.

Perhaps there were no more beings like the flaming giant and the ice giant ahead that would ask for any crystals to trade for the dragon saliva, but Ling Han was unconcerned. There were too many people on that island, so his gains were negligible. At this time, he should decisively give up.
The Imperial Path was so long, so how could it only have this little bit of good fortune?
Ten days later, he discovered another large island.
He landed on the island. At first glance, the plants on this island looked very normal. However, upon closer inspection, he gritted his teeth.
The leaves of these plants were too sharp, like supreme weapons.
Ling Han's physique was tough enough, wasn't it? However, he only lightly rubbed the leaves, and immediately, a bloody mark appeared.
He was already like this, so if it were anyone else, they would have directly cut open a wound.

Not only were the leaves sharp, but even the stems were filled with destructive power. If one pounced into the bushes, it was guaranteed that his entire body would be pierced full of holes. It was not impossible that he would die directly.
But what was even more surprising was the fact that these plants themselves were very soft, and could be easily broken.
This was really a strange island.

This was really a strange island.

chapters.title: Chapter 4420 Path of becoming trash
paragraphs: Ling Han circled around the island.

This had already become his experience. As expected, after walking for a while, he saw a beach that he could land on. Then, using this as his starting point, a giant that was shining with golden light appeared in his vision.
He was still trapped on the metal pillar, still tied with metal chains. Sigh, it was still the same trick.
It was too unoriginal.
Ling Han mocked internally, and the golden giant had already greeted him, "Little guy, come here, come here!"
Since he was already here, he would just have to take things as they came.
Fine then.

Ling Han walked over and conversed with the golden giant. The words that he heard were practically the same. However, what he wanted here were silver light crystals, and what he would trade was still dragon's saliva.
Without bargaining, Ling Han expressionlessly set out. He had redeemed this for who knew how many times, and was already familiar with it to the point of numbness.
He continued forward, searching for anything that shone with silver light. At the same time, he kept an eye out for any ferocious beasts.
However, after searching for a long time, he did not find a single silver light crystal.

However, a low growl rang out, and Ling Han turned around to look. A golden panther had appeared diagonally to his side. It was about 70 feet long, and its whole body was covered with metallic scales. It did not have a single feather.
"So ugly," Ling Han couldn't help but grumble.
There were too many things he could complain about in this sea. It was already quite impressive that he could endure for so long.
The golden panther didn't give a toss about his emotions. It immediately charged over.
Thankfully, this was not a Sect Master-level beast, but rather a Spirit Transformation Tier-level beast.
He still wanted to commit violence in front of Ling Han?

With three punches and two kicks, Ling Han dealt with the panther, but when his fists landed on the panther's body, those scales were incredibly sharp, causing the surface of his fists to split open, and blood gushed out.
Hiss, just like those plants, they were clearly soft yet extremely sharp, which was extremely contradictory.
For a Spirit Transformation to be capable of wounding Ling Han, this panther was most likely the first.
However, after the panther was killed, it disappeared, leaving behind only a golden crystal.
Ling Han instantly bared his teeth. This was definitely a silver light crystal, but the problem was, which color-blind person named this as a silver light crystal?
'Is this f*cking silver?'
Ling Han grumbled endlessly, but still shook his head, and picked up the golden crystal.
No wonder he hadn't discovered any silver light crystals before. He had been looking for silver crystals, okay? How could he have imagined that these were actually gold!
"I really want to slap someone!" Ling Han exclaimed in displeasure.
He composed himself and continued to search for the silver light crystals.

This time, he had found the right direction, and added with the fact that he was the first person to arrive here, his gains were naturally great. Very soon, there were more and more silver light crystals in his hands.
Very good, very good. Aside from the troublesome points, the gains here were indeed quite great.
Only after a while, Ling Han could no longer laugh.
He encountered a fierce beast on the level of Sect Master.
Originally, he could have withstood it, but now that his power had dropped to the Eighth Change, he was no longer able to match it.

His Spiritual Power had been strengthened, but the wild beasts here were actually not real living beings. Thus, the barrage of murderous aura was useless. Furthermore, there were no ley lines that he could mobilize, so he, a formations grandmaster, could not make full use of his advantage.
Thus, the only thing Ling Han could do was turn around and flee.

The ferocious beast chased after Ling Han, unwilling to let him go. Furthermore, it was very stubborn. It chased Ling Han for a whole ten days, and only then did Ling Han manage to throw it off his tail.
Fortunately, Ling Han didn't forget to search for the silver light crystals as he fled. He still reaped great rewards.
In this way, the number of silver light crystals in his hands had already reached over sixty.
"Continue."
Ling Han silently made a fortune, but only half a month had passed, and people had already come. Then, gradually, more and more people began to come.
The island was large enough, and with just these people, everyone could completely ignore the others and obtain enough benefits.
After gathering 400 silver light crystals, Ling Han began to fuse with the second spiritual body.

After spending three days, Ling Han's main body once again received a powerful boost, and his Spiritual Power also soared greatly. However, when his spiritual body completely fused together with himself, he discovered that his Spiritual Power had decreased greatly again.
He had fallen to the level of Seventh Change.
It was as if a layer of seal had been placed on him, banning the power of two Changes.
"If this continues, it's really possible that I'll fall to the First Change or even the True Self Tier."
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Was he the first person in history to cultivate to the Spirit Transformation Tier and still experience a drop in cultivation level?
"In some novels, this is the standard way of how a prodigious protagonist who has become a piece of trash appears."
Ling Han mocked for a while, then felt a strong sense of hunger. Hurriedly, he went to redeem dragon's saliva to consume.
After swallowing four pieces of dragon's saliva, this feeling of hunger finally disappeared.
"Sigh, I'm looking forward to it more and more. When I truly complete the Tenth Change, just how great will the rebound of battle prowess be?"
Ling Han continued to search for the silver light crystals. However, more and more people came, so his gains weren't as great as before.
"Should I leave?"
Perhaps, there would be a fourth and fifth island, and he would be able to continue trading for the dragon's saliva.
"Although my gains now are a little small, they're not too bad."
"Furthermore, going to the next island, going by experience, it would need at least ten days. This is also a very great waste."
"Forget it, let's search again."
Ling Han continued to sweep through the island. Another month later, his gains were so small that he couldn't bear it any longer.
He planned to leave, but then, he shockingly discovered that he was unable to leave the island.
There was an invisible power suppressing him, preventing him from leaving.
This!

Not only him, but Ling Han also discovered that when others wanted to leave the island on the wooden raft, they had just traveled 10 to 15 meters when the wooden raft was pushed back by the waves. No matter how hard they tried, it was useless.
Obviously, they could not leave the island now.
Hiss, did that mean that everyone could only leave after the golden giant was released?
Very soon, everyone realized this fact, and all of them were trembling in fear.
The people here had all experienced the scene of the flaming giant killing people madly, and now they had to do it again?
In this way, many people became absent-minded when they searched for the silver light crystals.
What if when they went to redeem it, it just happened to help the golden giant escape?
Not only would they not be able to redeem the dragon saliva, but they would even lose their lives.
However, there were also courageous people. If others slacked off, it would give them a chance.
Ling Han belonged to the category of people who were calm in the face of adversity. He had been searching for silver light crystals, and his efficiency had increased again.
In half a year's time, he had gathered another four hundred silver light crystals.
He fused with the third spiritual body, then redeemed four drops of dragon saliva to solve the problem of his hunger.
"As expected... Sixth Change."

Ling Han was rendered speechless. It was clear that when he was fusing with the spiritual body, he could feel that he had become stronger, yet when the fusion was complete, his power declined instead of increased.
"Only Spiritual Power has been continuously improving. It has probably reached the level of Two-Star Sect Master."
What kind of concept was this?
If Ling Han unleashed the barrage of murderous aura at this moment, even a One Star Sect Master could possibly have his mind pierced through, and he would be directly insta-killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4421 Terrible Loss
paragraphs: However, Ling Han himself was also very weak. If he was ambushed by a One Star Sect Master, he would probably be in big trouble as well.
It was a standard case of strong offense and weak defense.
It couldn't be helped. Who asked his power to drop to Sixth Change?
—For a Sixth Change to be insta-killed by a Sect Master, that wouldn't be strange, right?
"Hopefully, I can safely survive this period of time."
His luck was not too bad. He had stayed on this island for close to a year, yet had not encountered Feng Miaoling even once, which made him sigh loudly that he finally had a change of luck.
Finally, one day, the golden giant gathered all the silver light crystals he needed, and escaped.
Instantly, this giant began a massacre.
Thankfully, everyone was prepared this time. The moment they discovered that the situation was off, they immediately began to evacuate.
The blockade on the seas had disappeared.
True enough, they definitely had to release the golden giant before they could leave.
Ling Han also soared through the air. Although his power had declined, he could still see the threads of Regulations. Thus, this didn't affect his ability to soar through the air.
Additionally, his speed was not affected either. He still maintained his original speed, which made Ling Han feel very gratified.
Twelve days later, he saw the fourth island.
Far from the shore, he saw blazing white lightning enshrouding the island.
Yi, an island of Lightning?

Ling Han was surprised. Previously, they had been the three islands of Fire, Water and Gold, which made him think that this should be the islands of the Five Elements, but now, he realized that was not the case.
There was a random island of lightning, so the deduction of islands of Five Elements was naturally wrong.
He stepped onto the island, and saw that this place was also covered with plants, but the leaves were all entwined with blazing white lightning, intimidating anyone who saw them.
"Let's not worry about this first. Hurry up and find the giant."
"This time, it should be the lightning giant, right?"
He found the landing point, then used this as his starting point to search. As expected, he soon found the lightning giant.
Without any nonsense, Ling Han immediately began to search for the lightning crystals.
Lightning crystals were easy to find, as the colors of gold and silver would not be turned upside down like before.
Ling Han continued to silently make a fortune. However, when he also fused the fourth spiritual body, his power fell further, and he was only left with the power of the Fifth Change.
This made it even more difficult for him to face wild beasts. The terrifying Spiritual Power was completely useless, and he could only turn around and run.
Ling Han was extremely displeased. When had he ever felt so aggrieved?
"Weakness now is for the sake of becoming stronger in future."
"I'll endure!"
The days of making a fortune quietly alone did not last too long, and more people came from the island.
However, after the torture from the last island, there were fewer people who dared to continue arriving at the islands.
Because if they didn't liberate the giant on the island, they wouldn't be able to leave the island. Firstly, this would waste a lot of time, and secondly, it would be too dangerous.
Thus, a great many people chose to pass the island by instead of landing on it.
This was only the beginning stage of the Imperial Path. In future, there would be plenty of opportunities. Why did they have to fight to the death in such a dangerous place?
However, these people soon returned.
That was because after they had advanced for a while, they discovered that the tides were overwhelming, and they could not advance at all.
Obviously, the giant on the island had to be liberated. Otherwise, no one would be able to leave, and this path would be considered severed.
There was nothing else that could be done, so everyone could only return to the island.
Thankfully, there was no danger at the beginning, and there was also a large number of opportunities, so everyone was very proactive.
In a daze, four months passed.
There were too many people, so everyone's gains became smaller, causing robberies to become more frequent.
Robbery was something that happened all the time, but it had become even more common now.

Ling Han strolled slowly in the mountains and forests. He had to be careful. The plants were merciless, and the slightest touch would cause lightning to strike him. Though it would not kill him, it was enough to numb him for a very long time.
If he encountered enemies at this time, that would naturally be a very terrible thing.
Sha, sha, sha! Light footsteps were heard, and then a wild boar rushed out.
This wild boar's body was massive, and it immediately charged towards Ling Han at an extremely fast speed.
Thankfully, it was Spiritual Transformation Tier-level.
Ling Han nodded. He could still fight a Spiritual Transformation Tier-level beast.
He charged forward, unleashing his full battle prowess.
It could not be helped. His present strength had already fallen to Fifth Change, so he had to give it his all.
After a great deal of trouble, he finally killed this wild boar, and there were also a few charred marks left on his body. Those had been left by the lightning.
"Leave behind the lightning crystals, and you can scram now." Just at this moment, a figure leaped out.
This was a young man who looked to be close to thirty years old. He was dressed in a long red robe, and looked very sturdy.
Ling Han looked towards this person, and asked calmly, "You want to rob me?"

"That's right." The red-robed young man did not deny it. He said proudly, "Don't have any delusions. I have already seen through you clearly. You are only Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change, and I... am Ninth Change!"
"What if I say no?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
"Then you are seeking death!" The red-robed young man shouted, "Hand over the lightning crystals quickly, and don't make me ask again!"
Ling Han spread his hands, "Isn't my answer already very clear?"
"Hehe, people really die for wealth!" The red-robed young man said coldly, "Unfortunately, you can't keep this wealth at all, and will only lose your life in vain."
He moved aggressively, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Ling Han's feet moved, dodging the red-robed young man's attack. He said with a smile, "Now, I'll give you a chance to live. Apologize to me, and I can spare your life."
"Hahaha, what a colossal joke!" The red-robed young man scoffed. Did he think that just because he could dodge one of his attacks, he could continue to dodge?
What mysterious confidence.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "If you don't believe me, you can give it a try."

"Ignorance!" The red-robed young man moved again. At present, he did not want to kill Ling Han so quickly. He wanted to capture the latter, and ruthlessly strike a blow to that baffling feeling of superiority he had.
This time, Ling Han didn't dodge.
His power had decreased, but his Spiritual Power hadn't.
The murderous aura surged forth.
Weng, with a though, his strike had reached his target.

"Ah!" The red-robed young man immediately released a terrible scream. He was holding his head with both hands, but what was terrifying was that blood was gushing out of his eyes, ears, nostrils, and mouth.
His mind had suffered a serious injury, which directly affected his physical body.
And this was still because Ling Han had held back. Otherwise, with how terrifyingly he could kill a One Star Sect Master, how could a mere Spirit Transformation Tier block a blow from him?
The red-robed young man's bloodshot eyes widened, as he looked at Ling Han in shock.
This was too terrifying. He hadn't even made a move, and the spiritual bodies in his mind had already shattered completely. His battle prowess had dropped all of a sudden to the True Self Tier.
Just what kind of freak are you?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Do you believe me now?"
The red-robed young man cried. If he had known that Ling Han was so terrifying, he wouldn't have come out to rob him even if it killed him.
The reason why he was robbbing lightning crystals was to trade for the dragon's saliva, and if he wanted to trade for the dragon's saliva, it was to make himself stronger, but now?
He directly dropped from the Ninth Change to the True Self Tier.
What a terrible loss.

He hadn't even made a move, and the spiritual bodies in his mind had already shattered completely.
His battle prowess had dropped all of a sudden to the True Self Tier.
Just what kind of freak are you?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Do you believe me now?"
The red-robed young man cried.
If he had known that Ling Han was so terrifying, he wouldn't have come out to rob him even if it killed him.
The reason why he was robbbing lightning crystals was to trade for the dragon's saliva, and if he wanted to trade for the dragon's saliva, it was to make himself stronger, but now?
He directly dropped from the Ninth Change to the True Self Tier.
What a terrible loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 4422 A tiger going down to level land
paragraphs: However, the red-robed young man was in no mood to pay attention to the problem of his cultivation level. Instead, he was more worried about his own life.
Now, if the other wanted to take his life, it would be a piece of cake.
—For a Spirit Transformation Tier to kill a True Self Tier, wouldn't it be a piece of cake?
"Spare me!" He forced himself to his knees, and began to kowtow to Ling Han.
Pride?
Faced with the possibility of losing life, what was pride worth?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "Hand over the lightning crystals."
F***, it had become him who was going to be robbed.
The red-robed young man was exasperated, and he could only take out his Spatial Tool and hand it over to Ling Han.
He was truly filled with regret.
Ling Han swept over it with his divine sense. Yo, there were actually 79 lightning crystals inside.
"Thanks," he said with a smile.
The red-robed young man wanted to cry but had no tears. This time, he had really suffered a double loss.
Right at this moment, Ling Han's figure moved, and he had already disappeared.
Only then did the red-robed young man confirm that Ling Han had no intention to kill him. Involuntarily, he couldn't help but plonk onto the ground, his heart throbbing wildly.
Thank goodness, thank goodness, he had finally managed to save his life.
He couldn't help but feel a sense of relief. Originally, Ling Han was completely capable of killing him, yet he had only robbed him instead.
From this aspect, it could be seen just how benevolent Ling Han was.
With this thought, the little bit of resentment in his heart instantly dispersed completely.
Ling Han strolled around, looking for lightning crystals everywhere.

There were so many people on the island, so he would definitely encounter other people. Some would just pass by after a short meeting, while others would reveal their ferocious expressions, planning to rob him.
Towards this kind of person, there was naturally no need to be reserved. He would definitely be counter-robbing them.

However, there was also a problem. Once cultivation level surpassed the level of Two Star Sect Master, Ling Han definitely wouldn't be able to stand against that kind of opponent now. He could only choose to flee.

His strength "advanced further" back to the Spirit Transformation Tier's Third Change, because he had already fused with six spiritual bodies, and this made it increasingly difficult for him to deal with the fierce beasts on the island—those weren't real fierce beasts, after all.
On this day, he encountered a Spirit Transformation Tier Eighth Change beast. He was no match, so he could only run.
"Yi?"
He streaked through the air, and a person was presently passing by below him. His eyes swept over the surroundings, and he exclaimed in surprise.
This person was Kong Wuyang, the Silver Generation of the Peacock Imperial Clan.

He was very surprised, because he had recognized Ling Han — though Ling Han had changed to a certain extent compared to before, he hated Ling Han too much. It could really be said that he would recognize Ling Han even if he was turned into dust.
The problem was that the fierce beast that was chasing Ling Han was only Spirit Transformation Tier Eighth Change.
An Eighth Change had chased Ling Han all over the place?
He could be said to be quite familiar with Ling Han's personality. As long as this guy had the slightest chance of winning, there was absolutely no way he could escape.
So, Ling Han's current battle prowess was inferior to even a fierce beast of Eighth Change?
His heart involuntarily beat wildly.
Previously, he had long since given up the idea of seeking Ling Han out to regain his pride. That guy was too freakish, so he could only have the Golden Generation suppress him.
In fact, he had a feeling that even the Golden Generation might not be able to suppress Ling Han.
But now?
He suddenly realized that his chance had come.
Chase!
He immediately leaped up and chased closely behind Ling Han.

—With the support of the endless resources of the Imperial Clan, he had already advanced into the level of Sect Master. Though he was only One Star, the gap between him and the Golden Generation had further shrunk.
The higher one's cultivation level, the smaller the difference in cultivation level brought about by the age gap.
For example, when one had reached the level of Saint, it was very normal for there to be a gap of 10,000 to 20,000 years between them.
Very soon, he saw that the wild beast had given up the chase. Because its speed was far inferior to Ling Han, it was naturally left behind.
However, he was a Sect Master, so how could he be thrown off his tail?
Ahead of him, Ling Han had already stopped. He too descended.
"Ling Han!" he said calmly.
"Yo, isn't this Imperial Son Kong?" Ling Han asked with a smile.

Kong Wuyang sized up Ling Han for a while, then said, "Going by your natural talent in martial arts, and added with the great opportunities here, you should at least be Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change, but you don't even dare to battle a wild beast of Eighth Change."
"With your personality, you wouldn't run if you had the slightest chance of winning."
"Thus, there must have been a great problem with your cultivation, causing your battle prowess to drop drastically."

"Like I said, a mere lowly commoner, how could you possibly match the Imperial Son? You must have cultivated some kind of evil cultivation technique, which can allow you to be invincible among your peers, yet sow the aftereffects."
"It's possible that breaking through to the Minor Advanced Tier is the explosive point."
Hearing his analysis come to an end, Ling Han actually felt slight admiration.
As expected of the Imperial Son. He clearly had so few clues, yet his deductions were practically all correct, aside from the part about cultivating the evil cultivation technique.

However, Ling Han didn't think that there was a huge problem with him. Instead, he thought that he was just accumulating strength for a great explosion. As long as he survived this stage, he would definitely experience a terrifying increase in strength.
As for this, there was no need to explain it to him.
He nodded very decisively, "That's right. My present cultivation level has indeed fallen. It should be about Third Change."
Seeing Ling Han admit it so readily, Kong Wuyang was a little suspicious instead.
Could it be a trap, deliberately tricking him?
But the problem was, how could Ling Han have predicted that he was on this path? Furthermore, what was the point of doing so?
Worse come to worst, even if Ling Han was only pretending, there was no doubt that he was Spirit Transformation Tier.
Then, as a Sect Master, what was there to be afraid of?
"Since that's the case, then surrender your life." Kong Wuyang stretched out his hand, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Boom! Sect Master-level power surged, and this large hand blotted out the sky and covered the earth, densely covered with divine patterns. It was incredibly terrifying.
If it was not for the fact that he was still wary of the lightning that was entwined around the plants in the surroundings, the might of this attack could be increased a few times over.
However, wasn't it enough to suppress a Spirit Transformation Tier?
Ling Han didn't face this attack head-on. Right now, he was only at the Third Change, so how could he withstand it?
I'll run!
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his figure immediately flew out. At the same time, he sent out a murderous aura attack.

Unfortunately, even if the strength of his Spiritual Power had been increased to the level of Sect Master, it was still useless against a rare treasure on the level of a Great Emperor. This murderous aura attack was completely ineffective.
Ling Han wasn't disappointed. This was within his expectations, so he simply gave it a try with a sliver of hope.
"Haha, as expected!"
Seeing that Ling Han didn't even dare to parry his attacks, and directly chose to flee, Kong Wuyang was instantly certain that something had really gone wrong with Ling Han.
"Die!" He gave chase.

Having been horribly defeated by Ling Han, he had become the joke of the Ancestral King Academy. In fact, even the members of his clan were displeased with him. The younger generation had practically lost all respect for him, causing him to hate Ling Han to death.
Now, the opportunity to exact revenge was right in front of him, so how could he not be excited?
Die! Die! Die!
He gave chase, wanting to blast Ling Han into smithereens.

However, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was the fastest movement technique in the world. Ling Han's power had decreased, but his speed was unaffected. As his fiery wings flapped, he gradually threw Kong Wuyang off his tail.
"You can run away once, but you can't escape forever!" Kong Wuyang roared from behind.
This time, he was filled with vigor, and was insufferably arrogant.

chapters.title: Chapter 4423 Just a little bit more
paragraphs: After some effort, Ling Han finally managed to throw Kong Wuyang off his tail.
This little thing.

Ling Han shook his head. If the Tenth Change didn't weaken his power, but instead strengthened it, what need was there for him to fear a battle? And if Kong Wuyang wasn't the Imperial Son, then if he unleashed the barrage of murderous aura, he could still make him kneel down and prostrate in submission.
Unfortunately, he could only allow this guy to be arrogant now.
"There are three more spiritual bodies. After fusing them all together, it will be clear who is stronger between us."
"Now, I'll let you be smug for a while."
However, it wasn't long before Kong Wuyang told everyone about how Ling Han's cultivation had gone wrong. News spread like wildfire, and it wasn't long before everyone on the island found out.
The thought of hunting down Ling Han rose up in quite a number of people.
It was very simple. Ling Han was inconceivably strong, and had even overwhelmed one or two of the Golden Generation. This kind of prodigy... would he have risen up for no reason?
Hence, Ling Han definitely had a great secret hidden on him. If one obtained it, who knows, he may become the second Ling Han.
Dark waves surged on the island, and a great many people noiselessly joined in on the hunt for Ling Han.
If one succeeded in capturing him, he would definitely make a fortune in secret. Otherwise, when the news spread out, he would probably become the public enemy.
Ling Han's situation instantly became extremely dire. It wasn't just one or two people who wanted to kill him, but a whole group of them.

Thankfully, at present, only Two Star Sect Masters and above could pose a threat to him. Of course, Imperial Son was an exception. He was equipped with a Great Emperor-level treasure, and was unafraid of the barrage of murderous aura, so Ling Han could do nothing against him.

However, there were not many Imperial Sons in the first place, and they were scattered all over the 99 routes. Even if Ling Han was very unlucky, and this route here had the highest number of Imperial Sons, it could not possibly be overwhelmingly many. It would only be three to five, at most.

Under such circumstances, it was practically impossible for Ling Han to obtain any more lightning crystals. He could only wait for others to gather all of them, and the lightning giant would be able to break free and leave the island.
Quickly, two months passed.

In this period of time, Ling Han was continuously hunted down, and he killed a group of those weaker than him. Did they really think that just because he had fallen from grace, anyone could bully him? However, there were still a great many people that he could not deal with now, and had no choice but to hide here and there.
Thankfully, this island was big enough. Otherwise, he would not be able to go out to sea either. His situation would definitely be even worse.
Finally, the lightning giant escaped.
Ling Han rushed out of the lightning island at the first instant, heading towards the next island — if it existed.
He only needed another twelve drops of dragon saliva, and he would be able to complete the fusion of all the spiritual bodies. Thus, he had to hurry.
The first person to reach the island had a huge advantage.
He stepped on the air, stepping on the threads of Regulations. He flew all the way, several times faster than the wooden raft.
Ten days later, he saw the fifth island.
Brilliant light blazed.
He stepped onto the island, and saw that every single blade of grass was exuding a blazing white light, so bright that it was blinding, causing him to open his eyes as if he was blind.
F***, his eyes were about to be blinded from the brightness, so how was he supposed to find anything?
After quite a while, he finally somewhat adapted.
He circled around the island and found the giant who would be trading dragon saliva. Er, this giant was naturally exuding blazing light all over his body as well.
Using the same trick, Ling Han began to search for the light crystals.
It was very, very difficult.
"I feel like my poor eyes are about to go blind. How am I supposed to search?"
"Would it be better if Old Black was here?"
As Ling Han mocked, he continued to search.

Now that he only had the power of the Third Change, it was naturally even more difficult for him to deal with wild beasts. Most of the time, he could only run. Thus, the way he could obtain the light crystals now basically came from picking them up.
Thankfully, he had the advantage of being the first person. Twenty days later, he had gathered a hundred light crystals.
After forty days, the others also reached the island one after another.
From this, it could be seen that though Ling Han had spent some time studying the threads of Regulations before, it was completely worth it. Furthermore, it was more than worth it.
Because the dazzling light was blinding, it naturally made it extremely difficult to hunt Ling Han down, so Ling Han didn't have to go to so much trouble, dodging pursuit from time to time.
Another four months passed, and Ling Han had gathered 400 light crystals.
He immediately activated the fusion of his spiritual body, then went to redeem the dragon saliva to fill his hunger.
As expected, even though he could clearly feel the strengthening of himself, in the end, his power directly fell to the level of Second Change.
A year had passed, but the light giant still hadn't escaped. Because of the unique environment here, it was extremely difficult to find the light crystals.
Everyone had very little to gain, including Ling Han. However, they were already trapped on the island, so they could only grit their teeth and continue.
Another three months passed, and the giant of light finally escaped.
Instantly, everyone began to flee.
Ling Han immediately stepped into the air. Ten days later, the sixth island appeared.
There was an island that was brightly coloured in a variety of shades. It was incredibly vividly coloured.
Yi, what island was this?
After Ling Han stepped onto it, he instantly felt dizzy, and almost passed out.
He hurriedly activated the Starlight Screen, blocking himself from the surrounding environment.
Poison!
He immediately realized that this was a poisonous island. Every flower and grass was exuding poison, so he almost fainted the moment he stepped on it.
No wonder this island was so dazzling. Poison was usually very bright and beautiful.
Forget about it. He first went to find the giant on this island. This was a colorful giant, and Ling Han would have to find seven-colored crystals to redeem the dragon saliva.
Without wasting any time, Ling Han immediately set off.
He had the advantage of time in his hands, so he definitely could not waste it.
Time flew by. When the first batch of people arrived at the island, Ling Han could already redeem two drops of dragon saliva.
He continued to search. Because his abilities had declined further, he had almost never been a match for any wild beasts. If he encountered them, he could only dodge.
Another three months passed, and there were already as many as four hundred seven-colored crystals in his hands.
Ling Han didn't immediately redeem it. Instead, he decided to save up enough for eight drops this time.
"Ling Han!"
Boom, Kong Wuyang charged out, and delivered a palm strike. Sect Master-level power was boiling.
After so many days, his strength had improved greatly. Though he had not yet advanced into Two Stars, he was not far from it.
This was very normal. Ling Han could obtain dragon's saliva, so how could it be that he couldn't?
Ling Han didn't linger in battle and immediately fled.
"Hey, where do you think you're running off to!" Another palm struck over, covering the sky and sun.
This was shockingly another Imperial Son, Shi Hao of the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan, who was also of the Silver Generation.
There were only two Silver Generation elites on the island, and they had joined forces at some point in time.

Ling Han humphed. Using the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he created possibilities in the midst of impossibility. Before the two Imperial Sons surrounded him, he escaped through the only gap between them.
"Damn it!" Kong Wuyang couldn't help but stomp his foot heavily. Even Ling Han had managed to escape from him.
"Chase!"

He and Shi Hao set off in pursuit of Ling Han together, but Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was really too fast. Even if the two of them pursued him with all their might, it was useless. Very soon, they had lost him.
"It's fine. There is really a huge problem with this boy's cultivation. His battle prowess is continuously declining."
"The next time we meet... killing him would be a piece of cake."
