Forget about it.
He first went to find the giant on this island.
This was a colorful giant, and Ling Han would have to find seven-colored crystals to redeem the dragon saliva.
Without wasting any time, Ling Han immediately set off.
He had the advantage of time in his hands, so he definitely could not waste it.
Time flew by.
When the first batch of people arrived at the island, Ling Han could already redeem two drops of dragon saliva.
He continued to search.
Because his abilities had declined further, he had almost never been a match for any wild beasts.
If he encountered them, he could only dodge.
Another three months passed, and there were already as many as four hundred seven-colored crystals in his hands.
Ling Han didn't immediately redeem it.
Instead, he decided to save up enough for eight drops this time.
"Ling Han!"
Boom, Kong Wuyang charged out, and delivered a palm strike.
Sect Master-level power was boiling.
After so many days, his strength had improved greatly.
Though he had not yet advanced into Two Stars, he was not far from it.
This was very normal.
Ling Han could obtain dragon's saliva, so how could it be that he couldn't?
Ling Han didn't linger in battle and immediately fled.
"Hey, where do you think you're running off to!" Another palm struck over, covering the sky and sun.
This was shockingly another Imperial Son, Shi Hao of the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan, who was also of the Silver Generation.
There were only two Silver Generation elites on the island, and they had joined forces at some point in time.
Ling Han humphed.
Using the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he created possibilities in the midst of impossibility.
Before the two Imperial Sons surrounded him, he escaped through the only gap between them.
"Damn it!" Kong Wuyang couldn't help but stomp his foot heavily.
Even Ling Han had managed to escape from him.
"Chase!"
He and Shi Hao set off in pursuit of Ling Han together, but Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was really too fast.
Even if the two of them pursued him with all their might, it was useless.
Very soon, they had lost him.
"It's fine.
There is really a huge problem with this boy's cultivation.
His battle prowess is continuously declining."
"The next time we meet... killing him would be a piece of cake."

chapters.title: Chapter 4424 Fully fused
paragraphs: After Ling Han shook off his pursuers, he continued to search for seven-colored crystals.
Though his efficiency had decreased considerably as the number of people increased, he still had some gains. The number of seven-coloured crystals was steadily increasing.
Five hundred, six hundred, seven hundred.
'Soon, I'll be able to reach eight hundred soon.'
Ling Han strolled in the mountains, and the Starlight Screen spread out, resisting the invasion of the poison.
The poison here was everywhere at all times, so one had to be on guard at all times.

Actually, this was still quite good. In some areas, the poison also had a strong corrosive ability, and could very easily corrode the Starlight Screen, and he needed to replenish it with mystical power at all times.

Before this, Ling Han would deliberately avoid these areas, but now that there were more and more people, the seven-colored crystals were harder and harder to find. Thus, he focused his attention here.
There shouldn't be many people in such a dangerous place.
Ling Han strode in, and instantly, the Starlight Screen became colorful. It was filled with corrosive patterns, and would shatter in two to three breaths' time, at most.
Ling Han channeled his mystical power to repair the damaged shield.
For others, this expenditure was really too great, and could not last much longer at all, but for Ling Han, this kind of expenditure was no big deal.
His power had indeed decreased, but his reserves of mystical power had not. On the contrary, there was a considerable increase.

Thus, when others entered into this area, they could only stay for a short ten minutes or so before they had to leave. Otherwise, when the mystical power was completely exhausted, they would die of poison here. And in Ling Han's case, he could practically stay as long as he wanted.
As expected, there was no one here.
After Ling Han searched around, a smile appeared on his face.
Eight hundred seven-colored crystals, all gathered.
He had to leave.
It was naturally impossible for him to fuse with a spiritual body in this area with extraordinarily strong poison. Thus, he strode out.
Unexpectedly, he had just walked out of this area, when seven people walked towards him. They were all young men, and all of them exuded a soldierly aura.
When they saw Ling Han, these seven people were also taken aback. They had not thought that someone would actually barge into the zone of strong poison.
However, they were only startled for a moment before one of them said, "Ling Han!" His face was filled with pleasant surprise.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Obviously, the reason why you are so happy is not because we are friends."
"That's right." That person laughed loudly. They had searched high and low for him, yet finding him had taken them no effort at all.
This guy had the secret of heaven-defying treasures on him, and he had just walked out of the zone of strong poison, so he definitely had seven-colored crystals.
"Capture him!" The seven people exchanged looks, and instantly reached a consensus. They moved to attack Ling Han.
They were all Spirit Transformation Tiers, and they were either Eighth or Ninth Change. Their abilities could be considered quite extraordinary.

Ling Han smiled faintly as he unleashed his murderous aura. Peng, peng, peng! Immediately, six people's minds were shattered, instantly dying on the spot. Only one person fortunately survived, though his face was filled with agony.

He was wearing a rare treasure of Spiritual Power, which could resist the barrage of divine sense attacks. However, after being barraged by the murderous aura, this rare treasure directly shattered. However, it was also because the rare treasure had blocked a portion of the barrage that he was fortunate enough to not die.
That person couldn't help but feel shocked. There were seven of them, and they were all Dao Child-level, but they actually couldn't even block a single move from Ling Han.
Who said that this guy had developed a huge problem in his cultivation?
He was clearly only a Spirit Transformation Tier, yet he was able to blast out Sect Master-level destructive power. He was still a super large monster.
He shivered in fear. At first, he had thought that he had encountered a great opportunity, but he had not thought that it would be his death.
"Heh." Ling Han smiled coldly, and unleashed another murderous aura attack. Pu, that person's mind was forcefully shattered.
These seven people all had seven-colored crystals, and there were actually more than 200 in total, which allowed Ling Han to make a small fortune.
He found a place where the poison was relatively weakest, then began to fuse with the eighth spiritual body.
Three days later, he successfully completed the task.
Just like before, he had become much stronger, but it was as if his power had been sealed, and his abilities had decreased to First Change.
He did not think too much about it, and immediately went to redeem the dragon saliva.
"Ling Han!" Enemies were bound to meet on a narrow road. He had just swallowed the dragon saliva, when Kong Wuyang charged over.
Boom! His killing intent permeated through the air, and his attacks were as quick as lightning.
Ling Han did not linger in battle at all. He turned around and left.
"Ling Han, aren't you very mighty and domineering?" Kong Wuyang shouted through divine sense as he gave chase. "I remember that you weren't so cowardly and afraid of death in the past."
He wanted to provoke Ling Han into turning around to fight.
However, how could Ling Han possibly pay any heed to him? Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he quickly distanced himself from Kong Wuyang.
"Don't worry, I'll personally chop off your wretched head," he said.
Kong Wuyang chased for a few more steps, but then stopped dejectedly.
It could not be helped. He really could not catch up.

He couldn't help but feel gloomy. Ling Han's power had clearly declined greatly, and there was a huge problem with his cultivation, but why did his speed not decrease at all? In fact, even he, a Sect Master and Imperial Son, couldn't catch up to him.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight!" he muttered. Only the supreme movement technique passed down by the True Phoenix possessed such extreme speed.
His eyes shone brightly, filled with greed.
This was another reason that he had to capture Ling Han. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was something that even the Great Emperors of the past were very interested in.

"I'll definitely catch you!" he said balefully. Ling Han's cultivation had gone horribly wrong, and his abilities had clearly declined again. At this rate, it was possible that he would fall all the way to the True Self Tier.
Then, how difficult would it be for a Sect Master to kill a True Self Tier?
'I don't believe that your speed can still be so fast.'
He was a little worried. He definitely could not allow others to beat him to it.
After Ling Han walked for a while, he immediately found a place where the poison was weaker, and began fusing with the last spiritual body.
Whether it would be smiling proudly above the nine heavens, or falling into the abyss, that would depend on this time.
The present version of himself was incomparably powerful, easily fusing with the ninth spiritual body and absorbing it bit by bit.
It was only a little over two days later, and the ninth spiritual body had completely fused into his mind, and could not be separated.
Kuang!
At this moment, thunder suddenly rumbled in the heaven and earth. Dark clouds gathered densely, enshrouding the island of poison.

It should be known that ever since they had entered here, though there was day and night, there had never been any extreme weather. Thus, when they heard the thunder rumbling, and saw the dark clouds covering the sky, everyone was stunned.
What was going on here?
Could it be that they had been teleported to the island of lightning?
But even if it was the island of lightning, the lightning was still spread all over the plants on the island, so how could it be like this?
However, the Imperial Sons all frowned.

They were experienced and knowledgeable, and not only did they know a great many secrets from ancient records, even they themselves had once broken some kind of limit, and drawn out the heaven's calamity.
This was because someone had broken through their limits, and attracted the jealousy of heaven and earth!
Who was it?
Which guy was so lucky that he actually broke through his limits?
A few people immediately associated it with Ling Han, but soon shook their heads.
Impossible!
This guy's cultivation had developed a huge problem, and his abilities had dropped drastically. Yet, he could still break through his limits? What kind of joke was this?
Looking at the thunderclouds in the sky, everyone was curious.
Who... was this person?

chapters.title: Chapter 4425 How Strong?
paragraphs: Kuang, a bolt of lightning struck.
At the same time, in Ling Han's mind, a black shadow appeared.
Its appearance could not be seen clearly. It was completely formed from black mist, but it was exuding a terrifying murderous aura, as if it was a great demon that had killed countless people.
Boom!
It came with the bolt of lightning, but did not disappear with the bolt of lightning. It raised its hand and wreaked havoc in Ling Han's mind.
How could Ling Han allow it to act wantonly? This was formed from the power of heaven and earth, intent on killing him.
What did this mean?

Though no one had ever walked this path before, and the end of this path could not be seen, it was incredibly powerful, that even the heaven and earth would be jealous. Thus, they had sent down the internal demon, wanting to destroy his mind, and turn him into a living corpse.
"Go!" His Spiritual Power also transformed into a human figure that charged at the demonic shadow.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
He battled fiercely with the demonic shadow. It was clear that they were both on the level of divine sense, but every time they battled, it would cause tumultuous waves.
This demonic shadow was very strong. In fact, it had even reached the level of Sect Master.

If it were any other person, even if they too had cultivated to Tenth Change, they should have lost all hope by now, because cultivation level and the strength of divine sense were two different things. However, if it was Ling Han, his divine sense was similarly freakish.
After crossing over to the Other Side, his soul had undergone a complete transformation and reached a state of perfection.
He and the demonic shadow battled fiercely, both sides exchanging blows, both clashing head-on without any fancy moves.
Murderous aura!
Ling Han unleashed his most powerful divine sense attack. His divine sense transformed into a rain of swords that slashed toward the projection.

The demonic shadow took it head-on. When the rain of swords had completely dispersed, a few spikes had also stabbed into its body, causing it to dim slightly. However, it immediately launched a counterattack, opening its mouth and spitting out a swarm of black locusts.
These were naturally manifestations of willpower as well, but they were densely packed, as if they were monsters that had come from the depths of hell.
Ling Han threw a mighty punch.
Boom, the majority of the black locusts were destroyed by him, but there was also a small number that had become fish that had slipped through the net, and were biting towards him.
"Wu!" Ling Han let out a muffled groan. The destructive power of these locusts was really not small. When they landed on him, they spat out foreign martial intent, wanting to destroy him forcefully.
"Go!" he roared loudly, his soul glowing, transparent and flawless.
His soul had long since reached a state of perfection. In fact, it had even rushed up to the level of Sect Master. How could this be a joke?
Boom!
They battled again, blasted again, and fought again.

The demonic shadow was truly powerful. It was actually capable of clashing with Ling Han, whose soul was in a state of perfection. Meanwhile, the two bodies of divine sense were also continuously being exhausted. After every exchange of blows, shards of soul would fall from their bodies.
This was not something as simple as returning to the mind, but had rather vanished without a trace.
Ling Han's spiritual body was originally thirty meters tall, but now it was only nine meters tall.
Of course, with a single thought, he could still enlarge his spiritual body to 30 meters, but in terms of strength, it would definitely be much weaker.
The demonic shadow wasn't much better off either. Its body was similarly sliced, and it looked extremely miserable.

Yet Ling Han was not in a rush. Instead, he was pleased. Though a great many of his soul fragments had been erased, and it looked like his divine sense had dropped greatly, in terms of strength, it was a level higher than it had been.
Getting rid of the weaknesses and keeping the strengths, the toughness increased!
It should be known that his soul was already perfect in the first place, and if he further refined it on this basis, how terrifying would the strength of the purified soul be?
Heaven's calamity was both a tribulation and a great opportunity.

After enduring it, the strength of the soul would soar. It would almost be undying, which was naturally a great thing, but what if he couldn't endure it to the end, and his soul was forcefully destroyed by the demonic shadow? Then, he would be falling into the abyss.
Thus, this was a double-edged saber.
Ling Han was unafraid. He only had one thought, and that was battle.
Fight, fight, fight. The present him did not have any intention of winning, and only wanted to have a vigorous battle.
His soul form became smaller and smaller, and so did the demonic shadow. From thirty meters to nine meters, from nine meters to three meters, then to three feet, one foot, and then half an inch!
The two spiritual bodies were about to be obliterated, but they were still fighting endlessly.
"Break!"
Ling Han roared loudly as he threw his final punch.
Peng, the demonic shadow was completely destroyed by him, and vanished without a trace.
This was too dangerous. As long as the demonic shadow could withstand this move, the next counterattack would be enough to destroy Ling Han.
But no matter what, Ling Han had won.
"Yi?"
The demonic shadow was shattered, but the last soul fragment turned into incredibly pure energy, nourishing Ling Han's soul.
Even though it was only half an inch tall, it was incomparably dense. The strength of his soul had reached a terrifying extent. It was a supreme nourishment for the soul.
Ling Han's mind was vast and mighty, as if an indescribable change had taken place.
In an instant, Ling Han discovered that his mind had transformed into a golden ocean.

His spiritual form took form, but it was very ordinary and average, and did not have any iridescent light. However, with a raise of his hand, the Regulations of heaven and earth were within his grasp.

Using the Regulations of heaven and earth naturally depended on divine sense. The stronger the divine sense, the faster the speed of using the Regulations of heaven and earth, and the stronger its might.
Xiu, Ling Han opened his eyes, and two streaks of divine light surged out, shooting directly into the endless air, as if they could see through the heaven and earth.
However, his eyes immediately became ordinary, leaving behind only gentleness. The depth of his gaze was indescribable.
"How... strong am I now?"
Ling Han stood up and casually moved his limbs. He felt an endlessly terrifying power surge, as if he only needed a light punch to be able to destroy heaven and earth.
This was the Tenth Change, the only Tenth Change in history.
"Not good, hungry!"
Ling Han hurriedly ran over to the seven-colored giant, wanting to redeem the dragon saliva to relieve his hunger.

Tenth Change was not within the range of normal cultivation. Even Imperial Scroll would not be able to cultivate to this cultivation level, unless Ling Han came up with a unique idea, and created his own cultivation technique for this cultivation level.
Thus, if he wanted to complete the cultivation of this cultivation level now, the only way was to ingest natural treasures.
"Ling Han!" Kong Wuyang appeared again. He charged out from the sidelines, intercepting Ling Han.
This was practically even more clingy than Feng Miaoling.
Ling Han ignored him. He only had one thought now, and that was to quickly redeem the dragon saliva to resolve his indescribable hunger.
Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he soon arrived at where the seven-colored giant was.
"Four drops of dragon saliva." With a wave of his hand, he threw four hundred crystals at the seven-colored giant.
The seven-colored giant was quite straightforward, and directly threw out four drops of dragon saliva.
Ling Han opened his mouth and swallowed all four drops of dragon saliva. Instantly, his hunger began to subside.
However, this had only dispersed more than half of his hunger. He still felt hungry.
Yi, four drops wasn't enough?
After completing the Tenth Change, forming a qualitative change, even his appetite had increased?
Ling Han tossed out another 200 crystals, "I'll trade for another two drops."
The seven-colored giant bared its mouth in a grin. After storing the crystal, it threw out another two drops of dragon's saliva.
Ling Han swallowed it in one gulp. Fiery energy surged through his body, finally dispersing that feeling of hunger. He could only vaguely feel it.
At this moment, Kong Wuyang had already caught up to him.
Ling Han turned around with a smile.
'Come, it's time for an accounting.'

Ling Han roared loudly as he threw his final punch.
Peng, the demonic shadow was completely destroyed by him, and vanished without a trace.
This was too dangerous.
As long as the demonic shadow could withstand this move, the next counterattack would be enough to destroy Ling Han.
But no matter what, Ling Han had won.
"Yi?"
The demonic shadow was shattered, but the last soul fragment turned into incredibly pure energy, nourishing Ling Han's soul.
Even though it was only half an inch tall, it was incomparably dense.
The strength of his soul had reached a terrifying extent.
It was a supreme nourishment for the soul.
Ling Han's mind was vast and mighty, as if an indescribable change had taken place.
In an instant, Ling Han discovered that his mind had transformed into a golden ocean.
His spiritual form took form, but it was very ordinary and average, and did not have any iridescent light.
However, with a raise of his hand, the Regulations of heaven and earth were within his grasp.
Using the Regulations of heaven and earth naturally depended on divine sense.
The stronger the divine sense, the faster the speed of using the Regulations of heaven and earth, and the stronger its might.
Xiu, Ling Han opened his eyes, and two streaks of divine light surged out, shooting directly into the endless air, as if they could see through the heaven and earth.
However, his eyes immediately became ordinary, leaving behind only gentleness.
The depth of his gaze was indescribable.
"How... strong am I now?"
Ling Han stood up and casually moved his limbs.
He felt an endlessly terrifying power surge, as if he only needed a light punch to be able to destroy heaven and earth.
This was the Tenth Change, the only Tenth Change in history.
"Not good, hungry!"
Ling Han hurriedly ran over to the seven-colored giant, wanting to redeem the dragon saliva to relieve his hunger.
Tenth Change was not within the range of normal cultivation.
Even Imperial Scroll would not be able to cultivate to this cultivation level, unless Ling Han came up with a unique idea, and created his own cultivation technique for this cultivation level.
Thus, if he wanted to complete the cultivation of this cultivation level now, the only way was to ingest natural treasures.
"Ling Han!" Kong Wuyang appeared again.
He charged out from the sidelines, intercepting Ling Han.
This was practically even more clingy than Feng Miaoling.
Ling Han ignored him.
He only had one thought now, and that was to quickly redeem the dragon saliva to resolve his indescribable hunger.
Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he soon arrived at where the seven-colored giant was.
"Four drops of dragon saliva." With a wave of his hand, he threw four hundred crystals at the seven-colored giant.
The seven-colored giant was quite straightforward, and directly threw out four drops of dragon saliva.
Ling Han opened his mouth and swallowed all four drops of dragon saliva.
Instantly, his hunger began to subside.
However, this had only dispersed more than half of his hunger.
He still felt hungry.
Yi, four drops wasn't enough?
After completing the Tenth Change, forming a qualitative change, even his appetite had increased?
Ling Han tossed out another 200 crystals, "I'll trade for another two drops."
The seven-colored giant bared its mouth in a grin.
After storing the crystal, it threw out another two drops of dragon's saliva.
Ling Han swallowed it in one gulp.
Fiery energy surged through his body, finally dispersing that feeling of hunger.
He could only vaguely feel it.
At this moment, Kong Wuyang had already caught up to him.
Ling Han turned around with a smile.
'Come, it's time for an accounting.'

chapters.title: Chapter 4426 Crushed
paragraphs: Seeing how Ling Han was clearly planning to fight him, Kong Wuyang couldn't help but be stunned.

Previously, he had provoked Ling Han repeatedly, wanting Ling Han to battle him, but Ling Han had not fallen for it. But now, Ling Han had taken the initiative and looked like he was about to start a confrontation, which made him extremely suspicious.
What was going on?
Why did this brat suddenly make this fatal decision?
Kong Wuyang frowned. There was definitely something off about this.

But the problem here was the aura that Ling Han was exuding was still that of Spirit Transformation Tier. Thus, Ling Han definitely hadn't solved the great problem in his cultivation, and he, on the other hand, with so much dragon saliva piled on him, was already a Two-Star Sect Master.
He was an Imperial Son of the Silver Generation. Just how terrifying would a Two Star Sect Master like him be?
Killing an ordinary Four-Star Sect Master should be child's play, right?
In this way, what did he have to worry about?
Empty city strategy.
He immediately thought. Ling Han was deliberately bluffing. His purpose was to scare him.
That should be the case.
"Hahaha!" Kong Wuyang laughed loudly, "Ling Han, I have already seen through your tricks."
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Do you feel that this scene is familiar?"
At that time in the Ancestral King Academy, everyone had thought that he was done for, but what happened?
Kong Wuyang's expression involuntarily changed drastically. Back then, it was because of this that he had been thrashed by Ling Han, causing the Silver Generation to lose all face.
"But you can't do it again. Do you think you can always be so lucky?" he forced out through gritted teeth.
"That's right." Ling Han nodded, without the slightest bit of modesty.
Kong Wuyang was furious. He had lost all patience, and moved directly, launching an attack at Ling Han.
'Die!'
Ling Han cracked a smile, brandished his fists, and greeted Kong Wuyang's attack.
Yi?
Kong Wuyang was a Silver Generation elite, after all, and was one of the strongest among the Imperial Sons. Naturally, he was extremely clever, and had outstanding intelligence.
If he was bluffing, why did Ling Han dare to return the attack instead of immediately turning around to flee?
That was because if Ling Han was putting on an act, he would immediately die from this attack.
Ling Han was extremely crafty, so how could he possibly be so stupid?
However... he was clearly Spirit Transformation Tier.
In an instant, countless thoughts surged through Kong Wuyang's mind. In the end, he did not withdraw this attack, but rather blasted it down directly.
He refused to believe that a Spirit Transformation Tier could defy the heavens.
He was a Two-Star Sect Master!

Boom, their attacks collided, instantly triggering a terrifying wave of energy. The Sect Master-level power boiled, instantly shattering all the plants and trees in the surroundings. Endless poisonous gas spread out, and had terrifying destructive power against the energy shield.
Xiu, Kong Wuyang was sent flying out of the poisonous gas, his face filled with shock and terror.
How, could this be!
In the clash, he, a Two Star Sect Master, was actually sent flying.
He hurriedly turned around and stood firmly. He felt his chest was slightly boiling, and his blood was not flowing smoothly.
Hiss, Ling Han's power was superior to his, though not by much.
Kong Wuyang's eyes widened, as he looked at Ling Han in disbelief.
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!" he exclaimed in shock. "You're clearly only Spirit Transformation Tier, so how can you stand against me?"

No matter how freakish Ling Han was, having battle prowess on par with a Sect Master, Ling Han would only be able to fight against a One Star Sect Master, at most. Furthermore, the Sect Master would have to be on the level of a Dao Child.
Him?
A Two-Star Sect Master, and a Silver Generation one at that. In truth, he was comparable to a Dao Child-level Four Star Sect Master!
After reaching the level of Sect Master, how could there still be mediocre people?
Excluding heaven-defying geniuses, only Dao Child-level prodigies could soar to such heights.
Thus, it was as difficult as ascending the heavens to battle above one's cultivation level.
It was precisely because he knew this that Kong Wuyang was so stunned. A dignified Two Star Sect Master of the Silver Generation was actually sent flying by a Spirit Transformation Tier.
Who could believe this?
Even he could not accept this, all right?
Ling Han smiled and said, "It can't be helped. I'm that strong!"

Kong Wuyang took a deep breath. He finally understood why Ling Han had been so weak previously. It was not because he had experienced a huge problem in his cultivation, but rather because of the accumulation of power before the great explosion.
Once he had passed this stage, the hidden dragon would soar into the sky, its might shaking the world.
He was filled with extreme regret. If he had known earlier, he would have spared no expense to kill Ling Han.

However, he thought that Ling Han's cultivation had developed a huge problem, and he would only become weaker and weaker. Thus, he was naturally unwilling to use his trump card. Wouldn't that be a waste?
It was too late for regrets now.
What could he do?
He could only battle.
Kong Wuyang knew that Ling Han would definitely not let him off the hook easily after he had hunted him down so many times.
—If this was in the outside world, he would still be able to use the Imperial Clan as a scare tactic, but in a Mystery Realm? Hehe.
He didn't speak any nonsense, nor did he beg for mercy. He simply adjusted his state of mind to reach the peak stage. He wanted to have a vigorous battle.
"Ling Han, even if you can kill me, you will have to pay a painful price," he said confidently.
"Hehe, you think too highly of yourself." Ling Han shook his head, and suddenly charged out.
After being on the back foot for so long, he couldn't even defeat a Sixth Change or Seventh Change beast, causing Ling Han to be filled with anger.
Now, he was going to battle the world.
Boom, he threw a punch, and endless Regulations whistled, incredibly domineering.
With the support of Ling Han's current soul strength, Regulations were easily used.
Kong Wuyang was astonished. He hadn't imagined that not only was Ling Han's power so powerful that it surpassed him, but even his divine sense was so terrifying.
Could he summon such terrifying Regulations in an instant?
Kong Wuyang greeted the attack, and similarly interwove Regulations, turning them into a shield.
Peng!
With this strike, the shield immediately shattered. The fists of Regulations continued to attack, sending Kong Wuyang flying.
Pu, Kong Wuyang threw up blood madly, his eyes filled with panic and shock.
As powerful as he was, he was actually no match for a single strike from Ling Han?

In terms of power, he was only at a slight disadvantage. At first, he had thought that just because his cultivation level was higher, he would have an advantage in terms of divine sense. In a battle of Regulations, he would have an advantage. Who would have thought that he would still be on the side that was at a disadvantage?
The two disadvantages compounded, actually resulting in him being injured by Ling Han's attack.
I am a Two Star Sect Master!
Ling Han was also slightly surprised. He was actually capable of beating up a Two-Star Sect Master, Silver Generation, so easily.
Tenth Change... was truly terrifying.
"How can you be so powerful?" Kong Wuyang asked through gritted teeth, his face filled with defiance.

He knew that his speed was far inferior to Ling Han's, and before the seven-colored giant was released, this was a remote island, and there was no way to leave at all. Thus, he was a wild beast trapped in a cage, and could only fight to the death.
He knew very well what the result would be if he fought to the death.
Thus, he was unwilling to give up, and wanted to understand before he died.
Ling Han gave an 'oh', and said, "I have cultivated Tenth Change."
Tenth Change!
Kong Wuyang was stunned, but he immediately shook his head, "Impossible, Tenth Change isn't that powerful!"
Ling Han was surprised, "You've seen Tenth Change before?"

"Amongst the Golden Generation, there were a few that formed ten True Selves when they were at the True Self Tier. Naturally, they could reach the Tenth Change." Kong Wuyang humphed. This was a secret of the Imperial Clans, but since he was about to die, he did not care either.
Ling Han gave an 'oh'. So that was the Tenth Change he was talking about.

Actually, if he had not branded the True Self of Destruction on the Celestial Cauldron, he could have completely formed ten or even eleven True Selves, but would that kind of Tenth Change or Eleventh Change be as powerful as he was now?

chapters.title: Chapter 4427 Crazy Woman
paragraphs: The strength of True Self Tier would naturally depend on how many cores were branded on the Celestial Cauldron, but it would also depend on the quality of the cores themselves.
Thus, ultimately, under the premise that the Celestial Cauldron was fully covered, what was important was the size of the Celestial Cauldron.
The larger the Celestial Cauldron, the more awesome it was.
Thus, this was also related to the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Things like cultivation naturally depended on layer after layer. The stronger the foundation, the more likely it was to break through the limits.
It was precisely because of this that Ling Han had always focused on tempering his foundations. He would definitely not be careless in this aspect.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "This Tenth Change of mine is different."
How was it different?
Questions flashed in Kong Wuyang's eyes, but he did not ask.
This was obviously a huge secret. If Ling Han was willing, he would naturally say, but if he wasn't, then it would be pointless for him to ask.
He was a Silver Generation elite; did he not have that kind of insight?
"I only have nine spiritual bodies. However, when I reached the peak stage of the Ninth Change, I erased the spiritual bodies one by one and fused them into my own body," Ling Han explained.
Kong Wuyang was dumbfounded.
You maniac!
This was the only thought in his mind.
He was definitely a maniac. Who would have thought of destroying his spiritual bodies and fusing them with himself?

Because the spiritual body could self-destruct, allowing the self to instantly recover to its full state, fusing the spiritual body? Who would have thought of such a terrible idea? Wasn't it more or less the same as self-destructing the spiritual body?
However, Ling Han had still chosen this seemingly crazy path. He had actually opened up a new path.

The path of cultivation was like this in the first place. Generation after generation of predecessors would explore, excavate the limits, break through the limits, and from there, future generations could learn from them and imitate.
Thus, everyone who had walked a path that no predecessor had walked could be called a wise sage.

No wonder Ling Han's strength had been continuously declining previously. That was because Ling Han was obliterating his spiritual bodies. With every additional body that was obliterated, his strength would decrease further.
Kong Wuyang understood, but now, what else could he do but sigh?
Losing to such a maniac wouldn't be unjust, right?
"We can only battle." Kong Wuyang's fighting spirit was reignited. An Imperial Son had never waited for death.
With a battle cry, he ignited the Imperial Blood, and blasted towards Ling Han.
He still had some backbone.
"Alright, I'll send you on your way in this battle." Ling Han nodded, and attacked with his full strength, blasting towards Kong Wuyang.
Though the two of them had always been on opposing sides, but because of the other's performance in the face of death, Ling Han decided to give him a quick death.
Those with courage were still deserving of some respect.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
In just ten moves, Kong Wuyang was killed. It was useless even if he combusted his Imperial Blood.
The higher the cultivation level, the less helpful it would be to combust the Imperial Blood.
Ling Han searched Kong Wuyang's body. Insdide the few Spatial Tools, there were very few treasures.
"Sigh, what Silver Generation? You're too poor, aren't you?" Ling Han shook his head, and continued to search for the seven-colored crystals.

He wanted to cultivate to the end of the Spirit Transformation Tier, and now, he could only depend on natural treasures. Moreover, if he didn't gather enough seven-colored crystals, he wouldn't be able to leave this island.
Sounds of battle traveled over from ahead of him.

Fighting here was too common. Originally, Ling Han wasn't the type to join in on the excitement, but it just happened to be in his path, so he didn't deliberately avoid it. Thus, he continued to advance.
After walking out of a thicket, they saw that a person and a beast were engaged in an intense battle.
"Yi?"
Ling Han was astonished. This world was far too small.
The person battling with the wild beast was none other than Feng Miaoling.
"Crazy woman!" Ling Han blurted out.
Feng Miaoling faltered for a moment, then immediately flew into a rage.

She used her ultimate move, and the great river behind her surged violently. A figure that was completely wrapped in a black Battle Armor rushed out, and pounced towards the fierce beast, directly sinking into the fierce beast's body.
A strange thing happened. The ferocious beast's body immediately shriveled, and it instantly lost all vitality. Then, with a bang, it turned into dust, leaving behind only a seven-colored crystal.
Yi, what kind of deadly move was this? It was so powerful.
"Yi, what technique is this?" he asked curiously.
"Die!" How could Feng Miaoling possibly care about him? She immediately charged over.
This time, Ling Han naturally wouldn't flee, exchanging blows with Feng Miaoling.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged blows once. Feng Miaoling's figure only swayed slightly, but Ling Han was sent flying.
F***, this mad woman could possibly have charged up to become a Four-Star Sect Master, and added with the super battle prowess of the Golden Generation, her power far surpassed Ling Han's.
Thankfully, he could disperse the attack, and his physique was tough. He was only sent flying, but was completely unharmed.

Feng Miaoling was also taken aback. She hadn't thought that Ling Han would dare to face her head-on, and what was even more terrifying was that this despicable brat was actually only sent flying, completely unharmed.
Was this really a Spirit Transformation Tier?

She couldn't help but think. Previously, Ling Han had been able to cross the seas from the air. The freakish heaven-defying nature made her think that he had the aptitude of a Great Emperor, and now, was kind of performance something that even the Great Emperor of the past could do?
However, when she thought of how this despicable brat had been naked in front of her, she could not tolerate it at all.
'Die!'
She charged toward Ling Han.
Ling Han was unafraid. He stretched out his hand to grab the Regulations, which turned into a divine light that shot towards Feng Miaoling.

Feng Miaoling had no choice but to wave her hand to parry. This divine light of Regulations was on the level of Sect Master. Even if she was a Four-Star Sect Master, she still had to parry it. Otherwise, she would definitely be severely injured if she was hit.
In this way, she naturally could no longer pose a threat to Ling Han.
Her almond-shaped eyes widened, disbelief flickering in them.
The might of the Regulations was too terrifying. It was more or less comparable to her already.
Heavens!
What was a MinorAdvanced Tier? Why could a Sect Master be called a great elite?

Just because after advancing into this cultivation level, the control and use of the Regulations of heaven and earth would increase by another level, causing a crushing effect on Spirit Transformation Tier.
But now, a Spirit Transformation Tier could match her in terms of Regulations. This was far more shocking than the fact that Ling Han's power had reached the level of Sect Master.
Monster, he was definitely a monster.

"I'd really like to see just how strong you are," Feng Miaoling said coldly. The great river behind her was turbulent and boundless, and black shadows kept charging out, causing her battle prowess to further increase.
Ling Han was completely unafraid. 'Who cares what you are? I will obliterate you with a single punch.'
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The two of them battled fiercely. In terms of power, it was naturally Ling Han who was at a disadvantage, but he was able to disperse the attack power, and his physique was also tough. This little disadvantage was completely negligible, and in terms of Regulations, it could be said that it was hard to decide who was stronger between the two of them.
Thus, even though the battle was intense, it was still difficult to determine the victor between the two of them.
If anyone saw this, they would exclaim in disbelief, completely unable to believe their eyes.
A Four-Star Sect Master, Golden Generation, was actually only capable of fighting Ling Han, a Spirit Transformation Tier, to a tie?
Heavens!
Ling Han only felt great. Such a carefree and unrestrained battle made him feel as if he had drunk a celestial fluid, which made him feel incredibly at ease.
It had been a long time since such a great battle had taken place.
After one day and one night, Feng Miaoling suddenly stopped.
Yi, why had they stopped fighting?
"Your strength has gained my approval. I have decided to choose you as my husband."

"Alright, I'll send you on your way in this battle." Ling Han nodded, and attacked with his full strength, blasting towards Kong Wuyang.
Though the two of them had always been on opposing sides, but because of the other's performance in the face of death, Ling Han decided to give him a quick death.
Those with courage were still deserving of some respect.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
In just ten moves, Kong Wuyang was killed.
It was useless even if he combusted his Imperial Blood.
The higher the cultivation level, the less helpful it would be to combust the Imperial Blood.
Ling Han searched Kong Wuyang's body.
Insdide the few Spatial Tools, there were very few treasures.
"Sigh, what Silver Generation?
You're too poor, aren't you?" Ling Han shook his head, and continued to search for the seven-colored crystals.
He wanted to cultivate to the end of the Spirit Transformation Tier, and now, he could only depend on natural treasures.
Moreover, if he didn't gather enough seven-colored crystals, he wouldn't be able to leave this island.
Sounds of battle traveled over from ahead of him.
Fighting here was too common.
Originally, Ling Han wasn't the type to join in on the excitement, but it just happened to be in his path, so he didn't deliberately avoid it.
Thus, he continued to advance.
After walking out of a thicket, they saw that a person and a beast were engaged in an intense battle.
"Yi?"
Ling Han was astonished.
This world was far too small.
The person battling with the wild beast was none other than Feng Miaoling.
"Crazy woman!" Ling Han blurted out.
Feng Miaoling faltered for a moment, then immediately flew into a rage.
She used her ultimate move, and the great river behind her surged violently.
A figure that was completely wrapped in a black Battle Armor rushed out, and pounced towards the fierce beast, directly sinking into the fierce beast's body.
A strange thing happened.
The ferocious beast's body immediately shriveled, and it instantly lost all vitality.
Then, with a bang, it turned into dust, leaving behind only a seven-colored crystal.
Yi, what kind of deadly move was this?
It was so powerful.
"Yi, what technique is this?" he asked curiously.
"Die!" How could Feng Miaoling possibly care about him?
She immediately charged over.
This time, Ling Han naturally wouldn't flee, exchanging blows with Feng Miaoling.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged blows once.
Feng Miaoling's figure only swayed slightly, but Ling Han was sent flying.
F***, this mad woman could possibly have charged up to become a Four-Star Sect Master, and added with the super battle prowess of the Golden Generation, her power far surpassed Ling Han's.
Thankfully, he could disperse the attack, and his physique was tough.
He was only sent flying, but was completely unharmed.
Feng Miaoling was also taken aback.
She hadn't thought that Ling Han would dare to face her head-on, and what was even more terrifying was that this despicable brat was actually only sent flying, completely unharmed.
Was this really a Spirit Transformation Tier?
She couldn't help but think.
Previously, Ling Han had been able to cross the seas from the air.
The freakish heaven-defying nature made her think that he had the aptitude of a Great Emperor, and now, was kind of performance something that even the Great Emperor of the past could do?
However, when she thought of how this despicable brat had been naked in front of her, she could not tolerate it at all.
'Die!'
She charged toward Ling Han.
Ling Han was unafraid.
He stretched out his hand to grab the Regulations, which turned into a divine light that shot towards Feng Miaoling.
Feng Miaoling had no choice but to wave her hand to parry.
This divine light of Regulations was on the level of Sect Master.
Even if she was a Four-Star Sect Master, she still had to parry it.
Otherwise, she would definitely be severely injured if she was hit.
In this way, she naturally could no longer pose a threat to Ling Han.
Her almond-shaped eyes widened, disbelief flickering in them.
The might of the Regulations was too terrifying.
It was more or less comparable to her already.
Heavens!
What was a MinorAdvanced Tier?
Why could a Sect Master be called a great elite?

Just because after advancing into this cultivation level, the control and use of the Regulations of heaven and earth would increase by another level, causing a crushing effect on Spirit Transformation Tier.
But now, a Spirit Transformation Tier could match her in terms of Regulations.
This was far more shocking than the fact that Ling Han's power had reached the level of Sect Master.
Monster, he was definitely a monster.
"I'd really like to see just how strong you are," Feng Miaoling said coldly.
The great river behind her was turbulent and boundless, and black shadows kept charging out, causing her battle prowess to further increase.
Ling Han was completely unafraid. 'Who cares what you are?
I will obliterate you with a single punch.'
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
The two of them battled fiercely.
In terms of power, it was naturally Ling Han who was at a disadvantage, but he was able to disperse the attack power, and his physique was also tough.
This little disadvantage was completely negligible, and in terms of Regulations, it could be said that it was hard to decide who was stronger between the two of them.
Thus, even though the battle was intense, it was still difficult to determine the victor between the two of them.
If anyone saw this, they would exclaim in disbelief, completely unable to believe their eyes.
A Four-Star Sect Master, Golden Generation, was actually only capable of fighting Ling Han, a Spirit Transformation Tier, to a tie?
Heavens!
Ling Han only felt great.
Such a carefree and unrestrained battle made him feel as if he had drunk a celestial fluid, which made him feel incredibly at ease.
It had been a long time since such a great battle had taken place.
After one day and one night, Feng Miaoling suddenly stopped.
Yi, why had they stopped fighting?
"Your strength has gained my approval.
I have decided to choose you as my husband."

chapters.title: Chapter 4428 What the Hell?
paragraphs: Hey, hey, hey, what was going on here?
'Haven't you been calling for a beating and killing? Why have you suddenly fallen in love?'
Ling Han hesitated for a moment before asking, "Did you take the wrong script?"

Feng Miaoling wasn't angered. Instead, she smiled and said, "Since ancient times, I've seen countless prodigies, but none of them can compare to you. So, the only one worthy of being my match should be you."
Had a fight become a matchmaking session?
Hold on.
Ling Han looked at him in surprise, "You are not the Golden Generation, but have been sealed until now with the Primordial Source Clay?"
Otherwise, why would she say that she had seen countless prodigies throughout history?
The Golden Generation had only lived for 100 or so years, so saying such words was far too laughable.
"That's right." Feng Miaoling nodded.
Hiss, then where had this crazy woman popped out from? What was her relation with Yang Yihuan and He Luo?
Ling Han chuckled and said, "I'm quite picky about my partner. I won't accept anyone older than me."
"It's all right, as long as I like it." Feng Miaoling charged out again. This time, she wasn't going to kill Ling Han, but to make him submit.
Boom, the two of them began fighting again.
They exchanged blows, and it was still a stalemate.

Ling Han really didn't want to fight anymore. By now, Feng Miaoling had already lost all her animosity and killing intent. Rather than calling it a battle, it would be better to call it a spar. It was too boring.
Let's flee.

Previously, he had still wanted to spank this crazy woman's behind, and teach her a lesson, but from the look of things now, if he really beat her up, not only would this woman not be enraged, she would instead be incredibly overjoyed, and would stick to him even more.
Thus, it was better not to. He had to keep his distance.
Right at this moment, a loud rumble was heard from afar, and a massive figure appeared, as if it was indomitable.
The seven-colored giant had escaped.
Just in time.
Ling Han hurriedly used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and directly headed out of the island.
Feng Miaoling gave chase, but how could she possibly catch up?
She looked at the sky where Ling Han had disappeared, and a smile appeared at the corners of her lips, "As expected of the man I have chosen, running so fast!"
"I'm definitely going to have you."
She hurriedly rushed to the harbor, and continued to chase after Ling Han.
Stepping on the threads of Regulations, Ling Han no longer used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. However, his speed was still astonishingly fast. After all, his current strength had increased again.
"Not good, the feeling of hunger is back!"
"Hiss, could it be that I can't fight now?"
Ling Han quickened his pace, and rapidly advanced.
However, even though he could fly, an island only appeared in front of him after 12 days.
It was still astonishingly huge, just like the previous six.
Ling Han climbed onto the island. The first thing he did was naturally to observe the terrain.
The plants here seemed to be transparent, and Ling Han carefully snapped one of them in half. Instantly, a terrifying tearing force assaulted him, as if it wanted to tear him into two.
Power of Space.
Ling Han circled around the island. He immediately discovered that if he wanted to go anywhere here, he would have to try his luck.
That was because as he walked, the space suddenly shifted. He took a step, and appeared a few hundred meters away, or even further away.
This was an island of space.
Forget it. As he walked on the island, he searched for anything that could be related to "spatial crystals".
Presumably, the giant here should need this kind of crystal.
The simplest method was naturally to kill the fierce beasts on the island, and immediately find out what the spatial crystal looked like.
His luck was not too bad, and very soon, he encountered a fierce beast.
This was a Sect Master-level beast. It had a strange appearance, and its entire body was covered with long red tentacles that fluttered lightly in the air.
The wild beast pounced, charging towards Ling Han.
Ling Han charged forwards. With just a few punches, he had killed this fierce beast, leaving behind a near-transparent crystal.
This was probably a spatial crystal.
Since he knew his target, Ling Han naturally wasn't in a hurry to find the giant on the island.
After a month, he found more than a hundred spatial crystals, but what depressed him was the fact that he actually had not found that spatial giant yet.
The space here was complicated, and he would be teleported from time to time. It was too difficult to directly reach his destination.
However, in this one month, Ling Han didn't waste any time. He found the spatial crystals, and at the same time, transmitted each node to a specific location, forming another map in his mind.
In this way, wherever he went somewhere on the island in the future, he would know what route he should choose.
At this moment, someone finally reached the island.
Another month passed, and Ling Han had more or less travelled all over this island. Finally, he found the corresponding giant.
This giant was also almost transparent, as if it was made of crystal, but there were Regulations flowing inside, which was very mysterious.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. Recently, his hunger had become even more intense, and he had almost eaten all those spatial crystals. Now that he had finally met the giant, he could redeem them.
"Ling Han!" A voice rang out.
Shi Hao.
Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed down, "Hold on first."
He was too hungry, and was not in the mood to fight.
Shi Hao's face involuntarily twitched. What kind of reaction was this?
What do you take me for?
"Ling Han!" He raised his voice, and roared again. Then, he charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head. As he dodged, he threw the 200 spatial crystals at the giant, "Exchange for two drops of dragon saliva."
"Little guy, you're working hard!" the spatial giant said with a smile as he threw out two drops of dragon's saliva.
Ling Han dodged Shi Hao's attack, and opened his mouth to swallow the two drops of dragon saliva.
Surging energy surged, and his hunger instantly disappeared.
He laughed loudly, and looked towards Shi Hao, saying calmly, "I haven't gone to find you yet, yet you have delivered yourself to my doorstep."
"Ling Han, today is different from the past. Your glory is no more," Shi Hao Hao said proudly.

In his eyes, Ling Han was forced to cultivate some strange technique because of the sudden appearance of Yang Yihuan, Myriad Dao, and the others. As a result, a huge problem arose, and his cultivation level declined instead of advancing.
And now, you still want to threaten me?
Haha.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and crooked a finger at Shi Hao. "Come, I'm in a good mood now, so I'll play with you."

"Stop pretending to be strong." Shi Hao humphed, "Your little deception has long since been seen through. No matter how pretentious you are, it would not be able to conceal the fact that you are weak on the inside."
Ling Han clapped his hands, and said, "I've let you say everything, so let's battle."
"That's precisely my intention." Shi Hao moved. His only worry was that Ling Han would run, and he really couldn't catch up to him.
However, how could Ling Han possibly escape this time?
He stretched out a finger, and tapped on Shi Hao.
"Ignorant!" Shi Hao sneered, while surprise rose up in his heart. How did Ling Han dare to face him head-on?
Where did you get such courage from?
He didn't care. Ling Han choosing to exchange blows with him instead of running was exactly what he wanted.
"I'll send you on your way!" he roared. He unleashed his full power, aiming to kill Ling Han with a single strike. In any case, plucking Ling Han's soul would allow him to know all of his secrets.

chapters.title: Chapter 4429 The stone door appears again
paragraphs: Ling Han shook his head, and pressed down with his hand. Shi Hao's attack was forcefully stopped.
Hiss, Shi Hao instantly inhaled sharply.
This was too terrifying.
He was a Two Star Sect Master, so just how terrifying was his attack? Yet, it was easily blocked by Ling Han? Just how inconceivable was this?
Weren't you in the Spirit Transformation Tier? Weren't you having a great problem in cultivation?
'F*ck! What the f*ck!'
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Your uncle is still your uncle. How is it? Are you convinced now?"
Shi Hao was speechless. Ling Han had easily blocked his attack, which meant that Ling Han's strength was far superior to his.
There was absolute disbelief in his heart, but reality surpassed all else, rendering him speechless.
After a long while, he asked darkly, "Why?"an
After all, he was the Imperial Son, so he had already regained his composure.
"Because I'm strong," Ling Han said with a smile.
This show-off.
Shi Hao really wanted to slap Ling Han, but he didn't have the strength to do so, so he could only swallow his anger.
"There's nothing else to say. We can only battle." His fighting spirit was firm. Even if he was outmatched, he could not bring shame to the pride of the Imperial Clan.
Moreover, even if he was willing to swallow his pride and beg for mercy, would Ling Han show any mercy?
Ling Han nodded. In a life-or-death situation, the Imperial Clan still had some backbone. No wonder when the Yin souls invaded, the Imperial Clans didn't just bother about themselves.
After all, there was still the blood of the Great Emperor flowing in their bodies. No matter how despicable they were, they would not fall to the level of currying favor from their enemies.
"Alright, I'll let you die a more dignified death."
Shi Hao laughed loudly, "It is still unknown who will emerge victorious!"
He was the first to move. Using the Imperial Technique, he extracted the Dao of Heaven and Earth, which turned into a divine spear that stabbed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han merely threw a punch. Peng, the divine spear immediately crumbled.
The force of his punch did not diminish, and continued to smash towards Shi Hao.
Shi Hao sighed. He was really no match for Ling Han.
There was nothing much to say. Weng, nine spiritual bodies walked out of his body, and along with himself, fled in ten different directions.
Yi, wasn't it agreed that they would only battle?
Ling Han shook his head, and leaped out. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unfolded, and his speed was instantly raised to its peak.
Did he think that just because he didn't have a spiritual body, he couldn't deal with this trick?
Peng!
He instantly caught up to a spiritual body and threw a punch with his right fist. Destructive Energy surged, and with a single strike, the spiritual body was obliterated.
Ling Han gave chase again. With a single step, the flaming phoenix wings flapped, and he had already caught up to the second spiritual body.
Peng, it was still destroyed with a single punch.

Only by combining the spiritual bodies with the self could one form the most powerful battle prowess of the Minor Advanced Tier. This was also why Ling Han had insisted on fusing the spiritual bodies into the self.

Now that Shi Hao had released all of his spiritual bodies, though this had increased the success rate of his escape, it had similarly weakened the battle prowess of himself and his spiritual bodies by tenfold.
In the first place, he was no match for Ling Han, what more when his own battle prowess was decreased?
One punch, one kill, without a doubt.
Shi Hao was greatly shocked. He had not thought that the two spiritual bodies would only be able to block two punches from Ling Han, and would not be able to have the effect of detaining him.
At this moment, Ling Han took another step and caught up to the third spiritual body.
Peng, it was still destroyed with a single punch.
However, at this moment, Shi Hao had already rushed to a spatial transfer node. Xiu, he instantly disappeared without a trace.
He had already appeared 6000 meters away.
Ling Han ignored him, and continued to hunt down the spiritual bodies.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
One punch, one person, and only another seven punches, and all the spiritual bodies were completely destroyed.
Shi Hao was extremely flustered, and hurriedly arrived at the next transfer point. Xiu, with another transfer, he had already arrived at the other side of the island.
The distance of teleportation this time was even greater.
He should have thrown Ling Han off his tail by now.
Shi Hao thought to himself. He naturally did not dare to relax and be careless, and continued to rapidly run forwards.
However, as he ran, another person suddenly appeared in front of him.
Ling Han!
He was numb with shock. How was this possible?
Ling Han had actually appeared in front of him?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "I know the transfer node of every place here like the back of my hand, so... it is naturally nothing strange for it to appear in front of you."
'Still not strange? You're a monster!'

Shi Hao did not know what else to say. Previously, he had still been able to make a bold claim: only battle. But now? His nine spiritual bodies had all been destroyed, and he was not even qualified to put his life on the line.
"Any last words?" Ling Han asked.

"Whether it is the Golden Generation, Yang Yihuan, or Myriad Dao, they all have the ability to kill you. I will wait for you in the underworld!" Shi Hao shouted loudly. He knew that this time, it would definitely be difficult for him to escape the calamity.
"Heh, you had best wait for me to send them down to accompany you." Ling Han shook his head, and shot out a punch.
Peng! Shi Hao was instantly killed. Under the effects of the Destructive Energy, the Substitution Seal was also rendered ineffective, and he died completely.
Ling Han searched for a while, and took away the Spatial Spirit Tool that Shi Hao had.
He strode off, and continued to search for spatial crystals to increase his cultivation level, charging to the end of the Tenth Change.
Now that he had reached this stage, he could no longer rely on cultivation techniques to cultivate. He could only rely on natural treasures.

Time passed slowly, and Ling Han collected more and more spatial crystals. He encountered Feng Miaoling, the crazy woman, a few more times. This woman was indeed determined to take him as her husband. She would chase him every time she saw him, and would not give up no matter what.
Finally, more than half a year later, the spatial giant escaped.
Instantly, everyone scattered like birds and beasts, fleeing for their lives.
Ling Han walked through the air. No one's speed could compare to his.
However, the situation this time was slightly different.
He had already flown on the sea for fifteen days, but there was still no land ahead of him.
Yi, could it be that there wasn't an eighth island?
He flew for another seven days, and finally, a horizon appeared in the distance.
What would the eighth island be?
That's not right!
Ling Han was astonished. This wasn't an island, but rather a stone door!
Heavens, there was a massive stone door on the sea. It was as large as land, and towered into the clouds. Merely its aura was filled with intimidation.
Ling Han walked for a while longer, and then arrived at the stone door.
This wasn't the stone door at the entrance to Imperial Path. It wasn't as large as it looked, but it was also filled with an ancient aura, as if it had transmigrated from the primitive age.
There were also various carvings on the stone door.
Ling Han looked closely. The top was the True Dragon, True Phoenix, Qilin and other Divine Beasts. Next, there were human figures, but some of them had bird wings, while others had flaming bodies.
Yi!
Ling Han suddenly faltered. He saw a familiar figure.
Ancestral King Pan Shi!
Ling Han had heard many legends about the Great Emperors, but the only Great Emperor that he had truly "seen" was Ancestral King Pan Shi.
That was because he had obtained a portion of Ancestral King Pan Shi's memories, regarding how this Great Emperor had grown from a stubborn rock to a supreme overlord.
He was certain that there were a few carvings on the stone door that were related to this Ancestral King.
Why?
Ling Han was astonished. Why was the image of the Ancestral King Pan Shi here?
Who had inscribed it?

Hold on, there were Divine Beasts such as the True Dragon, the True Phoenix and so on at the top, as well as later Great Emperors such as Ancestral King Pan Shi... hiss, could it be that what was engraved on this was the Great Emperors of all generations?
