Even if he was outmatched, he could not bring shame to the pride of the Imperial Clan.
Moreover, even if he was willing to swallow his pride and beg for mercy, would Ling Han show any mercy?
Ling Han nodded.
In a life-or-death situation, the Imperial Clan still had some backbone.
No wonder when the Yin souls invaded, the Imperial Clans didn't just bother about themselves.
After all, there was still the blood of the Great Emperor flowing in their bodies.
No matter how despicable they were, they would not fall to the level of currying favor from their enemies.
"Alright, I'll let you die a more dignified death."
Shi Hao laughed loudly, "It is still unknown who will emerge victorious!"
He was the first to move.
Using the Imperial Technique, he extracted the Dao of Heaven and Earth, which turned into a divine spear that stabbed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han merely threw a punch.
Peng, the divine spear immediately crumbled.
The force of his punch did not diminish, and continued to smash towards Shi Hao.
Shi Hao sighed.
He was really no match for Ling Han.
There was nothing much to say.
Weng, nine spiritual bodies walked out of his body, and along with himself, fled in ten different directions.
Yi, wasn't it agreed that they would only battle?
Ling Han shook his head, and leaped out.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unfolded, and his speed was instantly raised to its peak.
Did he think that just because he didn't have a spiritual body, he couldn't deal with this trick?
Peng!
He instantly caught up to a spiritual body and threw a punch with his right fist.
Destructive Energy surged, and with a single strike, the spiritual body was obliterated.
Ling Han gave chase again.
With a single step, the flaming phoenix wings flapped, and he had already caught up to the second spiritual body.
Peng, it was still destroyed with a single punch.
Only by combining the spiritual bodies with the self could one form the most powerful battle prowess of the Minor Advanced Tier.
This was also why Ling Han had insisted on fusing the spiritual bodies into the self.

Now that Shi Hao had released all of his spiritual bodies, though this had increased the success rate of his escape, it had similarly weakened the battle prowess of himself and his spiritual bodies by tenfold.
In the first place, he was no match for Ling Han, what more when his own battle prowess was decreased?
One punch, one kill, without a doubt.
Shi Hao was greatly shocked.
He had not thought that the two spiritual bodies would only be able to block two punches from Ling Han, and would not be able to have the effect of detaining him.
At this moment, Ling Han took another step and caught up to the third spiritual body.
Peng, it was still destroyed with a single punch.
However, at this moment, Shi Hao had already rushed to a spatial transfer node.
Xiu, he instantly disappeared without a trace.
He had already appeared 6000 meters away.
Ling Han ignored him, and continued to hunt down the spiritual bodies.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
One punch, one person, and only another seven punches, and all the spiritual bodies were completely destroyed.
Shi Hao was extremely flustered, and hurriedly arrived at the next transfer point.
Xiu, with another transfer, he had already arrived at the other side of the island.
The distance of teleportation this time was even greater.
He should have thrown Ling Han off his tail by now.
Shi Hao thought to himself.
He naturally did not dare to relax and be careless, and continued to rapidly run forwards.
However, as he ran, another person suddenly appeared in front of him.
Ling Han!
He was numb with shock.
How was this possible?
Ling Han had actually appeared in front of him?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "I know the transfer node of every place here like the back of my hand, so... it is naturally nothing strange for it to appear in front of you."
'Still not strange?
You're a monster!'
Shi Hao did not know what else to say.
Previously, he had still been able to make a bold claim: only battle.
But now?
His nine spiritual bodies had all been destroyed, and he was not even qualified to put his life on the line.
"Any last words?" Ling Han asked.
"Whether it is the Golden Generation, Yang Yihuan, or Myriad Dao, they all have the ability to kill you.
I will wait for you in the underworld!" Shi Hao shouted loudly.
He knew that this time, it would definitely be difficult for him to escape the calamity.
"Heh, you had best wait for me to send them down to accompany you." Ling Han shook his head, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
Shi Hao was instantly killed.
Under the effects of the Destructive Energy, the Substitution Seal was also rendered ineffective, and he died completely.
Ling Han searched for a while, and took away the Spatial Spirit Tool that Shi Hao had.
He strode off, and continued to search for spatial crystals to increase his cultivation level, charging to the end of the Tenth Change.
Now that he had reached this stage, he could no longer rely on cultivation techniques to cultivate.
He could only rely on natural treasures.
Time passed slowly, and Ling Han collected more and more spatial crystals.
He encountered Feng Miaoling, the crazy woman, a few more times.
This woman was indeed determined to take him as her husband.
She would chase him every time she saw him, and would not give up no matter what.
Finally, more than half a year later, the spatial giant escaped.
Instantly, everyone scattered like birds and beasts, fleeing for their lives.
Ling Han walked through the air.
No one's speed could compare to his.
However, the situation this time was slightly different.
He had already flown on the sea for fifteen days, but there was still no land ahead of him.
Yi, could it be that there wasn't an eighth island?
He flew for another seven days, and finally, a horizon appeared in the distance.
What would the eighth island be?
That's not right!
Ling Han was astonished.
This wasn't an island, but rather a stone door!
Heavens, there was a massive stone door on the sea.
It was as large as land, and towered into the clouds.
Merely its aura was filled with intimidation.
Ling Han walked for a while longer, and then arrived at the stone door.
This wasn't the stone door at the entrance to Imperial Path.
It wasn't as large as it looked, but it was also filled with an ancient aura, as if it had transmigrated from the primitive age.
There were also various carvings on the stone door.
Ling Han looked closely.
The top was the True Dragon, True Phoenix, Qilin and other Divine Beasts.
Next, there were human figures, but some of them had bird wings, while others had flaming bodies.
Yi!
Ling Han suddenly faltered.
He saw a familiar figure.
Ancestral King Pan Shi!
Ling Han had heard many legends about the Great Emperors, but the only Great Emperor that he had truly "seen" was Ancestral King Pan Shi.
That was because he had obtained a portion of Ancestral King Pan Shi's memories, regarding how this Great Emperor had grown from a stubborn rock to a supreme overlord.
He was certain that there were a few carvings on the stone door that were related to this Ancestral King.
Why?
Ling Han was astonished.
Why was the image of the Ancestral King Pan Shi here?
Who had inscribed it?

Hold on, there were Divine Beasts such as the True Dragon, the True Phoenix and so on at the top, as well as later Great Emperors such as Ancestral King Pan Shi... hiss, could it be that what was engraved on this was the Great Emperors of all generations?

chapters.title: Chapter 4430 The Great Emperor appears
paragraphs: Ling Han looked up at this stone door, his face filled with surprise.
Was this a family portrait of the Great Emperors?
His eyes swept over them, and memorized the appearances of the Great Emperors one after another.
Yi, was this the ancestor of Brother Monkey, the Battle Saint Emperor?

Ling Han saw a Great Emperor with the face of a monkey. He wielded a metal staff, and there was also a tail growing from his behind. It was clearly just a stone carving, yet it exuded a boundless domineering aura that wanted to pierce a hole into heaven and earth.
"And this is the ancestor of the perverted pig?"
He saw another Great Emperor. He actually had a pig's head, and held a nine-tooth rake in his hand, exuding a wild aura.
"It can't be, right? The pervert pig really has a Great Emperor Tier-level ancestor!"
Ling Han had always thought that the perverted pig was just boasting. Judging by its appearance, it did not have the slightest bit of the bearing of a descendant of a Great Emperor.
Sigh, but he just had to be.

Ling Han's knowledge of Great Emperors was limited, and he could only identify a few Great Emperors. As for the others, he could only keep them in mind. When he found some information in the future, he would make a correct identification.
"There would be lapses in history from time to time. In fact, even now, it is impossible to calculate exactly how many Great Emperors have appeared in history."
"However, in this place, the image of every Great Emperor is clearly displayed."
"It should be known that it is not every Great Emperor that has walked through Imperial Path."
"Strange, who exactly carved this?"
Ling Han was curious. He tried to bombard the great doors, but even if he used Destructive Energy, the stone doors still did not move. He was completely helpless.
Hiss, what cultivation level did the person who had carved it have?
Saints couldn't enter this place!
Ling Han couldn't figure it out no matter what. Involuntarily, he couldn't help but feel angry, and punched the stone door.
Instantly, a terrifying aura appeared, and a figure actually walked out of the stone door.
Instantly, a terrifying aura appeared, and a figure actually walked out of the stone door.
F***, Ling Han was dumbfounded. This was actually the Great Emperor that his fist had landed on.
Without another word, this Great Emperor immediately launched an offensive at Ling Han.
It was only a simple palm strike, but it was world-shaking, and was extremely perfect.
Ling Han hurriedly brandished his fists to parry. Boom, boom, boom! The two of them battled fiercely.
This Great Emperor clearly wasn't real, but he definitely wasn't just an empty image either. His battle prowess was incredibly terrifying.
The Great Emperor was naturally domineering. His punches and palm strikes all exuded a might that could suppress the heavens and earth.
After a few moves, Ling Han immediately understood.
The cultivation level of this Great Emperor was unknown, but his power was completely equal to his. This was a completely equal-level battle in the true sense of the word.
In the eyes of others, this was practically hopelessness.
This was a Great Emperor, the synonym for invincible in the world. Even if his cultivation level was suppressed, he should still be invincible among his peers. Who could match him?
But for Ling Han, his ultimate goal had always been a Great Emperor. So what if he faced a Great Emperor at the same cultivation level?
He was unafraid. In fact, he was confident that he could defeat him.
'Come!'
His fighting spirit soared, and he began to battle with the projection of the Great Emperor.
Where had the Great Emperor gone after his death?

The soul had not gone to the Netherworld, but had rather been directly absorbed by the heaven and earth, and become a part of it. Thus, it should be very normal for the heaven and earth to be able to manifest the image of the Great Emperor.
Yi, going by that theory, could it be that the Battle Saint Emperor had already died?
Peng!
He gritted his teeth. The palm strike from the projection of the Great Emperor had landed on his left shoulder, almost breaking his bones. He did not dare to be distracted any longer.
This was a Great Emperor!
Ling Han set everything else aside, and only had the thought of battle.
A Great Emperor at the same cultivation level was really too strong.

What Golden Generation? Compared to the real Great Emperor, they were practically trash. He really did not know how they could bring themselves to compare themselves to the Great Emperors of the past.

In a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han was confident that he could suppress any Golden Generation single-handedly. However, the projection of a Great Emperor was completely capable of opposing him. It was so powerful that it could destroy the heavens and earth, and was indescribably domineering.
However, the victor would definitely be me.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and countered aggressively, not showing any weakness at all.
However, he soon fell into a disadvantage.
Why? It was clear that his power was not weak.
Ling Han quickly understood. That was because the Great Emperor had created his own path. Thus, even though their power was clearly equal, he still had the upper hand in terms of battle prowess.
After all, power was only a part of battle prowess.
After understanding this, Ling Han counterattacked as he continued to smooth out the path he had taken.
However, this was only the beginning, and it was still far from being complete.
This was just right. He could use this opportunity to continue expanding his territory.
However, after battling for only a day, the projection of the Great Emperor disappeared.
Ling Han immediately sat down in a cross-legged position, recalling the previous battle scenes, capturing every mistake he had made, and then went to make adjustments.
This help was really too great.
Who could ask a Great Emperor to personally spar with them?
No wonder this was called Imperial Path.
A day later, Ling Han continued to issue challenges.
It was very simple. Whichever Great Emperor you wanted to challenge, you would have to pat on the corresponding stone carving of the Great Emperor, and the image of the Great Emperor would appear.
Fight, fight, fight.
The battle time of the Great Emperor's projection was limited, with each battle lasting one day.
This was enough.
Ling Han pondered for a day every day he battled. Slowly, he discovered that his battle prowess was increasing.

This was inconceivable. Logically speaking, he should have long since touched the ceiling of Spirit Transformation Tier-level battle prowess, but on these strongest foundations, he was still steadily improving. It had to be admitted that this was a miracle.
After a month, Ling Han discovered that there was finally a clear direction on the path he wanted to take.
It was still far from the finishing line, but finally, it was no longer vague.

On the other hand, when he was fighting against the projection of the Great Emperor, he had also turned from returning two strikes in every ten strikes to returning three strikes in every ten strikes.
His improvement was obvious!
Another half month later, others finally arrived.
Feng Miaoling.
However, this time, Feng Miaoling merely smiled beautifully at him before turning her attention to the massive stone door, a reverent expression on her pretty face.
These were the generations of Great Emperors, and any one of them was an overlord that had suppressed an era, so they were naturally deserving of respect.
She seemed to be very familiar with this, and immediately sent out a palm strike, activating the projection of a Great Emperor, and began to battle.

This was very normal. She was also an old prodigy like Yang Yihuan. She had entered the Imperial Path more than once, and at most, it was because she had not chosen the same rainbow bridge before. Thus, it was normal that she was very familiar with this place.
The power of the Great Emperor that she had battled against had increased considerably, and was completely in line with hers. This was a true battle of equal cultivation levels.
However, she was completely inferior to Ling Han. They had only exchanged a hundred moves, and she had already been defeated.
Feng Miaoling showed a hint of defiance, but at the same time, there was also a sliver of pride.

She was brimming with confidence, and she thought that she would be able to rival a Great Emperor at the same cultivation level this time. However, she had still lost terribly, and she hadn't been able to fight back at all. She had been defeated after enduring 100 exchanges. However, how many people could withstand 100 exchanges from a Great Emperor at the same cultivation level?
With this in mind, she couldn't help but turn to look at Ling Han.
If it was this guy, he should be able to last three hundred moves... no, five hundred moves.
After all, he was the man that she had her eye on, so it was only natural that he was so strong.
Of course, he was definitely no match for the Great Emperor.

It was not that Ling Han was really inferior to the Great Emperor of the past, but rather because this was a Great Emperor that had had his power suppressed, and not a Great Emperor that had not attained Dao. These were two completely different matters.
Right at this moment, Ling Han stood up and slammed his palm onto the stone door.

chapters.title: Chapter 4431 Opening the doors
paragraphs: Peng! Ling Han slammed his palm onto the stone door.
A streak of light shot out in response, turning into the projection of a Great Emperor.

Without another word, this projection of the Great Emperor immediately charged towards Ling Han. Every move was indescribably amazing. It was clear that their power was equal, but the might that the Great Emperor delivered was still much stronger.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and charged forwards fearlessly.
Immediately, Feng Miaoling's beautiful eyes widened, completely in disbelief.
What, what, what!
Ling Han was actually exchanging blows with the projection of the Great Emperor!
No, no, no. He was not that powerful yet. Instead, in every ten moves, he could return three moves.
But even so, she was still completely stunned.

For example, she was already the strongest Imperial Daughter, and had walked through Imperial Path quite a few times, tempering her battle prowess to the pinnacle, but she was still unable to fight back in the face of the projection of the Great Emperor.
To compare oneself with another, it was really infuriating.
This was really a monster!
Though Ling Han was still at a disadvantage, if this corresponding Great Emperor had really returned to his youth, he may not be a match for Ling Han.

Firstly, the Great Emperor might not have reached Ling Han's level at that time. After all, for a Spirit Transformation Tier to be capable of rivalling a Sect Master, or even Two Star or Three Star Sect Master, this was unheard of, and no Great Emperor had ever done so when he was young.
Secondly, the reason why these projections of Great Emperors were so powerful was because they possessed battle experience on the level of Great Emperors. They had already forged their own paths.
Thus, even if their power was suppressed, they were still no match for these projections.
But what about Ling Han?
Monster, a super monster.
Feng Miaoling stared blankly. She had already overestimated Ling Han, but from the look of things now, she had still underestimated him. Furthermore, she had far underestimated him.
So strong. As it turned out, even before becoming Emperor, he could still be as strong as this.
She shook her head, and for the first time, felt dispirited. As it turned out, she was still very far from being the strongest.
Then, she broke into a smile.
It didn't matter. The strongest would be her man.
After battling for a day and night, the projection of the Great Emperor disappeared.

Ling Han immediately began to digest this precious battle experience. He had already reached a point. If he could cross over, he was sure that he would be able to take another solid step on his own path.
The night passed, and more people came. Moreover, they came one after another, almost endlessly.

Three Imperial Sons arrived, but they were all ordinary-level. Then, it was Dao Child, and practically all of them were Dao Childs. The remaining were mediocre, and no longer had the right to come here.
When they saw Ling Han, these people all revealed heated expressions.
In their eyes, Ling Han was a walking great opportunity that they could grasp.

"Who dares?" Seeing Ling Han sitting in a cross-legged position, it was obvious that he was digesting his experience from the battle. Feng Miaoling immediately stepped out and drew her treasured sword. Her cold eyes swept over them, her killing intent blazing.
"Miss, this has nothing to do with you. Don't protect this person, or else—"
Pu!
A Dao Child wanted to open his mouth to threaten her, but before he could finish his words, Feng Miaoling beheaded him with a slash of her sword.
Sword light danced unhindered, its might terrifying.
This instantly intimidated everyone, and they shivered, not daring to speak any further.
She was a demonic woman, who would kill at the slightest disagreement.
The three Imperial Sons also frowned. Though Feng Miaoling had only made one move, it made them realize that this woman was incredibly frightening. Even they themselves may not be a match for her.
But this was such a good opportunity!
Ling Han's cultivation had developed a huge problem, and his abilities had fallen to rock bottom. This was the best time to kill him. Why had a demonic woman suddenly appeared out of nowhere?
"May I ask how should I address you, miss?" An Imperial Son asked Feng Miaoling.
The three Imperial Sons were all conflicted. Why was Ling Han so good with women?
Previously, there was Chi Menghan, and now, there was Feng Miaoling. They both had the aptitude of the Golden Generation, yet they had both been blind enough to fall in love with Ling Han.
"Get lost!" Feng Miaoling had no intention of answering at all. She slashed out with her sword, capable of piercing through the heavens.
The sword slashed over, and that Imperial Son hurriedly retreated, his face completely pale with shock.
She was too strong. He was completely no match for her.
Was this the Golden Generation?
"This is my future husband. Whoever dares to touch him will become enemies with me, Feng Miaoling!" the woman declared proudly.
At this moment, everyone was about to have a breakdown.
Why would such a powerful Imperial Daughter actually take a fancy to a weak piece of trash like Ling Han?
Hadn't this guy developed a huge problem in his cultivation? Hadn't he long since fallen off the pedestal?
Why, how could such a trashy guy still manage to court the Imperial Daughter?
How could this be believed?

There was nothing else they could do. These people could only go and activate the Great Emperor's carving on the stone door. Fighting with this kind of existence was a rare experience. It was too helpful.
Most people would only be able to last ten moves before being defeated, and some people were even insta-killed.
This was not just a great opportunity, but also a great danger.
It was as if it was saying, "The might of the Great Emperor cannot be insulted. You can't even block a single move, and you still want to spar with the Great Emperor?"
Naturally, the only fate was death.
In this way, everyone shivered. They had all decided to recover to their prime condition, and only then would they issue another challenge.
Meanwhile, Ling Han had sunk into a state of deep comprehension. On his own path, he was about to take a very crucial step. Thus, he had completely no time to continue the challenge.
Another three days later, a terrifying aura swept over.
"Not good!" Everyone shivered. A supreme elite was about to arrive.

As expected, after only an instant, seven black dots appeared in the horizon. Then, they rapidly enlarged, turning into seven figures that became larger and larger. They were all giants that were as tall as three hundred meters.
Flame-shaped, ice-formed, lightning-shaped... the giants from the seven islands!
Hiss, they actually charged over together.
These were all Venerate Tiers, and not one of them could be resisted by the combined forces of everyone here, let alone seven of them.
This was a supreme killing tribulation.
Ling Han also woke up at the right moment. This aura was too terrifying, and he naturally could no longer sit still.
He swept an eye over Feng Miaoling, yet saw that there was not the slightest bit of panic in her eyes.
Then it should be fine, because she had entered the Imperial Path more than once.
The others weren't like this. They all boarded the wooden rafts and paddled with all their might.
However, how fast was Venerate Tier?
They would arrive in an instant!
Feng Miaoling glanced at him, and only Ling Han remained calm. As for the others, even the Imperial Sons looked terrified.
She couldn't help but feel a sense of pride. As expected of the man she had her eye on. He was calm in the face of any situation, unlike those idiots.
The seven giants charged over, but they didn't give a toss about Ling Han and the others. Instead, they stared at the stone door.
"Brothers, it's time for revenge."
"Charge in!"
The seven giants pushed open the stone door at the same time. Hong long long, the stone door immediately released a loud sound, and then a crack appeared.
As expected of Venerate Tier. Ling Han had already tried before, and was completely unable to push open the stone door in the slightest.
Obviously, only when the seven giants were released, would they be able to push open the stone doors, and step into the next stage of Imperial Path.
Soon, the crack in the door became wider and wider, and then the door was completely open.
The seven giants did not cast a look at any of them, and directly passed through the great doors, charging out.

sentences.text: Peng!
Ling Han slammed his palm onto the stone door.
A streak of light shot out in response, turning into the projection of a Great Emperor.
Without another word, this projection of the Great Emperor immediately charged towards Ling Han.
Every move was indescribably amazing.
It was clear that their power was equal, but the might that the Great Emperor delivered was still much stronger.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and charged forwards fearlessly.
Immediately, Feng Miaoling's beautiful eyes widened, completely in disbelief.
What, what, what!
Ling Han was actually exchanging blows with the projection of the Great Emperor!
No, no, no.
He was not that powerful yet.
Instead, in every ten moves, he could return three moves.
But even so, she was still completely stunned.

For example, she was already the strongest Imperial Daughter, and had walked through Imperial Path quite a few times, tempering her battle prowess to the pinnacle, but she was still unable to fight back in the face of the projection of the Great Emperor.
To compare oneself with another, it was really infuriating.
This was really a monster!
Though Ling Han was still at a disadvantage, if this corresponding Great Emperor had really returned to his youth, he may not be a match for Ling Han.
Firstly, the Great Emperor might not have reached Ling Han's level at that time.

After all, for a Spirit Transformation Tier to be capable of rivalling a Sect Master, or even Two Star or Three Star Sect Master, this was unheard of, and no Great Emperor had ever done so when he was young.
Secondly, the reason why these projections of Great Emperors were so powerful was because they possessed battle experience on the level of Great Emperors.
They had already forged their own paths.
Thus, even if their power was suppressed, they were still no match for these projections.
But what about Ling Han?
Monster, a super monster.
Feng Miaoling stared blankly.
She had already overestimated Ling Han, but from the look of things now, she had still underestimated him.
Furthermore, she had far underestimated him.
So strong.
As it turned out, even before becoming Emperor, he could still be as strong as this.
She shook her head, and for the first time, felt dispirited.
As it turned out, she was still very far from being the strongest.
Then, she broke into a smile.
It didn't matter.
The strongest would be her man.
After battling for a day and night, the projection of the Great Emperor disappeared.
Ling Han immediately began to digest this precious battle experience.
He had already reached a point.
If he could cross over, he was sure that he would be able to take another solid step on his own path.
The night passed, and more people came.
Moreover, they came one after another, almost endlessly.
Three Imperial Sons arrived, but they were all ordinary-level.
Then, it was Dao Child, and practically all of them were Dao Childs.
The remaining were mediocre, and no longer had the right to come here.
When they saw Ling Han, these people all revealed heated expressions.
In their eyes, Ling Han was a walking great opportunity that they could grasp.
"Who dares?" Seeing Ling Han sitting in a cross-legged position, it was obvious that he was digesting his experience from the battle.
Feng Miaoling immediately stepped out and drew her treasured sword.
Her cold eyes swept over them, her killing intent blazing.
"Miss, this has nothing to do with you.
Don't protect this person, or else—"
Pu!
A Dao Child wanted to open his mouth to threaten her, but before he could finish his words, Feng Miaoling beheaded him with a slash of her sword.
Sword light danced unhindered, its might terrifying.
This instantly intimidated everyone, and they shivered, not daring to speak any further.
She was a demonic woman, who would kill at the slightest disagreement.
The three Imperial Sons also frowned.
Though Feng Miaoling had only made one move, it made them realize that this woman was incredibly frightening.
Even they themselves may not be a match for her.
But this was such a good opportunity!
Ling Han's cultivation had developed a huge problem, and his abilities had fallen to rock bottom.
This was the best time to kill him.
Why had a demonic woman suddenly appeared out of nowhere?
"May I ask how should I address you, miss?" An Imperial Son asked Feng Miaoling.
The three Imperial Sons were all conflicted.
Why was Ling Han so good with women?
Previously, there was Chi Menghan, and now, there was Feng Miaoling.
They both had the aptitude of the Golden Generation, yet they had both been blind enough to fall in love with Ling Han.
"Get lost!" Feng Miaoling had no intention of answering at all.
She slashed out with her sword, capable of piercing through the heavens.
The sword slashed over, and that Imperial Son hurriedly retreated, his face completely pale with shock.
She was too strong.
He was completely no match for her.
Was this the Golden Generation?
"This is my future husband.
Whoever dares to touch him will become enemies with me, Feng Miaoling!" the woman declared proudly.
At this moment, everyone was about to have a breakdown.
Why would such a powerful Imperial Daughter actually take a fancy to a weak piece of trash like Ling Han?
Hadn't this guy developed a huge problem in his cultivation?
Hadn't he long since fallen off the pedestal?
Why, how could such a trashy guy still manage to court the Imperial Daughter?
How could this be believed?
There was nothing else they could do.
These people could only go and activate the Great Emperor's carving on the stone door.
Fighting with this kind of existence was a rare experience.
It was too helpful.
Most people would only be able to last ten moves before being defeated, and some people were even insta-killed.
This was not just a great opportunity, but also a great danger.
It was as if it was saying, "The might of the Great Emperor cannot be insulted.

Naturally, the only fate was death.
In this way, everyone shivered.
They had all decided to recover to their prime condition, and only then would they issue another challenge.
Meanwhile, Ling Han had sunk into a state of deep comprehension.
On his own path, he was about to take a very crucial step.
Thus, he had completely no time to continue the challenge.
Another three days later, a terrifying aura swept over.
"Not good!" Everyone shivered.
A supreme elite was about to arrive.
As expected, after only an instant, seven black dots appeared in the horizon.
Then, they rapidly enlarged, turning into seven figures that became larger and larger.

Obviously, only when the seven giants were released, would they be able to push open the stone doors, and step into the next stage of Imperial Path.

chapters.title: Chapter 4432 North Prosperity City
paragraphs: Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. They had not thought that the crisis would pass so easily.
After resting for a while, someone still wanted to challenge the projection of the Great Emperor, but discovered that there was no reaction from the stone door.
The others went up to give it a try, and the result was the same.
Obviously, after the doors opened, the "benefits" were gone.
This should be a reward for those who had rushed here the earliest. Fighting with a Great Emperor of the same cultivation level would be of great help.

To say who had benefited the most, it was naturally Ling Han. He had arrived too early, and was at least one and a half months ahead of the others. How many times had he exchanged blows with the projection of the Great Emperors?
Helpless, everyone could only enter the great doors one by one. Obviously, this was their next stop.
After passing through the stone door, a plain appeared ahead of them, and looking further behind them, where were the stone doors?
It was clear that there was no turning back now that they had reached this place. They could only forge onwards bravely.

Quite a number of people turned their eyes to Ling Han. This was a great opportunity, and there was a supreme opportunity hidden on him. Furthermore, he himself was in his weakest state, and one only had to move, and he would be able to snatch it.
But when they saw Feng Miaoling standing next to Ling Han with a murderous look on her face, everyone had no choice but to bow their heads.
They could not afford to trifle with her.
They all advanced, fearing that the demonic woman would suddenly develop killing intent and start a massacre.
Ling Han also leaped up, and headed into the distance.
"Wait for me!" Feng Miaoling gave chase.
However, how could Ling Han possibly listen? He unfurled his flaming phoenix wings, and his speed increased instead of decreasing.
Feng Miaoling had only chased a few steps, and Ling Han had already disappeared. She was so furious that she stomped her feet.

Everyone gritted their teeth upon seeing this. With such a heaven-defyingly powerful Imperial Daughter by your side, you actually dislike her? And what struck them even harder was the fact that Feng Miaoling had absolutely no intention of giving up, stubbornly continuing her pursuit.
Sigh!
Comparisons were truly infuriating.
Ling Han set off quickly, and after walking for half a day, a city actually appeared ahead of him.
Yi?
There were no city walls in this city, and it was completely open. One could enter the city from any direction.
Ling Han strolled in, and the city was bustling with noise and excitement.
He activated his eye technique and looked over. However, he was surprised because everyone had the flame of life flickering in their bodies.
These were all real living beings, and not manifestations of heaven and earth.
He did not act rashly. Instead, he strolled around first, and discovered that though there were no inns here, there were still restaurants.
Hence, he entered into the restaurant, and began his investigation.

On the Imperial Path, there were a total of nine such cities. This city was called North Prosperity City, and could be considered as a relay station. It was said that further down, there were many dangers. One out of ten people that entered could come back out.

Thus, those who did not have the courage could stay here. That was because once they reached this place, when the Imperial Path closed, they would be teleported out, and if they did not reach this city, they could only be trapped here forever.
Additionally, it was said that there was also an envoy here, who would select the strongest person and deliver a Qingfeng Order.
However, what exactly was the use of the Qingfeng Order? Everyone was vague in their words, and did not have a specific explanation.
Additionally, no one knew who the envoy was. They only knew that this envoy would observe them secretly, and quietly bestow the Qingfeng Order on them.

—It seemed like the people here were deliberately spreading knowledge to outsiders. There was no need for you to deliberately ask around at all. You only had to sit here for a while, and all the information would be revealed to you.
Ling Han and the others weren't the first batch of people to enter the city. Previously, two groups of people had already arrived.
In other words, it was not only those who had chosen this rainbow bridge, but also those who had taken other rainbow bridges. They had reached this city before them.

Ling Han thought for a moment. The people in the city had said that there were a total of nine such cities on the Imperial Path, and there were 99 rainbow bridges. Then, it should be that the people from every eleven rainbow bridges would gather in one city.
Now that there were the people from three rainbow bridges, there was still a shortage of the people from the eight other bridges.
What was the Qingfeng Order?
Ling Han could leave, but he could also stay and see if he could obtain the Qingfeng Order.
—If he had known earlier, he should have asked Feng Miaoling for guidance.

This thought flashed through his mind, and Ling Han immediately shook his head. Forget it, forget it, he'd better forget it. She was already so enthusiastic now, so if he showed her any goodwill, he really wouldn't be able to throw her off his tail forever.
Ling Han settled down in the city. Though there were no inns here, with his cultivation level, where could he not rest?

It wasn't long before those who had exited the stone door arrived one after another. Not long after, they also received the same information as Ling Han. Only a very small number of people left, and the majority stayed behind.
Those who left did not have any confidence in themselves, and thought that it was impossible for them to obtain the Qingfeng Order, so there was no need to waste time.
It wasn't long before the news of Ling Han's cultivation developing some huge problem spread throughout the entire city.

The evidence was irrefutable, because the majority of the people who entered the city in the third wave had participated in the hunt for Ling Han. Furthermore, at the stone door previously, it was also because Feng Miaoling had stepped out bravely, which saved Ling Han's life.
Instantly, quite a number of people were restless, wanting to capture Ling Han and kill him to snatch the fated opportunity from him.

When Ling Han heard about this, he couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself. At that time, he had been studying his own path, and was not in the mood to pay attention to these trash at all. Yet, this caused others to be even more certain that some problem had developed in his cultivation.
He had no intention of explaining either. This was even better. Whoever wanted to take advantage of his misfortune, he would make them pay the price.

Day after day passed, and more and more people arrived at North Prosperity City. A month later, there were already seven groups of people that had arrived, and they were all people that had taken different rainbow bridges.
There were still four batches.
Another month passed, and the last four groups of people had also arrived.

With this, North Prosperity City was bustling with noise and excitement. There were almost 3000 outsiders, and they were all at least at the Spirit Transformation Tier. The number of Imperial Sons had also reached 30, and this was a very powerful force.
Immediately, the Imperial Sons suggested organizing a martial arts tournament.
Wasn't there an envoy hidden among the ordinary citizens, bestowing the Qingfeng Order on whoever was the strongest?
In that case, wouldn't it be simpler to hold a martial arts competition and directly decide the strongest among them?
With the Imperial Sons taking the lead, the various rules of the martial arts competition were also drafted, one after another.
Because there was still a hidden observer, no one dared to go too far. What if they missed out on the Qingfeng Order because of this reason, then wouldn't that be a great loss?
It wasn't long before the competition began.

It was very simple. Sixteen high platforms had been erected in the plaza of the city. Whoever was capable could stand on them to guard the arena for ten days and face challengers. After ten days, the sixteen people standing on the arena would be seeds, and they would be able to enter into the knockout battles for the top sixteen.
In this manner, eight would be chosen from the sixteen, four from the eight, two from the four, and then the final battle would be held, and the strongest person would naturally appear.
Another day later, tall platforms were erected, and the tournament began.

These high platforms were all built from special stone materials, and possessed powerful resistance. They could even withstand the attacks of Sect Masters. They would not be destroyed abruptly in battle.
Ling Han also strolled over. He wasn't in a hurry to go on stage.
"Yi, Ling Han?"
"He actually dares to come here?"
"It can't be that he too wants to participate in the tournament, right?"
"Hahaha!"
Everyone burst into laughter. A piece of trash actually dared to come and embarrass himself?
Ling Han stroked his chin. Some people were asking for a beating.

chapters.title: Chapter 4433 Step Out
paragraphs: "You guys... are you all asking for a beating?" Ling Han swept an eye over them, a faint smile on his face.
"Hahahaha!" Everyone burst into laughter.

In their eyes, this was the most powerless threat. It was said that Ling Han's power had already dropped to the First Change of the Spirit Transformation Tier, and he could be suppressed by anyone here.
He still dared to issue threats? Hehe.
"Ling Han, aren't you going to take a piss and look at your reflection?"
"That's right, don't you have any idea how weak you are?"
"Come, come, come, let me battle you!"
"No, I'll do it."

Everyone scrambled over one another, wanting to have a battle with Ling Han. After all, Ling Han had been in the limelight too much previously. Whoever could become the first person to defeat Ling Han would definitely be famous.
Moreover, Ling Han still possessed a supreme opportunity. Who didn't want to obtain it and become the second Ling Han?

"Hehe, is there any need for us to make a move?" A young man dressed in red and blue brocade walked out, his arms crossed behind his back, his expression filled with pride, "Just leave this kind of weak trash to my servant."
Behind him, there were two young men standing with their hands by their sides.
"Yi, the Hai Yuan Holy Land's Ma Qiyang."
"Amongst Dao Childs, he can be considered one of the strongest."

"It's said that he had heaven-defying luck and obtained the inheritance of a Saint. Although he's only 400 or so years old, he's already advanced to the Spirit Transformation Tier. He's only one step away from becoming a great elite of Minor Advanced Tier."
Many people recognized him, and they all whispered among themselves, expressing their reverence for this man.
It was also because of this Ma Qiyang's strength that everyone shut their mouths, not daring to compete with him.
This was a Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change elite! Moreover, he was only 400 years old! Apart from Imperial Sons, who else could rival him?

In the distance, all the Imperial Sons merely watched coldly from the sidelines. They were also happy to have these people humiliate Ling Han. In any case, no matter who had obtained the great opportunity that belonged to Ling Han, would they dare to take it all for themselves?
You see, you were so awesome all those years ago, and still dared to call yourself the Imperial Son Killer, and what was the result?
The Imperial Son was the Imperial Son, forever high and mighty.
At this time, one of the two servants behind Ma Qiyang walked out.

Previously, he had stood with his hands by his sides, completely inconspicuous, but now that he had walked out, it was as if a supreme treasured sword had been unsheathed. Instantly, he shone brilliantly.
"Hiss, isn't this guy Sheng Haiyuan?"
"I know, the Dao Child of the Liuhe Sect!"
"Heavens, though the Liuhe Sect is a Venerate Tier-level force, Sheng Haiyuan is still a Dao Child of a sect, no matter what. Why is he willing to become Ma Qiyang's subordinate?"
"Obviously, Ma Qiyang is even more powerful than we had imagined."
Someone recognized this servant, and when he told them his history, it instantly caused everyone to be stunned.
No wonder Ma Qiyang was so full of confidence. That was because his servant was also a Dao Child. Though his level was slightly inferior, it could not be considered weak either.
Sheng Haiyuan stood in front of Ling Han, his eyes disdainful, a cold smirk on his face.
Ling Han was once a label for the unattainable for him, but now? He was about to defeat him with his own hands.
"You people have gone too far!" Xiu, a figure streaked past, and stood in front of Ling Han. Her slender figure was perfect, and her pretty face was enchanting.
This was an exceptional beauty, and immediately, a great many people in the area looked besotted.
Beautiful, too beautiful.
"Song Lan!" someone blurted out.
As it turned out, she was the ninth beauty of the galaxy. No wonder she was indescribably beautiful, making one want to commit crime.
"So it's Song Lan!"
"The ninth most beautiful woman in the galaxy."
"Beautiful, truly beautiful!"
"If I could sleep with her for a night, I would be willing to live a hundred years less."
"Hehe, in your dreams!"
Song Lan was a well-known figure, and she was immediately recognized by a great many people. A great many people had dirty mouths, and their expressions were perverted.

However, she was a supreme beauty, after all, so he didn't want to be rude.
Yet Song Lan held her sword in front of her, "If you want to go over, you have to ask my sword first!"
Yi, was she determined to protect Ling Han?

Everyone couldn't help but feel jealous. Song Lan was a stunning beauty, ranked ninth in the galaxy, and her martial arts cultivation had also advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier. With her age of less than a hundred, she could completely be called a super genius.
But it was this kind of prodigy that was both talented and beautiful, yet was completely devoted to a piece of trash. Anyone would feel suffocated, right?
What right did he have?
Ma Qiyang finally spoke up, and said, "Haiyuan, be careful when you attack. Don't hurt Celestial maiden Song."
"Yes, Young Master!" Sheng Haiyuan turned around and answered respectfully.
Then, he set his eyes on Song Lan, clasped his hands, and said, "Celestial maiden Song, apologies!"
Xiu, he charged over.
Song Lan brandished his sword to parry, instantly unleashing battle prowess of Spirit Transformation Tier.

However, in the Spirit Transformation Tier, the difference of one or two minor levels really couldn't be afforded. That was because the spiritual body was independent of the original, and with every additional spiritual body, the increase in battle prowess was real and solid.

Sheng Haiyuan's three spiritual bodies appeared at the same time, and that was a four-on-two situation. Furthermore, every spiritual body had an absolute advantage in power, so this kind of battle was naturally one-sided.
Fortunately, Sheng Haiyuan didn't dare to wound Song Lan. He was extremely careful, and this allowed Song Lan to last for so long. Otherwise, she would definitely have been defeated instantly.

Even so, she only managed to last a hundred moves, and Song Lan and her spiritual body were already restrained by two spiritual bodies of Sheng Haiyuan respectively, rendering them unable to continue fighting.

Hehe, he had indeed only used a spiritual body, but both himself and the spiritual body had the strength of Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change, and still had an absolute advantage.
"Ling Han, have you really fallen to the point of relying on women?"
"Haha, what Imperial Son Killer, you have the nerve to bear such a nickname."
"How embarrassing!"
"Get lost, don't dirty our eyes!"
Quite a few people hit him when he was down, and began to mock and ridicule him.
Ling Han was destined to be a thing of the past. Thus, this should be the only chance to humiliate him.
Ling Han sighed. These people were so despicable.
Previously, he had not made a move because he had seen that Song Lan was not in danger, so he would just treat it as a training exercise for her.
Alright, he would deal with these trash first, then go up onto the martial arts ring and defeat those Imperial Sons.
He looked at Sheng Haiyuan, and shook his head, "How many pieces do you want to be smashed into?"
Pu, everyone laughed loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4434 All killed instantly
paragraphs: "Ling Han, are you still living in the past?" Sheng Haiyuan asked disdainfully.

Ling Han shrugged, and said, "Seeing that you were quite polite to Song Lan just now, I had planned to leave you with a complete corpse, but since you insist on courting death, I can only smash you into a shower of blood with a single punch."
"Haha, I discovered that though your strength has declined, your mouth is still as bad as before!" Sheng Haiyuan laughed loudly.

Everyone nodded. Those who had heard of Ling Han's reputation all knew that he, the large black dog and the little azure dragon were all the type to drive people to death with their curses. All of them had sharp mouths.
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, "Make your move. I do not have the time to waste on a minor character."
"Damn it!" Sheng Haiyuan roared furiously, and finally made his move.
Previously, he had wanted to increase his presence. After all, his opponent was Ling Han! However, after Ling Han's repeated mockery, he finally couldn't control himself.
"Die!" He charged over, his fists pummelling furiously. Instantly, the air was filled with his fists. Whether it was a few hundred, or a few thousand, his fists pounded like lightning.
Everyone's eyes lit up. How powerful.
"It's completely on the level of a top-notch Dao Child."
"With such strength, he's actually still willing to become someone's servant?"
"Hiss, just how strong is this Ma Qiyang?"

Everyone exclaimed in shock. If they were at the same cultivation level, how many of them were confident that they could defeat Sheng Haiyuan? More importantly, he was only a servant, so how strong was his master?
Could he compare to the Imperial Son?
"It is rumored that Ma Qiyang has fused with the blood essence of a Saint. It is very possible that it is not empty words."
"This guy may even have the bearing of an Imperial Son!"
"Heavens!"
Sheng Haiyuan was so powerful, which was enough to prove that Ma Qiyang was even more inconceivably powerful.
Meanwhile, Song Lan looked worried, because she had heard that Ling Han's cultivation had gone horribly wrong, and his cultivation level had fallen back to Spirit Transformation Tier First Change.
How was a First Change going to fight a Third Change?
However, there was nothing that could be done. She was being suppressed by Sheng Haiyuan's two spiritual bodies, and could not move at all.
Right at this moment, Ling Han shot out a punch.
In this punch, he brandished it extremely carelessly. Everyone could clearly see the trajectory of the punch, as if it was overwhelmingly slow.
However, when he threw a punch, a terrifying force surged out, like a violent tsunami crashing towards ordinary people.
Peng!
In just a short while, Sheng Haiyuan and his spiritual body immediately crumbled, directly turning into a rain of blood. Then, they were crushed, not even leaving behind the slightest bit of residue.
At this moment, the entire area was silent.
F***, this was called having a huge problem in cultivation?
F***, who said that?
'You're the one with a problem! You've got a problem with your eyes! You've got a problem with your brain!'

Meanwhile, the two spiritual bodies that were suppressing Song Lan were trembling. They were connected to the original on the soul level, and could sense the helplessness that he felt when he died more clearly than others.
That was a crushing power that would drive one to despair!

Subconsciously, the two spiritual bodies stretched out their hands at the same time and placed them on the heads of Song Lan and her spiritual body. They shouted at Ling Han, "Don't come over, or I will kill her!"
As long as her mind was shattered, Song Lan, the ninth beauty of the galaxy, would die.
Ling Han was neither too fast nor too slow. Instead, he showed a smile, "What do you want?"
"What's there to be afraid of?" Sheng Haiyuan had not even opened his mouth, when he heard Ma Qiyang's baleful voice say, "Aren't I still here?"
Hearing these words, Sheng Haiyuan instantly calmed down.
That's right, there was still Ma Qiyang.
He was deeply aware of the strength of this Lord. Otherwise, with his identity as a Dao Child, how could he be willing to acknowledge him as Master?
Yet Ling Han did not even look at Ma Qiyang, and merely said to Sheng Haiyuan, "Let go!"
Sheng Haiyuan ignored him. Since his Master had said that there was no need to be afraid, he naturally had no need to be afraid.
Ling Han shook his head. With a thought, a murderous aura surged out.
Pu, pu! Sheng Haiyuan's two spiritual bodies instantly exploded like balloons.
—The barrage of his murderous aura was presently enough to insta-kill any ordinary Two Star Sect Master. How easy would it be to kill a Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change?
It was precisely because he was confident that he could succeed that he was so calm and unhurried.
Song Lan instantly regained her freedom, and hurriedly ran towards Ling Han.
Killing intent flashed through Ma Qiyang's eyes, and he said balefully, "How dare you kill even my servant."
This was a blatant slap to the face!
Oh, he had just said that there was no need to be afraid and that he was there, and what was the result? Sheng Haiyuan had died.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "Wrong, my courage is much greater than this."
"Ignorant!" Ma Qiyang humphed, and charged towards Ling Han.
He was now extremely furious. This should have been the time for him to show off himself, yet now, it was only paving the way for Ling Han.
It didn't matter. As long as he killed Ling Han, the world would praise his name in the future.
At this moment, Ling Han threw a punch.
It was clear, simple, and direct.
Anyone could see the trajectory of this punch, but no one thought that if they faced this punch head-on, would they be able to parry it in time?
Peng!

Ma Qiyang didn't even have the time to raise his hand to block the attack. The terrifying power of the punch surged over, crushing him forcefully, turning him into a rain of blood that filled the skies.
Heavens!
In an instant, everyone inhaled sharply.
They could not believe their eyes at all.
Was this real?

Wasn't it said that Ma Qiyang was comparable to the Imperial Son? Cultivation level of Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change, and added with the fact that he had fused with the Saint's blood essence, he should have been invincible in a battle of equal cultivation levels, yet he had been destroyed with a single punch.
This, this, this!

Everyone looked at Ling Han in shock. This was different from destroying Sheng Haiyuan. After all, Sheng Haiyuan was only a Spirit Transformation Tier Third Change, but in the case of Ma Qiyang, he was standing at the peak of the Spirit Transformation Tier.
Just how powerful was Ling Han if he could obliterate him with a single punch?
'F*ck your sister! Didn't you say that you had encountered a huge problem in your cultivation?'
Who was screwing them over?
Those who had previously mocked Ling Han were all trembling, feeling as if they had suffered 10,000 points of damage. The extent of psychological trauma was indescribable.
If they had known, they wouldn't have dared to mock him even if they were beaten to death. And to think, they even wanted to kill Ling Han and snatch his fated opportunity.
Wasn't this courting death?
They wanted to cry but had no tears. Which b@stard was screwing them over?

Even those who were walking the same rainbow bridge as Ling Han were dumbfounded. They had personally witnessed Ling Han fleeing on the island, and it was not just once. In fact, even they had gone out to hunt Ling Han down before.
But now, Ling Han was strong to the point that he could insta-kill anyone and anything, which was completely unacceptable to them.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Do you regret it now?"
Everyone hurriedly nodded.
"Too bad, it's too late!" He withdrew his smile, and the barrage of murderous aura activated. Pa, pa, pa, masses of people collapsed.
Looking closely, they were all those who had previously mocked him and wanted to make a move on him. None of them were innocent.
Hiss, this caused everyone else's scalps to go numb.
He didn't even need to raise his hand, yet he could deliver such a precise and fatal strike. This guy's strength had already surpassed common sense, and they couldn't even imagine it.
And on those tournament stages, the Imperial Sons all looked solemn.
Ling Han was not crippled. F***, which b@stard was misleading them?

chapters.title: Chapter 4435 Killing Imperial Son with a Single Punch
paragraphs: However, even more Imperial Sons were still proud.
No matter how strong you are, you are only a Spirit Transformation Tier.
A Sect Master would crush a Spirit Transformation True Lord. This was a truth that would never change for eternity, and would definitely not change for Ling Han.
And in this place, the majority of Imperial Sons had already advanced into Minor Advanced Tier, so what did they have to fear?
Indeed, you are invincible among your peers, so what?
Only Feng Miaoling smiled. Previously, she had stood in front of Ling Han because Ling Han was comprehending Dao and couldn't be disturbed, and at this time... was there any need for her to step out?
However... that woman actually dared to have designs on her man?
'Humph, I'll kill her after the competition ends. Shameless!'

The gazes of the people below them that were looking at Ling Han were filled with terror. Your uncle is still your uncle. He had first insta-killed Sheng Haiyuan and Ma Qiyang, and then stunned the whole area. Then, it was even more terrifying, as he had directly insta-killed dozens of people with a strange technique.
God of Slaughter!
A great many people did not dare to look at Ling Han, fearing that if they made eye contact with Ling Han, it would draw out his killing intent, and he would insta-kill them.
"Ling Han, are you all right?" Song Lan asked in pleasant surprise.
Ling Han scratched his head, and said, "I'm fine. Which idiot said that I had a problem?"
Hearing these words, everyone was driven mad.
That's right. They too wanted to know which idiot had given out such false news. Wasn't this just screwing them over?
—If Kong Wuyang found out after his death, how would he feel?

On the high platform, all the Imperial Sons looked down on Ling Han, as if they were the high and mighty lords of the heavens, waiting for the challenge of mortals, but the only result was that he would be easily suppressed.
"Anyone who wants to become defending champion can come and challenge me," an Imperial Son shouted in a deep voice from one of the stages.
His voice boomed out, bringing with it supreme might.
Instantly, the majority fell silent. The might of the Imperial Son was deeply ingrained in their hearts. This represented the strongest battle prowess.
Meanwhile, Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his eyes sweeping over stage after stage.
Those Imperial Sons all looked proud, completely unafraid.
Ling Han merely smiled, but did not step forwards to issue a challenge.
It was too early.
There were a total of 10 days. If he went up now, so what if he knocked down an Imperial Son with a single punch? He would still have to wait for 10 days. How boring would that be?
Let's go, find a place to sleep.
"Ling Han!" Seeing Ling Han turn around and leave, Song Lan faltered for a moment before hurriedly following him. There were too many things she wanted to say to Ling Han.
Everyone was envious. He wasn't goinf to fight on the martial arts ring, so what could a lone man and a lone woman do?
One didn't need to think to know that.
However, there were also those who made cynical remarks, and said, "Heh, he still does not dare to match the Imperial Son, so he fled!"

There were very few people who responded. Even if Ling Han was no match for the Sect Master, he had already completely proven himself just now. He was still the Ling Han that had stunned others and even driven them to despair.
Because there was potentially an envoy present, no Imperial Son would target Ling Han. In any case, everyone was in the city, so Ling Han wouldn't be able to escape.
One day, two days, time passed quietly, and soon, it was the tenth day.
Once midnight had passed, the tournament stage battles would be over, and they would enter into the next stage of the knockout battles.

Ling Han finally arrived at the tournament stage. He chatted with Song Lan for a while. This woman had found a place to live in seclusion alone after the Nine Suns Holy Land disbanded, and she hadn't returned to the clan.
Thankfully, she had obtained a great many fated opportunities on the Imperial Path, and had successfully broken through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Which one should he fight?
Ling Han swept his gaze over the 16 people on the tournament stages. In the end, he leaped onto a tournament stage.

"Haha, I thought you would continue to be a coward," the Imperial Son on the tournament stage said coldly. He was Pei Mingcheng of the Crimson Rainbow Imperial Clan, and belonged to the Silver Generation. At present, he had already charged up to become a Two Star Sect Master.
As he saw it, even a One Star Sect Master would be able to suppress all Spirit Transformation Tiers, what more when he was already a Two Star Sect Master. In fact, he was the Silver Generation.
Ling Han shook his head and said, "How dare you speak so rudely. I can tell that you don't have any manners."
Pei Mingcheng couldn't help but feel stifled. This retort made him feel uncomfortable.
Sure enough, this person had a toxic tongue. The rumors were true.
He no longer attempted to attack Ling Han verbally, because he knew himself well. The result of this bickering was very likely that he would be fuming with anger.
What martial artists looked at was not the ability to speak verbally, but their physical skill!
"Die!"
He charged towards Ling Han. Not only was he going to defeat Ling Han, he was even going to kill him.
Who wouldn't be interested in the reason why Ling Han was so powerful?
He clearly wasn't a member of the Imperial Clan, and joining the Holy Land was only a matter of later. So, why was he so powerful that even the Golden Generation was no match for him?
Who would not be interested in this kind of secret?

Ling Han's expression was baleful. If Pei Mingcheng only wanted to spar a bit, then he wouldn't mind stopping before things went too far. After all, it was his habit to speak with a toxic mouth, but it didn't mean that he would really be merciless.
But the moment Pei Mingcheng attacked, his killing intent blazed. It was clear that he wanted to kill him. How could Ling Han not feel killing intent?
He merely threw a punch.
This punch was clearly ordinary, but it seemed to have some kind of demonic power, and was unstoppable!
Peng!

With a single punch, Pei Mingcheng was instantly sent flying, drawing an arc in the skies. Only then did he fall heavily onto the stage. Under the barrage of Destructive Energy, Substitution Seal was completely ineffective, and he died directly.
Hiss, this punch had too shocking an effect.
Pei Mingcheng was no ordinary person. Not only was he an Imperial Son, he was also a Sect Master.
Heavens, even a Sect Master was no match for a single punch from Ling Han?
Not only the spectators, but even the Imperial Sons on the platforms all wore expressions of disbelief. They were so stunned that their eyes bulged.
Was this real?
The only one who still looked normal was Feng Miaoling. She had fought with Ling Han before, so she naturally knew just how powerful Ling Han was.
Otherwise, how could Ling Han be worthy of becoming her future husband?
Of course, it was not all the Imperial Sons that were trembling, because there were four Golden Generations here!
Though they were all Sect Masters as well, they were either Eight Stars or Nine Stars, and their abilities could not be compared to Two Stars or Three Stars Sect Master.
If they moved, they would still be able to easily suppress Ling Han.
In a state of silent shock, the tournament stage battles finally ended.
It was time for the elimination battles.
The sixteen people drew lots to decide their opponents for the quarterfinals.

Ling Han's luck was not too bad. He had drawn a Silver Generation. Though he was a Two Star Sect Master, with Pei Mingcheng's example, it was believed that no one would believe that this Imperial Son could win.

As expected, when the battles for the quarterfinals began, that Imperial Son decisively admitted defeat. There was no reason for him to insist on courting death, when it was definite that he would lose.
The top eight were decided. Aside from the four Golden Generations, there was also Ling Han, Feng Miaoling, and two Silver Generations.
Lots were drawn again. This time, Ling Han wasn't so lucky, drawing a Golden Generation.
Imperial Son Han, Guan Xinghan, Golden Generation of the Xuan Feng Imperial Clan, an Eight Star Sect Master!
The battle began, and Guan Xinghan moved without mercy. He shot out both palms, which turned into multiple black millstones that crushed towards Ling Han.
On the millstones, Regulations were densely covered, and divine patterns interwove, exuding endless might.

chapters.title: Chapter 4436 Outmatched
paragraphs: The Silver Generation elites all frowned. Even in a battle of equal cultivation levels, they could only retreat in the face of such might. If they stubbornly fought head-on, they would definitely be severely injured.
Feng Miaoling nodded as well. No wonder this generation's Imperial Sons had the title of Golden Generation. Indeed, this was much stronger than the Imperial Sons that she had seen before.
After an era of repression, there was indeed a great backlash.
She exclaimed in her mind.
Boom!
On the other side, Guan Xinghan's killing intent blazed as he pushed the millstones toward Ling Han.
Ling Han didn't faced this head-on. After all, there was a huge gulf between their cultivation levels.

The limit of his battle prowess was probably Five Star Sect Master, and it had to be an ordinary one at that. However, Guan Xinghan was not only an Eight Star Sect Master, but also a Golden Generation.
Who could withstand such might?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Guan Xinghan attacked madly, while Ling Han was completely unable to fight back. This was a battle on two completely different levels.

However, Ling Han still tried his best to create possibilities in midst of the impossible. He used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and even if the area of battle was limited, he still tried his best to move evasively in this area, and then take advantage of the opening to counterattack.
In every ten moves, he could return one or two blows.
This was the result of him taking a few steps on his own path of martial arts. Otherwise, having encountered such an opponent, he would not have the chance to fight back at all.
Even though Ling Han was at a huge disadvantage, everyone only felt admiration and fear.
Just how wide was the gap between the two of them?
Merely in minor level, there were already a considerable number of cultivation levels, what more when there was still a major tier of cultivation level that lay between them, but what was the result?
Though Ling Han was at a disadvantage, he was still trying his best to counterattack.
What if Ling Han advanced to the level of Sect Master?
To say nothing of defeating Guan Xinghan, he would at least be qualified to match him, right?
This, this, this, he had just entered into Sect Master-level, and was already capable of matching the Golden Generation that represented the strongest of this era. Just how freakish was this?

Guan Xinghan's killing intent blazed even brighter. He definitely had to kill Ling Han. Firstly, that was so he could get rid of any potential for future trouble, and secondly, he would be able to obtain Ling Han's secrets.
If he could advance another step further, he would be able to dominate the Golden Generation. Then, if the position of Emperor did not fall into his hands, who else would be qualified?
However, no matter what he did, Ling Han was as slippery as an eel. No matter what, he couldn't deliver a fatal strike and completely deal with Ling Han.
After battling for half a day, Ling Han's entire body was covered in sweat, and there were also several new wounds on his body.
After all, his opponent was too strong. Even he could not possibly avoid injury.
After battling for half a day, Ling Han withdrew from the battle, expressing his intention to forfeit.

No one looked at him in disdain. A Spirit Transformation Tier had fought a Sect Master, an Eight Star Golden Generation at that. Moreover, they battled for close to a day before finally expressing his loss. Wasn't this a massive victory?
This was a monster!
Seeing Ling Han stand proudly, Guan Xinghan almost couldn't suppress his killing intent, wanting to continue to hunt down Ling Han.

However, firstly, he had to be wary that there was a mysterious envoy here, and secondly, he had also experienced Ling Han's movement technique. If Ling Han fled with all his might, he would not be able to catch up to him either.
Thus, he did not act rashly.
"Phoenix Wings Divine Flight!" All the Imperial Sons thought, their thoughts of capturing Ling Han even hotter.
This person was a walking treasure trove. The True Dragon's legacy, the True Phoenix's legacy, and even the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor's legacy were all in Ling Han's hands.
Ling Han didn't feel any regrets. He had finally exchanged blows with the higher end of the Golden Generation. He was indeed very strong, but he was far from enough to make him wary.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he could easily crush him.

'It's fine even if I don't get the Qingfeng Order,' he thought. 'Even if I don't walk the Imperial Path, I still have the confidence to become Emperor, what more when I am only lacking that Qingfeng Order.'
He found a restaurant, and planned to set out after a delicious meal, continuing his Imperial Path adventure.
The dishes were served. He had not eaten many mouthfuls, when he saw a child walk over, drooling as he looked at the table full of dishes.
Ling Han couldn't help but smile, "Hungry? Come, sit down."
That child was really not reserved. Immediately, he sat down, stretched out his chopsticks and picked up the food, beginning to eat.
After eating a few mouthfuls, the child said to the waiter, "Bring me a wine bowl."
Yi?
Ling Han wasn't surprised that this child wanted to drink, but when he spoke, his voice was old, and he didn't sound like a child at all.
What the hell?
"Young man, I've been observing you for a long time," the child said in an experienced voice.
Ling Han chuckled, "Brat, how old are you this year?"

"Pei, I have only cultivated a strange cultivation technique, and that is why I would become a child every three hundred years for a few days. In terms of real age, I am more than qualified to be your grandfather." The child declared proudly.

Ling Han gritted his teeth. Even if this child wasn't lying, he was still asking for a beating. From the very beginning, he declared that he wanted to become his grandfather. How could he take advantage of him like this?
"Don't you have that little bit of common sense that the mouth that eats the food of others is softened?" he asked with a smile.
At this moment, the waiter brought over a wine bowl. The child filled it up for himself, and immediately began to drink noisily.
Peng!
He placed the wine bowl heavily on the table, and praised, "Good wine!"
Ling Han didn't care. Whether you were a child or an old geezer, since he said he would treat, then he would treat.
"Huh? Aren't you curious about my background?" the child couldn't help but ask.
"If you want to talk, you will. If you don't want to talk, it's useless even if I ask," Ling Han said with a smile.
"You definitely don't look like a young man with majestic vitality," the child said.
"You don't look like a child at all, so old-fashioned," Ling Han said with a shake of his head.
The child couldn't help but emphasize, "I'm not a child. It's just because of the cultivation technique I cultivate that I've temporarily become like this."
"You've already said that. My memory is very good, so there's no need to repeat it," Ling Han said with a smile.
"I'm about to die from fury!" The child panted heavily, and suddenly took out a token, which he slapped onto the table, "Here, take it."
This token was completely dark green in colour, and it was unknown what material it was made of. It looked like stone, yet was at the same time not. It looked like gold, yet was not.
A thought flashed in Ling Han's head, "Qingfeng Order?"
"That's right." The child became proud again, his expression saying that he should come and admire him quickly.
Ling Han gave an 'oh', and put away the Qingfeng Order.
"You're done with an 'oh'?" The child almost jumped up.
"Thank you?" Ling Han probed.
The child was speechless, as if he had suddenly lost all his temper. Only after a while did he say, "Aren't you curious why I gave the Qingfeng Order to you?"
"Why?" Ling Han asked.
"I'm the one asking you!" The child was angered again.
"How would I know?" Ling Han spread out his hands, "That is your own action. I am not the worm inside your stomach that can read your mind."
This... seemed to make a lot of sense.
The child sighed. Looks like in terms of bickering, he was completely no match for Ling Han, so it was better not to seek his own humiliation.
Just look, he was trembling with anger, yet Ling Han's expression didn't change at all. This was practically unbelievable.

"The strongest person being able to obtain the Qingfeng Order isn't definitely the strongest in terms of abilities, but rather the relatively strongest," the child explained. "You are invincible among your peers, and you completely deserve to possess the Qingfeng Order!"
