chapters.title: Chapter 4437 Stone Forest
paragraphs: Ling Han scratched his head, and said with a smile, "Although I know that, I'm still a little embarrassed that you're praising me like this right to my face."
This... where was the slightest bit of embarrassment?
The child was extremely speechless. He had never seen anyone more shameless than Ling Han.
Forget it. He focused on eating, and ignored Ling Han.
Yet Ling Han asked about Imperial Path, wanting to find out what he would be experiencing next. However, the child did not respond to him, and merely ate and drank madly.
By the looks of it, he wouldn't be able to get anything out of him.
Ling Han also began to eat. After eating and drinking to his heart's content, the child left without a second thought.
He was leaving.

Ling Han also set out to continue his journey. After leaving this city, he turned around to take a look, and a smile involuntarily appeared at the corners of his lips. He had no idea what Guan Xinghan and the others would be thinking, after fighting so hard with one of them finally emerging as first place, but there would be no sight of the envoy delivering the Qingfeng Order to him.
It was definite that they were going to curse, and if they knew that he had obtained the Qingfeng Order, then there would probably be ten thousand curses stampeding madly through their heads.
Haha, interesting.
This wasn't fair?

What a joke. The envoy had not said how to obtain the Qingfeng Order, and it was them who had acted on their own initiative, insisting on hosting a martial arts tournament. Then why did the envoy have to follow their rules?
'You guys can slowly play around and wait.'

Ling Han strode off. He had to break through to the level of Sect Master as soon as possible. Otherwise, if he encountered the Golden Generation, he would only be outmatched, even if he could parry a few moves.
After all, the gap in cultivation level was too wide.
Ling Han advanced on his journey. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, and his speed was astonishingly fast.
Three days later, a stone forest appeared ahead of him.

Ling Han's eyes swept over the surroundings, and couldn't help but frown. This stone forest was completely charred, as if it had just been burned by a great fire. But the problem here was this was a stone forest. It was completely filled with stone pillars soaring into the sky, and there wasn't even half a tree, so how could it be burning?
He walked closer, and raised his head.
The stone forest was truly tall. The shortest of these stone pillars were a few hundred meters tall, while the taller ones were actually a few thousand meters tall, piercing directly into the clouds.
The stone forest was vast, and as far as the eye could see, there was no end in sight.

According to the residents of North Prosperity City, after one passed through North Prosperity City, the Imperial Path would become extremely dangerous, and would this stone forest be the beginning of danger?
He didn't dare to be careless. No one could help him here, so he could only rely on himself.
However, if one observed from the outside, they wouldn't be able to see anything.
Ling Han leaped into the air.
He was going to look down from the sky.
But he had not even begun to advance, when he saw multiple stone pillars glowing all over. Then, xiu, xiu, xiu, multiple pillars of light shot towards him.
He parried with a punch, and couldn't help but grit his teeth. He felt a great pain in his fist, and the surface of his fist had even broken, bleeding bright red blood.
The offensive power of this pillar of light was very strong.

Ling Han hurriedly descended. If there were a few pillars of light, he could withstand them, but if there were several hundred, or even several thousand stone pillars attacking him at the same time, he really wouldn't be able to withstand it.
He had best just walk on the ground obediently. Looks like he would not be able to circle around this stage.
Ling Han adjusted his breathing, and strode into the stone forest.
He stepped in; the ground was soft.
Yi?
He lowered his head to look. There was a thick layer of ash on the ground, and that was why it felt so soft.
Where had the ash come from?
Ling Han raised his head to look. Each of these stone pillars seemed to have been burned before. Could it be that they had produced this?
He dug up a pile of ash, and saw that there were clear layers from top to bottom.
The top layer of ash was very recent. Perhaps, it had only happened one or two days ago.

Ling Han walked forwards, but he didn't walk too fast, because this stone forest was too densely packed. One after another, stone pillars stood in front of him, and he had to circle around them, which naturally greatly decreased his speed.
As he walked, he saw a bright object on a certain stone pillar.
He couldn't help but feel a jolt in his heart, and hurriedly climbed up.
Thankfully, no pillar of light assaulted him.
He could see clearly. This was a scale that was burning like flames, so it looked bright.
"What powerful power of flames!" Ling Han used his eye technique to scan the surroundings, and immediately understood.
This was Venerate Tier-level, and even he felt apprehensive. If he touched it, he would definitely die.
However...
He took out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and without wrapping it with his Spiritual Power, directly used it to enshroud the scale.
He stored it away.
This was forged from the essence of Origin Gold. So what if it was a Venerate Tier-level flame energy? He was completely unafraid.
He had gained a little. If he threw it out at the right moment, even if it couldn't hurt anyone, it could still scare people.
Ling Han smiled knowingly, and continued onwards.
After walking for a while, he felt a powerful wave of heat assault him.
He hung the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower above his head. If there really was a Venerate Tier-level flame spewing out, he would use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to collect it.

The further he walked, the more terrifying the waves of heat became. Even with the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, Ling Han still felt as if every hair on his head was about to be burnt.
After all, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was only forged from the Origin Gold, and not the real Imperial Weapon. Thus, it was indestructible, but Primal Chaos Qi wasn't indestructible.
He tried to take a different path, and after walking for a while, he discovered that the heat wave had subsided slightly.

After circling around for a while, he was certain that it wasn't that the depths of the stone forest were all as hot as this. Instead, there was a point that was like this, and the heat affected an area.
He could take a different path and leave, but due to his curiosity, Ling Han still decided to get a clear look.
Adjusting his course, Ling Han headed towards the centre of the heat source.
The further ahead he went, the hotter it became.

After about half an hour, he shockingly discovered that a sinkhole had appeared ahead of him. Its depth was indescribable, yet waves of heat surged out, making him feel as if his skin was about to burn.
With his current strength, he could just barely withstand it, but it was really not a pleasant feeling.
Ling Han was slightly relieved. He put away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, taking it head-on with his physique.
He saw it as tempering, to further temper his physique.
—As long as there was no life-threatening danger, Ling Han was extremely unwilling to rely on external power.
Waves of heat rolled out, extremely scorching.

Ling Han stretched out his head to look at the bottom of the sinkhole, but it was completely dark, and nothing could be seen clearly. Even if he used his eye technique, it was useless. It was as if some kind of energy or Regulations had formed an obstruction.
What... could it be underneath?
Could it be a passageway?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. If this was a passageway, then Imperial Path would really be difficult to travel.

He believed that he could still withstand this kind of heatwave at present, but if he entered into the depths of the abyss and came into direct contact with the source of heat, even with the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it would probably be useless. He would still be burnt to ashes.

"What if I use this pearl?" Ling Han took out the Saint Tool staff. There was a treasure inside, and it was a natural treasure that could resist all negative effects. The prerequisite was that the effects had to be formed naturally, and martial intent could not be contained within.
He activated this bead, and instantly, a shield of light appeared, enshrouding him within.
However, as the wave of heat surged out, this shield of light shattered.
Ling Han's expression involuntarily changed.
He himself could withstand this wave of heat, which meant that this was far from surpassing the might of the Venerate Tier, but why was this natural treasure unable to withstand it?
There was only one answer. This was not a wave of heat that was naturally formed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4438 Alive?
paragraphs: "Underneath, there should be a powerful existence. It is he who has formed this kind of wave of fire, and also because of him, his martial intent is mixed within the wave of fire. Thus, even a natural divine item would not be able to block it."
Ling Han murmured to himself as he took a few steps back.
It was suspected that there was a Venerate Tier-level existence beneath this deep pit. In that case, it was even more impossible for him to rashly go down and take risks.
"Yi?"
He suddenly saw a ray of red light surge out of the sinkhole.
Because he had taken a few steps back, when he saw the red light, the red light was actually not far from the ground.
It was flames!
Ling Han hurriedly broke into a run. Boom, behind him, flames surged out, burning in all directions, instantly turning the surrounding stone forest into a forest of fire.
It was too fast!
There was no way to use the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight here, so Ling Han's speed was greatly restricted. He couldn't outrun the flames at all, so he could only climb up a stone pillar.
As long as he didn't climb to the top, he probably wouldn't be attacked.
Boom, the waves of fire surged past, surging like the tide.

Ling Han breathed a slight sigh of relief. Then, he gritted his teeth. The temperature of this flame was too high, causing all the clothes on his body to dry and crack. It looked like they were about to burn.
F***, this was a Five Star Celestial Material!
Sigh, this was the bad thing about coming to this kind of place to train. It was too expensive.

Ling Han felt a little heartache. As for the issue of his image, he was not considering it. After all, there was not even a ghost in this place, so there was no need to worry that others would see him.

However, very soon, he was no longer in the mood to consider the problem of money, because the wave of heat was getting more and more intense, directly penetrating into his heart and lungs, causing the breath he exhaled from his nostrils to be red in colour, and the temperature to be extraordinarily high.
Was he going to be roasted?
Ling Han felt that it really was a bit like that. See, wasn't he hanging on a stone pillar?

He continued to climb upwards, staying further away from the waves of fire. This indeed improved the situation slightly, but the stone pillar itself was also burning extraordinarily hot, so hot that even his skin was about to fall off.

"Hu! Hu!" He kept switching from his left hand to his right hand, and from his right foot to his left foot. He had a chance to escape the stone pillar and "cool down" for a while, but as time passed, this was still not feasible.
Forget it.
He leaped up, directly piercing through the clouds.
He couldn't be burnt to the point of severe injury, or even to the point of actually being burnt to death, right?
Yi?
After arriving in the air, Ling Han discovered that the stone pillars here weren't glowing, or launched an attack at him.
Could it be that because of the flames, these stone pillars had temporarily lost their offensive ability?
Forget it. At least for now, he could avoid the assault of the waves of heat.
He cast his gaze over, and saw that there was a pillar of fire behind him that had shot up to a height of three hundred meters. It was precisely coming from the sinkhole.
Furthermore, looking into the distance, there were actually a considerable number of such pillars of fire that could be vaguely seen.
Which also meant that there was more than one sinkhole, and there was more than one Venerate Tier-level existence?
The flames surged, and after about half an hour, they finally stopped, no longer surging.
Another layer of the stone forest had been burnt, and with a slight breeze, the ashes continued to fall, forming a very thin layer on the ground.
Ling Han felt a sense of confusion. This stone forest was continuously burning, and a layer of "skin" would be shed every time, but after so many years, why was it still not completely burnt?
This was illogical.
However, he immediately shook his head. There were too many illogical things here. How could he investigate each and every thing in detail?
Weng! The stone pillars lit up.
Not good. The flames had passed, and the stone forest returned to normal. It had become offensive again.
Ling Han hurriedly descended, not daring to face it head-on.
The wave of flames had just passed, and the ground was still filled with a burning sensation, forcing Ling Han to have no choice but to activate the Starlight Screen.
He advanced, and he had not walked too far, when he discovered another scale on a stone pillar.
Had this come out of the colossal pit along with the gushing waves of fire?
Ling Han deduced that there were fierce beasts in the sinkhole, and this naturally had fallen from the bodies of fierce beasts.
"What a strange place."

If one's reaction speed was slower, they would be instantly killed by the pillar of light if they rashly rose into the air, and if they walked on the ground, the waves of fire would also instantly kill them.

The stone forest was too big, and in fact, Ling Han discovered that the stone forest itself was also changing the direction. That was because he was clearly advancing continuously, but after two days, he discovered that he had actually walked back the way he came.
This was too inconceivable.
Ling Han was certain that his mind definitely hadn't been affected. Then, without the influence of external power, why had he suddenly started to walk back the way he came?
What was even stranger was that he was clearly walking backwards, yet did not pass by the place that he had previously walked to.
Though it was all the same scenery inside the stone forest, with Ling Han's insight, he could still distinguish the slightest difference.
Strange, too strange.
Ling Han adjusted his course. However, this time, he was even more shocked, because he discovered that he had walked these paths before.
What was going on?

For example, he had been walking east, but as he walked, he realized that he had turned west at some point in time. Logically speaking, he should have walked the path he walked before, yet the scenery was completely different.
However, he adjusted his direction and headed east again, only to discover that he was actually going back the way he came.
"There is only one possibility!"
Ling Han tapped his fingers, "Actually, this is not some kind of psychedelic formation, but rather the whole stone forest is spinning!"

—To make an analogy, if he was on the body of a giant tortoise, he would have been heading east at first, but as he walked, the giant tortoise turned 180 degrees. Then, though Ling Han was still advancing straight ahead, he had turned westwards, yet had not gone backwards.
Thinking about it this way, the matter became simple.
"Hiss, then doesn't that mean that this stone forest is alive?"

Ling Han gritted his teeth. Could it be that he was presently standing on top of a massive beast? This could explain why the stone forest had not been burnt to nothing, because it was a living creature, so there was growth.
He had to leave as soon as possible.
Ling Han determined the direction, and continued onwards.

However, the stone forest would change direction from time to time, and because it was huge, this change was really noiseless, causing even Ling Han to fall for it. The more he adjusted his direction, the more he lost himself in it.
After ten days, he realized that he had really lost all sense of direction.
Forget about it. He might as well stick to a single direction and walk to the end. He would definitely be able to leave.
And he had also discovered the rhythm of the waves of fire gushing out here. It would happen once a day, punctually, and would last for half an hour.
"It's coming again," Ling Han murmured. He leaped up and soared into the sky.
Boom! True enough, the waves of flames surged over in an instant.
Yi?
He suddenly saw a figure standing proudly in midair in the distance.
Though they were very far away, with Ling Han's sharp eyesight, he could tell with a single glance that that person wasâ¦ Guan Xinghan.
This Golden Generation also discovered Ling Han's presence. Without another word, he immediately charged over.
Boom! Divine light surged from his body, transforming into nine-colored light that boosted his might.
"Die!"
This Imperial Son delivered a palm strike, which turned into a colossal axe, intending to slash down on Ling Han.

Could it be that he was presently standing on top of a massive beast?
This could explain why the stone forest had not been burnt to nothing, because it was a living creature, so there was growth.
He had to leave as soon as possible.
Ling Han determined the direction, and continued onwards.
However, the stone forest would change direction from time to time, and because it was huge, this change was really noiseless, causing even Ling Han to fall for it.
The more he adjusted his direction, the more he lost himself in it.
After ten days, he realized that he had really lost all sense of direction.
Forget about it.
He might as well stick to a single direction and walk to the end.
He would definitely be able to leave.
And he had also discovered the rhythm of the waves of fire gushing out here.
It would happen once a day, punctually, and would last for half an hour.
"It's coming again," Ling Han murmured.
He leaped up and soared into the sky.
Boom!
True enough, the waves of flames surged over in an instant.
Yi?
He suddenly saw a figure standing proudly in midair in the distance.
Though they were very far away, with Ling Han's sharp eyesight, he could tell with a single glance that that person wasâ¦ Guan Xinghan.
This Golden Generation also discovered Ling Han's presence.
Without another word, he immediately charged over.
Boom!
Divine light surged from his body, transforming into nine-colored light that boosted his might.
"Die!"
This Imperial Son delivered a palm strike, which turned into a colossal axe, intending to slash down on Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4439 Transforming into a giant
paragraphs: Ling Han didn't complain about the injustice.

It was not the first or second time that he had been targeted by the Imperial Clan. Furthermore, he had also killed Guan Yuanming. It could be said that he had become deadly enemies with the Guan Clan. If they did not kill him, the Imperial Clan would be losing pride!
He used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and with a leap, his speed was extraordinarily fast.

In fact, in fact, this place was already filled with soaring flames in the first place. As the flaming wings flapped, they actually created quite a number of waves of fire that swept towards Guan Xinghan.
These flames were far too terrifying, and even Guan Xinghan didn't dare to face them head-on. He had no option but to dodge.
His speed was inferior to Ling Han's in the first place, so if he continued to dodge like this, how could he possibly catch up to Ling Han?
Thus, even though one was fleeing and the other was chasing, there was no danger at all.
"Ling Han, don't you feel aggrieved?" Guan Xinghan suddenly spoke up with his divine sense.
Ling Han ignored him. There was nothing much to say to him. When his abilities improved, he would naturally be able to beat him up.
What Imperial Son? What Silver Generation? Hadn't they all been dealt with like this by him?
Which other Silver Generation dared to act arrogant in front of Ling Han?

"Heh, you clearly didn't do anything wrong, so why does it seem like the entire world is against you?" Guan Xinghan didn't seem to care, and he continued, "That's because you clearly don't have any background, yet you're showing signs of becoming Emperor!"

"An Imperial Son can display his brilliance to his heart's content, and have no fear of being assassinated out of jealousy. That is because there is the signboard of the Imperial Clan, and no one dares to touch it!"
"It's the same for Yang Yihuan and He Luo. Although they don't have the Imperial Clan behind them, they do have a Pseudo-Emperor backing them up. Who dares to touch them?"
"Thus, the so-called fair competition was completely unfair from the very beginning!"
"Weaklings have no right to demand fairness!"
Every word was piercing to the heart.
He was deliberately provoking Ling Han, wanting to make Ling Han lose his composure. The best scenario would be if Ling Han couldn't contain his anger and turned around to fight him.
Unfortunately, Ling Han didn't fall for it.
Even though he had only been in this world for a hundred years, just how many years had he passed in the Genesis World?
How could such an old monster be so easily provoked?
That's right. Sometimes, he would act on impulse, but it was definitely impossible that he would fall for such a low-level provocation.
He couldn't even be bothered to pay him any regard. With a flap of his fiery wings, he suddenly sped up, instantly leaving Guan Xinghan far behind.
Guan Xinghan suddenly stopped in his tracks, and did not pursue any further.
If he couldn't catch up, there was no need to waste time.

"Your fortune is so nature-defying that you have obtained more than one inheritance from the Great Emperor. It is as if you have been favoured by the heaven and earth. If I do not kill you, who would be able to rest easy?" Guan Xinghan murmured, "There is only one position of Great Emperor, so you must die!"
After Ling Han broke free from Guan Xinghan, he waited for a while, and the explosion of the waves of fire ended. Peace returned to the stone forest.
He strode forwards, his heart filled with curiosity.
This was the Imperial Path, so the existence of this stone forest was most likely not just to obstruct the advance of those who entered.
What kind of great opportunity would there be?
As Ling Han walked, he drew out the Qingfeng Order.
He studied it for a long time, but still couldn't find anything special about this thing—if he had to say there was one, it would be hardness.
Occasionally, he would take it out to see if it would form a resonance with the environment here.
However, he was only disappointed time and time again.
Time slowly passed, and more and more people entered into the stone forest. Because of how big this stone forest was, Ling Han still encountered others time and time again.
By now, his name was already well-known, so who would dare to provoke him? The moment they saw him, their expressions changed drastically, and they hurriedly turned around and fled.
This made Ling Han very depressed. He wasn't a god of death, so why did everyone avoid him when they saw him?

If the large black dog were here, he would definitely say in disdain, "Brat, you don't even blink when you kill the Imperial Son. Why should others be afraid of you? Don't you have any estimates in your heart?"
Another dozen over days later, Ling Han suddenly discovered that the ground was trembling.
Yi, he had not encountered this before.
There was indeed some movement when the waves of fire surged out, but it was definitely not as great as this.
He didn't dare to be careless. He leaped up and stood in the air.
However, no waves of fire surged over, and instead, the stone pillars lit up one after another.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, pillars of light shot out madly.
Ling Han hurriedly descended, brandishing his fists to parry.
Even so, when he landed on the ground, blood was still dripping from his fist.
Boom, right at this moment, the tremors from the ground became even more intense. Ling Han shockingly discovered that the sky was actually spinning.
No, it was not the world that was spinning, but rather that the whole stone forest had suddenly moved.

All of a sudden, his movements sped up, and Ling Han discovered that the ground level in the distance was rapidly becoming lower, and a great many areas that could not be seen at first were all visible — this forest of stone was presently rising into the air.
What on earth was going on?
At this moment, waves of fire surged out.
Run!
Ling Han hurriedly flew away. He wasn't the only one; multiple people were standing in midair.
Everyone looked ahead in shock. That stone forest... was shockingly a person!

No, to be more precise, this was the skin of a certain human figure. His entire body was covered with stone spikes. Previously, he had been lying on the ground, and now, he had suddenly stood up. Thus, everyone felt as if the world around them was spinning.
Hiss, such a colossal person?
Compared to him, the giants they had encountered on the island were on two completely different levels.
It could be clearly seen that there were multiple holes on this "person", and it was presently spewing out flames.
This super giant released a howl of pain. Its voice was like thunder, so loud that everyone's eardrums seemed like they were about to burst.

He stretched out a finger and dug into a hole. After a while, he actually took out an insect that was as long as three hundred meters. Its entire body was covered with crimson scales. Then, he ruthlessly threw it onto the ground, and stepped on it.
"Zhi!" The insect released a strange cry, and was stomped into mush.
Ling Han saw very clearly that the scales on the insect's body were exactly the same as the one that he had drawn into the Primal Chaos Lightning Tower.
As it turned out, the so-called sinkhole was actually a wound left behind by this kind of insect that had wormed into the body of the giant.

This giant began digging in the other wounds, and drew out long insects, one after another. He trampled them to death. Every time he dug, he would howl, his voice shaking the world so much that it paled in comparison.
When he had emptied out all the insects in his body, it was as if he had lost all his strength. Boom, he collapsed onto the ground, turning once more into a forest of stone.
Everyone's eyes were wide open, as they watched this scene that stunned them, unable to come back to their senses for a long time.
What breed was this giant? And what the hell was this insect?

Yet Ling Han's eyes swept over the area. The giant had already shifted position, leaving behind a massive pit where he had been lying, and in this pit, there were actually a great many plants growing.
Celestial medicine!
His eyes immediately lit up.

These Celestial medicines should have been nurtured by the life force of the giant. After all, there were a great many openings on his body, so there would definitely be energy essence seeping out, turning this place into a small-scale Medicinal Garden.
Xiu, he immediately rushed out, heading straight for the place where the energy was the densest.

chapters.title: Chapter 4440 Black Heavenly Dao Lotus
paragraphs: "Humph!"
Four Golden Generations immediately came to their senses, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
The reactions of the others weren't slow either. They followed closely behind Guan Xinghan and the others.
There were only so many Celestial medicines, and those who were faster would be able to obtain them.
Because the wounds of the giant were distributed all over the body, the Celestial medicines were also growing in patches, far apart.
As they flew, everyone made their own choice, and headed towards the growth points of different Celestial medicines.

—Everyone wanted to obtain the best Celestial medicine, but that meant an incredibly intense competition. They would have to weigh their own strength first. Otherwise, they would only miss out on this great opportunity for nothing.

Ling Han headed directly for the Celestial medicine that he felt had the strongest energy, and the four people from the Golden Generation followed closely behind. Feng Miaoling had also appeared. Her speed was similarly swift, not falling the slightest bit behind.
With the six of them here, the others naturally would not seek their own humiliation and fight over this Celestial medicine. If they did, it could only leave themselves empty-handed.
"Black Heavenly Dao Lotus!" Chang Daoyu was the first to recognize the origins of that Celestial medicine.

He was the Imperial Son of the Chang Clan, and there was no need to mention the Chang Clan. They were the owner of Galaxy Network. After countless generations of accumulation, the depth of their wealth was something that ordinary people would not even dare to think about.
Hearing his words, Guan Xinghan and the others all looked tempted.
Black Heavenly Dao Lotus, among Six Star Celestial medicines, it could be called peak grade.
What was Minor Advanced Tier?

Cultivating the fruits of cultivation in the mind, plucking the Celestial Qi to nurture them, and when the fruits of cultivation reached Great Accomplishment-level, it would be the day that one reached the consummate level of Minor Advanced Tier.

And the heaven and earth was filled with energy everywhere, but there were very few types that could be called Celestial Qi, and they had to be captured in the Void. And among Celestial medicines like the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus, there was at least a streak of Celestial Qi contained within.
Hence, even for the Golden Generation, this was still an irresistible temptation.
Ling Han's speed was the fastest. With the blessing of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, who could compare to him in speed?
He did not care whether this was the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus or something else, as long as it was a Celestial medicine.
Xiu, his figure landed on the ground, and pulled out the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus, directly throwing it into his Spatial Spirit Tool.
"Impudence!" Guan Xinghan and the others roared. They all charged toward Ling Han.
"Scram!" Feng Miaoling shouted, brandishing her sword to slash at Guan Xinghan and the others.
Shua, the sword light was especially fierce, capable of piercing through the Void.
Guan Xinghan and the others were all about to go crazy. Was there something wrong with you, woman? It was clearly Ling Han who had obtained the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus, but why did you attack us?
Idiot!
However, though Feng Miaoling's strength was slightly inferior to theirs, there wasn't much of a gap between them. When this sword strike swept past, they had no choice but to parry.
With this, they naturally could no longer stop Ling Han.
Ling Han's figure flashed again, and he did not greedily pluck the other Celestial medicines. Instead, he left quickly.
Guan Xinghan's eyes were baleful as he stared at Feng Miaoling. "Are you seeking death?"
Feng Miaoling was completely unafraid, and said calmly, "I have killed at least eighty Imperial Sons, even if not a hundred. Who do you think you are?"

These words caused Guan Xinghan's expression to become filled with fury. He was the Golden Generation, and was acclaimed as one of the people closest to the young Great Emperors of the past. However, Ling Han and this woman completely didn't take the Golden Generation seriously.
What right do you all have?
Chang Daoyu, Liu Xiyun and Su Qianhai, the three Golden Generations, were also seething with killing intent. Since Ling Han had fled, they would vent their anger on this woman.
"Fine, if you're so determined to seek death, then I'll oblige you!" Guan Xinghan waved his hands, launching a palm strike at Feng Miaoling.
Feng Miaoling dodged, and didn't confront him head-on.
She wasn't stupid. Guan Xinghan's strength was superior to hers, so fighting him head-on wasn't a good idea.
Chang Daoyu and the others exchanged looks, and joined the battle at the same time.
They wanted to capture Feng Miaoling at the first instant, and use her to threaten Ling Han.
—This woman had stepped out bravely for Ling Han's sake. Clearly, the relationship between the two of them was not shallow.

Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. Although he didn't want to have any kind of relationship with Feng Miaoling, Feng Miaoling had indeed helped him just then. If he left now, he would definitely feel guilty.
He had travelled the world, and the most important thing was having a clear conscience.
The four Golden Generations attacked in unison. Just how terrifying was this?
Amongst those at the level of Sect Master, who could stop this?

Although Feng Miaoling was a freakish prodigy who had surpassed countless years, and her battle prowess at the same cultivation level was incredibly powerful, she was at a disadvantage in terms of cultivation level. She couldn't even match Guan Xinghan alone, what more four Golden Generations.
Instantly, she was in a dangerous situation.
"Sigh, women are so troublesome!" Ling Han sighed, yet charged back.
If Feng Miaoling hadn't interfered, he could have actually fled too. However, favors were favors, and these were separate matters.
Seeing Ling Han charge back, Feng Miaoling couldn't help but reveal a sweet smile.
F***, don't f****** misunderstand.
Ling Han immediately wanted to turn around and run back, but this was naturally impossible. Thus, he could only brace himself and charge over.
"Haha, you've come to seek death!" Chang Daoyu said with a cold chuckle. He launched a palm strike at Ling Han.
He was a Nine Star Sect Master, and added with the fact that he was the Golden Generation, he was already standing at the peak of Sect Master-level. Just how terrifying was the might of his strike?
Ling Han was no match for him at all, and he hurriedly turned around to dodge.
"Let's go!" he shouted at Feng Miaoling.
Feng Miaoling nodded, and charged out with her sword, meeting up with Ling Han.
The four Imperial Sons did not stop her, and took advantage of the opening to form a siege, surrounding Ling Han and Feng Miaoling.
"Now, you guys are like turtles in a jar!" Su Qianhai declared balefully.
"Is that so?" Ling Han bared his teeth in a grin. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unleashed, directly throwing out four scales of fire.
Hong, Venerate Tier-level aura surged out.
The four Imperial Sons were all astounded. F***, why had Ling Han suddenly launched a Venerate Tier-level attack?
They hurriedly dodged, and no matter how conceited they were, they did not dare to match the might of a Venerate Tier.
However, they immediately discovered that they had been tricked.
Though the scale was burning with Venerate Tier-level flames, the force of the attack was extremely weak. They only had to wave their hands and they would be able to sweep it away.
Thus, there was no need for them to dodge at all.
However, the subconscious reaction was definitely to seek fortune and avoid calamity. This was the most normal response.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Ling Han and Feng Miaoling took advantage of it to escape from the encirclement.

The four Imperial Sons hurriedly gave chase, but whether it was Ling Han or Feng Miaoling, their speed was not inferior to the four Imperial Sons at all. In fact, they had even surpassed them. Thus, as they chased, they were instead getting further and further away from Ling Han and Feng Miaoling.
Finally, they had no choice but to stop harshly.
Damn it, that was a Black Heavenly Dao Lotus!

Flames of fury flickered in the eyes of the four Imperial Sons. Minor Advanced Tier was really too hard to cultivate. Even if they all had the full support of their clans, their progress was still very slow.

For Chang Daoyu and Su Qianhai, this Celestial medicine was enough to help them break through to Venerate Tier-level, and for Guan Xinghan and Liu Xiyun, the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus was more or less enough to help them advance into Nine Stars.
But now, all this had nothing to do with them.
"If you see him, kill him!"
"En!"
The four of them nodded at the same time. Ling Han definitely had to die. He had really become a serious threat to their path of becoming Emperor.

Although he didn't want to have any kind of relationship with Feng Miaoling, Feng Miaoling had indeed helped him just then.
If he left now, he would definitely feel guilty.
He had travelled the world, and the most important thing was having a clear conscience.
The four Golden Generations attacked in unison.
Just how terrifying was this?
Amongst those at the level of Sect Master, who could stop this?

Although Feng Miaoling was a freakish prodigy who had surpassed countless years, and her battle prowess at the same cultivation level was incredibly powerful, she was at a disadvantage in terms of cultivation level.
She couldn't even match Guan Xinghan alone, what more four Golden Generations.
Instantly, she was in a dangerous situation.
"Sigh, women are so troublesome!" Ling Han sighed, yet charged back.
If Feng Miaoling hadn't interfered, he could have actually fled too.
However, favors were favors, and these were separate matters.
Seeing Ling Han charge back, Feng Miaoling couldn't help but reveal a sweet smile.
F***, don't f****** misunderstand.
Ling Han immediately wanted to turn around and run back, but this was naturally impossible.
Thus, he could only brace himself and charge over.
"Haha, you've come to seek death!" Chang Daoyu said with a cold chuckle.
He launched a palm strike at Ling Han.
He was a Nine Star Sect Master, and added with the fact that he was the Golden Generation, he was already standing at the peak of Sect Master-level.
Just how terrifying was the might of his strike?
Ling Han was no match for him at all, and he hurriedly turned around to dodge.
"Let's go!" he shouted at Feng Miaoling.
Feng Miaoling nodded, and charged out with her sword, meeting up with Ling Han.
The four Imperial Sons did not stop her, and took advantage of the opening to form a siege, surrounding Ling Han and Feng Miaoling.
"Now, you guys are like turtles in a jar!" Su Qianhai declared balefully.
"Is that so?" Ling Han bared his teeth in a grin.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unleashed, directly throwing out four scales of fire.
Hong, Venerate Tier-level aura surged out.
The four Imperial Sons were all astounded.
F***, why had Ling Han suddenly launched a Venerate Tier-level attack?
They hurriedly dodged, and no matter how conceited they were, they did not dare to match the might of a Venerate Tier.
However, they immediately discovered that they had been tricked.
Though the scale was burning with Venerate Tier-level flames, the force of the attack was extremely weak.
They only had to wave their hands and they would be able to sweep it away.
Thus, there was no need for them to dodge at all.
However, the subconscious reaction was definitely to seek fortune and avoid calamity.
This was the most normal response.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Ling Han and Feng Miaoling took advantage of it to escape from the encirclement.
The four Imperial Sons hurriedly gave chase, but whether it was Ling Han or Feng Miaoling, their speed was not inferior to the four Imperial Sons at all.
In fact, they had even surpassed them.
Thus, as they chased, they were instead getting further and further away from Ling Han and Feng Miaoling.
Finally, they had no choice but to stop harshly.
Damn it, that was a Black Heavenly Dao Lotus!
Flames of fury flickered in the eyes of the four Imperial Sons.
Minor Advanced Tier was really too hard to cultivate.
Even if they all had the full support of their clans, their progress was still very slow.

For Chang Daoyu and Su Qianhai, this Celestial medicine was enough to help them break through to Venerate Tier-level, and for Guan Xinghan and Liu Xiyun, the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus was more or less enough to help them advance into Nine Stars.
But now, all this had nothing to do with them.
"If you see him, kill him!"
"En!"
The four of them nodded at the same time.
Ling Han definitely had to die.
He had really become a serious threat to their path of becoming Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 4441 Dimensions Change
paragraphs: Ling Han and Feng Miaoling ran madly, shaking off their pursuers before finally slowing down.
"Er, thanks," Ling Han said to Feng Miaoling.
Feng Miaoling smiled beautifully, "You are my future husband, so it is only right that I help you."
Er, if you don't say such words, there is still a way for us to communicate.
"Bye." Ling Han turned around and ran.

"Hey, I'm not an ugly woman!" Feng Miaoling chased after him, and as she did so, she removed her veil, revealing a breathtakingly beautiful face. She was definitely no inferior to Song Lan, Chi Menghan, and the others.

Ling Han swept an eye over her, and was indeed stunned for a moment. However, he presently was not in the mood for romance, nor did he want to trifle with this crazy woman. If he really took her into his harem, who knows, she may kill the empress and the others.
He definitely couldn't touch this hornet's nest.
Flee.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, and very soon, he had disappeared without a trace.
After throwing Feng Miaoling off his tail, Ling Han began to study the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus.
"There is actually Celestial Qi in this!" Ling Han was stunned. No wonder Guan Xinghan and the others had pursued him so intently.

There were countless energies in the heaven and earth, such as the power of fire, the power of water, and the power of lightning. They could all be absorbed and refined into mystical power. Thus, they could all be called ordinary energy or low-level energy.

And in the case of high-level energy, it could not be refined, and could only be used in battle — aside from a freak like the True Dragon, who had actually created a cultivation technique, which would allow a cultivator to use high-level energy to temper their physique.

However, there was also some extremely rare energy. It was of an extremely high level, yet could be absorbed and refined. Every time a sliver of it was refined, it would be of great help to the improvement of one's cultivation level.
This was called Celestial Qi!
—Cultivating progressed one step at a time, but if one could endlessly absorb Celestial Qi, he could completely realize a leap in cultivation level.

And in the case of the Minor Advanced Tiers who had formed the fruits of cultivation, they could only use the Celestial Qi as irrigation to stimulate the growth of the fruits. They had an incredibly strong yearning for the Celestial Qi.
To describe in further detail, there was actually a difference among Celestial Qi. There was also a notion of quality.
Even for Imperial Clans, which had an astonishing background, and also had a considerable number of Celestial Qi, in terms of high quality Celestial Qi... hoho, that was in extremely limited supply.

When Celestial Qi of different quality was nurtured, the quality of the fruits of cultivation that grew would also be different. Thus, so many Golden Generations had all advanced into Sect Master Tier, but why had only three of them broken through to Venerate Tier?
It wasn't that others couldn't, but rather that their fruits of cultivation hadn't reached perfection yet, and they were unwilling to break through.
And in the case of this Black Heavenly Dao Lotus, the Celestial Qi contained within was of extremely high quality, and would be of great help in improving the quality of the fruits of cultivation.
No wonder Guan Xinghan and the others seemed to have gone crazy after seeing Ling Han take away the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus.
"Should I eat it or not?" Ling Han hesitated slightly.

The Black Heavenly Dao Lotus wasn't meant for Spirit Transformation Tier. If he ate it now, the Celestial Qi within it could only be used to increase his cultivation level, and wouldn't have the effect of improving the fruits of cultivation. It was equivalent to a massive waste.
"The most pressing matter for me now is to increase my cultivation level. Otherwise, I can only run when I see those Golden Generations."
"So what if it's a waste? As long as my cultivation level increases, would I still need to worry about not being able to obtain Celestial Qi?"
Ling Han was very decisive, and immediately began to eat the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus.
However, this thing was not delicious at all. It was like chewing on grass, causing Ling Han to frown deeply.
"There should be no one else that would experience such pain when ingesting a high-level Celestial medicine as I am now."
"At this moment, I am really envious of the Ox Tribe and Horse Tribe. They are herbivorous in the first place, and there is nothing unusual for them to eat this."
After ingesting the Celestial medicine, the effects were immediately produced.
Bursts of energy surged, incredibly dense.
In his mind, the self was like a bottomless pit, madly absorbing this energy, not leaving a single bit behind. His appetite was astonishingly huge.

However, this Celestial medicine was originally prepared for the Minor Advanced Tier. No matter how freakish he was, he was only in the Spirit Transformation Tier, and was close to reaching its peak. Thus, after half a day, he felt that he had reached the consummate level and was no longer absorbing the medicinal effects.

All right, he had finally reached the consummate level of the Spirit Transformation Tier. Next, he only had to stabilize his cultivation level, and he would be able to break through to the Minor Advanced Tier.
Yi?

He was just about to breathe a sigh of relief. He could finally break through to a higher cultivation level. However, he suddenly discovered that the millions and millions of dimensions in his body were trembling slightly at the same time. They began to absorb the medicinal effects, turning them into pure energy, causing the Spiritual Qi in each dimension to increase greatly.
What was going on here?
What are you all joining in on the excitement for?

A long time ago, Ling Han had fed back to the dimensions in his body, raising all the dimensions to the transcendent level, but now, it seemed like these dimensions were going to evolve again, and advance to a new height.
Ling Han was a little worried. His consciousness entered into the dimensions, and stood together with Shui Yanyu and the others, carefully sensing for any changes.
The Spiritual Qi increased dramatically.

Though the medicinal effects were shared among millions and millions of dimensions, and for every dimension, what they obtained was only a sliver, the dimensions themselves were also of a very low level. A sliver was enough to bring about a massive change.
With the explosive increase in Spiritual Qi, plants grew madly, and all things showed signs of developing a spirit, and the path of cultivation for intelligent creatures became even easier.
What did this signify?
Ling Han could obtain even more Power of Dimensions than this.
That was because the Power of Dimensions was the power of living beings, and only intelligent living beings could respond to Ling Han's consciousness and provide him with Spiritual Power.
Now, the number of intelligent living beings was beginning to increase, and each of them had also become stronger. The Power of Dimension that he had obtained naturally improved as well.
Celestial Qi... actually brought about such a change?
Ling Han was astounded. This was naturally a good thing for him, because a great many extreme breakthroughs were related to the Power of Dimension in his body.

He channelled the Imperial Scroll, speeding up the circulation of the medicinal effects. Though the Imperial Scroll was ineffective at the level of Tenth Change, it was a piece of cake to speed up the circulation of the medicinal effects.
Two days later, the effects brought about by the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus were finally exhausted.

Ling Han's true self was already at the consummate level, reaching the peak stage of the Spirit Transformation Tier. However, he had a feeling that he probably hadn't reached the consummate level of the Spirit Transformation Tier yet. The key lay in the dimensions inside his body.
He could now attempt to break through to the Minor Advanced Tier, but the fruits of cultivation that he bore would definitely be affected, and he would not be able to reach his strongest.
What he pursued was the path of the strongest, so how could he be willing to accept an imperfection?
"That's good too."

Ling Han nodded and said, "I'll stabilize my cultivation level and prepare to break through to the Minor Advanced Tier. Meanwhile, I'll also continue to search for Celestial Qi, allowing the dimensions in my body to evolve again and reach perfection."
However, this was very difficult.

Ling Han sighed. Celestial Qi could only be captured by elites at the Minor Advanced Tier. If one's cultivation level wasn't high enough, they wouldn't be able to sense it at all. They could only obtain it from Celestial medicines or natural treasures. It was something that could only be encountered by chance.
Thankfully, this was Imperial Path.

"The Imperial Path is actually not to help you become Emperor, but to help you build a good foundation as much as possible, so that you would have the qualifications to break through to become a Great Emperor."
Ling Han nodded. Why was it that the Great Emperor was basically in the top ten, or even the top three in fact, among those that had walked out of the Imperial Path?
That was because there was great fortune for those who were in the lead!

chapters.title: Chapter 4442 CIty at the seabed
paragraphs: Ling Han stood up, and continued on his way.
The giant had already shifted its position, so there was already a stretch of flat land ahead of him.

At this time, the others had already left, and there were a great many people that had stayed behind in the North Prosperity City. They would not advance any further, and would stay here until the Imperial Path closed, and leave safely.
The previous adventures had already frightened these people, and they did not dare to take any more risks.
Ling Han passed by this massive pit, and after walking for a few more days, he saw a vast ocean stretching out in front of him.
Yi, why was it an ocean again?
The previous trip to the seven islands was still vivid in his mind. In the blink of an eye, he was going to do it again?
Ling Han tried to fly over, but with a plop, he fell into the sea.

Sure enough, there was a terrifying pressure in the air, making it impossible for him to maintain flight. However, there was no terrifying killing intent in the sea, so he could completely swim freely.
Since that was the case, Ling Han didn't expend any more effort to find a way to travel through the air. Instead, he dove into the depths of the sea.
Perhaps, there would be some Celestial medicines in the sea?
At present, he was filled with longing for Celestial Qi, and he could not directly capture it from the heaven and earth, so he could only set his sights on the Celestial medicine.
He hoped that he would be extremely lucky.
The sea... was filled with vitality.

This wasn't a dead sea, but one that was filled with seaweed, fish, shrimp, and all kinds of other lifeforms. However, these lifeforms were all in their most primitive states. They hadn't stepped on the path of cultivation and developed intelligence.

Ling Han continued to swim. Even in the great ocean, he could still channel the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. With a flap of his fiery wings, he could instantly evaporate a large area of seawater around him, so his speed would not be greatly affected.
Of course, if it weren't necessary, he wouldn't have channeled the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight either. After all, this would expend a lot of mystical power.

As he advanced, the variety of living creatures became more and more varied, and also became larger and larger. Ling Han saw giant fish that were several hundred meters long, as well as sea turtles that looked like small islands.

As he advanced, the variety of living creatures became more and more varied, and also became larger and larger. Ling Han saw giant fish that were several hundred meters long, as well as sea turtles that looked like small islands.

These living beings still hadn't developed intelligence, but their bodies were nurtured by the power of heaven and earth, so they had boundless strength. They were already qualified to be called vicious beasts.

Some giant fish were extremely fierce, and after discovering Ling Han, they immediately launched an attack. In the end, they were naturally easily killed by Ling Han. If he found that it was delicious, he would put it away, and if it wasn't delicious, he would directly discard it.
Unfortunately, he did not discover a Celestial medicine.

Sigh, this was the Celestial medicine, after all. How could it be so easily discovered? Furthermore, there should be quite a number of people walking in front of him. Even if there was Celestial medicine, it would have already been plucked.
Another few days later, a city suddenly appeared ahead of him.
Yi!
This was not an island that had appeared in the sea. There was a city on this island, and it was at the bottom of the sea!

This city was extremely large, and it was circular in shape. In the center of the city, there was a tall tower that almost reached the surface of the sea. Then, the height of the buildings on the side gradually decreased, and when they reached the outermost circle, they were only six to nine meters tall.
The architectural style of the city was very gaudy. Some were made into the shape of a conch, while others were shell-like. They were all based on marine creatures.
In the city, there were very strange creatures swimming here and there.

Some were murlocs, but for some that too were murlocs, they had the head of a fish, the body of a fish, and then the lower half of a human. Some were the opposite, having the head of a human, and human arms, but the lower half was the body of a fish.
Aside from the murlocs, there were also lobstermen, octopusmen, and crabmen. Like the murlocs, they had two forms.
This was the city of the Sea Race.

Ling Han immediately swam over. It was a good thing that there was a change in the scenery. He had been afraid that he would be wandering around aimlessly. That could very possibly be a waste of time.
As expected, he wasn't the first to arrive. There were other outsiders in the city, and this was also one of the reasons why Ling Han swam over without hesitation.
The members of the Sea Race didn't pay much attention to him. Perhaps there were too many outsiders here, so he was naturally unremarkable.
However, the people and objects here did not exist for no reason.

Just take the stone forest from before as an example. It was actually a super giant, and insects had wormed into its body and wreaked havoc from the colossal pit. When the giant left, a large amount of Celestial medicines appeared.
Then, what was the purpose of the existence of this city?
Ling Han roamed around, trying to understand the situation.
After a while, he had a rough understanding of this city.
This was the Blue Star Nation, which was ruled by the Blue Star King, and in the far north, there was another Underworld Nation, which was constantly at odds with the Blue Star Nation.

By this generation, there was hope that this feud could be resolved, because the Blue Star King only had one daughter, and in the case of the Underworld Nation, the old king only had one son. The two kings had the intention in having the next generation unite in matrimony. In that way, the two nations would become one, and there would naturally be no more disputes.
This was a good thing. The Prince of the Underworld Nation had already come here, but the princess of the Blue Star Nation had disappeared.
Now, the whole nation was alarmed, and were searching for the whereabouts of this princess.

The disappearance of the princess was a huge matter in the first place, and at this point in time... could it be that it was the doing of the stubborn people in the country, who were determined to fight, and did not want to form an alliance through marriage with the Underworld Nation?
Of course, it was also possible that the culpits were supporters of war from the Underworld, because if the two nations merged, it was destined that some people would lose their power.
In short, the most important thing now was to find the missing princess, so they naturally were not in the mood to care about the problem of outsiders.
As long as they didn't cause trouble, no one would care about them.

Not long after, he encountered Su Qianhai, one of the Golden Generation elites. The latter did not say another word, and immediately charged over. His terrifying battle prowess was not affected even in the great sea.
Ling Han didn't linger in battle, and directly fled.
But this time, he was angered. After shaking off Su Qianhai, he quietly returned.

When the Strange Shadow Steps unfolded, he was like a shadow in the sea. Unless one had a cultivation level that far surpassed him, and was close enough, it would be impossible to discover his existence.
He walked quietly just like that, and found Su Qianhai.
Did they think that he could only passively take a beating?
He snuck over, then suddenly attacked. As he shot out a punch, the Destructive Energy blazed. He had pushed his battle prowess to the extreme.
Peng!

Su Qianhai was a Nine Star Sect Master, after all, and furthermore, he was a Golden Generation. Though he had been hit in a rush, he managed to parry in time, and parried this punch from Ling Han. In fact, the rebound from the collision was extremely terrifying, and sent Ling Han flying, throwing up blood madly.
However, Su Qianhai immediately discovered that where Ling Han's punch had landed, his flesh and bones were actually melting, as if they had disappeared into thin air.
He paled in shock, and decisively severed a large piece of flesh in this area, along with the bones.
He could clearly see that the blood, flesh, and bones that had been severed immediately disappeared into thin air.
What terrifying destructive power.

He looked at Ling Han in the distance as he channeled his secret technique. His blood and flesh instantly began to regenerate, but the growth of his bones slowed considerably. As he approached Ling Han, he said in a baleful voice, "I didn't expect you to be proficient in the Strange Shadow Steps of the Battle God Palace!"
As expected of the Golden Generation. He had seen through it just like that?
Ling Han laughed loudly, "So, you had best keep your eyes open when you sleep. Otherwise, you won't even know when I will chop off your head!"

Ling Han saw giant fish that were several hundred meters long, as well as sea turtles that looked like small islands.
As he advanced, the variety of living creatures became more and more varied, and also became larger and larger.
Ling Han saw giant fish that were several hundred meters long, as well as sea turtles that looked like small islands.
These living beings still hadn't developed intelligence, but their bodies were nurtured by the power of heaven and earth, so they had boundless strength.
They were already qualified to be called vicious beasts.
Some giant fish were extremely fierce, and after discovering Ling Han, they immediately launched an attack.
In the end, they were naturally easily killed by Ling Han.
If he found that it was delicious, he would put it away, and if it wasn't delicious, he would directly discard it.
Unfortunately, he did not discover a Celestial medicine.
Sigh, this was the Celestial medicine, after all.
How could it be so easily discovered?
Furthermore, there should be quite a number of people walking in front of him.
Even if there was Celestial medicine, it would have already been plucked.
Another few days later, a city suddenly appeared ahead of him.
Yi!
This was not an island that had appeared in the sea.
There was a city on this island, and it was at the bottom of the sea!
This city was extremely large, and it was circular in shape.
In the center of the city, there was a tall tower that almost reached the surface of the sea.
Then, the height of the buildings on the side gradually decreased, and when they reached the outermost circle, they were only six to nine meters tall.
The architectural style of the city was very gaudy.
Some were made into the shape of a conch, while others were shell-like.
They were all based on marine creatures.
In the city, there were very strange creatures swimming here and there.
Some were murlocs, but for some that too were murlocs, they had the head of a fish, the body of a fish, and then the lower half of a human.
Some were the opposite, having the head of a human, and human arms, but the lower half was the body of a fish.
Aside from the murlocs, there were also lobstermen, octopusmen, and crabmen.
Like the murlocs, they had two forms.
This was the city of the Sea Race.
Ling Han immediately swam over.
It was a good thing that there was a change in the scenery.
He had been afraid that he would be wandering around aimlessly.
That could very possibly be a waste of time.
As expected, he wasn't the first to arrive.
There were other outsiders in the city, and this was also one of the reasons why Ling Han swam over without hesitation.
The members of the Sea Race didn't pay much attention to him.
Perhaps there were too many outsiders here, so he was naturally unremarkable.
However, the people and objects here did not exist for no reason.
Just take the stone forest from before as an example.
It was actually a super giant, and insects had wormed into its body and wreaked havoc from the colossal pit.
When the giant left, a large amount of Celestial medicines appeared.
Then, what was the purpose of the existence of this city?
Ling Han roamed around, trying to understand the situation.
After a while, he had a rough understanding of this city.
This was the Blue Star Nation, which was ruled by the Blue Star King, and in the far north, there was another Underworld Nation, which was constantly at odds with the Blue Star Nation.
By this generation, there was hope that this feud could be resolved, because the Blue Star King only had one daughter, and in the case of the Underworld Nation, the old king only had one son.
The two kings had the intention in having the next generation unite in matrimony.
In that way, the two nations would become one, and there would naturally be no more disputes.
This was a good thing.
The Prince of the Underworld Nation had already come here, but the princess of the Blue Star Nation had disappeared.
Now, the whole nation was alarmed, and were searching for the whereabouts of this princess.

The disappearance of the princess was a huge matter in the first place, and at this point in time... could it be that it was the doing of the stubborn people in the country, who were determined to fight, and did not want to form an alliance through marriage with the Underworld Nation?
Of course, it was also possible that the culpits were supporters of war from the Underworld, because if the two nations merged, it was destined that some people would lose their power.
In short, the most important thing now was to find the missing princess, so they naturally were not in the mood to care about the problem of outsiders.
As long as they didn't cause trouble, no one would care about them.
Not long after, he encountered Su Qianhai, one of the Golden Generation elites.
The latter did not say another word, and immediately charged over.
His terrifying battle prowess was not affected even in the great sea.
Ling Han didn't linger in battle, and directly fled.
But this time, he was angered.
After shaking off Su Qianhai, he quietly returned.
When the Strange Shadow Steps unfolded, he was like a shadow in the sea.
Unless one had a cultivation level that far surpassed him, and was close enough, it would be impossible to discover his existence.
He walked quietly just like that, and found Su Qianhai.
Did they think that he could only passively take a beating?
He snuck over, then suddenly attacked.
As he shot out a punch, the Destructive Energy blazed.
He had pushed his battle prowess to the extreme.
Peng!
Su Qianhai was a Nine Star Sect Master, after all, and furthermore, he was a Golden Generation.
Though he had been hit in a rush, he managed to parry in time, and parried this punch from Ling Han.
In fact, the rebound from the collision was extremely terrifying, and sent Ling Han flying, throwing up blood madly.
However, Su Qianhai immediately discovered that where Ling Han's punch had landed, his flesh and bones were actually melting, as if they had disappeared into thin air.
He paled in shock, and decisively severed a large piece of flesh in this area, along with the bones.
He could clearly see that the blood, flesh, and bones that had been severed immediately disappeared into thin air.
What terrifying destructive power.
He looked at Ling Han in the distance as he channeled his secret technique.
His blood and flesh instantly began to regenerate, but the growth of his bones slowed considerably.
As he approached Ling Han, he said in a baleful voice, "I didn't expect you to be proficient in the Strange Shadow Steps of the Battle God Palace!"
As expected of the Golden Generation.
He had seen through it just like that?
Ling Han laughed loudly, "So, you had best keep your eyes open when you sleep.
Otherwise, you won't even know when I will chop off your head!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4443 Missing Princess
paragraphs: Faced with Ling Han's provocation, Su Qianhai was actually rendered speechless.

He really couldn't catch up to Ling Han, and Ling Han had also mastered the mysterious movement technique of the Battle God Palace. It was really impossible to guard against him when he was planning to kill.
Why was the Battle God Palace so infamous, that others hated and feared them at the same time?
No one knew where their lair was, and the other reason was naturally the Strange Shadow Steps. Many people had been assassinated, without even knowing what was going on.
"Who would've thought that your true identity is an assassin from the Battle God Palace!" Su Qianhai finally spoke up.

Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, "Hehe, don't flatter the Battle God Palace. They are not qualified to take in a prodigy like me! Hehe, it was only by chance that I managed to learn a movement technique from the Battle God Palace."
Just how lucky are you?
In truth, in terms of speed, the greatest technique in the world was definitely the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, but in terms of concealment, it would definitely be the Strange Shadow Steps.
Su Qianhai just looked at Ling Han like that, the killing intent in his eyes cold.
It wasn't that he didn't want to kill Ling Han, but that he couldn't.

If one wanted to kill Ling Han, it would either have to be a Venerate Tier elite making a move, or one had to plan ahead of time, so that the latter would not be able to make full use of his advantage in speed. Otherwise, if Phoenix Wings Divine Flightwas used, what Sect Master would be able to catch up to him?

A powerful sense of urgency rose up in his heart. By the looks of it, he had to advance into the fourth pinnacle level. After becoming a Venerate Tier, he only had to stretch stretch out a hand, and heaven and earth could be controlled. Wouldn't it be easy to kill Ling Han then?

However, the problem was that his fruits of cultivation hadn't reached perfection yet. If he allowed the fruits of cultivation to transform into the Fourth Extreme at this moment, it would definitely affect his future potential.
At this moment, he was extremely conflicted.
"Dumb c*nt, I'll come kill you next time. There's no need to send me off." Ling Han's figure flashed, and the Strange Shadow Steps activated. He once again fled into the darkness.
Though Su Qianhai was so angry that even his hair was standing on end, there was nothing he could do.
After Ling Han roamed around the city for two days, the royal family suddenly issued a bounty.

Anyone who could provide information on the whereabouts of the princess would be rewarded with five kilograms of Extreme Radiance Shell, and if they could bring the princess back, they would be rewarded with an additional Extreme Cold Pearl!

Ling Han made some analyses. The Extreme Radiance Shell was really a kind of shell. Its taste was incredibly fresh and delicious, and was also greatly nutritious. It would be of great help in improving one's cultivation level and physique.
And the Extreme Cold Pearl was even more incredible. That was a natural treasure, nurtured by heaven and earth, and contained Celestial Qi!

When the news spread out, not only were the citizens of the Blue Star Nation excited, even the outsiders were restless. In fact, there were also cultivators from the distant Underworld Nation that were rapidly rushing over, wanting to join the ranks of searching for the Blue Star Princess.
Ling Han's heart thumped in excitement. This was Celestial Qi! He needed it!
Sigh, others would only need Celestial Qi after becoming a Sect Master, but him? He actually needed it long before that, when he was only in Spirit Transformation Tier.
However, this also proved how freakish he was.
However, the sea was boundless, so where was he supposed to find this Blue Star Princess?
This was in line with the saying, it was like fishing out a needle from the sea.

Ling Han first went to the palace, but discovered that the royal family here could not be more approachable. Though there were guards in the palace, they were very polite towards the commoners, and there was no ban on visitors at all — as long as they did not go to the bedroom of the king, queen and princess.
With such lax defenses, whether the Blue Star Princess had been kidnapped, or she had left home on her own, either could happen too easily.
Had she run away from home?
Of course, this was very likely. That was because this princess may not agree to marry, so wasn't it very understandable for her to throw a tantrum and run away from home?
But whether the Blue Star Princess had been kidnapped, or she had run off on her own, where should they go to find her?
Several days had already passed, and there were no more clues. How were they supposed to find her?
Ling Han exited the city and roamed around aimlessly. However, he didn't find anything.
This sea was so big, and it was a three-dimensional one at that. If a person was really hidden here, how could they possibly find her?
He racked his brains.
This Blue Star Princess had not disappeared earlier or later, but just so happened to be at such a crucial time when outsiders had come. This was really too coincidental.
Thus, Ling Han definitely wouldn't believe that this wasn't deliberately planned.
Unknowingly, there was a force behind this.
This was Imperial Path, and could be seen as the heaven and earth moving to select a future Great Emperor. Thus, it was very normal for there to be traces of arrangements.
Since that was the case, then the whereabouts of the Blue Star Princess would definitely be traceable. It would not really be like trying to find a needle in a haystack.
Yi?
Could it be that this princess was actually still in the city?

Ling Han suddenly had a flash of inspiration. If a princess who enjoyed a comfortable life suddenly had to wander the world, and there was no shortage of fierce beasts in the sea, how many days would this princess be able to live?
The conditions for obtaining the bounty were that the princess had to return to the palace alive.
Thus, if the Blue Star Princess was still in the city, then where would she be?

Firstly, it must be a very remote place. Otherwise, no matter how well it was hidden, there would definitely be clues left behind. Secondly, there must be someone taking care of her. Otherwise, there would still be clues left behind.
With these two points in mind, Ling Han began to sift through his memory, based on his understanding of this city from the last few days.
"There are a total of three places."

"The two places are poverty-stricken caves, and there are both good and bad people mixed in. Even the power of the nation would find it very difficult to infiltrate these places. They are both controlled by the underground forces."

"There's also a land of the dead. An earthquake happened in the past, and a terrifying energy surged out. All living things were wiped out there, and it's still considered a land of the dead and uninhabited."
"En, let's go to this danger zone first."
Ling Han immediately set off, and soon arrived at his destination.
Previously, he had come here, but did not venture too deep, because he could still sense a strange energy fluctuation.
However, this time was different. He planned to search carefully.
At this moment, he felt a little regretful. That was because there was only one self, and there was no spiritual body that he could send out to help him search.
"There are gains and losses. Although I have lost some convenience, my own battle prowess has become stronger. This is what is most important."

Ling Han strolled slowly. In the centre of this area, there was shockingly a ravine that was so deep that one could not see the bottom. There was also rolling energy seeping out from within, causing one's heart to palpitate.
"Hmm?"
He faltered slightly. He had actually heard a song.
This was a female voice, extremely ethereal.
It couldn't be so coincidental that it was that Blue Star Princess that was singing, right?
He followed the direction of the song, and very soon, he saw a figure's back. She was seated on a massive shell, her long hair fluttering in the waves, revealing her snow-white back.

Though she was only showing her back, her willowy waist was slender, her skin was snow-white, and was already very enchanting. However, there was a fish tail growing from the lower half of her body, and it was swaying gently, looking extremely beautiful.
Er, seeing this tail, it should be able to instantly make a great many men lose interest.
Ling Han opened his mouth, and asked, "Blue Star Princess?"
The song came to an abrupt stop. The mermaid seemed to have received a shock, and immediately swam forwards. With a wave of her tail, her speed was extremely fast.
Ling Han hurriedly set off in pursuit, and the distance between the two of them rapidly shortened.
Shua, a cold light suddenly shot over from the side, aimed directly at Ling Han's left shoulder.
