chapters.title: Chapter 4444 Boss Zhang, the Sea Alligator
paragraphs: Sneak attack!
However, it was only Spirit Transformation Tier-level.
Now, a Spirit Transformation Tier-level attack wanted to pose a threat to Ling Han? Hehe.
He stretched out a hand and pressed down. This cold light immediately stopped. It was actually a sharp spike.
Ling Han looked towards the side and saw that there was a... sea cucumber standing there?
It was clearly a sea cucumber, but he had a human head, and his whole body was covered with sharp spikes.
F***, did the spines of sea cucumbers look like this?
Ling Han smiled, and said, "You are misleading my impression of sea cucumbers. If they look like you, would I still have the appetite to eat sea cucumbers in future?"
That sea cucumber person flew into a thunderous rage, and immediately arched his body. Xiu, xiu, xiu, several more flashes of cold light shot towards Ling Han.
Right at this moment, the woman in front of him suddenly turned around.
Aiyo!

Ling Han's impression of the mermaid also crumbled abruptly. This was indeed a female's image, but her face was green, and her skin was layered at that. It would be more accurate to call her a vengeful spirit with a green face and fangs.
Could this possibly be the Blue Star Princess?

Ling Han couldn't help but scratch his head. The Blue Star Nation was really careless. They clearly sent people to search for the missing princess, yet they didn't even hand out a portrait of the princess.
So, was this green-faced, fanged mermaid really the Blue Star Princess?
Shua, this mermaid also charged back, a harpoon in her hand.
Yi?
As the princess of a nation, would she use such a tasteless weapon? Furthermore, you yourself are a fish, so is it really good to use a harpoon?
Ling Han mocked internally as he brandished his fists.
Peng! A terrifying power surged, and the mermaid's hands instantly loosened. The weapon slipped from her hands, and the web between her thumb and forefinger split open, blood dripping.
The sea cucumber person hurriedly charged over as well. His whole body shook, and sharp spikes shot out madly.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen, and the sharp spikes couldn't break through his defenses at all.
He smiled faintly, "Come, tell me about your origins."
The mermaid and sea cucumber both looked stunned. This opponent was too strong. They were completely no match for him.
The two of them still wanted to resist stubbornly, but Ling Han had already lost all patience. The barrage of murderous aura surged out, immediately causing the two of them to scream in pain.
Of course, he had only used a little of his might. Otherwise, with this strike, the minds of the two of them would have long since been destroyed.
"I'll speak! I'll speak!"
"We are the subordinates of the Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang."
The two of them hurriedly confessed.
"What Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang?" Ling Han asked.

The sea cucumber man hurriedly explained. This Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang, was the boss of one of the two underground gangs in the slums. It was said that he had once been a general of the Blue Star Nation, but for some reason, he suddenly quit the army. Instead, he went to the slums.
This was a Sect Master elite. Thus, he quickly suppressed that slum and became the leader.
"Then why did you guys ambush me?" Ling Han asked.

The two of them stuttered for a moment before finally revealing the truth. As it turned out, Boss Zhang was also looking for the Blue Star Princess, and had sent his subordinates to search everywhere for the whereabouts of this princess, while the "mermaid" and sea cucumber were responsible for searching this area.

Of course, they had not gained much here, but an idea came to them, and they decided to carry out a robbery here, because they knew that there would definitely be a great many outsiders that were also searching for the Blue Star Princess.
However, it was a shame that their first business trip ended up encountering Ling Han. Not only did they not reap any rewards, but they even ended up as prisoners.
Ling Han didn't make things difficult for the two of them. They only wanted to rob him, and had no intention of killing him. Thus, after he counter-robbed them, he let the two of them leave.
He searched again, but did not find any clues about the Blue Star Princess, so he could only leave.
Now, there were only two places left, which were the two slums.
Would the Blue Star Princess be there?
In that kind of place, the boss of an underground force had extremely great power. In their territory, if someone wanted to live quietly for a period of time, the chances of this was extremely low.
Then, wasn't the Blue Star Princess in these two slums?
Ling Han thought for a moment, but still decided to personally take a look.
He set out, and soon arrived at the east side of the city.

The buildings in the city were the tallest in the center, symbolizing imperial authority, and the further one went, the shorter these buildings became, and when one reached the slums, they were only a few meters tall. There were no more gorgeous adornments like corals, and they looked dilapidated.
The moment Ling Han entered, he instantly attracted the gazes of many people. They all turned to look at him.
However, they all ignored him, having no intention of speaking to him.
After walking for a short while, two octopus people walked over and stopped him.
"Our boss wants to see you," one of them said.
"Who is your boss?" Ling Han asked.
"Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang!"
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, "All right, then let's go and meet him."
With these two octopus people leading the way, or rather holding him hostage, they arrived at a conch-shaped building.
The room was very big. After Ling Han walked in, he suddenly felt as if he had entered into a nation of giants.
Indeed, the citizens of the Blue Star Nation were generally huge in size.
"You're the one who robbed my subordinates?" A voice rang out, and a sturdy man was seated at the end of the room.
His upper body was human, but his lower body was a crocodile. He had two long legs and an even thicker tail, covered with green scales.
Yi, aren't crocodile's legs very short? What breed are you considered?
Ling Han mocked internally, already confirming the other's identity.
The Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang.
Ling Han's eyes swept over him. With the activation of his eye technique, he had tentatively determined that the other's cultivation level was Six Star Sect Master.
His maximum battle prowess was around five stars, so he probably wouldn't be able to win against this sea crocodile person. However, with his defenses, he wouldn't necessarily lose either.
"They wanted to rob me, but they weren't as powerful as me. Thus, I turned around to rob them instead," Ling Han explained with a smile.
Yet the Sea Alligator smirked coldly, "On the basis that you have not hurt anyone, return the items, and apologize, and I will forget the past."
Ling Han shook his head, "Boss Zhang is really protective of his own people!"
"Humph, no matter how big a mistake my people have made, it is not up to others to interfere!" Sea Alligator Zhang declared very domineeringly.
"Then I'm afraid I won't be able to comply." Ling Han stood up and was just about to leave.
"Humph, did I allow you to leave?" the Sea Alligator said menacingly. Suddenly, he stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Ling Han replied with a punch of his own. Peng! The two of them exchanged a blow, instantly creating powerful ripples of water, causing the conch house to instantly shatter.

Thankfully, this seawater had a very strong digestive ability for power, and added with the fact that the structures here were extraordinarily sturdy, when the conch house was shattered, the remaining power had more or less dissipated.
The Sea Alligator was astonished, and looked at Ling Han in disbelief.
Was this guy really Spirit Transformation Tier?
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I am indeed a Spirit Transformation Tier, as real as can be. Er, Boss Zhang, are you still going to stop me from leaving?"

Ling Han looked towards the side and saw that there was a... sea cucumber standing there?
It was clearly a sea cucumber, but he had a human head, and his whole body was covered with sharp spikes.
F***, did the spines of sea cucumbers look like this?
Ling Han smiled, and said, "You are misleading my impression of sea cucumbers.
If they look like you, would I still have the appetite to eat sea cucumbers in future?"
That sea cucumber person flew into a thunderous rage, and immediately arched his body.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, several more flashes of cold light shot towards Ling Han.
Right at this moment, the woman in front of him suddenly turned around.
Aiyo!
Ling Han's impression of the mermaid also crumbled abruptly.
This was indeed a female's image, but her face was green, and her skin was layered at that.
It would be more accurate to call her a vengeful spirit with a green face and fangs.
Could this possibly be the Blue Star Princess?
Ling Han couldn't help but scratch his head.
The Blue Star Nation was really careless.
They clearly sent people to search for the missing princess, yet they didn't even hand out a portrait of the princess.
So, was this green-faced, fanged mermaid really the Blue Star Princess?
Shua, this mermaid also charged back, a harpoon in her hand.
Yi?
As the princess of a nation, would she use such a tasteless weapon?
Furthermore, you yourself are a fish, so is it really good to use a harpoon?
Ling Han mocked internally as he brandished his fists.
Peng!
A terrifying power surged, and the mermaid's hands instantly loosened.
The weapon slipped from her hands, and the web between her thumb and forefinger split open, blood dripping.
The sea cucumber person hurriedly charged over as well.
His whole body shook, and sharp spikes shot out madly.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen, and the sharp spikes couldn't break through his defenses at all.
He smiled faintly, "Come, tell me about your origins."
The mermaid and sea cucumber both looked stunned.
This opponent was too strong.
They were completely no match for him.
The two of them still wanted to resist stubbornly, but Ling Han had already lost all patience.
The barrage of murderous aura surged out, immediately causing the two of them to scream in pain.
Of course, he had only used a little of his might.
Otherwise, with this strike, the minds of the two of them would have long since been destroyed.
"I'll speak!
I'll speak!"
"We are the subordinates of the Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang."
The two of them hurriedly confessed.
"What Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang?" Ling Han asked.
The sea cucumber man hurriedly explained.
This Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang, was the boss of one of the two underground gangs in the slums.
It was said that he had once been a general of the Blue Star Nation, but for some reason, he suddenly quit the army.
Instead, he went to the slums.
This was a Sect Master elite.
Thus, he quickly suppressed that slum and became the leader.
"Then why did you guys ambush me?" Ling Han asked.
The two of them stuttered for a moment before finally revealing the truth.

As it turned out, Boss Zhang was also looking for the Blue Star Princess, and had sent his subordinates to search everywhere for the whereabouts of this princess, while the "mermaid" and sea cucumber were responsible for searching this area.

Of course, they had not gained much here, but an idea came to them, and they decided to carry out a robbery here, because they knew that there would definitely be a great many outsiders that were also searching for the Blue Star Princess.
However, it was a shame that their first business trip ended up encountering Ling Han.
Not only did they not reap any rewards, but they even ended up as prisoners.
Ling Han didn't make things difficult for the two of them.
They only wanted to rob him, and had no intention of killing him.
Thus, after he counter-robbed them, he let the two of them leave.
He searched again, but did not find any clues about the Blue Star Princess, so he could only leave.
Now, there were only two places left, which were the two slums.
Would the Blue Star Princess be there?
In that kind of place, the boss of an underground force had extremely great power.
In their territory, if someone wanted to live quietly for a period of time, the chances of this was extremely low.
Then, wasn't the Blue Star Princess in these two slums?
Ling Han thought for a moment, but still decided to personally take a look.
He set out, and soon arrived at the east side of the city.

The buildings in the city were the tallest in the center, symbolizing imperial authority, and the further one went, the shorter these buildings became, and when one reached the slums, they were only a few meters tall.
There were no more gorgeous adornments like corals, and they looked dilapidated.
The moment Ling Han entered, he instantly attracted the gazes of many people.
They all turned to look at him.
However, they all ignored him, having no intention of speaking to him.
After walking for a short while, two octopus people walked over and stopped him.
"Our boss wants to see you," one of them said.
"Who is your boss?" Ling Han asked.
"Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang!"
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, "All right, then let's go and meet him."
With these two octopus people leading the way, or rather holding him hostage, they arrived at a conch-shaped building.
The room was very big.
After Ling Han walked in, he suddenly felt as if he had entered into a nation of giants.
Indeed, the citizens of the Blue Star Nation were generally huge in size.
"You're the one who robbed my subordinates?" A voice rang out, and a sturdy man was seated at the end of the room.
His upper body was human, but his lower body was a crocodile.
He had two long legs and an even thicker tail, covered with green scales.
Yi, aren't crocodile's legs very short?
What breed are you considered?
Ling Han mocked internally, already confirming the other's identity.
The Sea Alligator, Boss Zhang.
Ling Han's eyes swept over him.
With the activation of his eye technique, he had tentatively determined that the other's cultivation level was Six Star Sect Master.
His maximum battle prowess was around five stars, so he probably wouldn't be able to win against this sea crocodile person.
However, with his defenses, he wouldn't necessarily lose either.
"They wanted to rob me, but they weren't as powerful as me.
Thus, I turned around to rob them instead," Ling Han explained with a smile.
Yet the Sea Alligator smirked coldly, "On the basis that you have not hurt anyone, return the items, and apologize, and I will forget the past."
Ling Han shook his head, "Boss Zhang is really protective of his own people!"
"Humph, no matter how big a mistake my people have made, it is not up to others to interfere!" Sea Alligator Zhang declared very domineeringly.
"Then I'm afraid I won't be able to comply." Ling Han stood up and was just about to leave.
"Humph, did I allow you to leave?" the Sea Alligator said menacingly.
Suddenly, he stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Ling Han replied with a punch of his own.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, instantly creating powerful ripples of water, causing the conch house to instantly shatter.

Thankfully, this seawater had a very strong digestive ability for power, and added with the fact that the structures here were extraordinarily sturdy, when the conch house was shattered, the remaining power had more or less dissipated.
The Sea Alligator was astonished, and looked at Ling Han in disbelief.
Was this guy really Spirit Transformation Tier?
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I am indeed a Spirit Transformation Tier, as real as can be.
Er, Boss Zhang, are you still going to stop me from leaving?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4445 Prince of the Underworld Nation
paragraphs: The Sea Alligator was incredibly stunned.

What kind of Spirit Transformation Tier was this? This was too terrifying, wasn't it? It should be known that he was a Six Stars Sect Master, and to only be at a slight disadvantage even in a head-on clash with him, this kind of strength was truly heaven-defying.
He was a decisive person, and he immediately nodded. "Those two subordinates of mine are blind. I'll apologize to you on their behalf!"
—If a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator provoked a Sect Master, based on the hierarchy of martial arts, this was a crime of great rebellion. The Sect Master was completely capable of killing him.
How could the authority of the Sect Master be slighted?
However, Ling Han had only turned around to rob the two of them, and had not taken their lives. From this aspect, it could be said that he was incredibly generous.
Thus, when the Sea Alligator Zhang discovered that Ling Han had battle prowess on the level of Sect Master, he immediately turned around to apologize to Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled and said, "Boss Zhang is too polite."
"As an apology, I'll treat you to a meal." The Sea Alligator was very direct.
Ling Han politely refused. The members of the Sea Race ate raw food and didn't use firewood, so he wasn't used to eating their food.
"Boss!" At this moment, a crabman suddenly rushed in.
"What's going on?" The Sea Alligator glanced at him, appearing slightly displeased. He was so flustered, had he forgotten how he usually taught them?
"There's news about the Blue Star Princess," the crabman hurriedly replied.
"En?" The Sea Alligator Zhang immediately stood up.
Ling Han was also surprised. He had not thought that he would actually have an unexpected gain from this trip.
The Sea Alligator hesitated slightly, but did not keep their words from Ling Han either, and asked, "What news?"
"Someone said that they have information about the Blue Star Princess, and are currently selling it everywhere," the crabman said.
The Sea Alligator Zhang immediately humphed, and said, "How dare they, to even dare to earn such money!"

Meanwhile, Ling Han was slightly surprised. Judging by the way the Sea Alligator was speaking, he seemed to be on the side of the Blue Star Royal Family. Then why had he left the army in the first place, and come here to become a boss?
The Sea Alligator looked at Ling Han, and couldn't help but smile, "Looks like we won't be saying goodbye for the moment."
"Hehe." Ling Han laughed as well. At present, everyone was searching for the Blue Star Princess, and this was no secret.
"Lead the way." The sea crocodile said to the crabman.
They set out, and soon arrived at a place in the city.
Unexpectedly, there was actually a queue here, and from the scraps of information, they had all come to find out about the disappearance of the Blue Star Princess.
People came out one after another, and immediately left in large strides.
Had they gotten a clue and begun their search?
Finally, it was Ling Han and the Sea Alligator's turn.
The two of them entered, and there was only a snakeman sitting here. Although he had a human face, his hair was like small snakes that were sleeping.
"So it is a rotten snake like you!" Sea Alligator Zhang immediately humphed, his eyes revealing a sliver of killing intent.
"Please calm your anger, General Zhang!" The snakeman hurriedly put on a smile, and said, "I'm a citizen of this nation, so all I earn is lawful money."
"I have long since ceased to be a General of the nation." The Sea Alligator shook his head, but there was a sliver of nostalgia in his eyes.

"General Zhang, are you underestimating my ability to gather intel?" the snakeman said with a smile. He even blinked at the sea alligator. "On the basis that you're General Zhang, I'll give you a 60% discount and collect 12 drops of conch spirit from you."
"You really dare to ask!" The Sea Alligator humphed, "The princess of the Royal Family has also become a tool for you to earn money?"

"Hehe, I have so many lackeys, so we have to earn a living somehow! General Zhang, don't you have to take care of a large group of people? You have to take care of even their daily necessities, so you definitely can understand me." The snakeman put on a humble attitude.
The Sea Alligator hesitated for a moment, then threw out a bottle. Then, he said, "If you give me false information, then chop off your own head."
"Don't worry. I've always been a trustworthy businessman, and I definitely won't screw others over," the snakeman said with a smile as he put the vial away.
"Speak," the Sea Alligator said darkly, his expression definitely not looking good.
"6km east of the Green Source Trench, someone picked up the bracelet that the princess had dropped," the snakeman revealed the news.
This bit of information was worth twelve drops of conch spirit, and it was under the condition of a 40% discount?
Ling Han knew that the conch spirit was an extremely valuable treasure in the Blue Star Nation. It could help the members of the Sea Race improve their bloodline.
The Sea Alligator immediately turned around and left.
Ling Han naturally left as well. When they walked out, they shockingly discovered that the entrance had actually been cleared. There were more than 20 guards standing guard, shooing the others aside.
A man in purple-gold scales strode over. There were barely any traces of the Sea Race on him, and only his hands were claws, exuding a baleful chill.
When he saw Sea Alligator Zhang and Ling Han, he humphed, and said, "Don't block my path, scram!"
There was no prince in the Blue Star Nation.
"Jiao Delei!" The Sea Alligator opened his mouth, his eyes focused on this armored man.
"Oh, and who might this be? So it's General Zhang." Jiao Delei smiled proudly, "However, I heard that General Zhang has already removed his armor and returned to the fields?"
"Humph, if the Underworld Nation dares to attack, you guys will still see me on the battlefield!" Sea Alligator Zhang retorted.
As it turned out, this person was the prince of the Underworld Nation.

His fiancee had gone missing, so it was logical for him to come out and look for her. However, wasn't this attitude a little too arrogant? He had not married the princess yet, and he was already treating this place as his own territory?

Yet Jiao Delei laughed loudly, "General Zhang must be joking. When I marry the Blue Star Princess, the Underworld Nation and Blue Star Nation would be one family, so how could there be any mention of attack?"
"Hehe." The Sea Alligator merely responded with a smile, and strode off.
Ling Han naturally would not deal with this Prince of the Underworld Nation, and followed the Sea Alligator.
Instead, it was Jiao Delei. His eyes paused on Ling Han, as if he was curious why Sea Alligator Zhang was involved with a human.
However, he quickly withdrew his gaze, and strode into the house.

His fiancee had gone missing, and whether she had run away on her own volition or been kidnapped, it was a matter that would greatly damage his pride. Thus, he had to find the missing princess as soon as possible.

Ling Han followed the sea alligator. Soon, they left the city, and arrived at a massive oceanic trench. There was a large amount of green seaweed in the oceanic trench. No wonder it was called the Green Source Trench.
After walking along the oceanic trench for a while, the sea alligator stopped, and began to search extremely carefully.
There were signs of a battle here.
However, this was the ocean bed, and there were always ocean currents surging here. Many days had already passed, so what other clues could they find?
After a while, the Sea Alligator shook his head, appearing very disappointed.
The trail had been cut off again?
Unable to find any useful clues, Sea Alligator Zhang's mood was not very high. He merely smiled at Ling Han, and left.
Meanwhile, Ling Han circled around for a while longer. Unfortunately, he had not grasped the Regulations of Time. Otherwise, if he traced back time, he might discover something.

Previously, he had always suspected that the Blue Star Princess had fled from the marriage, but since traces of a fight had been discovered here, and there was even a bracelet worn by the princess, it meant that this princess had really been kidnapped now.
'Hmm?'
In the distance, Jiao Delei was presently swimming over rapidly, and there was a team of guards behind him. It was a very extravagant display.

chapters.title: Chapter 4446 Kidnapper Exposed
paragraphs: "Scram!" When Jiao Delei saw Ling Han, he immediately rebuked coldly.
Ling Han wasn't Sea Alligator Zhang. He had regained his arrogant attitude.
"Hehe." Ling Han merely smiled faintly, and ignored him.
"I told you to scram. Don't you have ears?" Jiao Delei said balefully. He hadn't been in a good mood these past few days. If anyone dared to trifle with him now, they would become his punching bag.
Ling Han still ignored him. Now that the trail was cut off again, should he give up on the idea of finding the princess to collect the bounty?
"Human, you actually dare to ignore me!" Jiao Delei was furious, and waved a claw, "Apprehend him!"
Instantly, those guards swam out and surrounded Ling Han.
Ling Han couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself. "That so-called Prince, this is the Blue Star Nation, so isn't it a little too early for you to issue commands now?"
"Sooner or later, it'll be my territory, so what does it matter if it is earlier?" Jiao Delei humphed.
Instantly, the guards all charged out, attacking Ling Han.
The weapons of these guards varied. Some used harpoons, some used halberds, but all of them were Spirit Tools. After awakening, they shone brightly.
Ling Han shook his head as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Weng, a spiritual attack shot out. Pa, pa, pa, these guards instantly rolled their eyes into the back of their heads, and all of them passed out.
And this was still because Ling Han had held back. Otherwise, what Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator could withstand the barrage of his murderous aura?
Jiao Delei was stunned upon seeing his guards floating along with the sea currents. However, he was more so infuriated and humiliated.

He was indeed astonished by Ling Han's strength. Ling Han didn't even raise his hand, and his Spirit Transformation Tier guards all fell to the ground. However, what followed was fury. He was the son of the Underworld King, so how could it be that he couldn't capture a single person?
"Human, immediately kneel down and surrender. Don't force me to make a move personally!" he said balefully.
No matter how strong you are, so what? After all, you are only a Spirit Transformation Tier, and what about him?
A Four-Star Sect Master!
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I have always been the type to not offend others if they did not offend me. If you insist on offending me, that would only be asking for your own suffering!"
He took the initiative to charge out, charging towards Jiao Delei.
"You're seeking death!" Jiao Delei said with a cold chuckle. He swung his claw, and hong! Five streaks of cold light slashed toward Ling Han.
These five flashes of cold light were all formed by Regulations, as if they were ice.
Ling Han was unafraid, and shot out a punch to greet the incoming attack.
Peng!
Under the barrage of the punch, the five flashes of cold light immediately crumbled. Ling Han was only slightly slowed down, and then charged towards Jiao Delei again.
'What?'
This time, Jiao Delei was finally shocked.

Previously, though he knew that Ling Han's strength was extraordinary, he was only a Spirit Transformation Tier after all, so how could he compare to the strength of a Sect Master? But now that they had exchanged blows, he realized that not only did Ling Han possess Sect Master-level battle prowess, it was even possible that Ling Han possessed battle prowess above his.
How could this not make him pale in shock?
At the first instant, he drew out the Spirit Tool. It was a three-pronged halberd that stabbed towards Ling Han. Boom, the Spirit Tool revived, shining brilliantly.

This was a six-star Spirit Tool, and it was a treasure of this level at that. After he activated it, it released a might that reached the level of Nine Star Sect Master. The Regulations appeared, turning into multiple small flood dragons that entwined around the three-pronged Spirit Tool.
Ling Han didn't dare to face it head-on. He could only retreat with a tap of his foot.
Seeing that he had forced Ling Han to retreat with a single strike, Jiao Delei instantly regained his confidence.
"Hahaha!" He laughed loudly. This was the power of the royal family.
"Idiot!" Ling Han scoffed. The murderous aura burst forth. Weng, Jiao Delei immediately gave a muffled humph, tears of blood streaming from his eyes.
He wasn't an Imperial Son, possessing a treasure of Spiritual Power that a Great Emperor had created. Thus, he was naturally unable to block the murderous aura.
So what if his cultivation level was higher than Ling Han's? So what if he had a SIx Star Spirit Tool? It was already very impressive that he hadn't been insta-killed.
Jiao Delei finally understood what method Ling Han had used to knock out his subordinates.
Even his eyes were bleeding and tearing. How could Spirit Transformation Tiers stand against that?
However, knowing was one thing, but how was he supposed to defend?
This was practically impossible to guard against.
"You, who exactly are you?" He was a little fierce on the surface, but cowardly on the inside.
That was because Ling Han possessed the ability to wound him, or even kill him. Furthermore, this was outside the city, and Ling Han was an outsider. He could completely just kill him and leave.
Ling Han ignored him, and merely unleashed another murderous aura attack.
"Ah!" Jiao Delei clutched his head, appearing to be in extreme pain.
How was he supposed to defend against this?
He had already set up a mystical power shield. In fact, he had even covered his body with Regulations, but that attack had still shot over, completely unaffected.

It should be known that even if it was an attack of Spiritual Power, completely unrelated to the mystical power, it was one thing for the mystical power shield to be ineffective, but the Regulations were superior to Spiritual Power. Why was it that even the shield of Regulations could not block it?

Without waiting for him to mull over it, hong, hong, hong, the murderous aura struck him wave after wave, forcing him to retreat continuously. Not only were his eyes bleeding, but even his seven apertures were bleeding.
"I'll teach you a lesson this time. Remember, if you're not in your own territory, then behave," Ling Han said calmly, then turned and left.
He didn't deliver a fatal strike, mainly because this was the territory of the Sea Race. Once he killed Jiao Delei, that king from the Blue Star Nation would probably move as well.
—That was a Venerate Tier elite!
After returning to the city, Ling Han was hesitating about whether he should leave or not.
After waiting for two days, a huge piece of news suddenly spread out.
The Blue Star Nation's princess... had indeed been kidnapped. Moreover, the kidnapping party had even issued a " ransom demand", forcing the Blue Star Nation's king to abdicate!
Hiss, had this kidnapping agent taken the wrong medicine? He wanted to become a king just like that after the king abdicated?
All of a sudden, everyone thought that there was something wrong with this kidnapping agent or this group of kidnapping agents. However, as more information was revealed, no one thought so.
That was because the leader of the kidnappers was shockingly the younger brother of the current ruler of the Blue Star Nation!

In the past, he had left angrily because he was displeased that the previous King had passed the throne to his older brother. One had not thought that after so many years had passed, he would still be so malicious. He had kidnapped the Blue Star Princess, and directly threatened the King into abdicating.

Not only did this enrage the entire Blue Star Nation, but even the Underworld Nation expressed their strong indignation, expressing their willingness to fully and unconditionally support the Blue Star Nation. They were determined to save the Blue Star Princess.
It was understandable that the Underworld Nation was so furious, because once the Blue Star King accepted the condition, wouldn't the peace between the two sides come to nothing?
Even if it didn't come to nothing, what was the point of Jiao Delei marrying the Blue Star Princess? Could he still use this political marriage to annex the Blue Star Nation?
Thus, they naturally had to spare no effort to support the Blue Star Nation.
Only a few days later, the general of the Underworld Nation, Jiao Yuan, brought a team of elites over.
Jiao Yuan was the younger brother of the King of the Underworld Nation, and was also the second strongest elite in the Underworld Nation, a three-star Venerate Tier elite.
In the team, there were as many as nine elites at Sect Master-level. It could be said that the Underworld Nation had really invested a lot, sending half of the strongest elites of their nation over.

sentences.text: "Scram!" When Jiao Delei saw Ling Han, he immediately rebuked coldly.
Ling Han wasn't Sea Alligator Zhang.
He had regained his arrogant attitude.
"Hehe." Ling Han merely smiled faintly, and ignored him.
"I told you to scram.
Don't you have ears?" Jiao Delei said balefully.
He hadn't been in a good mood these past few days.
If anyone dared to trifle with him now, they would become his punching bag.
Ling Han still ignored him.
Now that the trail was cut off again, should he give up on the idea of finding the princess to collect the bounty?
"Human, you actually dare to ignore me!" Jiao Delei was furious, and waved a claw, "Apprehend him!"
Instantly, those guards swam out and surrounded Ling Han.
Ling Han couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself.
"That so-called Prince, this is the Blue Star Nation, so isn't it a little too early for you to issue commands now?"
"Sooner or later, it'll be my territory, so what does it matter if it is earlier?" Jiao Delei humphed.
Instantly, the guards all charged out, attacking Ling Han.
The weapons of these guards varied.
Some used harpoons, some used halberds, but all of them were Spirit Tools.
After awakening, they shone brightly.
Ling Han shook his head as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Weng, a spiritual attack shot out.
Pa, pa, pa, these guards instantly rolled their eyes into the back of their heads, and all of them passed out.
And this was still because Ling Han had held back.
Otherwise, what Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator could withstand the barrage of his murderous aura?
Jiao Delei was stunned upon seeing his guards floating along with the sea currents.
However, he was more so infuriated and humiliated.
He was indeed astonished by Ling Han's strength.
Ling Han didn't even raise his hand, and his Spirit Transformation Tier guards all fell to the ground.
However, what followed was fury.
He was the son of the Underworld King, so how could it be that he couldn't capture a single person?
"Human, immediately kneel down and surrender.
Don't force me to make a move personally!" he said balefully.
No matter how strong you are, so what?
After all, you are only a Spirit Transformation Tier, and what about him?
A Four-Star Sect Master!
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I have always been the type to not offend others if they did not offend me.
If you insist on offending me, that would only be asking for your own suffering!"
He took the initiative to charge out, charging towards Jiao Delei.
"You're seeking death!" Jiao Delei said with a cold chuckle.
He swung his claw, and hong!
Five streaks of cold light slashed toward Ling Han.
These five flashes of cold light were all formed by Regulations, as if they were ice.
Ling Han was unafraid, and shot out a punch to greet the incoming attack.
Peng!
Under the barrage of the punch, the five flashes of cold light immediately crumbled.
Ling Han was only slightly slowed down, and then charged towards Jiao Delei again.
'What?'
This time, Jiao Delei was finally shocked.
Previously, though he knew that Ling Han's strength was extraordinary, he was only a Spirit Transformation Tier after all, so how could he compare to the strength of a Sect Master?
But now that they had exchanged blows, he realized that not only did Ling Han possess Sect Master-level battle prowess, it was even possible that Ling Han possessed battle prowess above his.
How could this not make him pale in shock?
At the first instant, he drew out the Spirit Tool.
It was a three-pronged halberd that stabbed towards Ling Han.
Boom, the Spirit Tool revived, shining brilliantly.
This was a six-star Spirit Tool, and it was a treasure of this level at that.
After he activated it, it released a might that reached the level of Nine Star Sect Master.
The Regulations appeared, turning into multiple small flood dragons that entwined around the three-pronged Spirit Tool.
Ling Han didn't dare to face it head-on.
He could only retreat with a tap of his foot.
Seeing that he had forced Ling Han to retreat with a single strike, Jiao Delei instantly regained his confidence.
"Hahaha!" He laughed loudly.
This was the power of the royal family.
"Idiot!" Ling Han scoffed.
The murderous aura burst forth.
Weng, Jiao Delei immediately gave a muffled humph, tears of blood streaming from his eyes.
He wasn't an Imperial Son, possessing a treasure of Spiritual Power that a Great Emperor had created.
Thus, he was naturally unable to block the murderous aura.
So what if his cultivation level was higher than Ling Han's?
So what if he had a SIx Star Spirit Tool?
It was already very impressive that he hadn't been insta-killed.
Jiao Delei finally understood what method Ling Han had used to knock out his subordinates.
Even his eyes were bleeding and tearing.
How could Spirit Transformation Tiers stand against that?
However, knowing was one thing, but how was he supposed to defend?
This was practically impossible to guard against.
"You, who exactly are you?" He was a little fierce on the surface, but cowardly on the inside.
That was because Ling Han possessed the ability to wound him, or even kill him.
Furthermore, this was outside the city, and Ling Han was an outsider.
He could completely just kill him and leave.
Ling Han ignored him, and merely unleashed another murderous aura attack.
"Ah!" Jiao Delei clutched his head, appearing to be in extreme pain.
How was he supposed to defend against this?
He had already set up a mystical power shield.
In fact, he had even covered his body with Regulations, but that attack had still shot over, completely unaffected.

It should be known that even if it was an attack of Spiritual Power, completely unrelated to the mystical power, it was one thing for the mystical power shield to be ineffective, but the Regulations were superior to Spiritual Power.
Why was it that even the shield of Regulations could not block it?
Without waiting for him to mull over it, hong, hong, hong, the murderous aura struck him wave after wave, forcing him to retreat continuously.
Not only were his eyes bleeding, but even his seven apertures were bleeding.
"I'll teach you a lesson this time.
Remember, if you're not in your own territory, then behave," Ling Han said calmly, then turned and left.
He didn't deliver a fatal strike, mainly because this was the territory of the Sea Race.
Once he killed Jiao Delei, that king from the Blue Star Nation would probably move as well.
—That was a Venerate Tier elite!
After returning to the city, Ling Han was hesitating about whether he should leave or not.
After waiting for two days, a huge piece of news suddenly spread out.
The Blue Star Nation's princess... had indeed been kidnapped.
Moreover, the kidnapping party had even issued a " ransom demand", forcing the Blue Star Nation's king to abdicate!
Hiss, had this kidnapping agent taken the wrong medicine?
He wanted to become a king just like that after the king abdicated?
All of a sudden, everyone thought that there was something wrong with this kidnapping agent or this group of kidnapping agents.
However, as more information was revealed, no one thought so.
That was because the leader of the kidnappers was shockingly the younger brother of the current ruler of the Blue Star Nation!
In the past, he had left angrily because he was displeased that the previous King had passed the throne to his older brother.
One had not thought that after so many years had passed, he would still be so malicious.
He had kidnapped the Blue Star Princess, and directly threatened the King into abdicating.

Not only did this enrage the entire Blue Star Nation, but even the Underworld Nation expressed their strong indignation, expressing their willingness to fully and unconditionally support the Blue Star Nation.
They were determined to save the Blue Star Princess.
It was understandable that the Underworld Nation was so furious, because once the Blue Star King accepted the condition, wouldn't the peace between the two sides come to nothing?
Even if it didn't come to nothing, what was the point of Jiao Delei marrying the Blue Star Princess?
Could he still use this political marriage to annex the Blue Star Nation?
Thus, they naturally had to spare no effort to support the Blue Star Nation.
Only a few days later, the general of the Underworld Nation, Jiao Yuan, brought a team of elites over.
Jiao Yuan was the younger brother of the King of the Underworld Nation, and was also the second strongest elite in the Underworld Nation, a three-star Venerate Tier elite.
In the team, there were as many as nine elites at Sect Master-level.
It could be said that the Underworld Nation had really invested a lot, sending half of the strongest elites of their nation over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4447 Rescue
paragraphs: "Uncle!"
In the temporary residence that the Blue Star Nation had specially prepared for the Underworld Nation, Jiao Delei paid his respects to Jiao Yuan.
Firstly, this was his uncle, a senior, and secondly, and most importantly, he was a Venerate Tier elite who could crush him with a single finger.
Jiao Yuan raised his hand and asked, "How's the situation now?"
"The Blue Star King is still considering," Jiao Delei said.
Jiao Yuan pondered for a moment, "We have to rescue the Blue Star Princess as soon as possible."

"Understood," Jiao Delei replied with a nod. This marriage was related to their plan to annex the Blue Star Nation, and without the Blue Star Princess, they naturally wouldn't need to think about anything beyond that.
"Go on." Jiao Yuan waved him off.
"Uncle." Jiao Delei wanted to say something but hesitated.
"What is it?" Jiao Yuan asked.
Jiao Delei hesitated for a moment, then said, "Nephew would like to ask uncle to suppress a human."
"Oh?" Jiao Yuan couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself. "Amongst the humans that came in this time, could it be that there are Venerate Tiers among them?"
Jiao Delei revealed an awkward expression, and said, "That human... is a Spirit Transformation Tier."
"Spirit Transformation Tier?" Jiao Yuan was truly shocked at this moment. He swept an eye over Jiao Yuan, revealing his displeasure.
Are you playing with me?
To ask for his help to suppress a mere Spirit Transformation Tier, who do you think I am?
"Uncle, this Spirit Transformation Tier is extremely strange. His battle prowess is at least comparable to a Five Star Sect Master," Jiao Delei hurriedly explained.
Jiao Yuan laughed in spite of himself. Naturally, he did not believe it at all.
A Spirit Transformation Tier possessed battle prowess on the level of Sect Master, and it was on the level of five stars at that?
Why don't you say that he can even kill Venerate Tier elites?
"It's true," Jiao Delei hurriedly emphasized, and related his previous exchange with Ling Han.
After hearing this, Jiao Yuan's expression became slightly serious, but then his expression relaxed.

No matter how freakish that human was, he was only a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator. Being able to match a Sect Master was already his limit. Compared to Venerate Tier, the gulf between them was naturally insurmountable.
"The most important thing now is to find the Blue Star Princess. Everything else can be set aside first," Jiao Yuan emphasized.
"Understood," Jiao Delei replied respectfully. No matter how domineering he was, he wouldn't dare to ruin this important matter.
Another few days later, the location of Sha Yuanxing's lair was unexpectedly exposed.
Oh, Sha Yuanxing was the younger brother of the sovereign of the Blue Star Nation, and was also the leader of the kidnapping squad this time round.

It was like this. One of his subordinates had entered into the city to gather information, yet accidentally let the cat out of the bag. In the end, he just happened to be apprehended by a member of the Underworld Nation, and under strict interrogation, the location of Sha Yuanxing's lair was forced out of him.
Now, Jiao Yuan had already moved out with elites, wanting to personally rescue the Blue Star Princess.
When the news spread out, the outsiders from the Blue Star Nation also moved out one after another.

They were naturally no match for Jiao Yuan, a Venerate Tier elite. However, they weren't going to face Jiao Yuan head-on. Instead, they were going to take advantage of the stalemate between Jiao Yuan and Sha Yuanxing to rescue the Blue Star Princess first and return to collect the bounty.
Who didn't know how to fish in troubled waters?
Ling Han followed behind the team led by Jiao Yuan. They left the city and headed north.

Setting aside the factor of water, there was actually not much difference between the ocean bed and land. Though there were no trees, there were corals and seaweed. Though it was dark, cultivators would not be affected at all in such an environment.
They traversed many oceanic trenches and mountain peaks, and finally, they arrived in front of a massive coral forest.
Sha Yuanxing's lair should be here.
Boom!

Jiao Yuan unleashed his aura like a tidal wave as he sent a message through divine sense to Jiao Delei, saying, "I'll hold Sha Yuanxing back, and you take the chance to rescue the Blue Star Princess."
He didn't say that he wanted to kill Sha Yuanxing, because Sha Yuanxing was also a Venerate Tier At most, his abilities were slightly inferior to his, so how could it be easy to kill him?

"Yes, Uncle." Jiao Delei nodded. This was naturally a good chance for him to perform. Being rescued from isolation and helplessness, a young girl's heart was the easiest to be touched. She would definitely fall in love with him at first sight.
"Jiao Yuan?" A deep voice rang out, and a man walked out from the coral. He strode forwards boldly, his royal air filled with confidence.
"Sha Yuanxing!" Jiao Yuan shouted loudly. "Hand over the Blue Star Princess, or I will behead you today!"
Sha Yuanxing smiled faintly, "Why have you come here instead of staying quietly in your Underworld Nation? Hehe, when did the Underworld Nation become Sha Tongyu's lackey?"
"Humph, looks like you're determined to force me to make a move!" Jiao Yuan immediately charged towards Sha Yuanxing. "You're only a Two Star Venerate Tier; do you think I don't know your strength?"
The two of them exchanged blows. Boom, the terrifying commotion instantly shook the heavens and earth.
This was a Venerate Tier-level battle!
"Let's go!" Jiao Delei waved his hand, indicating for those Sect Master-level elites to follow.

He was extremely at ease. His uncle was a Three Star Venerate Tier, so victory was naturally within his grasp. Moreover, Jiao Yuan didn't want to kill Sha Yuanxing, so he naturally wouldn't push him too far, forcing Sha Yuanxing to put his life on the line.
Not only him, but the others also followed suit, sneaking into the coral forest.
After all, this was Sha Yuanxing's lair, and who knew how many elites were still lying in ambush here. Thus, it was naturally best to be careful.

However, as they ventured deeper and deeper, they didn't come across any ambushes. It was just that this coral forest was extremely complicated. After circling around it, they suddenly realized that they had actually exited the coral forest somehow.
Ling Han naturally entered into the coral forest as well, but he was very unfortunate. At the first instant, he bumped into Guan Xinghan, who immediately charged towards him.
There was no need to linger in battle. Ling Han immediately fled, and then used the Strange Shadow Steps to sneak back.

If it weren't for the fact that he was in a rush to find the Blue Star Princess, Ling Han wouldn't have minded dealing a blow to Guan Xinghan. However, the gap in cultivation level between the two of them was extremely large. Even if he successfully launched a sneak attack, he would still suffer a backlash and pay a corresponding price.
Thus, he decided to look for the Blue Star Princess first.

The coral forest was incredibly complicated, but it could not hold up to the fact that Ling Han's ability of deduction was too strong. Very soon, he had made heads or tails of the situation. He searched, and could practically guarantee that he would not take the same path twice.

Close to half a day later, he passed through a coral cave, and the space ahead of him suddenly opened up, revealing a conch-shaped building. It was not very tall. Otherwise, it could not have possibly been hidden in the coral forest.
He used his divine sense to sense the surroundings, and discovered that there was someone inside.
Was it the Blue Star Princess?
With a sweep of his divine sense, all the details were practically revealed to Ling Han, as if he could see them with the naked eye.
This was a mermaid. The upper half of her body was human, while the lower half was a fish tail. Her hair was crimson red, and she was astonishingly beautiful.
Spirit Transformation Tier.
When Ling Han sensed the other's cultivation level, he strode in.
Pu!
This mermaid was eating, and when she saw Ling Han walk in, she instantly spluttered out all the food in her mouth. Then, she looked dumbly at Ling Han, her face filled with shock.
Was this how a captive should look like?
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Your Highness, it's time to go home."
The mermaid looked at him dumbly, "Why is it you? Where's Uncle?"
F***, this seemed to be a huge trap!

chapters.title: Chapter 4448 A Trap
paragraphs: Shouldn't the Blue Star Princess be wild with joy upon seeing someone come to her rescue?
But what kind of expression did she have?
Her face was filled with shock!
Moreover, as a hostage, why was she still in such a good mood to eat? Moreover, she had even addressed Sha Yuanxing as Uncle.
There was something fishy, there was a trap!
Of course, this trap was not meant for him, but rather targeted the Underworld Nation.
Ling Han felt that everything was too coincidental.

You see, in a situation when they were completely clueless, the specific information about the princess being kidnapped was suddenly revealed. Through the mouth of a snakeman, they were lured to the Green Source Trench, which then led to Sha Yuanxing.

Because it involved the issue of annexing the Blue Star Nation, the Underworld Nation could no longer sit still, and sent out Jiao Yuan to assist, fearing that Sha Tongyu would not be able to hold up and surrender his throne.

It was too coincidental. Sha Yuanxing's subordinate just happened to bump into someone from the Underworld Nation, and he had even let the cat out of the bag, revealing the location of Sha Yuanxing's lair.
If everything was too coincidental, then it was completely deliberately planned.
Ling Han mocked internally, yet a smile appeared on his face, and he said, "My name is Ling Han, and I have deliberately come to save Your Highness."
"I don't need you to save me. You can leave." The Blue Star Princess waved her hand, looking like she was in a hurry to chase him away.
Er, compared with the cunning and wily Sha brothers, this princess really did not have much subtlety. However, it was precisely because of this that she appeared adorable.
"Your Highness, there is no need to be afraid. Your uncle is being held back by Jiao Yuan, and now is the best time to flee," Ling Han said, deliberately teasing this princess.
The Blue Star Princess hurriedly shook her head, "You don't understand!"
"What do I not understand?" Ling Han asked.
"Because—" The Blue Star Princess was only innocent, but she was not stupid. Realizing that she was about to spill the beans, she hurriedly covered her mouth with her hand.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, "Then let me guess. Could it be... that the real purpose of this so-called disappearance of the princess is to kill Jiao Yuan?"
"How did you know?" the Blue Star Princess blurted out. Then, she immediately realized that something was off, and instantly, her expression was filled with regret.
Ling Han smiled and said, "It's all right. I guessed this myself, so it has nothing to do with you."
"That's right. You guessed it, but I didn't say it," the Blue Star Princess murmured. Comforting herself, she immediately smiled again, appearing a little endearingly silly.
Ling Han echoed her words, and said, "So because you're suppressing such a secret in your heart, you can't tell anyone, so you must be feeling very depressed, right?"
"I'm about to die from suffocation!" The Blue Star Princess nodded repeatedly. This was a friend that knew her well.
"In any case, I've already guessed it now, so why don't you tell me?" Ling Han said with a smile.

The Blue Star Princess hesitated for a moment, appearing slightly hesitant. However, upon further thought, Ling Han had indeed guessed their ultimate motive, so the details naturally weren't important anymore.
Most importantly, she really felt uncomfortable from holding it in, and wanted to share it with someone!
The matter had to start from a long time ago.

Long ago, when the current King of the Underworld Nation had just ascended the throne, Sha Tongyu and Sha Yuanxing had already felt that this person was filled with ambition. One day, he would make a move on the Blue Star Nation.
As expected, the Underworld Nation continued to make small moves after this, waging war repeatedly, wanting to use force to force the Blue Star Nation to submit.

However, the Blue Star Nation was protected by an ancient formation, so even if the overall power of the nation was inferior to the Underworld Nation, it would only be empty words to say that the Underworld Nation would destroy the Blue Star Nation.
However, this wasn't a good idea. After all, who would want to be pummeled all the time?
Thus, Sha Tongyu and his brother began to lay out their plans.
Firstly, they had created signs of discord between brothers fighting over the throne. Sha Yuanxing had left angrily, causing the Blue Star Nation to feel as if they been crippled.

Then, under the continuously strengthening oppression of the Underworld Nation, the Blue Star Nation put on a posture of seeking peace, intending to have the crown prince and crown princess of the two nations get married.
For the Underworld Nation, this was naturally what they wanted.

As long as they gave birth to a descendant that possessed the bloodline of the royal family of the Blue Star Nation, they would be able to control the ancient formation of the Blue Star Nation, and complete their dream of annexing the Blue Star Nation.
However, this was a huge trap.

The Blue Star Nation had created a false image of the princess's disappearance. Of course, for the sake of authenticity, the Blue Star Princess had indeed been brought out of the palace, and she had been kidnapped by the "infamous" Sha Yuanxing.

Because the plan had been laid out for many years, when they found out, the Underworld Nation did not suspect anything. Instead, they mobilized Jiao Yuan, bringing with them almost half the Sect Master elites of the nation, to guarantee that they would definitely rescue the Blue Star Princess, and complete the mission of the two royal families uniting through marriage.
However, what awaited Jiao Yuan was the combined forces of Sha Yuanxing and Sha Yuanxing.

Once Jiao Yuan died, and added with that half of the Sect Master elites of the nation, the Underground Nation's vitality would naturally be greatly damaged. To say nothing of invading the Blue Star Nation, they could only depend on the ancient formation to struggle at death's door.
In this way, not only could the Blue Star Nation be safe and sound, it could even ensure that it would flourish for tens of thousands of years, or even longer.

As for Sea Alligator Zhang, he belonged to the category of powerful people that the Blue Star Nation had removed, putting on a display of weakness for the Underworld Nation. Additionally, it was also because the Blue Star Nation wanted to clean up the slums. Since it was impossible to get rid of all these local ruffians, it would be better to keep them under the control of their own people.
Why couldn't the Blue Star Princess leave even though Jiao Yuan had already fallen into the trap?

That was because Jiao Yuan was a Three Star Venerate Tier elite, after all. Even if Sha Tongyu and his brother teamed up, it would not be an easy feat to kill him. If he was determined to flee, and if worse came to worst, he would have to pay some price, but he would definitely be able to escape.
Thus, in order to ensure that Jiao Yuan was killed, they had to set up a formation so that he would not be able to easily escape.

Moreover, Venerate Tier elites were too powerful, so this formation definitely couldn't be set up in advance. If there was the slightest bit of aura leaking out, Jiao Yuan would definitely be able to see through it.
Thus, the Blue Star Princess couldn't appear now. Once she escaped, there would be no point for Jiao Yuan to continue battling. Whether he realized something was off or not, he would definitely flee.
Ling Han nodded. Looks like Jiao Yuan wouldn't be able to escape death this time.
However, this had nothing to do with him.
"Er, if I bring you back to the palace, will the bounty still be valid?" Ling Han asked.

"It should be." The Blue Star Princess nodded. After all, this was the words of the Royal Family. Even if it was for the sake of screwing over the Underworld Nation, it could not be so easily annulled, and break their word so easily.
"That's good." Ling Han nodded.
Boom!
The ground suddenly started to tremor violently, and it was as if it were about to collapse.
"The great formation is activated!" Blue Star Princess looked into the distance. From this position, she could easily see a massive blue screen of light in the distance.
That direction was where Sha Yuanxing and Jiao Yuan had been battling.
"Let's go, let's go!" The Blue Star Princess appeared slightly excited. She could only stay in the coral forest these few days, which made her feel extremely uncomfortable.
Ling Han smiled, and left with Blue Star Princess.
After swimming for a while, and just when they were about to come out of the coral forest, they suddenly bumped into a group of people.
Jiao Delei.
'What a pitiful child,' Ling Han thought.
"It's you!" Jiao Delei's eyes suddenly widened, revealing an angry and embarrassed expression.
Ling Han actually managed to save the Blue Star Princess before he did.
This was too despicable!

But what kind of expression did she have?
Her face was filled with shock!
Moreover, as a hostage, why was she still in such a good mood to eat?
Moreover, she had even addressed Sha Yuanxing as Uncle.
There was something fishy, there was a trap!
Of course, this trap was not meant for him, but rather targeted the Underworld Nation.
Ling Han felt that everything was too coincidental.
You see, in a situation when they were completely clueless, the specific information about the princess being kidnapped was suddenly revealed.
Through the mouth of a snakeman, they were lured to the Green Source Trench, which then led to Sha Yuanxing.

Because it involved the issue of annexing the Blue Star Nation, the Underworld Nation could no longer sit still, and sent out Jiao Yuan to assist, fearing that Sha Tongyu would not be able to hold up and surrender his throne.
It was too coincidental.
Sha Yuanxing's subordinate just happened to bump into someone from the Underworld Nation, and he had even let the cat out of the bag, revealing the location of Sha Yuanxing's lair.
If everything was too coincidental, then it was completely deliberately planned.
Ling Han mocked internally, yet a smile appeared on his face, and he said, "My name is Ling Han, and I have deliberately come to save Your Highness."

You can leave." The Blue Star Princess waved her hand, looking like she was in a hurry to chase him away.
Er, compared with the cunning and wily Sha brothers, this princess really did not have much subtlety.

"How did you know?" the Blue Star Princess blurted out.

Ling Han smiled and said, "It's all right.
I guessed this myself, so it has nothing to do with you."
"That's right.
You guessed it, but I didn't say it," the Blue Star Princess murmured.
Comforting herself, she immediately smiled again, appearing a little endearingly silly.
Ling Han echoed her words, and said, "So because you're suppressing such a secret in your heart, you can't tell anyone, so you must be feeling very depressed, right?"
"I'm about to die from suffocation!" The Blue Star Princess nodded repeatedly.
This was a friend that knew her well.
"In any case, I've already guessed it now, so why don't you tell me?" Ling Han said with a smile.

However, this wasn't a good idea.
After all, who would want to be pummeled all the time?
Thus, Sha Tongyu and his brother began to lay out their plans.
Firstly, they had created signs of discord between brothers fighting over the throne.
Sha Yuanxing had left angrily, causing the Blue Star Nation to feel as if they been crippled.

For the Underworld Nation, this was naturally what they wanted.

However, this was a huge trap.

Of course, for the sake of authenticity, the Blue Star Princess had indeed been brought out of the palace, and she had been kidnapped by the "infamous" Sha Yuanxing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4449 Caught in the Act?
paragraphs: The Blue Star Princess also widened her small mouth, and her pretty face flushed, as she buried her head in her hands.

After all, this was a trap laid against the Underworld Nation, and she was the most important part of it. With how easily embarrassed she was, now that she had seen the victim of their plans, she would naturally feel guilty.
However, when Jiao Delei saw this, suspicion instantly rose up in his heart.
Why did she look like she had done something wrong the moment she saw him?
She was clearly the one who had been kidnapped, yet it was as if she had betrayed him?
How could it be!
He looked towards Ling Han, his eyes practically popping out.
Had he been cuckolded?
"Detestable human!" he cursed in a low voice. This was the only possibility. Otherwise, why would the Blue Star Princess look guilty the moment she saw him?
Seeing the fury on his face, Ling Han couldn't help but feel awkward.
You have misunderstood.
Furthermore, you have to think about it. The Blue Star Princess was a fish in the first place, so how was he supposed to... make a move?
"Kill him!" Jiao Delei pointed at Ling Han.
Instantly, the nine Sect Masters behind him all turned to look at Ling Han, revealing baleful expressions.

"Merely a Spirit Transformation Tier, let me deal with him!" a crabman said, moving his eight legs at a surprisingly fast speed. Then, with a wave of his two large pincers, he scissored towards Ling Han.
Three Star Sect Master?
Ling Han shook his head. This was delivering himself to death.

If the Blue Star Nation hadn't set a trap for the Underworld Nation, Ling Han would have to think about it. If he killed this person, he definitely wouldn't be able to go to the Blue Star Nation to collect the bounty. Whether increasing his cultivation level was more important or venting his anger was more important would be worth considering.
But now, hehe, he did not have the slightest bit of reservations.
He greeted the incoming attack, brandishing his fists in a rapid barrage.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and the crabman was sent flying. Cracks appeared on his pincers.
'What?'
Seeing this scene, those elites of the Underworld Nation were all dumbfounded, completely unable to believe their eyes.
What kind of f****** Spirit Transformation Tier are you!
Even the Blue Star Princess was gaping, looking at Ling Han in shock.
Impressive!

Only Jiao Delei's reaction was slightly better, but he still felt a sliver of shock. That was because he knew just how sturdy the pincers of the crabman were. They were comparable to Six Star Divine Metal, and a crack had actually appeared on them from a single punch. Just how terrifying was the destructive power of this punch?
"Attack! Attack together!" However, he immediately roared, "This freakish human can't be judged with common sense."
En.

The remaining eight elites all walked out. There were seahorsemen, murlocs, and sea turtlemen, and they all drew their Spirit Tools. Some had a cultivation level as high as seven stars. Though their Spirit Tools were not as strong as Jiao Delei's, when the nine of them attacked together, their might was still terrifying.

A worried expression immediately appeared on the Blue Star Princess's face. These nine great generals were also the people that they planned to kill together this time, but this coral forest was too big. The elites that the Blue Star Nation had laid in ambush could not find them easily just like that.
Now that Ling Han was facing it alone, the situation was very dire.
Jiao Delei saw this, and couldn't help but feel even more certain.
This was an adulterous couple!
You see, he had not even made a move from his side, and the Blue Star Princess was already so worried.
No man could tolerate this!
Yet Ling Han was eager to give it a try. With a battle cry, he took the initiative to attack.
"You're seeking death!"
"What an ignorant human!"

The nine great generals all smirked coldly. Though Ling Han had previously displayed strength that surpassed the crabman, it was only comparable to a Five Star Sect Master, at most. However, among the nine of them, there were three that had attained Five Stars, or even actually surpassed that level.
They all moved to counterattack. Various Regulations manifested, their brilliance shaking the skies.
Ling Han smiled and unleashed his murderous aura.

All of a sudden, the nine great generals all showed expressions of pain. Those above five stars were still fine, and recovered after a little pain, but the six below five stars were miserable. All of them were bleeding from their seven apertures. One of them had even directly lost his battle prowess, and his whole person was floating, stomach facing upwards.
'Holy f*ck!'

You are only in the Spirit Transformation Tier, and faced nine great Sect Masters alone, you actually did not even raise your hand, and caused the nine great elites to suffer a loss. In fact, one of them had directly passed out?
Monster!
Since Ling Han had made his move, how could he be merciful? He waved his hands, and reaped the harvest without any mercy.
Peng! Destructive Energy was wrapped around his fist, and with a single punch, he had directly pierced through the chest of a swordfishman.

Boom, the murderous aura surged again, and instantly, terrible screams rang out again. Aside from three Sect Masters that had reached Five Stars and more that continued to push their attacks over, four of the remaining five people were grabbing their heads and screaming. The last one was the one who had been knocked unconscious previously. This time, his mind had directly exploded, and he had died.

He had only made two moves, and two Sect Masters had already died by Ling Han's hand. It was as if they were not people that could be considered great elites at all, but mere commoners that could be killed easily.
Xiu, Ling Han used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and quickly left the battle area, dodging the three attacks that were aimed at him.
Under the barrage of the murderous aura, Ling Han wasn't afraid of being ganged up on at all—unless all of them were far more powerful than him.
Right now, his soul was already perfect. In fact, it was even being purified further on the foundations of perfection. Just how terrifying was this?
The Blue Star Princess's small mouth was gaping, while her hands were pressing down on her chest, as if she feared that her heart would jump out of her chest if she was too shocked.
Meanwhile, Jiao Delei's hair was dancing wildly in his fury. His hands were tightly clenched into fists, and he had used so much force that the veins on his forehead were popping.
"I'm going to kill you!" He brandished his three-pronged halberd and joined the battle.
"Humph!" Ling Han was completely unafraid, and charged out again.

The murderous aura continued to blast out, greatly disintegrating his opponent's battle prowess and coordination. Then, he could do as he liked. Waving his fists, he was agile, imposing, and majestic.
This was the path of cultivation that he had walked, and now, he was playing it out to his heart's content.
A maniac of martial arts like him would definitely use every opportunity to increase his strength.
"I should give this fist technique a name."
A thought suddenly occurred to Ling Han. This actually couldn't be called a fist technique, because there was no fixed technique. It was just a way of using energy and Regulations.
"It can't be called the Fists of Fury anymore. I have neither joy nor sorrow now, and let nature take its course."
"En, since my name is Ling Han, I'll call it Han Fists."

He had always been an idiot when it came to naming. Just look at the pet beasts by his side. They were all like Little Red and Little White, and now, this had finally brought disaster to his path fo cultivation as well.

—If the future generations were to study the fist technique that Ling Han had created, they would definitely praise it greatly and complain endlessly at the same time. How could Ling Han come up with such a name that was not impressive or domineering at all?

Ling Han was immersed in his own world. He used the Han Fists, and various high-level energies were continuously combined, attempting to unleash the strongest destructive power. Meanwhile, Regulations was freely used, turning into saber flashes, sword flashes, and projections, all of them overbearing in their might.

Jiao Delei and the others all roared in fury. They clearly had the upper hand in terms of battle prowess, yet were completely unable to do anything against Ling Han. Instead, they were being punched left and right, continuously losing members.
Crazy, they were really going crazy. What kind of Spirit Transformation Tier was this!
