chapters.title: Chapter 4450 Fighting Against Many Alone
paragraphs: A great battle ensued.

On Jiao Delei's side, the number of people was continuously decreasing. At the beginning, there were ten of them, but two of them had died right from the start. The remaining people were quite hardworking, and only after fighting for half an hour did another two die.
These were all below five stars in battle prowess, and above five stars, even if they were affected by the barrage of murderous aura, it was still difficult to deal with them.

This was especially the case for that Seven Star Sect Master. The might of his counterattack could not be underestimated. With a single strike, the Regulations directly slashed into Ling Han's mind, preventing him from expelling it for at least a minute. He had to focus his divine sense before blasting the murderous aura again.

Moreover, he had only been caught off guard by Ling Han at the beginning. Now that he had regained his footing, and with Jiao Delei's participation, he possessed a Spirit Tool that could unleash a battle prowess of nine stars. It was extremely powerful.

If it was not for the fact that Jiao Delei was selfish, and insisted on stimulating this Tool by himself, then having the Seven Star Sect Master stimulate the Spirit Tool, the pressure on Ling Han would undoubtedly be even greater.

Right now, Ling Han was using the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. The seawater evaporated continuously, and a vacuum was actually created from the heat. He moved unhindered here and there, and Jiao Delei and the others couldn't even touch a corner of his clothes.
Their expressions changed drastically. If this continued, they would lose more members.
Who would have thought that this Spirit Transformation Tier would be so freakish?
Jiao Delei was already filled with regret.
After impulsively attacking, he realized that he may have misunderstood.
In such a short amount of time, how could the Blue Star Princess possibly fall in love with Ling Han at first sight? Furthermore, an adulterous relationship had happened in such a dangerous place?
But now that things had come to this, even if he was willing to give up, what about the deaths of the four great generals?
Only killing Ling Han would appease the fury of the Underworld Nation.
However, how was he supposed to kill Ling Han?
Before this, who would have thought that a Spirit Transformation Tier would be so hard to kill?

He gritted his teeth, and said, "General Tie, you control this Spirit Tool. I'll go and inform Uncle that the princess has been rescued, and there's no need to continue fighting. He'll move to kill this human."
One of the sharkmen took the Spirit Tool and nodded. "Alright."
He was the Seven Star Sect Master, and added with this Spirit Tool, he alone was enough to suppress Ling Han.
He should have done so long ago.
"There is no need for you all to be here. All of you, go and protect the prince!" With the halberd in hand, the sharkman appeared mighty and powerful.
"Yes." The other Sect Masters all nodded.
Jiao Delei glanced at Ling Han again, then suddenly turned around and left.
Ling Han didn't give chase. The sharkman could be considered a powerful opponent, and he couldn't be careless.

Jiao Delei and the others left, yet the sharkman was in no rush to make a move. Ling Han's movement technique was too agile, and he had no confidence that he could capture him. Thus, he only had to detain Ling Han here as much as possible, and when Jiao Yuan arrived, killing Ling Han would be a piece of cake.

Since the other party didn't make a move, Ling Han had no interest in making a move either. He merely said calmly, "I'm afraid I have to tell you some unfortunate news. That General Jiao of yours is really going to be burnt this time.."
'Hmm?'
The sharkman smirked coldly, "Exaggerating!"
Ling Han shrugged and said, "Believe it or not, it's up to you. You can wait, and see if it's Jiao Yuan who comes or the person who's going to kill you!"

The sharkman's expression involuntarily changed drastically. He carefully recalled the entire process, and then, his expression became uglier and uglier. In fact, even his body was trembling slightly.
"Ling Han, how could you tell him?" the Blue Star Princess asked in slight displeasure.

Ling Han smiled, "It's all right. In any case, Jiao Yuan has already fallen into the great formation, and there are two great elites besieging him. He is like a fish in a pond, and would not be able to do much."
"That's true." The Blue Star Princess was indeed easily deceived, and nodded.
Hearing these words, the sharkman's heart became even more fervent.
Was this really a trap?

He hurriedly turned around and chased after Jiao Delei and the others. He was going to stop these five people. Even if Jiao Yuan could no longer be saved, he had to at least preserve some hope for the Underworld Nation. Otherwise, they would be suppressed by the Blue Star Nation for tens of thousands of years.
"Let's go," Ling Han said to the Blue Star Princess.
"Yi, are you going to waste these corpses?" The Blue Star Princess pointed at the four Sect Masters that Ling Han had killed.
Ling Han was stunned for a moment, "I didn't expect you to have such extreme tastes. They are humanoid monsters, and I can't bring myself to eat them!"
Although these giant crabs and sea cucumbers looked very tempting, cooking a seafood soup should be very delicious, right?
The Blue Star Princess rolled her eyes at him, "No, no. The Sect Master has a fruit of cultivation in his body, and the fruit of cultivation contains Celestial Qi, don't you know?"
That's right!
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. Celestial Qi wasn't something that only existed in natural treasures. Sect Masters also had Celestial Qi.
He could not waste it.

If these four members of the Sea Race were human, then even if he knew that there was Celestial Qi in their bodies that could be extracted, Ling Han probably wouldn't be able to do it. However, it didn't matter if they were from another race. He would just treat it as killing fish and crabs. In any case, he wouldn't eat them.
"Hurry up. If we don't take away the fruits of cultivation as soon as possible, they will be assimilated by the heaven and earth," the Blue Star Princess warned.
Ling Han first sliced open the crabman, and obtained a bright object in his head. It was only the size of his pinky, but contained astonishing power.
The fruit of cultivation.
As the light surged, the energy was also rapidly dissipating, returning to the heaven and earth.

Ling Han hurriedly channelled the Imperial Scroll and absorbed all the energy in the fruit of cultivation. However, he couldn't absorb most of it, and in the case of the Celestial Qi, he could only extract a sliver.
He did the same with the remaining three generals of the Sea Race. He obtained four wisps of Celestial Qi, which was pitifully little.

"It's too impure. It can't compare to the Black Heavenly Dao Lotus at all. I would have to refine about a hundred fruits of cultivation of Sect Masters to match the quantity approximately, and in terms of quality, the gap is even greater."
"Fortunately, I'm only upgrading my dimensions now, so I don't need any high-quality Celestial Qi."
"In the future, when I advance into the Minor Advanced Tier, this method is not advisable."
Ling Han pondered for a moment before nodding at the Blue Star Princess and saying, "Let's go back to the palace."
They continued onwards, but they had not walked too far, when they encountered another person.
—The outsiders that had entered this place also wanted to find the princess and collect the bounty.
"The Blue Star Princess!" This was a small team of seven. When they saw the Blue Star Princess, they all looked pleasantly surprised.
Although they had never seen the Blue Star Princess before, one of them was a human outsider, while the other was a mermaid. Even an idiot would be able to guess, right?

At this moment, Ling Han couldn't help but complain again. No wonder the royal family didn't even attach a portrait of the princess even though they were clearly offering a bounty to find her. As it turned out, they weren't sincerely searching for her at all.
Now that he thought about it, it was an obvious loophole.
The seven of them looked at Ling Han again, and couldn't help but grit their teeth.
At present, Ling Han's might was already deeply ingrained in the hearts of the people, so who did not know?
After the seven of them weighed the pros and cons, they all shook their heads, and took the initiative to retreat.
They were no match for Ling Han. If they tried to be brave and make a move, they would only be asking for trouble.
Ling Han didn't make a move either. He was in a rush to send the Blue Star Princess back to collect the bounty.
The two of them continued onwards, but enemies were bound to meet on a narrow road. Not long after, they encountered Guan Xinghan.
"Run!" Ling Han grabbed the Blue Star Princess, and suddenly sped up with Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
Everything could be discussed after he advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier.
